data/adventures/book-of-faces/city.kyr:
Module ombra "The Book of Faces" {
  Description "Ombra, a delta city of forty thousand where it rains nine days in ten and every person goes masked by day: seven Sleeves of islands, a reed-garden, the cisterns under the poor ones, and nine days to the Drawing.".

  // ── The map ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // Ombra is a coat laid out on the water: its islands are the Sleeves and the water between them the Cuff. The delta
  // road comes in from the landward side to the Gate of Strangers; Counting Row and the Wet Post lie behind it,
  // Chapel Island at the middle of the coat, Maskers' Lane and Quiet Hill to the west of it, the Drip beyond, and the
  // Heronry at the lagoon's edge. Positions on the region map (x to the east, y to the south):
  //      0,0 Heronry     1,0 Quiet Hill   2,0 Chapel Island   3,0 the Wet Post
  //      0,1 the Drip    1,1 Maskers' Lane 2,1 Counting Row    3,1 the Gate of Strangers
  //                                                            3,2 the delta road
  // Every room here is owned by the file named in its comment; the owner writes its scene (Observe) and its people.
  Place ombra_delta "the Delta of Ombra" is region.
  Initially Assert terrain(ombra_delta, marsh).
  Place delta_road "the delta road" is wilderness within ombra_delta at 3, 2.
  Place gate_sleeve "the Gate of Strangers" is settlement within ombra_delta at 3, 1.
  Place post_sleeve "the Wet Post" is settlement within ombra_delta at 3, 0.
  Place chapel_sleeve "Chapel Island" is settlement within ombra_delta at 2, 0.
  Place row_sleeve "Counting Row" is settlement within ombra_delta at 2, 1.
  Place maskers_sleeve "Maskers' Lane" is settlement within ombra_delta at 1, 1.
  Place hill_sleeve "Quiet Hill" is settlement within ombra_delta at 1, 0.
  Place drip_sleeve "the Drip" is settlement within ombra_delta at 0, 1.
  Place heronry "the Heronry" is wilderness within ombra_delta at 0, 0.
  Place cisterns "the cisterns under the Drip" is site within drip_sleeve.
  Place duelling_stair "the Duelling Stair" is site within hill_sleeve.

  // ── Buildings ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // gate.kyr
  Place gatehouse "the Gatehouse" is building within gate_sleeve.
  Place hospice "the Hospice of the Bare" is building within gate_sleeve.
  Place annex "the Wardrobe Annex" is building within gate_sleeve.
  // maskers.kyr
  Place pavane_house "Madame Pavane's house" is building within maskers_sleeve.
  Place mask_shop "the Cockle and Heron mask-shop" is building within maskers_sleeve.
  Place wet_stage "the Wet Stage" is building within maskers_sleeve.
  // counting.kyr
  Place exchange "the Exchange" is building within row_sleeve.
  Place weights_hall "the Hall of Weights" is building within row_sleeve.
  Place locks_house "the Warden of Locks' house" is building within row_sleeve.
  Place collegium "the Collegium of Measures" is building within row_sleeve.
  Place coffee_house "the Tally Coffee-house" is building within row_sleeve.
  // vane.kyr
  Place candid_house "the Candid Reading-room" is building within row_sleeve.
  // post.kyr
  Place post_office "the Dead Letter Office" is building within post_sleeve.
  Place loft "the pigeon loft" is building within post_sleeve.
  // drip.kyr
  Place rain_hall "the Rain-Wives' hall" is building within drip_sleeve.
  Place soup_kitchen "the Anonymous Saint's kitchen" is building within drip_sleeve.
  Place ostler_house "Ostler's umbrella-shop" is building within drip_sleeve.
  Place penhallow_house "Penhallow's umbrella-shop" is building within drip_sleeve.
  Place lisbet_house "the sempstresses' loft" is building within drip_sleeve.
  // serene.kyr
  Place cooperage "Hobb's cooperage" is building within drip_sleeve.
  // hill.kyr
  Place palazzo_tarn "the Palazzo Tarn" is building within hill_sleeve.
  Place palazzo_venn "the Palazzo Venn" is building within hill_sleeve.
  Place seconds_hall "the Seconds' Guild hall" is building within hill_sleeve.
  // chapel.kyr
  Place chapel "the Chapel of the Bare Face" is building within chapel_sleeve.
  Place cloister "the cloister of the Bare Brothers" is building within chapel_sleeve.

  // Levels: below ground and on the roofs. A level of a settlement is a terrace.
  Place pavane_cellars "Pavane's cellars" is level within pavane_house.
  Place flies_level "the flies" is level within wet_stage.
  Place roofs_level "the Maskers' roofs" is level within maskers_sleeve.
  Place post_roofs "the Post's roofs" is level within post_sleeve.
  Place chapel_depths "the Chapel's depths" is level within chapel.
  Place pump_level "the pump level" is level within cisterns.
  Place cellar_level "the cellar level" is level within cisterns.

  // ── Rooms ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // The delta road and the Gate of Strangers (gate.kyr)
  Place offstage "elsewhere in Ombra" is room within delta_road at 5, 5.
  Place road_end "the end of the delta road" is room within delta_road at 0, 0 outdoors.
  Place customs_steps "the Customs Steps" is room within gate_sleeve at 0, 1 outdoors.
  Place gate_square "Strangers' Square" is room within gate_sleeve at 1, 1 outdoors.
  Place gate_hall "the Gatehouse hall" is room within gatehouse at 1, 0 indoors.
  Place hospice_hall "the Hospice hall" is room within hospice at 2, 1 indoors.
  Place hospice_dorm "the Hospice dormitory" is room within hospice at 2, 2 indoors.
  Place annex_counter "the Wardrobe Annex" is room within annex at 0, 0 indoors.
  // Maskers' Lane (maskers.kyr)
  Place maskers_lane "Maskers' Lane" is room within maskers_sleeve at 1, 1 outdoors.
  Place maskers_roof "the Maskers' roofs" is room within roofs_level at 1, 0 outdoors.
  Place fitting_room "Madame Pavane's fitting-room" is room within pavane_house at 0, 1 indoors.
  Place pavane_parlour "Madame Pavane's parlour" is room within pavane_house at 0, 2 indoors.
  Place cast_cellar "the Wall of Faces" is room within pavane_cellars at 0, 3 underground.
  Place mask_shop_floor "the mask-shop" is room within mask_shop at 2, 1 indoors.
  Place stage_pit "the pit of the Wet Stage" is room within wet_stage at 3, 1 indoors.
  Place stage_green_room "the green room of the Wet Stage" is room within wet_stage at 3, 2 indoors.
  Place stage_flies "the flies of the Wet Stage" is room within flies_level at 3, 0 indoors.
  // Counting Row (counting.kyr)
  Place row_street "Counting Row" is room within row_sleeve at 1, 1 outdoors.
  Place row_quay "the Row quay" is room within row_sleeve at 0, 1 outdoors.
  Place exchange_floor "the floor of the Exchange" is room within exchange at 2, 1 indoors.
  Place weights_floor "the Hall of Weights" is room within weights_hall at 1, 0 indoors.
  Place standard_room "the Standard Room" is room within weights_hall at 1, 2 indoors.
  Place locks_office "the Warden of Locks' office" is room within locks_house at 3, 1 indoors.
  Place locks_strongroom "the Lock-tax strongroom" is room within locks_house at 3, 2 indoors.
  Place collegium_hall "the hall of the Collegium of Measures" is room within collegium at 4, 1 indoors.
  Place collegium_study "the Collegium's workroom" is room within collegium at 4, 2 indoors.
  Place coffee_room "the Tally Coffee-house" is room within coffee_house at 2, 0 indoors.
  Place candid_room "the Candid Reading-room" is room within candid_house at 0, 2 indoors.
  // The Wet Post (post.kyr)
  Place post_street "the Wet Post" is room within post_sleeve at 1, 1 outdoors.
  Place arcade "the letter-writers' arcade" is room within post_sleeve at 0, 1 outdoors.
  Place dlo_counter "the Dead Letter Office" is room within post_office at 2, 1 indoors.
  Place dlo_sorting "the sorting-hall" is room within post_office at 2, 2 indoors.
  Place dlo_furnace "the burning-room" is room within post_office at 2, 3 indoors.
  Place loft_floor "the pigeon loft" is room within loft at 3, 1 indoors.
  Place loft_roof "the loft roof" is room within post_roofs at 3, 0 outdoors.
  // The Drip (drip.kyr)
  Place drip_landing "the Drip landing" is room within drip_sleeve at 1, 1 outdoors.
  Place bread_market "the Drip bread-market" is room within drip_sleeve at 2, 1 outdoors.
  Place umbrella_row "Umbrella Row" is room within drip_sleeve at 2, 0 outdoors.
  Place ostler_shop "Ostler's umbrella-shop" is room within ostler_house at 3, 0 indoors.
  Place penhallow_shop "Penhallow's umbrella-shop" is room within penhallow_house at 1, 0 indoors.
  Place lamp_yard "the Lamp-Trimmers' yard" is room within drip_sleeve at 0, 1 outdoors.
  Place eel_pond "the eel-pond" is room within drip_sleeve at 0, 2 outdoors.
  Place rain_hall_floor "the Rain-Wives' hall" is room within rain_hall at 3, 1 indoors.
  Place soup_room "the Anonymous Saint's kitchen" is room within soup_kitchen at 2, 2 indoors.
  Place lisbet_room "the sempstresses' loft" is room within lisbet_house at 1, 2 indoors.
  Place cistern_steps "the cistern steps" is room within drip_sleeve at 1, 3 outdoors.
  Place cooperage_floor "Hobb's cooperage" is room within cooperage at 3, 2 indoors.
  // The cisterns (cisterns.kyr)
  Place cistern_head "the foot of the cistern steps" is room within cisterns at 0, 0 underground.
  Place cistern_hall "the lamp-oil cistern" is room within cisterns at 1, 0 underground.
  Place lamp_boys_den "the lamp-boys' den" is room within cisterns at 2, 0 underground.
  Place drain_mouth "the mouth of the Ninefold Drain" is room within cisterns at 1, 1 underground.
  Place pump_chamber "the Aenean pump-chamber" is room within pump_level at 1, 2 underground.
  Place urn_cellar "the cellar under the Urn Hall" is room within cellar_level at 1, 3 underground.
  // The Heronry (heronry.kyr)
  Place heronry_edge "the Heronry's edge" is room within heronry at 0, 0 outdoors.
  Place reed_path "the reed path" is room within heronry at 1, 0 outdoors.
  Place heron_pool "the heron pool" is room within heronry at 2, 0 outdoors.
  // Quiet Hill (hill.kyr; the Stair's landings are the Gauntlet's, warrior.kyr)
  Place hill_foot "the foot of the Duelling Stair" is room within hill_sleeve at 0, 3 outdoors.
  Place stair_top "the head of the Duelling Stair" is room within duelling_stair at 0, 0 outdoors.
  Place hill_quay "the Hill's water-gate" is room within hill_sleeve at 1, 3 outdoors.
  Place hill_terrace "the Terrace of the Fourteen" is room within hill_sleeve at 1, 1 outdoors.
  Place tarn_hall "the hall of the Palazzo Tarn" is room within palazzo_tarn at 2, 1 indoors.
  Place tarn_dining "the great dining-room of the Palazzo Tarn" is room within palazzo_tarn at 2, 2 indoors.
  Place tarn_study "the Contessa's study" is room within palazzo_tarn at 2, 0 indoors.
  Place venn_hall "the hall of the Palazzo Venn" is room within palazzo_venn at 0, 1 indoors.
  Place venn_gallery "the Venn gallery of portraits" is room within palazzo_venn at 0, 2 indoors.
  Place seconds_yard "the yard of the Seconds' Guild" is room within seconds_hall at 3, 1 indoors.
  // Chapel Island (chapel.kyr)
  Place chapel_steps "the Chapel steps" is room within chapel_sleeve at 1, 1 outdoors.
  Place nave "the nave of the Chapel of the Bare Face" is room within chapel at 1, 0 indoors.
  Place lamp_room "the lamp-room" is room within chapel at 2, 0 indoors.
  Place bier_room "the bier-room" is room within chapel at 2, 1 indoors.
  Place registry "the Registry of the Concord" is room within chapel at 1, 2 indoors.
  Place urn_hall "the Urn Hall" is room within chapel_depths at 1, 3 underground.
  Place vestry "the vestry" is room within chapel at 0, 0 indoors.
  Place confessionals "the confessionals" is room within chapel at 0, 1 indoors.
  Place cloister_garth "the cloister garth" is room within cloister at 3, 1 outdoors.
  Place brothers_cells "the Brothers' cells" is room within cloister at 3, 2 indoors.
  Place refectory "the Brothers' refectory" is room within cloister at 4, 1 indoors.

  // ── Ways ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // The road in and the Gate of Strangers.
  Passage road_in "the delta road" is road between road_end and customs_steps taking 20 minutes.
  Passage customs_in "the Customs Steps" is steps between customs_steps and gate_square.
  Passage gate_door "the Gatehouse door" is door between gate_square and gate_hall.
  Passage hospice_door "the Hospice door" is door between gate_square and hospice_hall.
  Passage dorm_door "the dormitory door" is doorway between hospice_hall and hospice_dorm.
  Passage annex_door "the Annex door" is door between gate_square and annex_counter.
  // The bridges between the Sleeves.
  Passage bridge_row "the Gate bridge" is bridge between gate_square and row_street taking 5 minutes.
  Passage bridge_post "the Post bridge" is bridge between gate_square and post_street taking 5 minutes.
  Passage bridge_row_post "the Tally bridge" is bridge between row_street and post_street taking 5 minutes.
  Passage bridge_row_chapel "the Chapel bridge" is bridge between row_street and chapel_steps taking 5 minutes.
  Passage bridge_post_chapel "the Candle bridge" is bridge between post_street and chapel_steps taking 5 minutes.
  Passage bridge_row_maskers "the Mask bridge" is bridge between row_street and maskers_lane taking 5 minutes.
  Passage bridge_maskers_drip "the Rainwives' bridge" is bridge between maskers_lane and drip_landing taking 8 minutes.
  Passage steps_maskers_hill "the Terrace steps" is steps between maskers_lane and hill_terrace taking 10 minutes.
  // The ferries: Rill's boat, and the Cuff's other crossings.
  Passage ferry_row_drip "the Drip ferry" is ferry between row_quay and drip_landing taking 15 minutes.
  Passage path_row_quay "the Row quay path" is path between row_street and row_quay taking 3 minutes.
  Passage ferry_chapel_hill "the Hill ferry" is ferry between chapel_steps and hill_quay taking 15 minutes.
  Passage ferry_drip_hill "the water-gate ferry" is ferry between drip_landing and hill_quay taking 15 minutes.
  Passage path_drip_heronry "the Heronry path" is path between drip_landing and heronry_edge taking 20 minutes.
  Passage water_gate "the water-gate" is gate between hill_quay and hill_terrace.
  // Hill, Stair: the foot of the Stair to its head is the Gauntlet's (warrior.kyr); from the head to the Terrace:
  Passage stair_head_way "the Terrace gate" is gate between stair_top and hill_terrace.
  Passage terrace_foot_way "the foot of the Hill" is path between hill_terrace and hill_foot taking 5 minutes.
  // Maskers' Lane.
  Passage fitting_door "Madame Pavane's door" is door between maskers_lane and fitting_room.
  Passage parlour_door "the parlour door" is doorway between fitting_room and pavane_parlour.
  Passage cellar_stair "the cellar stair" is stair between pavane_parlour and cast_cellar.
  Passage mask_shop_door "the mask-shop door" is door between maskers_lane and mask_shop_floor.
  Passage pit_door "the Wet Stage's door" is door between maskers_lane and stage_pit.
  Passage green_room_door "the green-room door" is doorway between stage_pit and stage_green_room.
  Passage flies_ladder "the flies ladder" is ladder between stage_pit and stage_flies.
  Passage roof_ladder "the roof ladder" is ladder between maskers_lane and maskers_roof.
  Passage roof_flies "the skylight" is doorway between maskers_roof and stage_flies.
  Passage roof_parlour "the parlour skylight" is doorway between maskers_roof and pavane_parlour.
  // Counting Row.
  Passage exchange_door "the Exchange door" is door between row_street and exchange_floor.
  Passage weights_door "the Hall of Weights door" is door between row_street and weights_floor.
  Passage standard_door "the Standard Room door" is door between weights_floor and standard_room.
  Passage locks_door "the Warden's door" is door between row_street and locks_office.
  Passage strongroom_door "the strongroom door" is door between locks_office and locks_strongroom.
  Passage collegium_door "the Collegium door" is door between row_street and collegium_hall.
  Passage workroom_door "the workroom door" is doorway between collegium_hall and collegium_study.
  Passage coffee_door "the coffee-house door" is door between row_street and coffee_room.
  Passage candid_door "the Reading-room door" is door between row_street and candid_room.
  // The Wet Post.
  Passage dlo_door "the Dead Letter Office door" is door between post_street and dlo_counter.
  Passage sorting_door "the sorting-hall door" is doorway between dlo_counter and dlo_sorting.
  Passage furnace_door "the burning-room door" is door between dlo_sorting and dlo_furnace.
  Passage arcade_way "the arcade" is path between post_street and arcade taking 2 minutes.
  Passage loft_door "the loft door" is door between post_street and loft_floor.
  Passage loft_hatch "the loft hatch" is ladder between loft_floor and loft_roof.
  // The Drip.
  Passage market_way "the market lane" is path between drip_landing and bread_market taking 3 minutes.
  Passage umbrella_way "Umbrella Row lane" is path between bread_market and umbrella_row taking 3 minutes.
  Passage ostler_door "Ostler's door" is door between umbrella_row and ostler_shop.
  Passage penhallow_door "Penhallow's door" is door between umbrella_row and penhallow_shop.
  Passage rain_door "the Rain-Wives' door" is door between bread_market and rain_hall_floor.
  Passage soup_door "the kitchen door" is door between bread_market and soup_room.
  Passage cooperage_door "the cooperage door" is door between bread_market and cooperage_floor.
  Passage lamp_way "the lamp-yard lane" is path between drip_landing and lamp_yard taking 3 minutes.
  Passage eel_way "the eel-pond lane" is path between lamp_yard and eel_pond taking 3 minutes.
  Passage lisbet_door "the sempstresses' stair" is stair between umbrella_row and lisbet_room.
  Passage cistern_way "the cistern steps lane" is path between lamp_yard and cistern_steps taking 4 minutes.
  // The Heronry.
  Passage reed_way "the reed path" is path between heronry_edge and reed_path taking 10 minutes.
  Passage pool_way "the pool path" is path between reed_path and heron_pool taking 10 minutes.
  // Quiet Hill.
  Passage tarn_door "the Palazzo Tarn door" is door between hill_terrace and tarn_hall.
  Passage dining_door "the great doors" is doorway between tarn_hall and tarn_dining.
  Passage study_door "the study door" is doorway between tarn_hall and tarn_study.
  Passage venn_door "the Palazzo Venn door" is door between hill_terrace and venn_hall.
  Passage gallery_door "the gallery doors" is doorway between venn_hall and venn_gallery.
  Passage seconds_door "the Guild door" is door between hill_foot and seconds_yard.
  // The Chapel and its Island.
  Passage nave_door "the Chapel door" is door between chapel_steps and nave.
  Passage lamp_door "the lamp-room door" is doorway between nave and lamp_room.
  Passage bier_door "the bier-room door" is doorway between lamp_room and bier_room.
  Passage registry_door "the Registry door" is door between nave and registry.
  Passage urn_stair "the Urn Hall stair" is stair between registry and urn_hall.
  Passage vestry_door "the vestry door" is doorway between nave and vestry.
  Passage confessional_way "the confessionals" is doorway between nave and confessionals.
  Passage cloister_door "the cloister door" is door between chapel_steps and cloister_garth.
  Passage cells_door "the cells' door" is doorway between cloister_garth and brothers_cells.
  Passage refectory_door "the refectory door" is doorway between cloister_garth and refectory.
  // The Contessa's private stair, kept shut three hundred years: hill.kyr opens it.
  Passage private_stair "the Contessa's private stair" is stair between tarn_study and vestry hidden until private_stair_known opening when privateStairOpen(party).
  // Down to the cisterns, and the Drain's long way to the Urn Hall (cisterns.kyr gives the Drain its rooms and ways).
  Passage cistern_down "the cistern steps" is stair between cistern_steps and cistern_head.
  Passage cistern_hall_way "the oil-cistern arch" is arch between cistern_head and cistern_hall.
  Passage den_way "the lamp-boys' crawl" is crawl between cistern_hall and lamp_boys_den.
  Passage drain_way "the Ninefold Drain" is culvert between cistern_hall and drain_mouth taking 20 minutes.
  Passage pump_way "the pump-chamber stair" is stair between drain_mouth and pump_chamber.
  Passage cellar_way "the cellar shaft" is shaft between pump_chamber and urn_cellar.
  Passage cellar_hatch "the cellar hatch" is ladder between urn_cellar and urn_hall.
}
data/adventures/book-of-faces/growth.kyr:
Module ombra "The Book of Faces" {
  // ── What the company grows by ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // A company grows in Ombra by what it does for its people and for the truth, not only by what it survives: the small
  // stories are worth as much as the case, and settling the Drawing is worth most. Seeing the book through is worth the
  // module's own experience on top (module.json).
  Milestone m_warrant "took the Stranger's Warrant" worth 25 when warrantHeld(party).
  Milestone m_body "found how the Registrar died" worth 25 when knows(party, marrick_natural).
  Milestone m_mask "read how her mask was put on" worth 25 when knows(party, mask_reset).
  Milestone m_bands "found the older band under the white mask's" worth 50 when knows(party, old_band).
  Milestone m_hobb "sat with the Serene until he took the Mask off" worth 75 when hobbMoved(party).
  Milestone m_vane "was refused by the Candid, and refused her back" worth 75 when vaneDoubts(party).
  Milestone m_vane_consent "got the Candid to read only the names that were given" worth 75 when vane_consents(party).
  Milestone m_vail "earned the Watch's trust" worth 50 when vailTrust(party) >= 3.
  Milestone m_seal "opened the Registrar's letter" worth 50 when knows(party, letter_read).
  Milestone m_registry "stood in the Registry" worth 50 when state(registry_lock, open).
  Milestone m_book "read the Book of Faces" worth 100 when bookRead(party).
  Milestone m_urn "knew the Urn was empty" worth 100 when knows(party, urn_hollow).
  Milestone m_hearing "called the Hearing of the Unseen" worth 100 when hearingHeld(party).
  Milestone m_lacke_hearing "laid the case against the Warden of Locks before the Hearing" worth 100 when hearingLaid(party).
  Milestone m_drawing "held the Drawing" worth 150 when drawingHeld(party).
  Milestone m_face "answered the Concord's offer of a face" worth 100 when faceTaken(party) or faceDeclined(party).
  Milestone m_marks "mended four of the Registrar's Rounds" worth 100 when marks(party) >= 4.
  Milestone m_marks_all "mended all nine of the Registrar's Rounds" worth 150 when marks(party) >= 9.
}
data/adventures/book-of-faces/post.kyr:
Module ombra "The Book of Faces" {
  // ── The Wet Post ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // The Dead Letter Office, where Ombra's bureaucracy is at its kindest: a mountain of what was never delivered, forty
  // sacks of it, filed by a nursery rhyme, and burnt in the Office's own furnace at noon on the ninth day by the
  // Postmaster, by a Rule older than the Concord. Pell posted the Book of Faces to Nobody on the first night and it is in
  // one of the sacks. Three threads: the Burning (the book's set-piece, and its clock); the Clerk Who Reads (Mabel Vickery
  // delivers by night what the Office cannot, which is a kindness and also Unfacing); and a Delivery to a Mask (a parcel
  // for whoever wore the Cockle at the fifth bell on a Michaelmas Eve, in a city that does not say who wore what).

  // ── Buildings and rooms of my own ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Place ps_lodgings "the Post-lodgings" is building within post_sleeve.
  Place ps_bakehouse "the Wet Post bakehouse" is building within post_sleeve.
  Place dlo_office "the Postmaster's room" is room within post_office at 3, 1 indoors.
  Place dlo_roof "the Dead Letter Office's roof" is room within post_roofs at 2, 0 outdoors.
  Place ps_stair "the Post-lodgings stair" is room within ps_lodgings at 0, 0 indoors.
  Place ps_bake_floor "the bakehouse floor" is room within ps_bakehouse at 0, 0 indoors.
  Passage ps_office_door "the Postmaster's door" is doorway between dlo_counter and dlo_office.
  Passage ps_roof_way "the sweeps' ladder" is ladder between post_street and dlo_roof.
  Passage ps_stair_door "the lodgings door" is door between post_street and ps_stair.
  Passage ps_bake_door "the bakehouse door" is door between post_street and ps_bake_floor.

  // ── What the Office keeps ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // Forty sacks in eight lines of five. The Office sorts by a rhyme: each line of the first verse is a way of being
  // undeliverable, and the second verse says which sack of the line a thing goes into by what it is. The Book is a parcel
  // posted "To Nobody, Nowhere", and a parcel with no name and no door goes into Wanting: the third sack of the seventh line.
  Kind ps_rack.
  Entity ps_rack_water: ps_rack "'Gone to the water, gone to the wall'".
  Entity ps_rack_hill: ps_rack "'Gone up the Hill where nobody calls'".
  Entity ps_rack_drip: ps_rack "'Gone down the Drip and the lamps are out'".
  Entity ps_rack_sea: ps_rack "'Gone to sea and who's to say'".
  Entity ps_rack_haste: ps_rack "'Written in haste and never signed'".
  Entity ps_rack_sealed: ps_rack "'Sealed, and sorry, and none to find'".
  Entity ps_rack_wanting: ps_rack "'Wanting a name and wanting a door'".
  Entity ps_rack_nobody: ps_rack "'And Nobody's own on the bottom floor'".
  Measure ps_dug(ps_rack). Relation ps_pdone(ps_rack). Relation ps_book_in(ps_rack).
  Initially Assert ps_book_in(ps_rack_wanting).
  // Where the sacks are: the sorting-hall all year, the burning-room from ten on the ninth morning.
  Relation ps_sacks_at(place).
  Initially Assert ps_sacks_at(dlo_sorting).

  Discovery ps_pell_is_pell "The Crow at the Dead Letter Office's counter, who gives his name as Dacre, is Tomas Pell, the Registrar's Clerk of the Book, who has not been seen on Chapel Island since the night she died.".
  Discovery ps_mabel_is_strake "The young Crow with her sleeves pinned, in the sorting-hall, is Mabel Vickery, a clerk of the Dead Letter Office.".
  Discovery ps_rule_read "The Rule of the Nobodies: what is posted to Nobody belongs to Nobody; on the ninth day, at noon, the Postmaster burns it in a dry furnace, by her own hand; if the furnace be wet she waits on it and does not hurry; and no piece is kept back unless some person redeems it before the stroke by paying its carriage and putting a name to it.".
  Discovery ps_dry_clause "By the Rule the Nobodies are burnt in a dry furnace and not otherwise: if the furnace will not draw the Postmaster waits for it, and the Burning is not done until it does.".
  Discovery ps_redeem_clause "By the Rule any person may keep a Nobody from the fire before noon on the ninth day by paying its carriage and putting a name to it; and a face is a name, to the Office.".
  Discovery ps_rhyme_heard "The clerks of the sorting-hall file to a rhyme: 'Gone to the water, gone to the wall, gone up the Hill where nobody calls', and so on down eight lines, and a second verse that counts to five.".
  Discovery ps_filing "The Office files by its rhyme: eight lines for eight kinds of undeliverable, five sacks to a line, and in each line one for a letter, two for a card, three for a parcel, four for a bundle, five for a bale; 'Nobody's own' holds what is addressed to Nobody at some door, and 'Wanting a name and wanting a door' what has neither.".
  Discovery ps_rack_told "The Book of Faces went into the sorting-hall as a parcel directed To Nobody, Nowhere: the third sack of the seventh line, 'Wanting a name and wanting a door'.".
  Discovery ps_nobodies "The Dead Letter Office keeps eleven thousand pieces a year in forty sacks, and on the ninth day of the Novena, at noon, its Postmaster burns them all, as the Office has done since before the Concord.".
  Discovery ps_thanks_known "In 'Nobody's own' hundreds of letters thank Nobody for soup, boots and being found, in the careful hands of the poor of the Drip, and the Office has never been able to deliver one, because the Rule says Nobody is not a person.".

  Relation ps_sacks_looked(group). Relation ps_boy_paid(group). Relation ps_mabel_leave(group).
  Relation ps_book_found(group). Relation ps_book_burned(group). Relation ps_burned_by_choice(group). Relation ps_redeemed(group).
  Relation ps_snatched(group). Relation ps_pell_free(group). Relation ps_pell_admits(group). Relation ps_pell_robbed(group).
  Relation ps_pell_moved_it(group). Relation ps_pell_chapel(group). Relation ps_pell_fled(group). Relation ps_pell_wary(group).
  Relation ps_flue_wet(group). Relation ps_flue_choked(group). Relation ps_burning_begun(place). Relation ps_burnt(place).
  Relation ps_drawer_open(group). Relation ps_boy_dismissed(group). Relation ps_own_up(group).
  Measure ps_tryDay(group).

  // Who may be in the sorting-hall. By day the hall is the Office's: a Crow is one of its own and walks through, as does
  // whoever the boy, Mabel or Pell has let by. By night the way to it runs past whoever keeps the counter lamp, and whoever
  // sits in the hall, so a stranger is let through only when Pell is away at the Chapel or has been brought to admit it.
  Query ps_may_search(a: group) means ps_lawful_hour() and (ps_pell_free(a) or ps_mabel_leave(a)
    or (publicHours() and (wears(a, face_crow) or ps_boy_paid(a) or ps_dunnage_favour(a)))
    or (ps_sacksMoved() and masked(a))
    or (privateHours() and (ps_pell_admits(a) or (not at(pell, dlo_sorting) and not at(pell, dlo_counter))))).
  Query ps_speaks(a: group) means (masked(a) and publicHours()) or (not masked(a) and privateHours()).
  Query ps_cold_day(a: group) means not masked(a) and publicHours().
  Query ps_cold_night(a: group) means masked(a) and privateHours().
  Query ps_burnDay() means day(clock) == 9.
  Query ps_sacksMoved() means day(clock) == 9 and hour(clock) >= 10.
  // The furnace is laid on the ninth morning and the Postmaster lights it at noon, if it will draw; the Burning is an hour
  // and a half, and the last sack is in the fire at the end of it.
  Measure ps_burnStart(place).
  Query ps_burning() means ps_burning_begun(post_office) and not ps_burnt(post_office).
  Query ps_burn_done() means ps_burnt(post_office).
  Query ps_lawful_hour() means day(clock) < 9 or (day(clock) == 9 and hour(clock) < 12).

  // ── Scenes: the Wet Post ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Observe ps_street_day at post_street when publicHours() "The Wet Post is the street the rain was invented for. Pigeon-lofts lean out over the water on stilts, and under them the Crows run: post-clerks and runners in the black domino with the notched beak, each with paper under oilcloth, none looking at anyone. Over the Dead Letter Office's door, in gilt gone green, RETURN TO NOBODY, and under it, in a child's chalk, TRY AGAIN.".
  Observe ps_street_bare at post_street when not masked(party) and publicHours() "A Crow with a bundle steps round you without breaking stride, the way water goes round a post. Nobody on the Wet Post has ever been late for anything, and nobody here has ever been addressed.".
  Observe ps_street_night at post_street when privateHours() "At night the Wet Post belongs to the pigeons and the damp. Every shutter is closed but the Dead Letter Office's, where a lamp burns behind a pane of oiled paper: the Rule requires a light in the Office from the first morning to the ninth noon, and the Postmaster has never let it out. Under the lofts the birds mutter in their sleep like clerks.".
  Observe ps_street_pell at post_street when hour(clock) == 2 and not ps_pell_chapel(party) and not ps_pell_fled(party) and day(clock) < 9 "A man in a clerk's coat comes out of the Office with no mask and no lantern, and shuts the door as softly as a man leaving a sickroom. He goes away over the Candle bridge toward the Chapel, bare-faced in the dark, walking as if he were counting his steps.".
  Observe ps_street_ninth at post_street when day(clock) == 9 and hour(clock) >= 9 and hour(clock) < 20 and not ps_burn_done() "The Office chimney is smoking, thin and straight, and the Crows of the Wet Post have stopped running. They stand in the rain in their ranks under the lofts, masked, silent, each with a letter that has been delivered, watching the smoke the way a street watches a funeral it was not asked to.".
  Observe ps_street_after at post_street when ps_burn_done() "The smoke from the Office is gone, and the street smells of hot iron and wet ash. A grey flake the size of a thumbnail comes down on your sleeve out of the rain: it has a line of someone's handwriting on it.".

  Observe ps_counter_day at dlo_counter when publicHours() and not ps_sacksMoved() "The Dead Letter Office's counter is a long mahogany rail worn to the grain by forty years of elbows, and behind it a wall of pigeonholes labelled with the names of things that are not there: DECEASED, REMOVED, NO SUCH HOUSE, NOT KNOWN, UNKNOWN, and in the lowest and largest, NOBODY. A brass plate on the rail says T. DACRE, COUNTER. To the left the Postmaster's door; ahead, the sorting-hall, and the smell of it: wet wool, oilcloth, old glue, and paper that has been waiting.".
  Observe ps_counter_night at dlo_counter when privateHours() and not ps_sacksMoved() "By night the counter is a stool, a stove with a kettle on it and a lamp on a chain, and the pigeonholes go up into the dark like the cells of something enormous and asleep. The brass plate says T. DACRE. Somebody has been sitting on the stool for a long time, and the stool has taken a shape.".
  Observe ps_shelf at dlo_counter when not ps_parcel_given(party) and not ps_sacksMoved() "Over the pigeonholes, on a shelf under a card that says UNCLAIMED, a parcel in brown paper has been leaning for the best part of a year. Somebody has dusted it.".
  Observe ps_counter_ninth at dlo_counter when ps_sacksMoved() and not ps_burn_done() "The pigeonholes are empty and the Unclaimed shelf is bare; the Office has swept itself into the sacks, as it does once a year, and the counter has nobody behind it. The sorting-hall door stands open on a hall of empty hooks, and beyond it you can hear the furnace drawing.".
  Observe ps_counter_gone at dlo_counter when ps_pell_fled(pell) and publicHours() and not ps_sacksMoved() "The stool behind the rail is empty. The brass plate still says T. DACRE, COUNTER, and somebody has propped a card against it, in the boy's round hand: GONE OUT. Dickon is minding the shelf, and the forms, which are not square.".
  Observe ps_counter_after at dlo_counter when ps_burn_done() "The counter is clean. It has been wiped down with a wet cloth, the way you wipe a table after a wake.".

  Observe ps_office_scene at dlo_office when true "The Postmaster's room is a desk, a clock that has been four minutes slow since before the Concord, a taper-stand with one taper missing (she carries it), and on the wall a framed list of every Postmaster the Office has had, forty-one names, none with a face. In the desk, a drawer with a brass lock.".

  Observe ps_hall_day at dlo_sorting when publicHours() and not ps_sacksMoved() "A long cold hall under black beams, and from the beams on iron hooks, forty sacks of grey sailcloth in eight lines of five, each with a tin tag stamped with a number and nothing else. Down the middle run the sorting-tables, and at them the Office's clerks, in their Crows, file the morning's returns into the sacks with a flick of the wrist and a chant under their breath that is half a nursery rhyme and half a tally. A stove nobody has lit since the Concord. The smell is boiled glue.".
  Observe ps_hall_chant at dlo_sorting when publicHours() and not ps_sacksMoved() "The clerks' chant, when you stand still long enough to make it out, is a rhyme, sung flat, the way you sing a thing you have sung every day since you were seven: 'Gone to the water, gone to the wall, gone up the Hill where nobody calls, gone down the Drip and the lamps are out, gone to sea and who's to say', and on, and a second verse that only counts." teaches ps_rhyme_heard.
  Observe ps_hall_night at dlo_sorting when privateHours() and not ps_sacksMoved() "By night the sorting-hall is one lamp on a chain and forty sacks turning very slightly on their hooks in the draught from the furnace flue, as if each were being weighed. The tables are cleared. Somebody has left a stool in the aisle, between the seventh line and the eighth, with a coat folded on it.".
  Observe ps_hall_ninth at dlo_sorting when ps_sacksMoved() "The hooks are empty. Forty iron hooks, and on the whitewash under them the ghost of forty sacks, and on the floor one tin tag that has fallen off, 21. The tables have been pushed to the walls. Beyond the door you can hear the furnace and the clerks, and nothing else.".
  Observe ps_hall_water at dlo_sorting when ps_sacks_at(dlo_sorting) and ps_dug(ps_rack_water) >= 1 "On the table by the door lie the contents of the first sack of the first line: letters to the drowned, tied in tens with string. One is to a lamp-boy, in a mother's hand, from the hills, and it asks whether he is eating.".
  Observe ps_hall_hill at dlo_sorting when ps_sacks_at(dlo_sorting) and ps_dug(ps_rack_hill) >= 1 "Letters that went up the Hill and were not taken in are stacked in a heap by the stove, every one stamped in the same blue ink, REFUSED AT THE GATE; a Hill porter has a stamp for it and, you gather, a great deal of leisure.".
  Observe ps_hall_drip at dlo_sorting when ps_sacks_at(dlo_sorting) and ps_dug(ps_rack_drip) >= 1 "The Drip's sack was wet before it was hung. Its letters have run into each other, so that a promise of marriage has taken on a recipe for eel pie, and the addresses have gone to blue weather.".
  Observe ps_hall_sea at dlo_sorting when ps_sacks_at(dlo_sorting) and ps_dug(ps_rack_sea) >= 1 "Letters to sailors, most of them thick with what the writers wanted to say and could not, tied to the ends of voyages that went on without them. Somebody has cut one open and sewn it up again; you see the stitches.".
  Observe ps_hall_haste at dlo_sorting when ps_sacks_at(dlo_sorting) and ps_dug(ps_rack_haste) >= 1 "The letters of the unsigned: threats, offers, apologies and, in a bundle with a ribbon, forty-one love-letters in one hand to nobody who ever answered. The ribbon has been retied by someone who is not the sender.".
  Observe ps_hall_sealed at dlo_sorting when ps_sacks_at(dlo_sorting) and ps_dug(ps_rack_sealed) >= 1 "Letters that were sent, found, and refused. Each one has been opened by the person it was for and shut again, and marked on the back in a different hand, NOT KNOWN AT THIS ADDRESS, in the tone of a person closing a door.".
  Observe ps_hall_wanting at dlo_sorting when ps_sacks_at(dlo_sorting) and ps_dug(ps_rack_wanting) >= 1 "The letters of nobody to nobody, with no name and no door: a lock of hair, a child's drawing of a boat, a page of a hymnal, a key. They are the Office's saddest sack, and its clerks sort them in silence.".
  Observe ps_hall_nobody at dlo_sorting when ps_sacks_at(dlo_sorting) and ps_dug(ps_rack_nobody) >= 1 "'Nobody's own' is the heaviest line, and it is full of thanks: for soup, for boots, for a night's bed, for a name not asked, hundreds of them in the careful hands of the poor of the Drip, addressed To Nobody, at the Kitchen. The Office has never been able to deliver one. By the Rule, Nobody is not a person, and a person is what a letter needs." teaches ps_thanks_known.

  Observe ps_furnace_scene at dlo_furnace when not ps_sacksMoved() "The burning-room is whitewashed brick with a floor of iron plates, and in the end wall the furnace: a black mouth wide enough to take a sack and a clerk's arm to the shoulder, with a brass damper on a chain, and a brick chimney going up through the roof. Over the mouth, cut in a slate in a law-hand so old the s's are f's, THE RULE. It has not been lit since last year. It still smells of it, of a hot, sweet smell like sugar scorching, which is what burning paper smells like when there is enough of it.".
  Observe ps_furnace_ninth at dlo_furnace when ps_sacksMoved() and not ps_burning() and not ps_burn_done() and not ps_flue_wet(party) and not ps_flue_choked(party) "Forty grey sacks lie in a line along the iron floor in the order of the rhyme, tags outward, and at the back of the room the furnace stands laid and waiting: a bed of old envelopes and broken pigeon-boxes in its black throat, the brass damper open on its chain, and a cold breath coming down the flue that the clerks have all arranged to stand out of. The taper-holder on the lintel is empty. She carries it.".
  Observe ps_furnace_burning at dlo_furnace when ps_burning() and not ps_flue_wet(party) "The furnace door is open and the room is a held breath of heat. The Postmaster feeds it in her own hand, a sack at a time, tipping the paper into the fire so that it falls in a slow grey cascade, and the Office's clerks stand in a line along the wall in their Crows and say, at each sack, the number of it. The paper does not burn so much as depart.".
  Observe ps_pell_at_fire at dlo_furnace when at(pell, dlo_furnace) and ps_sacksMoved() and not ps_burn_done() "Tomas Pell stands at the Postmaster's elbow, as the Rule requires the counter's clerk to stand, with his hands at his sides and the Crow on. He is looking at the wall. He is not looking at the third sack of the seventh line, which stands at the end of the row, tags out, nearest the fire.".
  Observe ps_furnace_wet at dlo_furnace when ps_flue_wet(party) and not ps_burn_done() "Water is coming down the inside of the flue in a thin continuous thread and hissing on the grate. The fire will not draw. The room is full of the smell of wet soot, and the Office's clerks have stopped, as people do at a funeral when the hearse will not start.".
  Observe ps_furnace_choked at dlo_furnace when ps_flue_choked(party) and not ps_burn_done() "The flue is choked with sodden sacking from the damper up; whatever you do to it a draught will not come down this chimney before a sweep does. The smoke has come back into the room in a low brown layer, and the clerks are crouching in it with wet cloths over their faces.".
  Observe ps_furnace_after at dlo_furnace when ps_burn_done() and ps_burnt(post_office) "The furnace is dark, and the iron floor under it is warm. A hundredweight of fine grey ash lies in the pan, and in it, here and there, a curl of vellum or a corner of a stamp that has not entirely given in.".

  Observe ps_roof_scene at dlo_roof when true "The Dead Letter Office's roof is a shallow valley of black slate between two chimneys, one for the stove and one for the furnace, a squat brick stack with an iron cowl like a bishop's hat. Pigeons walk about on it as if they owned the lease. The rain runs off in a hundred directions, and a good part of it, you notice, runs straight down the furnace stack.".
  Observe ps_roof_cowl at dlo_roof when ps_flue_wet(party) "The cowl has been turned on its pivot to face the weather. Rain is running into the stack as if into a funnel.".

  Observe ps_stair_day at ps_stair when publicHours() "The Post-lodgings stair: four floors of narrow steps in the dark and, on the landings, four doors, each with a card in a clerk's hand: BRANDT, WICK, ROKE, and at the top, under the slates, FENWICK. By day it is empty and smells of damp stairwell and other people's breakfasts, and of aniseed from the bakehouse across the way.".
  Observe ps_stair_night at ps_stair when privateHours() "The Post-lodgings stair by night is a ladder of lamps under doors. Behind BRANDT someone is practising a speech; behind ROKE, a kettle. The smell of aniseed comes in under the street door, and somewhere above you a cradle is being rocked by a person with no baby.".

  Observe ps_bake_day at ps_bake_floor when publicHours() "The Wet Post bakehouse: low, white, hot, and smelling of aniseed and burnt sugar. Four ovens in the wall, a trough, a table the colour of flour, and the post's bakers in the Cockle, the humblest face in Ombra, a plain half-mask of undyed linen, bent over their dough. Nobody here looks up for a Crow. They would not look up for a bishop.".
  Observe ps_bake_night at ps_bake_floor when privateHours() "The bakehouse is dark and warm, the ovens banked, the trough covered with a cloth. On the table, a row of loaves rises for morning under towels like a row of sleeping heads.".

  // ── The people ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // Pell, Dunnage and Mabel have two registers: by day, masked, they are the Office, and a Crow is a colleague and
  // anyone else a customer; by night, bare, at the counter lamp or on the Chapel steps, they are what they are. A bare
  // company by day, or a masked one at night, is told one cold thing and no more.
  Person pell "Tomas Pell" at dlo_counter {
    Role "the Dead Letter Office's counter clerk" when not knows(party, ps_pell_is_pell).
    Role "the Registrar's Clerk of the Book, hiding behind a counter" when knows(party, ps_pell_is_pell).
    Known as "a Crow clerk at the counter" when not knows(party, ps_pell_is_pell) and publicHours().
    Known as "a grey, bare-faced clerk on a stool" when not knows(party, ps_pell_is_pell) and privateHours().
    Ancestry human. Peaceable. Pronouns he. Manner stoic.
    Greets "A grey man in a clerk's coat stands at the counter squaring a stack of forms that is already square. He does not look up until you are directly in front of him, and then he says 'Yes,' as if answering a question you had not asked, and goes on squaring.".
    Greets again "'Yes,' says the clerk at the counter, to the forms.".
  }
  Initially Assert unmaskTeaches(pell, ps_pell_is_pell).

  Person dunnage "Mistress Dunnage" at dlo_office {
    Role "the Postmaster of the Dead Letter Office, who burns what is not claimed".
    Ancestry human. Peaceable. Pronouns she. Manner proud.
    Greets "A tall woman, grey to the roots, with her sleeves tied back and an unlit taper in her hand, stands up from the desk and looks at you the way a ledger looks at a figure that does not agree. 'The Office is open,' she says. 'State your business in one piece. Pieces are what we have too many of.'".
    Greets again "'State it in one piece,' says the Postmaster.".
  }

  Person strake "Mabel Vickery" at dlo_sorting {
    Role "a clerk of the sorting-hall, with her sleeves pinned back".
    Known as "a young Crow with ink to the elbow" when not knows(party, ps_mabel_is_strake) and publicHours().
    Known as "a bare-faced young woman with ink to the elbow" when not knows(party, ps_mabel_is_strake) and privateHours().
    Ancestry human. Peaceable. Pronouns she. Manner compassionate.
    Greets "A young clerk with her sleeves pinned to the elbow looks up with a letter in each hand and puts both behind her back at once, in the manner of a person who has practised it. 'Sorting,' she says brightly. 'Nothing to see. It is all only paper.'".
    Greets again "'Sorting,' says the young clerk, and puts something face down.".
  }
  Initially Assert unmaskTeaches(strake, ps_mabel_is_strake).

  Person ps_corbin "Dickon" at dlo_sorting {
    Role "the Office's boy sorter, in a Crow's domino made for a man" when not ps_boy_dismissed(ps_corbin).
    Ancestry human. Peaceable. Pronouns he. Manner cheerful.
    Greets "A boy of twelve in a Crow made for a grown man comes out from under a sorting-table with a sack-hook, and looks at your belt, because that is as high as the domino lets him see. 'Staff only,' he says, with a conscience. 'Mostly.'".
    Greets again "'Staff only,' says the boy. 'Mostly.'".
  }

  // The bakehouse's four Cockles. The Cockle is the humblest face and two hundred wear it; these four are the ones on the
  // Wet Post bakehouse's floor, and one of them wore it at the fifth bell on a Michaelmas Eve (the third thread).
  Discovery ps_odile_is_she "The Cockle with the neat blue thread in her mask-string is Odile Ollerton, a baker's hand, who lodges in the garret of the Post-lodgings.".
  Discovery ps_wick_is_he "The tall Cockle with the string mended in black is Teodor Wick, a baker, who lodges on the second landing of the Post-lodgings and owes money.".
  Discovery ps_wynne_is_she "The Cockle in the mask a size too big is Nessa, the bakehouse's apprentice, fifteen.".
  Discovery ps_bram_is_he "The young Cockle with the string knotted in blue wool is Bram Cutter, a baker's journeyman.".
  Person ps_wick "Teodor Wick" at ps_bake_floor {
    Role "a baker of the Wet Post bakehouse".
    Known as "a tall Cockle whose mask-string is mended in black" when not knows(party, ps_wick_is_he) and publicHours().
    Known as "a big man in his shirt, with a candle" when not knows(party, ps_wick_is_he) and privateHours().
    Ancestry human. Peaceable. Pronouns he. Manner jovial.
    Greets "A tall man with a baker's forearms and the face of one who has had a good deal of bad news looks up from what he is doing. 'Mind yourself,' he says, and then, lower, as if it were a confidence, 'I owe for most things. Do not mind that.'".
    Greets again "'Mind yourself,' says the tall man.".
  }
  Initially Assert unmaskTeaches(ps_wick, ps_wick_is_he).
  Person ps_odile "Odile Ollerton" at ps_bake_floor {
    Role "a baker's hand of the Wet Post bakehouse".
    Known as "a Cockle whose mask-string is mended in a neat blue thread" when not knows(party, ps_odile_is_she) and publicHours().
    Known as "a woman with her hair down, bare-faced, on the garret landing" when not knows(party, ps_odile_is_she) and privateHours().
    Ancestry human. Peaceable. Pronouns she. Manner stoic.
    Greets "A woman with flour in the creases of her knuckles and a left hand that never quite stops moving looks at you with the patience of someone who has been looked at by strangers for a long time. 'Bread is not till ten,' she says. 'Unless you want yesterday's, which is cheaper and the same.'".
    Greets again "'Not till ten,' says the woman, and her left hand goes on.".
  }
  Initially Assert unmaskTeaches(ps_odile, ps_odile_is_she).
  Person ps_wynne "Nessa" at ps_bake_floor {
    Role "the Wet Post bakehouse's apprentice".
    Known as "a Cockle in a mask a size too big, with a blue ribbon in her hair" when not knows(party, ps_wynne_is_she).
    Ancestry human. Peaceable. Pronouns she. Manner cheerful.
    Greets "A girl of fifteen with flour in her eyebrows, in a Cockle that was cut for somebody larger, is humming a rhyme about a spoon. 'Mind the aniseed,' she says. 'It gets in everything. It gets in Wick.'".
    Greets again "'Mind the aniseed,' says the girl in the big mask.".
  }
  Initially Assert unmaskTeaches(ps_wynne, ps_wynne_is_she).
  Person ps_bram "Bram Cutter" at ps_bake_floor {
    Role "a journeyman of the Wet Post bakehouse".
    Known as "a young Cockle whose string is knotted in blue wool" when not knows(party, ps_bram_is_he).
    Ancestry human. Peaceable. Pronouns he. Manner acerbic.
    Greets "A young man in the Cockle, in a hurry, with one side of his mask-string knotted together in blue wool as a boy knots a bootlace, shoves a tray of rolls past you with his right hand. 'Counter is through there,' he says. 'If you are not buying you are standing in the way of the buns.'".
    Greets again "'In the way of the buns,' says the young Cockle.".
  }
  Initially Assert unmaskTeaches(ps_bram, ps_bram_is_he).

  // ── Where they are ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // Pell sits at the counter by day; at night he keeps the counter lamp until eleven, then sits in the hall beside the
  // seventh line until two, when he walks to the Chapel and stands on its steps for two hours, and then opens the Office
  // at four. Once he has left the Office for the Chapel (given up, or Named, or dismissed) he is on the steps for good.
  Query ps_pell_home() means not ps_pell_chapel(pell) and not ps_pell_fled(pell).
  Query ps_at_fire() means day(clock) == 9 and watch(clock) >= 1167 and watch(clock) < 1224 and not ps_burnt(post_office).
  Query ps_witnessing() means day(clock) == 9 and watch(clock) >= 1164 and watch(clock) < 1224 and not ps_burnt(post_office).
  Rule ps_pell_to_chapel when ps_pell_chapel(pell) and not at(pell, chapel_steps) { Assert at(pell, chapel_steps). }
  Rule ps_pell_to_nowhere when ps_pell_fled(pell) and not at(pell, offstage) { Assert at(pell, offstage). }

  // ══ THE BURNING OF THE NOBODIES ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // The clock: until ten on the ninth morning the forty sacks hang in the sorting-hall; at ten the clerks carry them to the
  // burning-room and line them up in the order of the rhyme; at noon the Postmaster lights the fire from her taper and
  // feeds it a sack at a time for an hour and a half. Up to the stroke of noon any person may redeem a piece by paying its
  // carriage and putting a name to it (to the Office, a face is a name). After it, nobody may touch a Nobody. A wet
  // furnace puts the Burning off (the Rule's own dry clause); a choked one stops it for the book. What is in the sacks
  // at the end is ash, the Book included.

  Discovery ps_book_located "The Book of Faces lies in the sorting-hall of the Dead Letter Office, in a sack among the Nobodies, and will be burnt with them at noon on the ninth day unless somebody takes it out.".
  Discovery ps_drawer_known "The Postmaster keeps the Filing, the card that says how the Office's rhyme sorts its sacks, in the locked drawer of her desk, and nowhere else, because a rhyme learned from a card is learned wrong.".
  Discovery ps_pell_suspect "The counter clerk who gives his name as Dacre came to the Office on the first morning, a few hours after a grey parcel with the Registrar's seal came in by the night-box, and spends his nights beside the seventh line of sacks.".
  Discovery ps_parcel_known "The Dead Letter Office has a parcel on its Unclaimed shelf directed to whoever wore the Cockle at the fifth bell on Michaelmas Eve; nobody has ever been able to say who that was.".

  // ── The Postmaster ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Topic ps_dun_cold with dunnage "Speak to the Postmaster" when ps_cold_day(actor) {
    Says "'Bare,' says the Postmaster, to a point a little above your head, 'is a condition and not an address. Come back with something I can write on an envelope.'".
  }
  Topic ps_dun_cold_night with dunnage "Speak to the Postmaster" when ps_cold_night(actor) {
    Says "'The Office is shut,' says Mistress Dunnage, from the other side of a door that is open a hand's breadth, and does not open further. 'I do not receive a mask in my own room. Take it off, and come in, or go away.'".
  }
  Topic ps_dun_night with dunnage "Speak to the Postmaster in her room, bare, at night" when not masked(actor) and privateHours() and at(dunnage, dlo_office) {
    Says "Without the Office on her face she is a plain, tired woman of sixty with a good deal of grey hair, and the taper lies on the blotter where she has put it down like a thing she does not need until the morning. 'Forty-one Postmasters,' she says, 'and not one of us has been asked what she thought of it.' She does not wait to be asked now. 'I do not enjoy the Burning. I do it. I have come to think that that may be the whole of being a Postmaster: to do a thing well which is not to be enjoyed, and which has not been asked for by anyone alive.'".
  }
  Topic ps_dun_night_reader with dunnage "Ask her, bare, whether she knows who opens the dead letters" when not masked(actor) and privateHours() and at(dunnage, dlo_office) and day(clock) >= 3 {
    Says "'Yes,' says Mistress Dunnage, 'and I have not decided to know.' She puts the taper straight on the blotter. 'It is in the evenings that I am a coward. By day I am the Rule, and the Rule is not a coward; it is something much worse, which is consistent. I have given her until the seventh day. That is a kindness. It is also a deadline, and the Rule, I find, will take no more of it than that.'".
    On discuss { Assert knows(actor, ps_dunnage_asked_known). }
  }
  Topic ps_dun_fire with dunnage "Ask the Postmaster, at the furnace, whether she will do it" when ps_speaks(actor) and ps_sacksMoved() and not ps_burn_done() and at(dunnage, dlo_furnace) {
    Says "'Dry, at noon, by my own hand, before the Office,' says the Postmaster, not turning her head. 'That is all it says. It has never said whether the Postmaster is to be glad.' She weighs the taper in her palm. 'Eleven thousand pieces. I know the weight of every sack. I have never once been told what was in them.' It occurs to you that she is the only person in the room who has not wanted to look.".
  }
  Topic ps_dun_burning with dunnage "Ask the Postmaster what the Office does with what it cannot deliver" when ps_speaks(actor) {
    Says "'Keeps it for a year,' says Mistress Dunnage. 'Forty sacks. Eleven thousand pieces by the last count, and the last count was mine. On the ninth day of the Novena, at noon, in this Office's own furnace, I burn them.' She turns the unlit taper once in her fingers. 'It was done before the Concord. The Concord copied it; and then, I notice, forgot what for.'".
    On discuss { Assert knows(actor, ps_nobodies). }
  }
  Topic ps_dun_rule with dunnage "Ask the Postmaster to read you the Rule of the Nobodies" when ps_speaks(actor) and knows(actor, ps_nobodies) {
    Says "She does not fetch it. 'What is posted to Nobody belongs to Nobody,' says the Postmaster, to the middle of the room, 'and Nobody is not to be found. Therefore on the ninth day, at noon, the Postmaster shall burn it, in a dry furnace, by her own hand, before the Office; and if the furnace be wet she shall wait on it and not hurry; and no piece shall be kept back, save such as be redeemed before the stroke by any person that will pay its carriage and put a name to it.' She stops, because it has stopped. 'Six coin the stone.'".
    On discuss { Assert knows(actor, ps_rule_read). Assert knows(actor, ps_dry_clause). Assert knows(actor, ps_redeem_clause). }
  }
  Topic ps_dun_filing with dunnage "Ask the Postmaster how the Office sorts" when wears(actor, face_crow) and publicHours() {
    Says "'By the Filing,' says Mistress Dunnage, with the faint pleasure of someone asked about her own handwriting. 'You will have it by heart in a week, if you are in the Office. You are not. It is kept in my desk and in the clerks' mouths, and nowhere else, because a rhyme learned off a card is learned wrong.'".
    On discuss { Assert knows(actor, ps_drawer_known). }
  }
  Topic ps_dun_reader with dunnage "Ask the Postmaster if there is trouble in the sorting-hall" when wears(actor, face_crow) and publicHours() and day(clock) >= 3 {
    Says "'Somebody,' says the Postmaster, 'opens what is not theirs to open.' She does not raise her voice; it is not a voice that rises. 'Four letters in a month came back to my counter from the other side of the Cuff with a word written on them in a hand that was not the sender's. Thanks. The Office does not receive thanks. The Office has not delivered.' She puts the taper down. 'I shall know by the seventh day.'".
    On discuss { Assert knows(actor, ps_dunnage_asked_known). }
  }
  Discovery ps_dunnage_asked_known "Mistress Dunnage knows that someone in the sorting-hall opens the dead letters and delivers some of them by hand, and says she will have found out who by the seventh day.".
  Action ps_ask_hold(actor: group, site: place) "Ask the Postmaster to put the Burning off a day, on account of the Drawing" {
    Speaker dunnage.
    Requires able(actor) and company(actor) and at(actor, site) and at(dunnage, site) and masked(actor) and publicHours() and ps_lawful_hour()
      and not ps_held(actor) and ps_tryDay(actor) < day(clock).
    Time 3 minutes.
    Resolve check(actor, persuasion, dc_formidable).
    On success { Assert ps_held(actor). Assert ps_dunnage_yielded(actor). }
    On failure { Set ps_tryDay(actor) to day(clock). }
    Result "Mistress Dunnage listens to all of it, the Drawing and the city and what a day's delay would be to people who have waited all year, and when you have done she says, 'I have never been asked that.' She sets her taper on the desk. 'The Rule does not mention the Drawing. It does not mention the day after. I have wondered, before now, why it was so exact about the one and silent about the other.' She is silent herself for a long moment. 'The Burning will be on the tenth. Not for you. For the Rule, which I find has been waiting to be asked.'".
    Otherwise "'The Rule,' says the Postmaster, with enormous gentleness, 'does not mention the Drawing.' It is the kindest refusal you have ever had, and it does not move at all.".
  }

  // Redeeming a piece: the lawful way. The Postmaster does not ask what a piece is; the Rule does not.
  Action ps_redeem(actor: group, site: place) "Redeem the parcel from the Nobodies: twelve coin by weight, in the name of your face" {
    Speaker dunnage.
    Requires able(actor) and company(actor) and at(actor, site) and at(dunnage, site) and masked(actor) and publicHours() and ps_lawful_hour()
      and ps_book_found(actor) and not carries(actor, book_of_faces) and not ps_book_burned(actor) and quantity(actor, gold) >= 12.
    Time 10 minutes.
    On success { Decrease quantity(actor, gold) by 12. Increase quantity(dunnage, gold) by 12. Give book_of_faces to actor. Assert ps_redeemed(actor). }
    Result "You put the parcel on her desk. She looks at the seal, a bare oval with nothing in it, and at the grey vellum under the oilcloth, and you see her know exactly what it is, and decide that the Rule does not ask. 'Carriage,' she says. 'By weight. Two stone.' You pay it. She writes in the Redemptions: one parcel, grey, directed To Nobody, Nowhere, redeemed before the stroke by the face that was wearing a mask this morning, and blots it, and pushes the book across for your face's signature. 'The Office thanks you,' she says. It has never, you suspect, said it before.".
  }

  // ── The boy ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // Dickon minds the Unclaimed shelf and runs between the counter and the hall, and he filed the grey parcel that came in
  // by the night-box on the first night. He is twelve and nobody has asked him what he thinks since he was hired.
  Topic ps_corbin_cold with ps_corbin "Speak to the boy" when ps_cold_day(actor) {
    Says "The boy looks at your belt, at your boots, at anything but the place where a mask would be. 'I'm not allowed,' he says, in a whisper, and goes red under the Crow. 'Sorry. It's only that I'm not.'".
  }
  Action ps_pay_boy(actor: group, site: place) "Give the boy two coin to look the other way when you go through to the sorting-hall" {
    Speaker ps_corbin.
    Requires able(actor) and company(actor) and at(actor, site) and at(ps_corbin, site) and masked(actor) and publicHours() and not ps_boy_paid(actor) and not wears(actor, face_crow)
      and quantity(actor, gold) >= 2 and not ps_sacksMoved().
    Time 1 minute.
    On success { Decrease quantity(actor, gold) by 2. Increase quantity(ps_corbin, gold) by 2. Assert ps_boy_paid(actor). }
    Result "The boy takes the coin as a thing he has been told about and never seen. 'I never saw you,' he says, with a conscience. 'I'm not sure what I'm not seeing. But I'm not.'".
  }
  Action ps_corbin_ask(actor: group, site: place) "Ask Dickon, as if his opinion mattered, what came in by the night-box on the first night" {
    Speaker ps_corbin.
    Requires able(actor) and company(actor) and at(actor, site) and at(ps_corbin, site) and ps_speaks(actor) and not ps_rack_known(actor) and ps_corbinDay(actor) < day(clock).
    Time 5 minutes.
    Resolve check(actor, persuasion, dc_fair).
    On success { Assert knows(actor, ps_rack_told). Assert ps_rack_known(actor). Assert knows(actor, ps_pell_suspect). }
    On failure { Set ps_corbinDay(actor) to day(clock). }
    Result "He thinks very hard, being asked. 'A big grey one,' he says. 'Heavy as a baby. Directed in a clerk's hand, To Nobody, Nowhere. It had a seal on it like a bare oval.' He draws one in the air. 'Nobody is not a name, Mistress Dunnage says, it is a lack of one, and Nowhere is not a door. So that is Wanting, the seventh line. Parcels are the third sack.' He is proud of it. 'Mr. Dacre came in the same morning for the lowest post in the Office, and he sits by that line all night. I think he likes the rhyme.'".
    Otherwise "The boy goes red under the Crow. 'It is not my place,' he says, which is what he has been told, and he goes back to the shelf and straightens a parcel that does not need it. Nobody, you gather, has ever asked him anything he was not told to know.".
  }
  Action ps_corbin_pay(actor: group, site: place) "Give Dickon five coin and ask what came in by the night-box on the first night" {
    Speaker ps_corbin.
    Requires able(actor) and company(actor) and at(actor, site) and at(ps_corbin, site) and ps_speaks(actor) and not ps_rack_known(actor) and quantity(actor, gold) >= 5.
    Time 3 minutes.
    On success { Decrease quantity(actor, gold) by 5. Increase quantity(ps_corbin, gold) by 5. Assert knows(actor, ps_rack_told). Assert ps_rack_known(actor). Assert knows(actor, ps_pell_suspect). }
    Result "The boy looks at five coin as at a sum he has been waiting years to be asked to carry. 'A big grey one,' he says, very fast. 'To Nobody, Nowhere, with a seal like a bare oval. Nobody is not a name and Nowhere is not a door, so that is Wanting, the seventh line, and a parcel is the third sack.' He pockets the coin. 'Mr. Dacre came the same morning and sits by that line all night,' he adds, because he is honest, 'and I do not know why, and I did not tell you.'".
  }
