Module hume "Half the Hive" {
  Description "The Wold of Hume, high limestone country south over the march, where four hundred people live inside a honeycomb under a cliff and belong to bees as big as hounds by the smell of their queen; in the week the old queen swarms, and half the town walks out behind her to found another.".

  // ── The country ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // The Wold rises out of the lowland farms in long dry swells of turf and linden wood. The drove road comes up from the
  // march to Smoke End at the mouth of the Hask gorge; up the gorge, under the Brow, hangs the Comb. North of the gorge
  // the linden wood, and beyond it the heather moor, which runs east a long day to the Far Brow. The Gallowtree stands
  // on its knoll west of the wood; the Chalk Dell is south-east; Larkhill and its chantry are on the Wold's western
  // edge, near the road from the lowlands. No plane is declared: the canonical Imbar is not on main (friction.md).
  Place hume_wold "the Wold of Hume" is region.
  Initially Assert terrain(hume_wold, hills).
  Place wold_edge "the Wold's edge" is wilderness within hume_wold at 0, 3.
  Place smoke_end "Smoke End" is settlement within hume_wold at 1, 3.
  Place hume_brow "Hume Brow" is settlement within hume_wold at 1, 2.
  Place high_wold "the High Wold" is wilderness within hume_wold at 1, 1.
  Place gallowtree "the Gallowtree" is site within hume_wold at 0, 1.
  Place chalk_dell "the Chalk Dell" is site within hume_wold at 2, 2.
  Place larkhill "Larkhill" is site within hume_wold at 0, 2.
  Place heather_moor "the heather moor" is wilderness within hume_wold at 2, 1.
  Place far_brow "the Far Brow" is site within hume_wold at 3, 0.
  Initially Assert landform(high_wold, land_wood).

  // ── Buildings ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Place rest_house "the Smoker's Rest" is building within smoke_end.
  Place quarrie_house "Nell Quarrie's" is building within smoke_end.
  Place thorle_house "Thorle's smithy" is building within smoke_end.
  Place scenting_house "the Scenting House" is building within hume_brow.
  Place comb "the Comb" is building within hume_brow.
  Place brood "the Brood" is level within comb.
  Place stores "the Stores" is level within comb.
  Place crown "the Crown of the Comb" is level within comb.
  Place gallow_trunk "the hollow of the Gallowtree" is building within gallowtree.
  Place chantry "the chantry at Larkhill" is building within larkhill.

  // ── Rooms ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // The Wold's edge, where the drove road comes up from the march
  Place drove_end "the drove road at the Wold's edge" is room within wold_edge at 0, 1 outdoors.
  Place larkhill_lane "the lane to Larkhill" is room within wold_edge at 0, 0 outdoors.
  // Smoke End, at the mouth of the gorge
  Place smoke_street "Smoke End" is room within smoke_end at 1, 1 outdoors.
  Place taproom "the taproom of the Smoker's Rest" is room within rest_house at 0, 1 indoors.
  Place nell_shop "Nell Quarrie's shop" is room within quarrie_house at 1, 0 indoors.
  Place forge "Thorle's smithy" is room within thorle_house at 2, 1 indoors.
  Place leavers_yard "the Leavers' Market" is room within smoke_end at 1, 2 outdoors.
  // Hume Brow: the gorge floor under the Comb, and the Comb
  Place gorge_path "the gorge path" is room within hume_brow at 0, 3 outdoors.
  Place apron "the Apron" is room within hume_brow at 0, 2 outdoors.
  Place scenting_room "the Scenting House" is room within scenting_house at 1, 2 indoors.
  Place brood_gallery "the Brood gallery" is room within brood at 0, 1 indoors.
  Place wax_gallery "the Waxwrights' gallery" is room within brood at 1, 1 indoors.
  Place royal_gallery "the royal gallery" is room within brood at 0, 0 indoors.
  Place dancing_hall "the Dancing Hall" is room within brood at 2, 0 indoors.
  Place mellor_cell "the Mellors' cell" is room within brood at 2, 1 indoors.
  Place honey_vaults "the honey vaults" is room within stores at 0, 0 indoors.
  Place capped_gallery "the Capped Gallery" is room within stores at 1, 0 indoors.
  Place mothers_chamber "the Mother's Chamber" is room within crown at 0, 0 indoors.
  Place drones_gallery "the Drones' Gallery" is room within crown at 1, 0 indoors.
  // The High Wold: the linden wood, the Toot above the gorge
  Place linden_wood "the linden wood" is room within high_wold at 0, 1 outdoors.
  Place honey_oak "the honey linden" is room within high_wold at 1, 1 outdoors.
  Place toot "the Toot" is room within high_wold at 1, 0 outdoors.
  // The Gallowtree, on its knoll
  Place gallow_knoll "the Gallowtree's knoll" is room within gallowtree at 0, 1 outdoors.
  Place gallow_hollow "the hollow of the Gallowtree" is room within gallow_trunk at 0, 0 indoors.
  // The Chalk Dell
  Place dell_rim "the rim of the Chalk Dell" is room within chalk_dell at 0, 0 outdoors.
  Place dell_floor "the floor of the Chalk Dell" is room within chalk_dell at 0, 1 outdoors.
  Place sett_mouth "the cave in the chalk" is room within chalk_dell at 1, 1 outdoors.
  // Larkhill
  Place chantry_yard "the chantry yard at Larkhill" is room within larkhill at 0, 1 outdoors.
  Place chantry_nave "the chantry at Larkhill" is room within chantry at 0, 0 indoors.
  Place corve_study "Squire Corve's study" is room within chantry at 1, 0 indoors.
  // The heather moor
  Place moor_edge "the edge of the heather moor" is room within heather_moor at 0, 1 outdoors.
  Place black_crag "the black crag" is room within heather_moor at 1, 0 outdoors.
  Place bothy "the shepherds' bothy" is room within heather_moor at 1, 2 outdoors.
  // The Far Brow
  Place far_ledge "the ledge under the Far Brow" is room within far_brow at 0, 0 outdoors.
  Place far_hollow "the hollow under the Far Brow" is room within far_brow at 1, 0 outdoors.
  // Where what is not yet anywhere waits.
  Place limbo "nowhere" is room within wold_edge at 9, 9.

  // ── Passages ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Passage drove_climb "the drove road" is road between drove_end and smoke_street taking 30 minutes.
  Passage lark_turn "the Larkhill lane" is track between drove_end and larkhill_lane taking 1 hour.
  Passage lark_gate "the chantry gate" is gate between larkhill_lane and chantry_yard.
  Passage chantry_door "the chantry door" is door between chantry_yard and chantry_nave.
  Passage study_door "the study door" is door between chantry_nave and corve_study.
  Passage rest_door "the door of the Smoker's Rest" is door between smoke_street and taproom.
  Passage nell_door "Nell Quarrie's door" is door between smoke_street and nell_shop.
  Passage forge_door "the smithy door" is door between smoke_street and forge.
  Passage yard_way "the way to the Chandlers' yard" is path between smoke_street and leavers_yard taking 2 minutes.
  Passage gorge_up "the gorge path" is path between smoke_street and gorge_path taking 20 minutes.
  Passage apron_way "the last of the gorge path" is path between gorge_path and apron taking 5 minutes.
  Passage scent_door "the Scenting House door" is door between apron and scenting_room.
  Passage foot_stair "the foot stair" is stair between apron and brood_gallery.
  Passage wax_arch "the Waxwrights' arch" is arch between brood_gallery and wax_gallery.
  Passage royal_arch "the royal arch" is arch between brood_gallery and royal_gallery.
  Passage dance_door "the dancers' door" is doorway between brood_gallery and dancing_hall.
  Passage mellor_door "the Mellors' door" is doorway between brood_gallery and mellor_cell.
  Passage stores_stair "the honey stair" is stair between brood_gallery and honey_vaults.
  Passage capped_arch "the arch of the Capped" is arch between honey_vaults and capped_gallery.
  Passage crown_stair "the crown stair" is stair between honey_vaults and mothers_chamber.
  Passage drones_arch "the yellow arch" is arch between mothers_chamber and drones_gallery.
  Passage toot_path "the Toot path" is path between gorge_path and toot taking 40 minutes.
  Passage wood_path "the wood path" is path between gorge_path and linden_wood taking 1 hour.
  Passage oak_path "the honey path" is path between linden_wood and honey_oak taking 20 minutes.
  Passage gallow_path "the knoll path" is path between linden_wood and gallow_knoll taking 1 hour.
  Passage gallow_door "the door in the Gallowtree" is doorway between gallow_knoll and gallow_hollow.
  Passage dell_track "the dell track" is track between linden_wood and dell_rim taking 2 hours.
  Passage dell_steps "the chalk steps" is steps between dell_rim and dell_floor.
  Passage sett_way "the way into the cave" is path between dell_floor and sett_mouth taking 2 minutes.
  Passage lark_way "the edge path" is path between linden_wood and larkhill_lane taking 2 hours.
  Passage moor_path "the moor path" is path between linden_wood and moor_edge taking 1 hour.
  Passage crag_path "the crag path" is path between moor_edge and black_crag taking 3 hours.
  Passage far_path "the far path" is path between black_crag and far_ledge taking 3 hours.
  Passage far_in "the way under the Far Brow" is path between far_ledge and far_hollow taking 5 minutes.
  // The shepherds' drove round the moor: longer, gentle, and known to nobody but the shepherds and one idle man.
  Passage drove_round "the shepherds' drove" is track between moor_edge and bothy taking 4 hours hidden until drove_known.
  Passage drove_on "the drove beyond the bothy" is track between bothy and far_ledge taking 4 hours hidden until drove_known.

  // ── The look of the country ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Observe drove_end_scene at drove_end when true "The drove road comes up out of the lowland hedges onto open turf, short and springy and full of thyme, and the sky gets bigger. Ahead the Wold goes up in long dry swells, linden-dark on the tops. A cut in it, like a door left ajar, is the Hask gorge, with smoke standing up out of its mouth in a column the wind cannot quite knock over. A lane goes off west along the edge toward a hill with a tower on it.".
  Observe drove_end_bees at drove_end as ambience when not leavingBegun() "Once, high up, something crosses the sky from north to south that you take for weather: a long brown smudge, unravelling and knitting up again, with a sound under it like a mill-race a long way off.".
  Observe lane_scene at larkhill_lane when true "A sunken lane under ash trees, with the Wold going up on one side and the lowland falling away green on the other. Ahead, on its hill, a little grey chapel with a square tower, and a new slate roof on the house beside it that does not match.".
  Observe smoke_scene at smoke_street when true "Smoke End is one street of turf-roofed houses and timber yards strung along a stream at the mouth of the gorge, and all of it smokes. Smudge-fires of damp bracken and dung burn in iron baskets at every door and at the street's ends, and the smoke goes up the gorge on the draught, grey and sweetish, and makes your eyes run. People here walk with a hand over their mouths, out of habit. Somewhere a hammer. Up the gorge, through the smoke, a glow like a lamp behind a curtain.".
  Observe smoke_notice at smoke_street as feature when not leavingBegun() "On the post of the Smoker's Rest a notice is nailed up, in a square hand, in lowland letters: SEARCHERS WANTED. ANY WHO CAN WALK AND LOOK. PAID IN WAX. ASK FOR K. DUNN, THE DANCING HALL, UP THE COMB. And under it, smaller: GET SCENTED FIRST.".
  Observe smoke_signs at smoke_street as sign when not leavingBegun() "Handcarts go up the gorge empty and come down loaded: chests, chairs, a cradle, a loom in pieces, all with that faint golden tackiness of things that have lived a long time in the Comb.".
  Observe taproom_scene at taproom when true "A low room under turf, with a bench round the wall, a smudge-basket by the door and a slate behind the bar headed SEARCHERS: a column of names, most rubbed to a smear, and room under them for yours. Everyone who comes in glances up the gorge, as if the hum could be heard through the roof, and then at the keeper, who is listening with his good ear.".
  Observe yard_scene at leavers_yard when true "The Chandlers' Company's yard, behind a fence of split oak: a long shed, a weighing-beam, and today a field's worth of other people's lives set out on the trodden mud in rows. Wax in cakes and candles. Honey in crocks. Spinning wheels, bee-veils, carved chests, a child's cot, a pair of good boots. A man in a black coat walks the rows with a boy and a slate, saying a number at each thing, low, and the boy writing it, and the families standing by their things not looking at each other.".
  Observe gorge_scene at gorge_path when true "The gorge closes in: grey limestone walls going up and up, ferns in every crack, a stream loud beside the path. The smoke thins behind you and something else takes its place: warmth, out of all proportion to the day, and a smell like a summer field baked and then poured into a jar, and a sound you feel first in your teeth.".
  Observe apron_scene at apron when true "The gorge opens into a bowl under a lip of grey rock a quarter of a mile long, and hanging from the underside of the rock is a honeycomb the size of a town, with people going in and out of it, and bees as big as hounds. It is gold and amber and brown and in places nearly black; it hangs in great curved sheets, like curtains frozen in a wind, the oldest of them four hundred years old; and it is cut through with doors, and stairs, and windows. The light through the wax is the colour of beer. The hum is everywhere: in the walls of the gorge, in the ground, in your breastbone.".
  Observe apron_sisters at apron as feature when not leavingBegun() "Overhead the Sisters come and go in brown streams the width of a road, gold-and-black, furred like a good coat, with eyes like wet coal. They land on the comb's lip and walk in. When one passes low the wind of her wings lifts your hair. The people on the Apron do not look up, the way people in a town do not look up at the weather.".
  Observe apron_market at apron as sign when daytime() "Stalls along the troughs sell honey-cake, comb in squares on vine leaves, bee-bread in brown loaves, mead by the horn, and a fried thing in paper cones that smells of nuts and butter, which the stallholder says is brood: the drone brood, a delicacy, fried in its own wax.".
  Observe scenting_scene at scenting_room when true "A low room cut into the rock beside the foot stair, very clean. Shelves of stoppered jars, a stone basin, a brazier with something resinous on it. A slate on the wall says in chalk: GUESTS SCENTED, ONE DAY. TWO COIN. SEARCHERS NOTHING.".
  Observe brood_scene at brood_gallery when true "Inside, the Comb is warm as a kitchen and gold as the inside of an egg. The gallery is a corridor of six-sided rooms, each as big as a cottage, their walls thin enough to see shapes through: bees, people, a cradle. The floor gives very slightly underfoot and is tacky, like a well-polished table on a hot day, and everyone here goes barefoot or in felt. The hum is so close now that you hear words in it if you let yourself.".
  Observe wax_scene at wax_gallery when true "The Waxwrights' gallery is cooler, and smells of warm candles and of something sharp they use to keep the wax workable. Benches, moulds, knives with long thin blades, cakes of wax from almost white to almost black. And going up out of the middle of it, through a hole in the ceiling, round and round, the Lantern Stair: a spiral of carved wax so fine the light comes through every tread, each step carved with flowers, bees, faces, hands, the whole of the Brow's life climbing up into the dark. It stops, three turns up, at nothing.".
  Observe royal_scene at royal_gallery when true "A high room where the ceiling comes down in a fold, and from the fold hang three things like great acorns made of brown wax, each as big as a cradle, each pitted all over like the skin of a lemon. Princess cells. Under each a stool, and on each stool someone sitting, watching, not talking to the others. The air here is thick and sweet and makes your scalp prickle.".
  Observe dancing_scene at dancing_hall when true "The Dancing Hall is the strangest room you have ever stood in. Its floor is tilted like a roof, steep enough that you would slide if it were not tacky; and its walls are written all over with marks scored into the wax: lines and loops and figure-eights, thousands of them, overlapping, generations deep. Up at the top of the slope a round window lets in the sun, and the Searchers dance on the slope below it: a straight run, waggling, then a loop back round, then the run again. The angle of the run from straight up is the angle from the sun. How long the waggle lasts is how far. How hard is how good.".
  Observe garrow_scene at mellor_cell when true "A family's cell: one six-sided room with a hearth-stone in the middle that has never had a fire on it, a loom, a bed in a wax alcove, children's drawings pressed into the wall. A bundle tied up in a blanket by the door, ready to go. The other half of the room is not packed at all.".
  Observe vaults_scene at honey_vaults when true "The honey vaults go back into the dark under the Brow: cell upon cell, each the size of a barrel, each capped with white wax, each full. Where the cap is thin, the honey shows through, dark gold, like looking into a lamp from the side. Bees stand on the comb fanning with their wings, and the air moves past you warm and thick and smelling of every flower you have ever known.".
  Observe capped_scene at capped_gallery when true "The Capped Gallery is cool and silent, the only place in the Comb where the hum is far away. Here the walls are clear wax, very thick, and in the wax, upright, in rows going back further than you can see, are the Humefolk dead. They stand in their best clothes with their eyes shut and their hands folded, perfectly kept, the newest nearest, the oldest so far back they are only shapes, four hundred years deep. Here and there someone living sits on a little stool in front of one of them, and talks to it in a low voice, and is not embarrassed.".
  Observe capped_dark at capped_gallery as feature when true "There is no light in the Capped Gallery but what comes down the arch from the vaults. By the arch a board is pegged, burnt in with a hot iron: NO FLAME AMONG THE CAPPED.".
  Observe chamber_scene at mothers_chamber when true "The Crown of the Comb is a long dim hall under the very rock of the Brow, where the comb is oldest and nearly black. In the middle of it, on a wide shallow cell like a bed, is the Mother: as long as a pony, slender, the gold of her body gone dark with age, her wings short on her long back. The Sisters stand round her in a ring facing in, touching her, stroking her, feeding her from their mouths. She is quite still. The hum here is so deep it is not a sound at all but a pressure, like being underwater.".
  Observe chamber_restless at mothers_chamber as sign when not leavingBegun() "Every little while the ring round the Mother breaks: a Sister pushes at her, butts her, runs up her back, and the Mother walks three steps, and the ring closes again. They are making her thin enough to fly.".
  Observe drones_scene at drones_gallery when true "The Drones' Gallery is all yellow: yellow hangings, yellow cushions, yellow-painted wax, a long table laid with honey-cake and fried brood and mead in yellow glass. A dozen men and a few women in yellow coats lie about on the cushions in attitudes, being fed by nobody in particular, talking about horses they do not own. It is the most comfortable room in the Comb and the saddest.".
  Observe wood_scene at linden_wood when true "The linden wood is tall and cool and full of the noise of bees: the limes are in flower, and the Sisters work the high branches, huge shapes in the green, and the scent of the flowers comes down so thick it is almost a taste. Paths go off every way: north to the moor, west to a knoll with one great tree on it, south-east downhill toward chalk, west along the edge toward Larkhill.".
  Observe oak_scene at honey_oak when true "A clearing round one enormous old lime, its trunk split and healed and split again. Forty feet up, where a limb was lost, there is a dark mouth in the bark, and out of it hangs a lip of wild comb, black and gold, with small wild bees going in and out, ordinary bees, the size of your thumbnail, which seems very strange now. Old pegs go up the trunk, some of them new.".
  Observe toot_scene at toot when true "The Toot is a round green hill above the gorge, with a single standing stone on top, leaning, and the whole Wold laid out round it: the wood, the moor going away purple to the east, the white scar of the Dell, the knoll with its great tree, and far off in the west the lowland, blue. Up here, on still afternoons, the drones gather: you can hear them, a deep rich droning over the hilltop, from bees you cannot see.".
  Observe knoll_scene at gallow_knoll when true "The Gallowtree stands alone on its knoll, a linden so old it has outlived its own name: nobody was ever hanged on it; the name is older than hanging. Its trunk is as big round as a cottage, grey and ridged and hollow, and its crown is still full and green and loud with wild bees. In the trunk, at the height of a man, someone long ago cut a door, and shaped its sill in wax, and the wax has gone grey.".
  Observe hollow_scene at gallow_hollow when true "Inside the tree is a room, round, tall as a chapel, lit greenly from cracks high up. The walls are comb: old grey comb, built up the inside of the trunk in sheets, abandoned, dry; and there are people in it.".
  Observe dell_rim_scene at dell_rim when true "The ground falls away into a dell: a great bowl of white chalk, scooped out of the Wold as if by a spoon, its sides bare and bright, its floor green and sheltered and warm. It faces full south. In its far wall, at the back, a dark low cave. Chalk steps, cut long ago, go down.".
  Observe dell_floor_scene at dell_floor when true "The floor of the Dell is the warmest place on the Wold, out of every wind, the grass full of harebells. The white walls throw the sun back. In the grass lies a bone the length of a man's thigh, gnawed pale and clean, and nobody has moved it.".
  Observe sett_scene at sett_mouth when true "The cave mouth is low and wide and dry, and smells strongly of musk and old bones. The chalk round it is scored deep in long parallel grooves, four together, higher than your head. A path in and out is worn to bare earth, wide as a cart.".
  Observe chantry_yard_scene at chantry_yard when true "A little walled yard round a grey stone chantry, very old, its windows empty, its tower square and stout and bigger than a chantry needs. Someone has been mending it: new mortar, a new door, beehives in a row along the south wall, ordinary straw skeps, with ordinary bees. Beside the chantry a farmhouse with the new slate roof.".
  Observe nave_scene at chantry_nave when true "The chantry's nave has been cleared of everything but its stone. The tower stair goes up from the west end. On the walls, pinned in rows, are drawings: bees, the Sisters, done from life in brown ink and coloured, wings, legs, eyes, stings, each with a note in a small neat hand. Hundreds of them. Twelve years of them, by the dates.".
  Observe study_scene at corve_study when true "A small warm room with books to the ceiling, a microscope of brass, a table covered with papers, a dead Sister's wing in a glass frame on the wall, gold and veined like a leaf of mica. Letters in a rack, each with the same seal broken: a hexagon.".
  Observe moor_edge_scene at moor_edge when true "The trees stop and the moor begins: heather, purple and humming, going away east in long swells under an enormous sky. A path goes on across it, straight as a thrown stone. Off to the south, far away, a smudge of smoke from somewhere on the moor.".
  Observe crag_scene at black_crag when true "Halfway across the moor a crag of black rock stands up out of the heather like a broken tooth, and the path goes right under it. The rock is split, and the splits are full of comb: black comb, and on it, and in the air round it, bees. Smaller than the Sisters, the size of a cat, black all over, quick and jerky in the air. Their sound is higher, and has an edge.".
  Observe bothy_scene at bothy when true "A shepherds' bothy, low, stone, turf-roofed, with a peat fire somebody banked and left, a kettle, a bench, a pile of fleeces, and on the lintel, scratched with a knife, a dozen names and dates, the oldest two hundred years.".
  Observe far_ledge_scene at far_ledge when true "The moor ends at the lip of another gorge, and across it, facing west into the afternoon sun, another Brow: a long grey overhang of limestone the twin of the one at home, with nothing under it at all.".
  Observe far_hollow_scene at far_hollow when true "Under the Far Brow it is dry and still and warm. The rock overhead is stained all over in long brown streaks, the ghost of comb that hung here once, and in the floor dust there are scraps of old wax gone hard as horn. At the back, where the rock comes down to meet the ground, in a smooth patch of old wax, there are handprints, small ones, a child's, a row of them, pressed in long ago and never taken out.".

  // The rooms of the country, and those of the Comb (where the Sisters are).
  Relation wold(place). Relation combRoom(place).
  Initially Assert wold(drove_end). Initially Assert wold(larkhill_lane). Initially Assert wold(smoke_street). Initially Assert wold(taproom).
  Initially Assert wold(nell_shop). Initially Assert wold(forge). Initially Assert wold(leavers_yard). Initially Assert wold(gorge_path).
  Initially Assert wold(apron). Initially Assert wold(scenting_room). Initially Assert wold(brood_gallery). Initially Assert wold(wax_gallery).
  Initially Assert wold(royal_gallery). Initially Assert wold(dancing_hall). Initially Assert wold(mellor_cell). Initially Assert wold(honey_vaults).
  Initially Assert wold(capped_gallery). Initially Assert wold(mothers_chamber). Initially Assert wold(drones_gallery). Initially Assert wold(linden_wood).
  Initially Assert wold(honey_oak). Initially Assert wold(toot). Initially Assert wold(gallow_knoll). Initially Assert wold(gallow_hollow).
  Initially Assert wold(dell_rim). Initially Assert wold(dell_floor). Initially Assert wold(sett_mouth). Initially Assert wold(chantry_yard).
  Initially Assert wold(chantry_nave). Initially Assert wold(corve_study). Initially Assert wold(moor_edge). Initially Assert wold(black_crag).
  Initially Assert wold(bothy). Initially Assert wold(far_ledge). Initially Assert wold(far_hollow).
  Initially Assert combRoom(brood_gallery). Initially Assert combRoom(wax_gallery). Initially Assert combRoom(royal_gallery).
  Initially Assert combRoom(dancing_hall). Initially Assert combRoom(mellor_cell). Initially Assert combRoom(honey_vaults).
  Initially Assert combRoom(capped_gallery). Initially Assert combRoom(mothers_chamber). Initially Assert combRoom(drones_gallery).
  Initially Assert unlit(capped_gallery).
}
data/adventures/half-the-hive/growth.kyr:
Module hume "Half the Hive" {
  // ── What the company grows by ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // Experience for what is found, made, carried and changed; nothing for killing but what killing costs.
  Milestone m_searcher "was taken on as a Searcher of Hume Brow" worth 25 when searcher(party).
  Milestone m_dance "learned the Searchers' dance" worth 50 when danceLearned(party).
  Milestone m_danced "danced for a place in the Dancing Hall" worth 75 when dancedAny().
  Milestone m_gallow "found what became of the seventh Leaving" worth 100 when knows(party, lost_leaving).
  Milestone m_rot "found the Gallowtree rotten at the heart" worth 50 when knows(party, gallow_rotten).
  Milestone m_merrit "brought Merrit Coke's wax bee home to her niece" worth 150 when hannetHasBee(hannet).
  Milestone m_far "stood under the Far Brow" worth 100 when hasSeen(far_brow).
  Milestone m_drove "learned the shepherds' drove from a Drone" worth 50 when knows(party, drove_known).
  Milestone m_kestrel "saw Kestrel Dunn take a Drone's word" worth 150 when kestrelTurned(kestrel).
  Milestone m_truce "read the brocks' truce on the chalk" worth 100 when knows(party, brock_truce).
  Milestone m_peace "kept the old peace with the brocks" worth 200 when brockTruce(brocks).
  Milestone m_brocks "killed the brocks of the Chalk Dell" worth 150 when brocksKilled(brocks).
  Milestone m_moss "kept Moss Ashdown from going into the Dell alone" worth 75 when mossWaits(moss).
  Milestone m_hannet "promised Hannet Coke she would be carried" worth 50 when promiseMade(carry_hannet).
  Milestone m_hannet_kept "saw Hannet Coke carried with the Leaving" worth 150 when promiseKept(carry_hannet).
  Milestone m_eben "learned what Eben Candlish meant to do" worth 50 when knows(party, eben_secret).
  Milestone m_linnet "learned what Linnet Amory meant to do" worth 50 when knows(party, linnet_secret).
  Milestone m_lovers "brought Linnet and Eben to say it to each other" worth 200 when linnetKnows(linnet) and ebenKnows(eben).
  Milestone m_white "cut white comb in the Gallowtree" worth 50 when whiteTaken(party).
  Milestone m_stair "set the last course of the Lantern Stair" worth 250 when stairLit(eben).
  Milestone m_watch "kept the dark watch with Agnes Mellor" worth 100 when keptWatch(party).
  Milestone m_heard "heard what comes into the Capped Gallery in the dark" worth 50 when knows(party, moth_heard).
  Milestone m_moth "rid the Capped Gallery of the Deathshead" worth 200 when mothDead(deathshead).
  Milestone m_tobit "won leave for Agnes Mellor to carry her dead" worth 150 when linnetPermitsDead(linnet).
  Milestone m_likeness "brought Agnes Mellor a likeness of Tobit" worth 100 when likenessGiven(agnes).
  Milestone m_nell "heard Nell Quarrie out" worth 75 when knows(party, nell_forges).
  Milestone m_nell_night "learned who sat with Tobit Mellor the night he died" worth 100 when knows(party, nell_sat_tobit).
  Milestone m_nell_named "saw Nell Quarrie named to the Comb" worth 200 when nellNamed(nell).
  Milestone m_flask "learned of the squire's flask" worth 100 when knows(party, flask_known).
  Milestone m_corve "saw Squire Corve give what he had stolen" worth 250 when corveGives(corve).
  Milestone m_poured "poured the squire's flask out on the ground" worth 100 when pouredFlask(party).
  Milestone m_ivo "asked a Drone to come searching" worth 50 when travelsWith(ivo, party).
  Milestone m_ivo_dance "saw Ivo Gildersleeve dance" worth 150 when ivoSearcher(ivo).
  Milestone m_duke "brought Duke home to Tibby" worth 50 when dukeHome(duke).
  Milestone m_spoon "found out about Dame Brenna's spoon" worth 75 when knows(party, breck_spoon).
  Milestone m_cast "saw a cast go out of the Brow" worth 200 when castWent(brenna).
  Milestone m_mead "got Huw Penry's mead working" worth 75 when meadSaved(huw).
  Milestone m_drewes "paid the Drewes what their candles were worth" worth 50 when drewesPaid(party).
  Milestone m_comb "cut wild comb from the honey linden" worth 25 when combCutDay(honey_oak) > 0.
  Milestone m_walked "walked with the Leaving" worth 200 when walkedWith(party).
  Milestone m_daughters "kept the night of the Daughters in the Brow" worth 200 when stayedForDaughters(party).
  Milestone m_named "was named to the hive" worth 250 when named(party).

  // ── Things to learn ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // Kestrel teaches a Searcher how to go unseen; Hild Thorle how to lay smoke in a fight; a night beside the Mother
  // teaches a patience that stays.
  Relation hideOffered(group). Relation smokeOffered(group). Relation motherNight(group).
  Topic kestrel_hide with kestrel "Ask Kestrel how a Searcher goes unseen among brocks and robbers" when searcher(actor) and reported(actor, ?s) and not hideOffered(kestrel) once {
    Says "'Slowly.' She looks at you. 'Low. Downwind. Still when they look, moving when they don't. Like a cloud's shadow.' She shows you, there on the slope, and you lose sight of her twice in the time it takes to say it. 'An hour's drill, if you've an hour.'".
    On discuss { Assert hideOffered(kestrel). Assert teaches(kestrel, hide). }
  }
  Topic hild_smoke with hild "Ask Hild to show you how to lay smoke in a fight" when holding(actor, bee_smoker) and not smokeOffered(hild) once {
    Says "'In a fight?' Hild Thorle grins. 'Same as with the Sisters. Smoke in their eyes and they go stupid. Men, brocks, bees: all the same underneath.' She takes your smoker and works the bellows and a grey wall goes up between you and the forge in a breath. 'An hour, and you'll do it without thinking.'".
    On discuss { Assert smokeOffered(hild). Assert teaches(hild, smoke_screen). }
  }
  Action mother_night(actor: group, reader: member, site: place) "Have {reader} sit the night beside the Mother with Linnet" {
    Description "A night of the hum, so deep it is not a sound. Something of its patience stays.".
    Requires at(actor, site) and memberOf(reader, actor) and awake(reader) and at(actor, mothers_chamber) and at(linnet, mothers_chamber) and scented() and not motherNight(actor)
      and not leavingBegun() and (hour(clock) >= 20 or hour(clock) < 4).
    Time 36. Resolve endow(reader, wisdom, by_one).
    On success { Assert motherNight(actor). }
    Result "Linnet makes room for {reader} on the warm comb beside the old queen, and does not talk. The hum goes through the night like a tide. Somewhere toward three {reader} stops hearing it and starts, instead, to be in it, the way you are in weather; and the Mother, once, turns her long head and touches {reader}'s hand with her feelers, light as breath, and turns back. In the morning the world seems very fast and very loud, and {reader} finds there is no hurry about any of it.".
  }
}
data/adventures/hessel/city.kyr:
Module hessel "The Banns at Hessel" {
  Description "Hessel, a spa city on a hillside over the river Lim, in the last four days of its Season: the old come to be mended and the young to be married, and a rich old woman with a navvy's laugh means to see three people settled before she dies.".

  // ── The country ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // One hillside, so that class is height: the Old Town by the river, where the work is done; the Baths in the middle,
  // where the water comes up hot; Upper Hessel, the new stone town built to look at itself; and the downs above it,
  // over which the road goes to Orm. The road from the south comes in at the bottom, over the Lim.
  Place hessel "the Lim valley" is region within imbar.
  Initially Assert terrain(hessel, hills).
  Place orm_way "the Orm road" is wilderness within hessel at 0, 0.
  Place downs "the downs above Hessel" is wilderness within hessel at 0, 1.
  Place hessel_town "Hessel" is settlement within hessel at 0, 2.
  Place lim_vale "the Lim vale" is wilderness within hessel at 0, 3.

  // ── Buildings ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Place carth_house "Carth House" is building within hessel_town.
  Place carth_upper "the floor above" is level within carth_house.
  Place carth_below "the rooms below stairs" is level within carth_house.
  Place wenlock_lodging "Lady Wenlock's lodgings" is building within hessel_town.
  Place cherrett_lodging "Mrs Cherrett's lodgings" is building within hessel_town.
  Place assembly "the Assembly Rooms" is building within hessel_town.
  Place twiss_house "Mr Twiss's house" is building within hessel_town.
  Place pump_house "the Pump Room" is building within hessel_town.
  Place ebbas "Saint Ebba's" is building within hessel_town.
  Place hartopp_house "Dr Hartopp's house" is building within hessel_town.
  Place apothecary_house "the apothecary's" is building within hessel_town.
  Place poles_house "the Two Poles" is building within hessel_town.
  Place hospital_house "the Hospital of the Waters" is building within hessel_town.
  Place hetty_house "Hetty Quiney's shop" is building within hessel_town.
  Place no_four_house "Number Four, Quay Lane" is building within hessel_town.
  Place hut_house "the shepherd's hut" is building within orm_way.

  // ── Rooms ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // Upper Hessel
  Place carth_drawing "the drawing room at Carth House" is room within carth_upper at 0, 0 indoors.
  Place carth_study "Sir Gervase's study" is room within carth_house at 1, 0 indoors.
  Place wenlock_room "Lady Wenlock's drawing room" is room within wenlock_lodging at 3, 0 indoors.
  Place carth_hall "the hall of Carth House" is room within carth_house at 0, 1 indoors.
  Place crescent "the Crescent" is room within hessel_town at 1, 1 outdoors.
  Place parade_top "the top of the Parade" is room within hessel_town at 2, 1 outdoors.
  Place circus "the Circus" is room within hessel_town at 3, 1 outdoors.
  Place cherrett_parlour "Mrs Cherrett's parlour" is room within cherrett_lodging at 4, 1 indoors.
  Place cherrett_bedroom "Mrs Cherrett's bedroom" is room within cherrett_lodging at 5, 1 indoors.
  Place carth_area "the area of Carth House" is room within carth_house at 1, 2 outdoors.
  Place carth_kitchen "the kitchen at Carth House" is room within carth_below at 0, 2 indoors.
  Place coal_cellar "the coal cellar under the Crescent" is room within carth_below at 0, 3 underground.
  Place twiss_parlour "Mr Twiss's parlour" is room within twiss_house at 2, 2 indoors.
  Place vestibule "the vestibule of the Assembly Rooms" is room within assembly at 3, 2 indoors.
  Place ballroom "the ballroom" is room within assembly at 4, 2 indoors.
  Place card_room "the card room" is room within assembly at 5, 2 indoors.
  // The Baths
  Place ebba_nave "Saint Ebba's" is room within ebbas at 3, 3 indoors.
  Place vestry "the vestry of Saint Ebba's" is room within ebbas at 4, 3 indoors.
  Place abbey_yard "the Abbey Yard, at the foot of the Parade" is room within hessel_town at 3, 4 outdoors.
  Place pump_room "the Pump Room" is room within pump_house at 4, 4 indoors.
  Place kings_bath "the gallery over the King's Bath" is room within pump_house at 5, 4 indoors.
  Place doctors_walk "Doctors' Walk" is room within hessel_town at 2, 5 outdoors.
  Place hartopp_room "Dr Hartopp's consulting room" is room within hartopp_house at 1, 5 indoors.
  Place apothecary "the apothecary's shop" is room within apothecary_house at 2, 6 indoors.
  Place cross_bath "the Cross Bath" is room within hessel_town at 4, 5 outdoors.
  // The Old Town
  Place stall_street "Stall Street, by the chairmen's stand" is room within hessel_town at 3, 6 outdoors.
  Place two_poles "the Two Poles" is room within poles_house at 2, 7 indoors.
  Place hospital "the Hospital of the Waters" is room within hospital_house at 4, 6 indoors.
  Place laundry_yard "the laundry yard" is room within hessel_town at 5, 6 outdoors.
  Place quay_lane "Quay Lane" is room within hessel_town at 3, 7 outdoors.
  Place hetty_shop "Hetty Quiney's shop" is room within hetty_house at 2, 8 indoors.
  Place no_four "Number Four, Quay Lane" is room within no_four_house at 4, 8 indoors.
  Place bridge_foot "the foot of Lim Bridge" is room within hessel_town at 3, 8 outdoors.
  // Outside the town
  Place south_road "the south road, at Lim Bridge" is room within lim_vale at 0, 0 outdoors.
  Place beacon "the Beacon walk" is room within downs at 1, 1 outdoors.
  Place sham_castle "the Sham Castle" is room within downs at 0, 1 outdoors.
  Place stile "the stile on the down" is room within orm_way at 1, 3 outdoors.
  Place hut_yard "the fold by the shepherd's hut" is room within orm_way at 0, 3 outdoors.
  Place hut "the shepherd's hut" is room within hut_house at 0, 2 indoors.
  Place crossways "the crossways on the down" is room within orm_way at 1, 1 outdoors.
  Place orm_gate "the south gate of Orm" is room within orm_way at 1, 0 outdoors.
  // Where what is not yet anywhere waits: a note not yet written, a ring not yet bought.
  Place limbo "nowhere" is room within lim_vale at 9, 9.

  // The town by its quarters (the shared inQuarter and heartOf: Go… sets the town out by them, and what another
  // adventure sets here, a garden behind the Two Poles, is in the quarter of the place it opens off).
  Entity upper_hessel: quarter "Upper Hessel". Initially Assert heartOf(upper_hessel, parade_top).
  Initially Assert inQuarter(carth_drawing, upper_hessel). Initially Assert inQuarter(carth_study, upper_hessel).
  Initially Assert inQuarter(wenlock_room, upper_hessel). Initially Assert inQuarter(carth_hall, upper_hessel).
  Initially Assert inQuarter(crescent, upper_hessel). Initially Assert inQuarter(parade_top, upper_hessel).
  Initially Assert inQuarter(circus, upper_hessel). Initially Assert inQuarter(cherrett_parlour, upper_hessel).
  Initially Assert inQuarter(cherrett_bedroom, upper_hessel). Initially Assert inQuarter(carth_area, upper_hessel).
  Initially Assert inQuarter(carth_kitchen, upper_hessel). Initially Assert inQuarter(twiss_parlour, upper_hessel).
  Initially Assert inQuarter(vestibule, upper_hessel). Initially Assert inQuarter(ballroom, upper_hessel).
  Initially Assert inQuarter(card_room, upper_hessel).
  Entity the_baths: quarter "the Baths". Initially Assert heartOf(the_baths, abbey_yard).
  Initially Assert inQuarter(ebba_nave, the_baths). Initially Assert inQuarter(vestry, the_baths).
  Initially Assert inQuarter(abbey_yard, the_baths). Initially Assert inQuarter(pump_room, the_baths).
  Initially Assert inQuarter(kings_bath, the_baths). Initially Assert inQuarter(doctors_walk, the_baths).
  Initially Assert inQuarter(hartopp_room, the_baths). Initially Assert inQuarter(apothecary, the_baths).
  Initially Assert inQuarter(cross_bath, the_baths).
  Entity old_town: quarter "the Old Town". Initially Assert heartOf(old_town, stall_street).
  Initially Assert inQuarter(stall_street, old_town). Initially Assert inQuarter(two_poles, old_town).
  Initially Assert inQuarter(hospital, old_town). Initially Assert inQuarter(laundry_yard, old_town).
  Initially Assert inQuarter(quay_lane, old_town). Initially Assert inQuarter(hetty_shop, old_town).
  Initially Assert inQuarter(no_four, old_town). Initially Assert inQuarter(bridge_foot, old_town).

  Initially Assert townRoom(carth_drawing). Initially Assert townRoom(carth_study). Initially Assert townRoom(wenlock_room).
  Initially Assert townRoom(carth_hall). Initially Assert townRoom(crescent). Initially Assert townRoom(parade_top).
  Initially Assert townRoom(circus). Initially Assert townRoom(cherrett_parlour). Initially Assert townRoom(cherrett_bedroom).
  Initially Assert townRoom(carth_area). Initially Assert townRoom(carth_kitchen). Initially Assert townRoom(coal_cellar).
  Initially Assert townRoom(twiss_parlour). Initially Assert townRoom(vestibule). Initially Assert townRoom(ballroom).
  Initially Assert townRoom(card_room). Initially Assert townRoom(ebba_nave). Initially Assert townRoom(vestry).
  Initially Assert townRoom(abbey_yard). Initially Assert townRoom(pump_room). Initially Assert townRoom(kings_bath).
  Initially Assert townRoom(doctors_walk). Initially Assert townRoom(hartopp_room). Initially Assert townRoom(apothecary).
  Initially Assert townRoom(cross_bath). Initially Assert townRoom(stall_street). Initially Assert townRoom(two_poles).
  Initially Assert townRoom(hospital). Initially Assert townRoom(laundry_yard). Initially Assert townRoom(quay_lane).
  Initially Assert townRoom(hetty_shop). Initially Assert townRoom(no_four). Initially Assert townRoom(bridge_foot).
  Initially Assert townRoom(beacon). Initially Assert townRoom(sham_castle).
  Initially Assert roadRoom(stile). Initially Assert roadRoom(hut_yard). Initially Assert roadRoom(hut). Initially Assert roadRoom(crossways). Initially Assert roadRoom(orm_gate).

  // ── Ways ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Passage lim_bridge "Lim Bridge" is bridge between south_road and bridge_foot taking 10 minutes.
  Passage quay_way "Quay Lane" is path between bridge_foot and quay_lane taking 2 minutes.
  Passage stall_way "Stall Street" is path between quay_lane and stall_street taking 5 minutes.
  Passage hetty_door "Hetty Quiney's door" is door between quay_lane and hetty_shop
    opening when hour(clock) >= 8 and hour(clock) < 20 "The milliner's shutters are up, and the bonnets in the window are only shapes.".
  Passage no_four_door "the door of Number Four" is door between quay_lane and no_four
    opening when hour(clock) >= 9 and hour(clock) < 18 and not mopsaHouse(mopsa) or mopsaHouse(mopsa) and hour(clock) >= 7 and hour(clock) < 23 "Number Four is locked, with a card in the window: TO LET, A GOOD LODGING-HOUSE, APPLY MR GILMOUR, DAYTIMES.".
  Passage laundry_way "the laundry lane" is path between quay_lane and laundry_yard taking 5 minutes.
  Passage poles_door "the Two Poles' door" is door between stall_street and two_poles.
  Passage hospital_door "the Hospital door" is door between stall_street and hospital.
  Passage baths_way "Stall Street, up to the Baths" is path between stall_street and abbey_yard taking 5 minutes.
  Passage cross_way "Bath Street" is path between abbey_yard and cross_bath taking 5 minutes.
  Passage wash_way "the steps down to the laundries" is steps between cross_bath and laundry_yard.
  Passage pump_door "the Pump Room door" is door between abbey_yard and pump_room
    opening when hour(clock) >= 7 and hour(clock) < 18 "The Pump Room's doors are shut, and through the glass the great room stands empty, with its chairs on its tables.".
  Passage gallery_arch "the arch to the gallery" is arch between pump_room and kings_bath.
  Passage ebba_door "the west door of Saint Ebba's" is door between abbey_yard and ebba_nave
    opening when hour(clock) >= 7 and hour(clock) < 20 "Saint Ebba's is locked for the night.".
  Passage vestry_door "the vestry door" is door between ebba_nave and vestry.
  Passage walk_way "Doctors' Walk" is path between abbey_yard and doctors_walk taking 3 minutes.
  Passage hartopp_door "Dr Hartopp's door" is door between doctors_walk and hartopp_room
    opening when hour(clock) >= 9 and hour(clock) < 17 "Dr Hartopp's brass plate is polished; his door is shut. CONSULTATIONS NINE TILL FIVE.".
  Passage apothecary_door "the apothecary's door" is door between doctors_walk and apothecary
    opening when hour(clock) >= 8 and hour(clock) < 20 "The apothecary's is shut, its great glass jars dark in the window.".
  Passage parade "the Parade" is path between abbey_yard and parade_top taking 15 minutes.
  Passage circus_way "Gay Street" is path between parade_top and circus taking 5 minutes.
  Passage crescent_way "Brock Street" is path between parade_top and crescent taking 5 minutes.
  Passage cherrett_door "Mrs Cherrett's door" is door between circus and cherrett_parlour
    opening when hour(clock) >= 7 and hour(clock) < 23 or legs(party) "Mrs Cherrett's door is shut for the night, and the knocker is muffled in a stocking.".
  Passage bedroom_door "the bedroom door" is door between cherrett_parlour and cherrett_bedroom
    opening when legs(party) or bedbound(cherrett) "Mrs Cherrett's bedroom door is shut, and her maid sits on a chair in front of it with her knitting, and looks at you over it.".
  Passage twiss_door "Mr Twiss's door" is door between circus and twiss_parlour
    opening when hour(clock) >= 10 and hour(clock) < 18 "Mr Twiss's door bears a card, beautifully lettered: THE MASTER OF THE CEREMONIES RECEIVES BETWEEN TEN AND SIX.".
  Passage rooms_door "the door of the Assembly Rooms" is door between circus and vestibule
    opening when hour(clock) >= 10 and hour(clock) < 24 "The Assembly Rooms are dark, and their great door is shut.".
  Passage ballroom_door "the ballroom doors" is door between vestibule and ballroom
    opening when evening() and admitted(party) or at(party, ballroom) or at(party, card_room) or ballNight() and admitted(party) "The ballroom doors are open, and through them the light and the music; a footman in the Rooms' blue stands across them, and does not move for you.".
  Passage card_door "the card-room door" is door between ballroom and card_room.
  Passage wenlock_door "Lady Wenlock's door" is door between crescent and wenlock_room
    opening when hour(clock) >= 10 and hour(clock) < 18 "Lady Wenlock is not at home. Lady Wenlock is never at home before ten, nor after six.".
  Passage carth_front "the front door of Carth House" is door between crescent and carth_hall.
  Passage area_steps "the area steps" is steps between crescent and carth_area.
  Passage kitchen_door "the kitchen door" is door between carth_area and carth_kitchen.
  Passage coal_hole "the coal-hole" is crawl between carth_area and coal_cellar hidden until coal_hole_known needing lockwork or brawn.
  Passage cellar_door "the cellar door" is door between coal_cellar and carth_kitchen.
  Passage back_stair "the back stair" is stair between carth_kitchen and carth_hall.
  Passage study_door "the study door" is door between carth_hall and carth_study.
  Passage great_stair "the great stair" is stair between carth_hall and carth_drawing.
  // The drawing-room window, over the area railings: a climber's way, and only while it is open.
  Passage carth_window "the drawing-room window" is ladder between crescent and carth_drawing needing climbing
    opening when state(drawing_window, ajar).
  Passage beacon_path "the path up to the Beacon" is path between parade_top and beacon taking 20 minutes.
  Passage castle_path "the walk to the Sham Castle" is path between beacon and sham_castle taking 10 minutes.
  Passage orm_road "the Orm road" is road between beacon and stile taking 1 hour.
  Passage hut_path "the sheep-track to the hut" is path between stile and hut_yard taking 20 minutes.
  Passage hut_door "the hut door" is door between hut_yard and hut.
  Passage down_road "the Orm road over the high down" is road between stile and crossways taking 90 minutes.
  Passage drove_track "the drove track" is track between hut_yard and crossways taking 90 minutes.
  // A shepherd's way across the down, straight where the road goes round: for someone who can read sheep-walks.
  Passage sheep_path "the sheep-path across the down" is path between hut_yard and crossways taking 40 minutes needing woodcraft or wayfinding.
  Passage orm_last "the last of the Orm road" is road between crossways and orm_gate taking 1 hour.

  // ── How the places look ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Observe south_road_scene at south_road when not visitedBefore(south_road) "The south road comes down out of the green country to a river, and on the far side of the river is Hessel, all of it at once, going up its hill: first the Old Town's roofs, wet and close, with steam coming out of them as if the whole place were a kettle; then a great dark church and a long pale pillared building in a haze of more steam; then terraces, honey-coloured, curving round the hill like the rings of a sawn log; and on the top of the hill, against the sky, a castle that is, when you look at it properly, only a wall with holes in it. The air smells of warm iron.".
  Observe south_road_again at south_road when visitedBefore(south_road) "The south road, at Lim Bridge, with Hessel going up its hill on the other side of the water.".
  Observe bridge_foot_scene at bridge_foot when true "The foot of Lim Bridge: fish-baskets, a tar-pot, washing strung between upper windows, and the river going by, brown and quick. A board on the toll-house says WELCOME TO HESSEL, THE QUEEN OF HEALING, and somebody has added in chalk AND OF HEALERS.".
  Observe bridge_foot_banns at bridge_foot when not bannsDone(ebbas) and not bannsWithdrawn(ebbas) "Pasted beside the board is a printed bill: THE BANNS OF MARRIAGE, WENLOCK AND CHERRETT, THE THIRD TIME OF ASKING, SUNDAY, SAINT EBBA'S. Under it someone has written in pencil, IF ANY OF YOU KNOW CAUSE.".
  Observe quay_scene at quay_lane when not dark() and not visitedBefore(quay_lane) "Quay Lane: narrow houses, a milliner's with three bonnets in the window on wooden heads, a lodging-house with a card in its window, and at the end the steam of the laundries rolling across the lane like weather.".
  Observe quay_again at quay_lane when not dark() and visitedBefore(quay_lane) "Quay Lane: the milliner's bonnets, the card in the lodging-house window, the laundries' steam.".
  Observe quay_night at quay_lane when dark() "Quay Lane at night: shutters, a dog, the laundries' steam lit from below.".
  Observe stall_scene at stall_street when not dark() and not strike(chairmen) and not visitedBefore(stall_street) "Stall Street: the chairmen's stand, a long bench under a penthouse roof, and the chairs themselves, black, glossy, like great beetles with their poles laid by them; men in blue coats sitting on the bench with their arms folded, every one of them broad enough to stop the Parade.".
  Observe stall_again at stall_street when not dark() and not strike(chairmen) and visitedBefore(stall_street) "Stall Street: the chairmen's stand, the black chairs, the blue coats on the bench.".
  Observe stall_strike at stall_street when not dark() and strike(chairmen) "Stall Street: the chairmen's stand, and every chair on it with its poles out and laid crossways on the bench, which in Hessel means NO. The chairmen sit behind them with their arms folded.".
  Observe stall_night at stall_street when dark() "Stall Street at night: the chairs chained to their bench, and the lamp of the Two Poles.".
  Observe poles_scene at two_poles when not visitedBefore(two_poles) "The Two Poles: a low room, a fire, a long table polished by blue sleeves, and over the chimney a pair of crossed chair-poles with a laurel wreath, very dusty, won by somebody in a race in the year of a comet.".
  Observe poles_again at two_poles when visitedBefore(two_poles) "The Two Poles: the fire, the long table, the crossed poles over the chimney.".
  Observe hospital_scene at hospital when not visitedBefore(hospital) "The Hospital of the Waters: a long whitewashed ward, twenty beds, twenty patients, a smell of vinegar and the river. The poor of three counties come to Hessel for the waters, the same as the rich, and here is where they lie. A bench by the door has a doctor's bag on it, packed.".
  Observe hospital_again at hospital when visitedBefore(hospital) "The Hospital of the Waters: the long ward, the twenty beds, the vinegar.".
  Observe laundry_scene at laundry_yard when not dark() and not visitedBefore(laundry_yard) "The laundry yard: coppers, mangles, steam, a dozen women with their sleeves up and arms red to the elbow, and lines and lines of white linen, the Season's sheets and bathing-gowns, rising and falling in the warm wind off the coppers like a fleet.".
  Observe laundry_again at laundry_yard when not dark() and visitedBefore(laundry_yard) "The laundry yard: coppers, steam, red arms, and the Season's linen on the lines.".
  Observe laundry_night at laundry_yard when dark() and not at(nan, laundry_yard) "The laundry yard at night: the coppers banked, the linen taken in, and in one window over the yard a candle.".
  Observe laundry_night_nan at laundry_yard when dark() and at(nan, laundry_yard) "The laundry yard at night: the coppers banked, the linen taken in, and on the step under the stair, in the light of one candle in the window over the yard, a woman sitting with her red hands folded, awake.".
  Observe cross_scene at cross_bath when true "The Cross Bath: the old one, open to the sky, a stone cross in the middle of a square of hot green water. The poor bathe here free, in their shifts, and the laundresses come up from below to fill their buckets. It is noisier and much happier than the King's Bath.".
  Observe abbey_scene at abbey_yard when not dark() and not visitedBefore(abbey_yard) "The Abbey Yard, at the foot of the Parade: on one side the great dark front of Saint Ebba's, carved all over with angels climbing ladders; on another the colonnade of the Pump Room; and between them the Parade going up the hill so steeply that the paving is cut into ridges for the chairmen's feet. Everyone here is either ill, or with someone who is, or selling something to both.".
  Observe abbey_again at abbey_yard when not dark() and visitedBefore(abbey_yard) "The Abbey Yard: the church, the Pump Room, the Parade going up the hill, and everybody looking at everybody.".
  Observe abbey_night at abbey_yard when dark() "The Abbey Yard at night, lit by the Pump Room's lamps; the angels on the church front climbing their ladders into the dark.".
  Observe pump_scene at pump_room when not visitedBefore(pump_room) "The Pump Room: a long cool room of pale stone, with tall windows, a gallery for musicians, and at one end a marble urn from which a man in a waistcoat dispenses the hot waters of Hessel by the glass, threepence. Over the urn, in gold letters, WATER IS BEST. Everyone in Hessel comes here at eight in the morning to drink a glass, and grimace, and look at everybody else, and write their names in the great book by the door.".
  Observe pump_again at pump_room when visitedBefore(pump_room) "The Pump Room: the urn, the gold letters, the book by the door, the glasses.".
  Observe bath_scene at kings_bath when true "From the gallery you look down into the King's Bath: a great steaming square of brown water, and standing in it up to their necks, in canvas gowns and canvas hats, thirty of the best people in three counties, bobbing slightly, with little floating trays in front of them for their handkerchiefs and their snuff. Along the gallery rail the rest of the best people watch them, and comment.".
  Observe ebba_scene at ebba_nave when true "Saint Ebba's: a high pale nave full of memorial tablets, put up by the Season to its dead. SACRED TO THE MEMORY of a colonel, a widow, a child, a bishop, all of whom came to Hessel for the waters and are in Hessel still. One tablet only says, HE CAME TOO LATE.".
  Observe vestry_scene at vestry when true "The vestry: surplices on pegs, a table, an inkstand, and the register of banns, which is a thin book, as most people in Hessel marry elsewhere.".
  Observe walk_scene at doctors_walk when not visitedBefore(doctors_walk) "Doctors' Walk: eleven brass plates on eleven doors, eleven physicians to the Season, each of whom will prescribe you the waters, in a different quantity, at a different hour, at a different price.".
  Observe walk_again at doctors_walk when visitedBefore(doctors_walk) "Doctors' Walk: eleven brass plates.".
  Observe hartopp_scene at hartopp_room when true "Dr Hartopp's consulting room: Turkey carpet, a bust of somebody wise, books with uncut pages, and a large chair for the patient that tips back so that the patient is lying down before they know it.".
  Observe apothecary_scene at apothecary when not visitedBefore(apothecary) "The apothecary's: rows of blue and white jars, a pestle as big as a child, scales, and on the counter a row of little brown bottles with handwritten labels waiting to be sent up the hill.".
  Observe apothecary_again at apothecary when visitedBefore(apothecary) "The apothecary's: the jars, the scales, the little brown bottles waiting to go up the hill.".
  Observe parade_scene at parade_top when not dark() and not visitedBefore(parade_top) "The top of the Parade, where the hill levels: you can see the whole of Hessel below you from here, the Baths smoking and the Old Town smoking and the river. Two terraces go off from here, the Crescent to the left and the Circus to the right, and a path goes on up to the downs and the Beacon.".
  Observe parade_again at parade_top when not dark() and visitedBefore(parade_top) "The top of the Parade: the Crescent one way, the Circus the other, the Beacon path going up.".
  Observe parade_night at parade_top when dark() "The top of the Parade at night: the whole town below you in lamps, going down to the black river.".
  Observe circus_scene at circus when not dark() and not visitedBefore(circus) "The Circus: a ring of tall houses round a round lawn, every one alike, columns on columns, so that wherever you stand you are looking at the same house. On one side, the Assembly Rooms; on another, a door with a brass plate, MR S. TWISS, M.C.; on another, the lodgings Mrs Cherrett has taken for the Season.".
  Observe circus_again at circus when not dark() and visitedBefore(circus) "The Circus: the ring of houses, the round lawn, the Rooms on one side and Mrs Cherrett's door on another.".
  Observe circus_night at circus when dark() "The Circus at night: the ring of houses with lamps at every door, and the Rooms lit like a ship.".
  Observe crescent_scene at crescent when not dark() and not visitedBefore(crescent) "The Crescent: thirty houses in one sweep of honey-coloured stone, built all of a piece to be looked at from the lawn below, and full of lodgers looking at one another. At the far end the last house is different. Every shutter of every window of it is closed, and smoke is coming out of all its chimneys, in the warm afternoon.".
  Observe crescent_again at crescent when not dark() and visitedBefore(crescent) "The Crescent: the pale sweep of houses, the lawn, the lodgers, and at the far end, shuttered and smoking, Carth House.".
  Observe crescent_night at crescent when dark() "The Crescent at night: lit windows the whole length of it, and then, at the end, nothing; only Carth House's chimneys against the stars, smoking.".
  Observe beacon_scene at beacon when true "The Beacon walk: turf, sheep, wind, and the whole valley below. This is where Hessel comes to walk in pairs at noon, slowly, to be seen walking in pairs. A road goes off north-west across the down, to Orm.".
  Observe castle_scene at sham_castle when true "The Sham Castle: a castle front, two towers and a gateway and battlements, all very fine from the Crescent, and from up here a single wall one stone thick, propped from behind with timbers, with sheep lying in its shade. Lovers carve their names in the back of it, where nobody in the Crescent can see.".
  Observe wenlock_scene at wenlock_room when true "Lady Wenlock's drawing room: the best lodgings in the Crescent, and too many chairs in them, all of them hard.".
  Observe twiss_scene at twiss_parlour when not visitedBefore(twiss_parlour) "Mr Twiss's parlour: a portrait of Mr Twiss, younger, dancing; a portrait of Mr Twiss, older, not; a framed copy of the Rules of the Rooms; and a great many letters, each tied with ribbon of a colour that means something to Mr Twiss.".
  Observe twiss_again at twiss_parlour when visitedBefore(twiss_parlour) "Mr Twiss's parlour: the two portraits, the Rules, the beribboned letters.".
  Observe vestibule_scene at vestibule when true "The vestibule of the Assembly Rooms: marble, mirrors, a footman, and by the ballroom doors, framed in gold, THE RULES OF THE ROOMS. No boots after six. No lady to dance two dances running with one gentleman, unless betrothed. No introductions but by the Master. No dancing after eleven, though the King himself should ask it. No companion, governess or paid attendant to stand up in the dances. Signed, Septimus Twiss, M.C.".
  Observe ballroom_scene at ballroom when not evening() and not ballNight() "The ballroom, empty: five chandeliers in holland bags, a floor chalked for dancing, the musicians' gallery with its chairs on end.".
  Observe card_scene at card_room when true "The card room is all green baize and lowered voices. The old play whist with great attention to their cards, and none at all to what they are saying across them, which is who danced with whom last night and what it will cost.".
  Observe hut_yard_scene at hut_yard when true "A hurdle fold on the open down, a dog asleep in it with one eye open, and a shepherd's hut on iron wheels with smoke coming out of its pipe. Beyond it the drove track goes off over the turf, and a fainter line, a sheep-walk, goes straight across the down toward the crossways.".
  Observe stile_scene at stile when true "A stile in a hedge on the high down, where the Orm road climbs out of the valley. Hessel is gone behind the brow; there is only grass and sky and larks, and the road going on, and on the top bar of the stile a row of snail shells that someone has lined up by size. A sheep-track goes off sideways to a hut.".
  Observe hut_scene at hut when true "The shepherd's hut is one room and has been heated to the limit of the fire. A woman sits as close to it as she can without being in it, her hands pushed up her sleeves, and in the bed a little girl lies flushed, with her eyes open and too bright, watching the dog under the bed as if he might be the first to go.".
  Observe crossways_scene at crossways when true "The crossways on the high down, where the Orm road meets the drove road. A gibbet stands at the crossing, empty, its chain creaking. Somebody has hung a garland on it.".
  Observe orm_scene at orm_gate when true "The south gate of Orm: a grey wall, a grey gate, a grey town behind it with a grey tower, and over the gate, in letters the College of Physicians paid for, MEDICUS CURAT, NATURA SANAT.".

  // ── The weather of the Season ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // No month is named. It is warm, as Hessel always is in the Season, because the hill is hot from inside.
  Observe steam_dusk at abbey_yard when hour(clock) >= 18 and hour(clock) < 21 "In the evening the steam stands up off the Baths in a pillar, gold, and the bells of Saint Ebba's ring for nothing in particular.".
}
data/adventures/hessel/growth.kyr:
Module hessel "The Banns at Hessel" {
  // ── What the company grows by ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // Experience for what is resolved: a chair stopped, a door opened, a man made brave, a woman let alone.
  Milestone m_chair "stopped Mrs Cherrett's chair" worth 100 when chairCaught(cherrett) or chairSteered(cherrett).
  Milestone m_kit_kept "kept Kit Danby on the poles" worth 50 when kitDefended(kit).
  Milestone m_legs "became Mrs Cherrett's legs" worth 50 when legs(party).
  Milestone m_rooms "got Mrs Cherrett back into the Rooms" worth 150 when householdAdmitted(cherrett).
  Milestone m_brocca "got Signor Brocca up the hill in time" worth 150 when broccaDone(brocca) and twissOwes(party) or broccaDone(brocca) and twissFavour(twiss) >= 2 and broccaSober(brocca).
  Milestone m_fares "settled the chairmen's fares" worth 100 when faresRestored(chairmen).
  Milestone m_stood "stood with the chairmen" worth 100 when stoodWith(party).
  Milestone m_drops_found "found out what was in Mrs Cherrett's drops" worth 100 when knows(party, drops_doubled).
  Milestone m_drops_stopped "kept Mrs Cherrett alive" worth 250 when not doubled(cherrett) and not gone(cherrett) and cameToHessel(party).
  Milestone m_rupert "found out Rupert Wenlock's secret" worth 100 when knows(party, rupert_married).
  Milestone m_family "put Jack in Lady Wenlock's arms" worth 250 when grandmother(lady_wenlock).
  Milestone m_banns "stopped the banns" worth 150 when bannsStopped(ebbas).
  Milestone m_kit_ismay "brought Ismay and Kit to the Sham Castle" worth 200 when kitEngaged(kit).
  Milestone m_blessing "got Mrs Cherrett's blessing on a chairman" worth 200 when cherrettBlessesKit(cherrett).
  Milestone m_poem "made a poem of what was seen" worth 150 when poemGood(rob) and celiaHasPoem(celia).
  Milestone m_knocker "found out who knocks at Carth House" worth 150 when knows(party, nan_is_lady).
  Milestone m_gervase "sat up with Sir Gervase" worth 150 when gervaseTold(gervase).
  Milestone m_celia_out "brought Celia Carth out into the Season" worth 200 when celiaOut(celia).
  Milestone m_mother "brought Celia to her mother" worth 200 when celiaMetMother(celia).
  Milestone m_door "saw the door of Carth House opened" worth 400 when carthReunited(carth).
  Milestone m_ottery "walked Dr Ottery to Orm" worth 150 when ottTurned(party).
  Milestone m_child "stayed while Ottery saw to the shepherd's child" worth 100 when childTreated(party).
  Milestone m_witness "stood witness for Dr Ottery" worth 150 when otteryLicensed(ottery).
  Milestone m_lease "got Mopsa Gedge her house" worth 200 when mopsaHouse(mopsa).
