  Milestone m_companion "kept faith with one who walked with you" worth 300 when marraStaysCohort(party) or marraHome(party) or fennCredit(party) or dunyaReported(party) or dunyaStaysKell(party) or ioneKeeper(party) or ioneSafe(party) or ioneTrust(ione) >= 3 or fennTrust(fenn_hallam) >= 3.
  Rule jory_comes when marraBoth(party) and at(party, green) and at(jory, apothecary)
    says "A lanky young man in a patched jerkin is standing at the trough with a bundle, looking at thirty houses with his mouth open. A woman with a crook is walking up the lane to meet him. Neither of them says anything. The goats do." {
    Retract at(jory, apothecary). Assert at(jory, green). }
  Rule delegation_met when at(party, green) and at(delegates, green) and not delegationCame(party) { Assert delegationCame(party). }
  Rule column_met when at(party, green) and at(column, green) and not columnCame(party) { Assert columnCame(party). }
  Relation columnCame(group).
  Observe wait_delegation at green when told_ostrander(party) and not delegationCame(party) "Greta Hennick has put a second lamp in the window. 'If they're coming,' she says, 'they'll be along in a few days. Sit.'".
  Observe wait_column at green when told_merula(party) and not columnCame(party) "The reeve keeps going to the north end of the village and looking up the road, and coming back, and going again.".
  Observe end_dunya_home at causeway3 when dunyaHome(party) "A wheel is scratched on the guard-post's lintel, new, in a hand that is used to it. Under it, a tally of one.".
  Milestone m_lore "carried the valley's history out of the valley" worth 200 when knows(party, school_changes) or knows(party, spring_pact) or knows(party, forgery_known) or knows(party, brass_known) or knows(party, two_sendings_known) or knows(party, viator_told).
  Milestone m_tavi "took a boy south" worth 200 when following(tavi, party).

  // The endings of a crossing. None is a verdict.
  Query waiting() means (told_ostrander(party) and not delegationCame(party)) or (told_merula(party) and not columnCame(party)).
  Query southSide() means within(party, passland) or within(party, cohort) or at(party, via_s) or at(party, eagle) or at(party, bog) or at(party, hollow) or at(party, rubble) or at(party, river_s) or at(party, parapet).
  Relation dispatchKept(group). Measure dispatchAt(group).
  Rule dispatch_waits when dispatchTaken(party) and not dispatchSent(party) and at(party, green) and dispatchAt(party) == 0 { Set dispatchAt(party) to watch(clock). }
  Rule dispatch_kept_rule when dispatchTaken(party) and not dispatchSent(party) and not dispatchKept(party) and at(party, green) and dispatchAt(party) > 0 and watch(clock) >= dispatchAt(party) + 36
    says "The reeve has stood at his board for most of a morning, looking at the pouch in your pack and not asking. In the end he goes back to his hammer." { Assert dispatchKept(party). }
  Query backAtFord() means been(party, forum) and at(party, green) and not travelsWith(dunya, party) and (dispatchSent(party) or not dispatchTaken(party) or dispatchKept(party)) and not waiting() and not delegationCame(party) and not columnCame(party).
  Ending ending_turned "Turned Back at the Viaduct" when lateSeason() and not been(party, via_s) and (at(party, octavius_hall) or at(party, via_n)) "The snow came down on the seventh day with the Viaduct still a white line ahead. You turned at Octavius with what you had left and the wind in the vault. The road will be there in the spring.".
  Ending ending_snowed "Snowed In at the Last Cohort" when lateSeason() and southSide() and been(party, via_s) and not knows(party, ropeway_known) "The passes shut behind you on the seventh day. The Cohort found you a bed in the barracks and a place at the Hearth's table on the Hearth's day and the Eagles' on the Eagles'. Octa Draycott wants to know whether you can knead. The Sending goes in the spring, and you may ask to walk with it, or not.".
  Ending ending_boy "A Boy Follows You South" when backAtFord() and following(tavi, party) "You came down to the trough at Kell Ford with a boy of eleven and a loaf, and he stood by the water looking at a tree. Greta Hennick says he can have the loft. Nobody has asked him what the Cohort is, and he has not said.".
  Query lostMarra() means marraStaysCohort(party) or marraHome(party) or (marraAngry(party) and not travelsWith(marra, party)).
  Query lostIone() means ioneFell(party) or ioneKeeper(party) or ioneHome(party).
  Query lostOne() means lostMarra() or lostIone() or fennGone(party).
  Query plainReturn() means backAtFord() and not following(tavi, party) and not lostOne() and not dispatchKept(party).
  Ending ending_fewer_marra "One Fewer, and She Chose It" when backAtFord() and not following(tavi, party) and lostMarra() "You came back to the Ford one fewer than you left it. Greta Hennick looks past you at the north road for a time, and then at the board, where the reeve is already writing something in a small neat hand that is not a name and not a verdict. 'She chose,' you say. The reeve says that is the only kind he can write down.".
  Ending ending_fewer_ione "One Fewer, and the Bell Not Rung" when backAtFord() and not following(tavi, party) and not lostMarra() and lostIone() "You came back to the Ford one fewer than you left it, and nobody asked which of the roads had it. The reeve pinned a slip. Greta Hennick lit the second lamp in the window without saying for whom, and you did not ask her not to.".
  Ending ending_fewer "With One Fewer" when backAtFord() and not following(tavi, party) and not lostMarra() and not lostIone() and lostOne() "You came back to the Ford one fewer than you left it. The reeve asks where the other one is. You tell him. He writes it on the board.".
  Ending ending_struck "What the Standard Cost" when plainReturn() and told_prefect(party) and not prefectReadSeal(party) and not marraBoth(party) and not goldReturned(party) "You came down to the trough at Kell Ford with the whole of the valley's grief still on your coat. The Prefect struck the standard the morning after you spoke. The Eagles took the Praetorium by noon, and the Sending, which had been put off for the weather, went north in the third week with every lot at once, and the passes were shut behind it. Dame Orsa's boy who sorted the herbs was in it. Nobody at Kell Ford can say that the news was not true. Greta Hennick asks whether it is as they say, and you cannot find a way to answer that is not about someone.".
  Ending ending_struck_jory "What the Standard Cost, and Who Was Spared It" when plainReturn() and told_prefect(party) and not prefectReadSeal(party) and marraBoth(party) and not goldReturned(party) "You came down to the trough at Kell Ford with the whole of the valley's grief still on your coat. The Prefect struck the standard the morning after you spoke. The Eagles took the Praetorium by noon, and the Sending, which had been put off for the weather, went north in the third week with every lot at once, and the passes were shut behind it. Dame Orsa's new boy was in it, the one who took Jory's place at the herb-table. Jory sits on the trough with his sister and does not ask whose place that was. Greta Hennick asks whether it is as they say, and you cannot find a way to answer that is not about someone.".
  Ending ending_slow "The Prefect Takes It Down by Degrees" when plainReturn() and told_prefect(party) and prefectReadSeal(party) and not goldReturned(party) "The standard comes down a hand a week now. The Prefect told nobody he had read the letter, and told you. Nothing broke; the market has its shutters open and its prices. At Kell Ford the reeve asks for the news, and you give it to him in the order he would write it on the board.".
  Ending ending_unsent "The Letter Kept" when backAtFord() and dispatchKept(party) and not following(tavi, party) and not lostOne() "The Prefect's dispatch is still sealed in your pack. The reeve did not ask for it, and you did not offer, and it goes on being the only thing in Kell Ford that was written to be read by someone. Greta Hennick lights the second lamp that night, and does not say for whom. It may be you.".
  Ending ending_golden "The Wing Goes Home" when plainReturn() and goldReturned(party) "Behind you the standard in the forum has a gold wing, and the Hearth has barred its granary against you from the inside: it is the only quarrel in the valley that has a new side. You carried a thing home that nobody had asked you to carry. At Kell Ford Greta Hennick wants to hear what the wing is like, and you tell her, and she says the lamp is not for that.".
  Ending ending_left "The Cohort Reached and Left" when plainReturn() and told_elpis(party) and not told_prefect(party) and not goldReturned(party) "A sixth of the barley that goes north in the spring will not go now. You told that to one woman at a scale, and she said she would think about it, and you did not wait to hear what. The loft at the Last Fire has been made up. Nobody at the Ford asks, and the talk in the taproom is of snow.".
  Ending ending_silent "Reached, and Said Nothing" when plainReturn() and not valleyTold(party) and not goldReturned(party) "You said nothing in the forum, and the forum said nothing to you. At Kell Ford the lamp was lit before you reached the trough, as it is lit every spring, and you walked under it. The board has no new name on it, and none crossed out.".
  Ending ending_rider "Someone Comes Down the Road" when told_ostrander(party) and delegationCame(party) and at(party, green) and not lostOne() and not following(tavi, party) "Three red cloaks come down the north road with a wheel on their packs. Greta Hennick's second lamp is already lit. The reeve, whom nobody has told anything, says: 'You'll be wanting feeding.' The one in front says that they were told to answer.".
  Ending ending_rider_fewer "Someone Comes Down the Road, and Counts" when told_ostrander(party) and delegationCame(party) and at(party, green) and lostOne() "Three red cloaks come down the north road behind you, and Greta Hennick counts the party at the trough, and counts again. The reeve writes the name that is missing. The one in front says that they were told to answer, and asks, civilly, which of you it was they were meant to answer to.".
  Ending ending_rider_boy "Someone Comes Down the Road, and a Boy" when told_ostrander(party) and delegationCame(party) and at(party, green) and following(tavi, party) and not lostOne() "Three red cloaks come down the north road, and the boy of eleven who came south with you stands still on the edge of the trough with a loaf. The one in front says that they were told to answer. He looks at the boy for some time, and then says, in careful plain-speech, that the baker will be wanting him back.".
  Ending ending_column"The First Century Comes South" when told_merula(party) and columnCame(party) and at(party, green) "Six red cloaks halt at the trough in ranks, with a horn. The Centurion sets down her cane and asks whether anyone is there. Greta Hennick says she supposes they will want feeding. It is the first time in eleven centuries that an army has arrived anywhere to find that it was expected.".
}
data/adventures/muster/finds.kyr:
Module muster "The Long Muster's Road" {
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // The legion's milestones: the numbers count down toward the Last, and say how far.
  Discovery days_known "The legion's milestones count the road down in cables, and the engineers' reckoning was three days' march from the Ford to the Last.".
  Observe milestone_causeway at causeway1 as sign when true "A milestone stands at the causeway's head, the wheel and a number cut in it. A later hand has scratched under it: THREE DAYS TO THE LAST." teaches days_known.
  Observe milestone_far at via_s as sign when true "The abutment's milestone: LXIII, in the legion's square capitals, and the wheel." teaches days_known.

  // What grows.
  Thing gorge_comfrey "the comfrey" at gorge1 is scenery { State growing "Comfrey grows in the wet below the road, tall hairy leaves and hanging bells.". }
  Initially Assert grows(gorge_comfrey).
  Discovery gorge_comfrey_hid "The gorge's comfrey is gathered, not found.".
  Item gorge_comfrey_1 "a bunch of comfrey" is comfrey in gorge_comfrey hidden until gorge_comfrey_hid.
  Initially Assert crop(gorge_comfrey_1, gorge_comfrey).
  Thing gorge_bruisewort "the bruisewort" at gorge1 is scenery { State growing "Bruisewort grows in the cracks of the old paving, thick leaves and small purple flowers.". }
  Initially Assert grows(gorge_bruisewort).
  Discovery gorge_bruisewort_hid "The gorge's bruisewort is gathered, not found.".
  Item gorge_bruisewort_1 "a handful of bruisewort" is bruisewort_gathered in gorge_bruisewort hidden until gorge_bruisewort_hid.
  Initially Assert crop(gorge_bruisewort_1, gorge_bruisewort).
  Thing high_heather "the heather" at high1 is scenery { State growing "Heather lies over the shoulder of the fell in low wiry purple-pink bells.". }
  Initially Assert grows(high_heather).
  Discovery high_heather_hid "The heather on the High Road is gathered, not found.".
  Item high_heather_1 "a bundle of heather" is heather in high_heather hidden until high_heather_hid.
  Initially Assert crop(high_heather_1, high_heather).
  Thing ledge_gentian "the gentian" at ledge1 is scenery { State growing "Gentian grows in the rock crevices of the Ledge, the deepest blue in the fells.". }
  Initially Assert grows(ledge_gentian).
  Discovery ledge_gentian_hid "The Ledge's gentian is gathered, not found.".
  Item ledge_gentian_1 "a blue gentian" is gentian_gathered in ledge_gentian hidden until ledge_gentian_hid.
  Initially Assert crop(ledge_gentian_1, ledge_gentian).
  Thing ledge_alhuren "the alhuren" at ledge2 is scenery { State growing "Alhuren grows where the Ledge narrows, silver-leaved, with blue flowers that give back a faint light.". }
  Initially Assert grows(ledge_alhuren).
  Discovery ledge_alhuren_hid "The Ledge's alhuren is gathered, not found.".
  Item ledge_alhuren_1 "a spray of alhuren" is alhuren_gathered in ledge_alhuren hidden until ledge_alhuren_hid.
  Initially Assert crop(ledge_alhuren_1, ledge_alhuren).
  Thing bog_cloudberry "the cloudberry" at bog is scenery { State growing "Cloudberry grows on the hummocks, a single amber berry to a plant.". }
  Initially Assert grows(bog_cloudberry).
  Discovery bog_cloudberry_hid "The bog's cloudberry is gathered, not found.".
  Item bog_cloudberry_1 "a handful of cloudberries" is cloudberry in bog_cloudberry hidden until bog_cloudberry_hid.
  Initially Assert crop(bog_cloudberry_1, bog_cloudberry).
  Item bog_cloudberry_2 "a handful of cloudberries" is cloudberry in bog_cloudberry hidden until bog_cloudberry_hid.
  Initially Assert crop(bog_cloudberry_2, bog_cloudberry).
  Thing hollow_kingsfoil "the kingsfoil" at hollow is scenery { State growing "Kingsfoil grows in the warm green turf of the hollow, a low three-leaved herb with a clean sharp scent.". }
  Initially Assert grows(hollow_kingsfoil).
  Discovery hollow_kingsfoil_hid "The hollow's kingsfoil is gathered, not found.".
  Item hollow_kingsfoil_1 "a sprig of kingsfoil" is kingsfoil in hollow_kingsfoil hidden until hollow_kingsfoil_hid.
  Initially Assert crop(hollow_kingsfoil_1, hollow_kingsfoil).
  Item hollow_kingsfoil_2 "a sprig of kingsfoil" is kingsfoil in hollow_kingsfoil hidden until hollow_kingsfoil_hid.
  Initially Assert crop(hollow_kingsfoil_2, hollow_kingsfoil).

  // What the legion left, and the road's travellers after it.
  Item track_piton "a rusted piton" is piton at track2.
  Item guard_harness "a legion harness, stiff" is climbing_harness at causeway3.
  Item septimus_spyglass "a spyglass in a niche" is spyglass at septimus_hall.
  Item septimus_oil "a flask of lamp oil" is lamp_oil at septimus_hall.
  Item septimus_blanket "a soldier's blanket" is blanket at septimus_hall.
  Item septimus_coin "a dull steel coin" is steel_coin at septimus_hall.
  Item octavius_glossary "a scribe's glossary of the old script" is old_glossary in satchel.
  Item octavius_ward "a scribe's wardstone" is wardstone in satchel.
  Thing satchel "the scribe's satchel" at octavius_hall {
    State hanging closed "A leather satchel hangs on a peg by the scribe's bench, buckled.".
    State open "The satchel hangs open, and a book and a stone lie in it.".
    Change open_satchel "Unbuckle the scribe's satchel" from hanging to open.
    Holds.
  }
  Item eagle_silver "a season of the Toll" is toll_silver at eagle.
  Item eagle_coin "a dull steel coin" is steel_coin at eagle.
  Item eagle_map "an ancient map of the road" is ancient_map at eagle.
  Item eagle_faded "a faded map, one corner burnt" is faded_map at eagle.
  Item pouch_a "a courier's pouch" is courier_pouch at eagle.
  Item pouch_b "a courier's pouch" is courier_pouch at eagle.
  Item pouch_c "a courier's pouch" is courier_pouch at eagle.
  Kind courier_pouch "a courier's pouch" is document teaching pouch_read described "A leather pouch sealed with a wheel, addressed in a clear square hand. It has waited eleven hundred years for a reply.".
  Discovery pouch_read "The pouch is addressed to the Emperor at Aen-Vessaly from the Prefect of the Last Cohort, and dated: the eleven hundred and fourth year of his reign.".
  Item roadhouse_waystone "a waystone, dragged in for a doorstop" is dun_rierdan_waystone at roadhouse.
  Item hollow_lamp "a lamp left in the hollow" is lamp at hollow.
  Observe eagle_pouches at eagle as sign when true "The courier-pouches are stacked in the angle of the wall as they were left, by someone who had come to the end of the road that the north had no longer.".
  Observe eagle_arch at eagle when knows(party, pouch_read) "The tags on the pouches all say the same: TO THE EMPEROR, WITH THE COHORT'S DUTY, AND A REQUEST FOR AN ANSWER.".
}
data/adventures/muster/places.kyr:
Module muster "The Long Muster's Road" {
  Description "Three days of broken Aenean road over the Hesper Fells, from Kell Ford to the valley of the Last Cohort.".

  Place fells "the Hesper Fells" is region within imbar.
  Place kell "Kell Ford" is settlement within fells at 0, 4.
  Place lowroads "the three roads of the first day" is wilderness within fells at 0, 3.
  Place heights "the heights of the second day" is wilderness within fells at 1, 2.
  Place viaduct "the Great Viaduct" is wilderness within fells at 2, 2.
  Place passland "the Giant's Pass" is wilderness within fells at 3, 1.
  Place cohort "the valley of the Last Cohort" is settlement within fells at 4, 0.
  Place septimus "the Mansio Septimus" is building within lowroads.
  Place octavius "the Mansio Octavius" is building within heights.
  Place lastfire "the Last Fire" is building within kell.
  Place kellstore "Pryor's store" is building within kell.
  Place praetorium "the Praetorium" is building within cohort.
  Place archive_h "the Archive" is building within cohort.
  Place apothecary_h "the apothecary" is building within cohort.
  Place prefect_h "the Prefect's house" is building within cohort.

  // Kell Ford.
  Place road "the Kell road" is room within kell at 0, 0 outdoors.
  Place green "Kell green" is room within kell at 1, 0 outdoors.
  Place taproom "the Last Fire" is room within lastfire at 2, 0.
  Place counter "Pryor's counter" is room within kellstore at 1, 1.
  // Day one.
  Place gorge1 "the Low Road gorge" is room within lowroads at 0, 0 outdoors.
  Place gorge2 "the flooded bend" is room within lowroads at 0, 1 outdoors.
  Place causeway1 "the head of the Old Causeway" is room within lowroads at 1, 0 outdoors.
  Place causeway2 "the long middle of the causeway" is room within lowroads at 1, 1 outdoors.
  Place causeway3 "the end of the causeway" is room within lowroads at 1, 2 outdoors.
  Place track1 "the goatherds' track" is room within lowroads at 2, 0 outdoors.
  Place track2 "the steep of the track" is room within lowroads at 2, 1 outdoors.
  Place septimus_hall "the Mansio Septimus" is room within septimus at 3, 3.
  // Day two.
  Place high1 "the foot of the High Road" is room within heights at 0, 0 outdoors.
  Place high2 "the open stretch of the High Road" is room within heights at 0, 1 outdoors.
  Place eyrie "the wyvern's eyrie" is room within heights at 1, 1 outdoors.
  Place gallery1 "the mouth of the Gallery" is room within heights at 2, 0 outdoors.
  Place gallery2 "the dark of the Gallery" is room within heights at 2, 1 underground.
  Place gallery3 "the Third Arch" is room within heights at 2, 2 underground.
  Place ledge1 "the Ledge" is room within heights at 3, 0 outdoors.
  Place ledge2 "the end of the Ledge" is room within heights at 3, 1 outdoors.
  Place octavius_hall "the Mansio Octavius" is room within octavius at 1, 3.
  // Day three.
  Place via_n "the north head of the Viaduct" is room within viaduct at 0, 0 outdoors.
  Place parapet "the parapet of the fifth arch" is room within viaduct at 1, 0 outdoors.
  Place river_n "the river beneath the Viaduct, north bank" is room within viaduct at 0, 1 outdoors.
  Place river_s "the river beneath the Viaduct, south bank" is room within viaduct at 0, 2 outdoors.
  Place rubble "the fallen arch" is room within viaduct at 1, 1 outdoors.
  Place via_s "the south abutment" is room within viaduct at 1, 3 outdoors.
  Place eagle "the Mansio of the Eagle" is room within viaduct at 2, 3 outdoors.
  Place bog "the cloudberry bog" is room within viaduct at 3, 2 outdoors.
  Place hollow "the sheltered hollow" is room within viaduct at 3, 3 outdoors.
  // Day four.
  Place pass_n "the foot of the Giant's Pass" is room within passland at 0, 0 outdoors.
  Place roadhouse "the road-house" is room within passland at 1, 0 outdoors.
  Place goat_path "the goat path above the road-house" is room within passland at 1, 1 outdoors.
  Place pass_s "the head of the descent" is room within passland at 2, 0 outdoors.
  // Day five: the Cohort.
  Place descent "the Long Descent" is room within passland at 3, 0 outdoors.
  Place gate "the gate of the Last Cohort" is room within cohort at 0, 0 outdoors.
  Place forum "the forum" is room within cohort at 1, 0 outdoors.
  Place praetorium_hall "the Praetorium" is room within praetorium at 2, 0.
  Place barracks "the barracks yard" is room within cohort at 1, 1 outdoors.
  Place granary "the granary" is room within cohort at 0, 2.
  Place apothecary "the apothecary" is room within apothecary_h at 2, 2.
  Place archive "the Archive" is room within archive_h at 3, 1.
  Place prefect_room "the Prefect's room" is room within prefect_h at 3, 0.
  Place shrine "the shrine of the Eagle" is room within cohort at 2, 1.
  Place terraces "the vineyard terraces" is room within cohort at 0, 1 outdoors.
  Place schola "the Cohort's schola" is room within cohort at 4, 1.
  Place salt_market "the salt-market" is room within cohort at 4, 0 outdoors.
  Place pistrina "the pistrina" is room within cohort at 3, 2.
  Place wall_walk "the wall-walk" is room within cohort at 0, 3 outdoors.
  Place sending_gate "the Sending gate" is room within cohort at 1, 3 outdoors.
  Place tally_yard "the Tally-yard" is room within cohort at 2, 2 outdoors.
  Place gold_cellar "the old farm under the terraces" is room within cohort at 0, 4.

  Relation exposed(place).
  Place nowhere "the place gifts come from" is room within lowroads at 9, 9.
  Initially Assert exposed(gorge1). Initially Assert exposed(gorge2). Initially Assert exposed(causeway1).
  Initially Assert exposed(causeway2). Initially Assert exposed(causeway3). Initially Assert exposed(track1).
  Initially Assert exposed(track2). Initially Assert exposed(high1). Initially Assert exposed(high2).
  Initially Assert exposed(eyrie). Initially Assert exposed(gallery1). Initially Assert exposed(ledge1).
  Initially Assert exposed(ledge2). Initially Assert exposed(via_n). Initially Assert exposed(parapet).
  Initially Assert exposed(river_n). Initially Assert exposed(river_s). Initially Assert exposed(rubble).
  Initially Assert exposed(via_s). Initially Assert exposed(eagle). Initially Assert exposed(bog).
  Initially Assert exposed(hollow). Initially Assert exposed(pass_n). Initially Assert exposed(roadhouse).
  Initially Assert exposed(goat_path). Initially Assert exposed(pass_s). Initially Assert exposed(descent).
  Initially Assert unlit(gallery2). Initially Assert unlit(gallery3).
 

  // ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Passage kell_road "the Kell road" is road between road and green taking 20 minutes.
  Passage fire_door "the door of the Last Fire" is door between green and taproom.
  Passage store_door "Pryor's door" is door between green and counter.
  // The first day.
  Passage low_road "the Low Road" is path between green and gorge1 taking 2 hours.
  Passage low_bend "the Low Road, deeper" is path between gorge1 and gorge2 taking 4 hours.
  Passage low_out "the end of the gorge" is passage between gorge2 and septimus_hall taking 2 hours.
  Passage causeway_in "the Old Causeway" is road between green and causeway1 taking 2 hours.
  Passage causeway_a "the Causeway, onward" is road between causeway1 and causeway2 taking 6 hours.
  Passage causeway_b "the Causeway, further on" is road between causeway2 and causeway3 taking 6 hours.
  Passage causeway_out "the Causeway's last mile" is passage between causeway3 and septimus_hall taking 2 hours.
  Passage track_in "the goatherds' track" is path between green and track1 taking 2 hours needing wayfinding.
  Passage track_up "the steep" is path between track1 and track2 taking 4 hours needing climbing or rope.
  Passage track_out "the track down to the Mansio" is passage between track2 and septimus_hall taking 2 hours.
  // The second day.
  Passage high_in "the High Road" is passage between septimus_hall and high1 taking 1 hour.
  Passage high_on "the open High Road" is road between high1 and high2 taking 4 hours.
  Passage high_out "the High Road's end" is passage between high2 and octavius_hall taking 2 hours.
  Passage eyrie_climb "the scree up to the eyrie" is path between high2 and eyrie taking 2 hours needing climbing.
  Passage gallery_in "the Gallery" is passage between septimus_hall and gallery1 taking 1 hour.
  Passage gallery_a "into the Gallery" is tunnel between gallery1 and gallery2 taking 2 hours.
  Passage gallery_b "the Gallery, further in" is tunnel between gallery2 and gallery3 taking 2 hours.
  Passage gallery_out "out of the Gallery" is passage between gallery3 and octavius_hall taking 2 hours.
  Passage ledge_in "the Ledge" is passage between septimus_hall and ledge1 taking 1 hour needing wayfinding.
  Passage ledge_a "along the Ledge" is path between ledge1 and ledge2 taking 6 hours
    opening when not state(sky, snow_sky) "Snow lies along the Ledge in a clean unbroken line, and nothing goes along it under snow.".
  Passage ledge_out "off the Ledge" is passage between ledge2 and octavius_hall taking 2 hours.
  // The third day.
  Passage via_in "the road to the Viaduct" is passage between octavius_hall and via_n taking 2 hours.
  Passage via_parapet "the parapet" is passage between via_n and parapet taking 2 hours
    opening when lineFixed(party) "The parapet is a foot and a half of stone over four hundred feet of air, and there is no line on it."
    opening when not lateSeason() "Snow has closed the fifth arch. Nothing crosses it until the thaw.".
  Passage via_parapet_out "the parapet, onward" is passage between parapet and via_s taking 2 hours.
  Passage via_down "down the north pier" is ladder between via_n and river_n taking 2 hours needing rope opening when not lateSeason() "Snow has closed the fifth arch. Nothing crosses it until the thaw.".
  Passage river_ford "the river" is ford between river_n and river_s taking 1 hour.
  Passage via_up "up the south abutment" is ladder between river_s and via_s taking 2 hours needing climbing.
  Passage rubble_in "down on to the fallen arch" is path between via_n and rubble taking 1 hour opening when not lateSeason() "Snow has closed the fifth arch. Nothing crosses it until the thaw.".
  Passage rubble_out "over the fallen arch" is path between rubble and via_s taking 2 hours needing climbing.
  Passage via_eagle "the road to the Eagle" is road between via_s and eagle taking 1 hour.
  Passage bog_path "the bog path" is path between eagle and bog taking 20 minutes.
  Passage hollow_path "the way behind the fort" is path between eagle and hollow taking 20 minutes.
  Passage ropeway "the Cohort's rope-way" is passage between via_n and via_s taking 20 minutes hidden until ropeway_known.
  // The fourth day.
  Passage pass_in "the road to the Pass" is road between eagle and pass_n taking 4 hours.
  Passage pass_through "the road through the road-house" is road between pass_n and roadhouse taking 20 minutes.
  Passage pass_on "past the road-house" is road between roadhouse and pass_s taking 20 minutes.
  Passage goat_up "up the goat path" is path between pass_n and goat_path taking 2 hours needing climbing.
  Passage goat_down "down the goat path" is path between goat_path and pass_s taking 2 hours.
  // The fifth day.
  Passage descend_in "the Long Descent" is road between pass_s and descent taking 6 hours.
  Passage descend_gate "the road to the gate" is road between descent and gate taking 20 minutes.
  Passage gate_forum "the gate of the Last Cohort" is gate between gate and forum.
  Passage forum_praetorium "the Praetorium steps" is steps between forum and praetorium_hall taking 1 hour.
  Passage prefect_door "the Prefect's door" is door between praetorium_hall and prefect_room taking 30 minutes.
  Passage forum_barracks "the barracks yard" is road between forum and barracks taking 1 hour.
  Passage barracks_granary "the granary lane" is road between barracks and granary taking 1 hour opening when not goldReturned(party) "The granary door is barred from the inside. The Hearth does not open it to the one who carried their wing across the forum.".
  Passage forum_apothecary "the apothecary's door" is door between forum and apothecary taking 1 hour.
  Passage forum_archive "the archive door" is door between forum and archive taking 1 hour.
  Passage forum_shrine "the shrine steps" is steps between forum and shrine taking 1 hour opening when not told_elpis(party) "The Eagles have barred the shrine to anyone who carried the Hearth's news to the granary. Two men stand on the steps with their arms folded.".
  Passage forum_terraces "the terraces" is path between forum and terraces taking 2 hours.
  Passage forum_schola "the schola door" is door between forum and schola taking 1 hour.
  Passage forum_market "the salt-market" is road between forum and salt_market taking 30 minutes opening when not told_prefect(party) or prefectReadSeal(party) "The salt-market is shuttered. A strip of black cloth is nailed across the door, and Rhea\'s steelyard is gone from the trestle.".
  Passage forum_pistrina "the pistrina door" is door between forum and pistrina taking 30 minutes.
  Passage forum_wall "the wall stair" is steps between forum and wall_walk taking 1 hour.
  Passage wall_sending "the Sending gate" is steps between wall_walk and sending_gate taking 1 hour.
  Passage barracks_tally "the Tally-yard gate" is gate between barracks and tally_yard taking 1 hour.
  Passage terraces_cellar "the trap in the vine-house floor" is steps between terraces and gold_cellar taking 1 hour hidden until gold_known.
}
data/adventures/muster/scenes.kyr:
Module muster "The Long Muster's Road" {
  Observe road_scene at road when true "The road comes up out of the lowlands to a ford and a huddle of grey houses with the fells standing behind them like a wall. A paved road, wider than any farm road, goes into the mountains from the far side of the village and is lost in a mile.".
  Observe green_scene at green when true "Kell Ford is thirty houses round a trough. The last fire in the country that anyone will admit to burns in the inn, and the store sells rope and pitons to people who are not going anywhere. A notice-board stands by the trough. Three ways leave the green for the hills: a gorge, a causeway, a goat track.".
  Observe taproom_scene at taproom when true "A long low room with a hearth big enough to roast a goat, which is what it is for. Every beam has a name cut in it, and a date, and a place: Septimus, Octavius, the Eagle. Nobody has added one in thirty years.".
  Observe counter_scene at counter when true "A store of rope, spikes, felt, firewood and tents, kept by Gil Pryor, who has never seen anyone finish the journey he equips.".

  Observe gorge1_scene at gorge1 when true "The Low Road follows a river into a gorge so narrow that the old paving is broken where the walls have leaned in. The water is loud and clear. Comfrey grows in the wet below the road, and bruisewort in its cracks.".
  Observe gorge2_scene at gorge2 when true "The gorge bends and the road goes under the river at the bend, paved still, a thumb of water over it in a dry week. In the walls above, a high-water line of silt and dead grass shows where the river has been in thaw.".
  Observe causeway1_scene at causeway1 when true "The Old Causeway runs along the top of a ridge on a bank of packed stone, dry and straight and far longer than the gorge. Every mile there is a milestone with a wheel and a number cut in it, and the numbers count down.".
  Observe causeway2_scene at causeway2 when true "Open ridge in every direction, with the road a pale line through heather. A dead sheep lies on the paving, not eaten but opened, and tracks cross the road in the dust: broad, four toes, no claw-marks to the front. A wolf's.".
  Observe causeway3_scene at causeway3 when true "The causeway dips toward a hollow where the last stones of a guard-post stand. Beyond it, in a fold of the hill, a roof.".
  Observe track1_scene at track1 when true "A path no wider than a goat, climbing the hill on the west of the gorge among rocks the goats have worn smooth. Nothing marks it. If you did not know it you would not find it.".
  Observe track2_scene at track2 when true "The goatherds' track goes straight up a face of broken rock where the goats go and people have to think. Pitons have been driven in the cracks, rusty and certain.".
  Observe septimus_scene at septimus_hall when true "The Mansio Septimus is a day's march from anywhere and has a roof: a long hall with a cracked vault, a hearth, and a wall of soldiers' scratches. SEPTIMUS, the lintel says, and under it a cohort and a count of days since the last pay. Three roads leave: the High Road, the Gallery, the Ledge.".

  Observe high1_scene at high1 when true "The High Road goes up on to a bare shoulder of the fell and is the plainest road in the world: paved, wide, dry, and open to the sky for as far as the eye goes. The old soldiers' road-menders cut a covered shelter into the rock here, a stone's throw off the road, and nobody has put anything in it.".
  Observe high2_scene at high2 when true "The open stretch. There is nowhere to stand but on the road. Bones lie in the paving's cracks, small ones, bleached, and a smear of white lime on a boulder. On the wide flag you are standing on is a stain the shape of a man, and it is not old.".
  Observe eyrie_scene at eyrie when true "A shelf of rock on the shoulder of the fell, strewn with bones and half-crushed stone. A heap of bracken, charred where something breathes on it, is nest enough for the one thing that lives here.".
  Observe gallery1_scene at gallery1 when true "A mouth in the fell, arched in dressed stone, with the legion's wheel cut over it. Cold, stale air breathes out. A mule would balk at the dark, and so does the goatherd.".
  Observe gallery2_scene at gallery2 when true "The Gallery: a paved tunnel cut by legionary engineers through the heart of the fell, a mile of it, black. The air is thick and sweet. A candle gutters low.".
  Observe gallery3_scene at gallery3 when true "A great arch, the third in the Gallery, where the legion's engineers put a bridge over a crack in the mountain. The roadway is paved and level. The span has been rotting since the legions went.".
  Observe ledge1_scene at ledge1 when true "A shelf cut into the cliff above the High Road, narrow, no more than the width of a man and a mule, the legion's survey path for the road-menders. It is out of the sight of the sky from above, and the stoop of a wyvern cannot find it.".
  Observe ledge2_scene at ledge2 when true "The Ledge narrows. Below it the fell drops to a green valley, three thousand feet. The old hand-rail sockets are cut at every pace and there is no rail in them.".
  Observe octavius_scene at octavius_hall when true "The Mansio Octavius: a roofed hall in the lee of a rock, one wall gone to the sky, a hearth, and a scribe's bench. A satchel hangs on a peg. OCTAVIUS, says the lintel, and the number of days since the last pay is larger than at Septimus.".

  Observe via_n_scene at via_n when true "The road runs out on to the Great Viaduct and stops. Nine arches carried it over the river four hundred feet below; the fifth has gone. The paving ends on air, and on the far side of the gap the road begins again, as if nothing had happened. The wind comes up the gap in a long roar.".
  Observe parapet_scene at parapet when true "The parapet, a foot and a half of dressed stone along the broken edge, with the wind trying to peel you off it. Pitons driven in a crack of the parapet make something to clip to.".
  Observe rubble_scene at rubble when true "The fallen fifth arch lies in the gorge in a slope of blocks as big as carts, leaning on the north pier. Climb it, and the other side is a wall.".
  Observe river_n_scene at river_n when true "The river runs between the piers of the Viaduct, loud and brown, and the north bank is a bar of shingle. Overhead the nine arches go away like a row of teeth with one missing.".
  Observe river_s_scene at river_s when true "The south bank of the river, a cobble beach under the abutment. The stonework goes up, sheer, with iron rungs let into it once, and a few left.".
  Observe via_s_scene at via_s when true "The far end of the Viaduct, with the road beginning again. A single milestone stands at the abutment, the legion's wheel cut on it, and under it in a later hand: A DAY TO THE LAST. The paving beyond is swept in places, by someone, once a year.".
  Observe eagle_scene at eagle when true "The Mansio of the Eagle is a fort of dressed stone with its roof off: four walls, a gate-arch, and the sky. Stacks of leather courier-pouches lie in the angle of the wall, rotted and sealed, each tagged in a clear square hand. An eagle is cut over the gate, and a wheel under it.".
  Observe bog_scene at bog when true "A bog of red moss and standing water behind the fort, with cloudberry on the hummocks, the amber fruit just showing among the leaves.".
  Observe hollow_scene at hollow when true "A hollow behind the fort, out of the wind, with a stand of thorn and a patch of green turf that stays green. The air here is warmer than it ought to be.".

  Observe pass_n_scene at pass_n when true "The road climbs to a notch in the fell where two crags nearly meet. On the crag is a house, and the road goes through the house. There are very large footprints in the snow-melt and the dung of a creature that eats grass and bone.".
  Observe roadhouse_scene at roadhouse when true "The road-house of the Pass: a hall of dressed stone built to hold a hundred soldiers, which holds one giant. The roof is up. The road goes in at one door and out at another, through the middle of a room full of heaped fleeces and the biggest hearth in the fells.".
  Observe goat_path_scene at goat_path when true "A shelf on the crag above the road-house, with a roof of rock and a view down through the smoke-hole to the giant's hearth. The goat path goes along it in a line of droppings.".
  Observe pass_s_scene at pass_s when true "The head of the descent. South of the Pass the fells fall away, and a long valley opens, green and terraced, and in it a smoke that goes straight up.".
  Observe descent_scene at descent when true "The Descent goes down in long paved zigzags, kept. Someone has swept the paving. There are fresh-cut wheel ruts. Far below, a white wall with a gate.".
  Observe gate_scene at gate when true "A gate of dressed stone with a bronze eagle over it, burnished. A clean paved road runs through it into a town of tiled roofs, and on the wall above stand soldiers in red cloaks, with spears, who have been watching you come down for an hour.".
  Observe forum_scene at forum when true "A forum paved in grey stone, with a well, an altar, and a bronze standard of an eagle on a pole in the middle. Everything is swept. People in red and brown wool stop what they are doing and look at your boots.".
  Observe praetorium_scene at praetorium_hall when true "The Praetorium: a basilica hall with a tribunal at the end and a plain chair on it. On the walls are the cohort's tablets, in rows, one for each year since the Muster marched out: ANNO CIV, CVI, CVII to MCIV.".
  Observe prefect_scene at prefect_room when true "A small room with a table, a brazier and a map of the road drawn on a goatskin. The map ends at the Eagle.".
  Observe barracks_scene at barracks when true "A parade ground of beaten earth where boys with wooden swords are being shouted at by a woman with a cane. A line of spears stands in the rack.".
  Observe granary_scene at granary when true "A stone granary on pillars, full. Sacks of barley and dried trout in brine are stacked to the beams, and on a tally-board at the door is written, in chalk, how many days the valley can eat if the road is not opened.".
  Observe apothecary_scene at apothecary when true "A herb shop of the old school: bundles hung from the beams, rows of jars with Aenean names, a bench and a pestle. The smell is a mountain in summer.".
  Observe archive_scene at archive when true "A long low archive of cedar presses and scrolls, lit by one lamp. A table holds a single book bound in red leather with a wheel stamped on it.".
  Observe shrine_scene at shrine when true "A shrine of the Eagle: a small round room with a bronze bird on a plinth and a lamp that has not gone out in eleven hundred years. A hundred scraps of wax tablet are tucked in the cracks: prayers for a letter.".
  Observe terraces_scene at terraces when true "Vineyard terraces cut into the hillside, walled in dry stone, rows of vines tied up with osier. An old man in a red cloak is talking to a vine.".
}
data/adventures/muster/wake.kyr:
Module muster "The Long Muster's Road" {
  // ── The acts of the road, and what the valley does with what it is told ────────────────────────────────────────
  Chapter ch_board "The Board at Kell Ford" when true "The legion's road goes over the Hesper Fells, three days to a number nobody in the village will say, and the notice-board at the trough carries the names of those who went and did not come back.".
  Chapter ch_lower "The Lower Country" when within(party, lowroads) "The first day is the easiest, and three ways long: the gorge that drowns in a thaw, the dry ridge the wolves keep at night, and a goat-track that wants a head for heights.".
  Chapter ch_heights "The Heights and the Viaduct" when within(party, heights) or within(party, viaduct) "Above the lower country the legion's engineers stopped bargaining with the mountain. The road goes into it, or along it, or across a gap where an arch used to be.".
  Chapter ch_pass "The Giant's Pass" when within(party, passland) "At the notch the road goes through a house, and the house has a tenant. Below it, the men who would not be Sent.".
  Chapter ch_cohort "The Last Cohort" when within(party, cohort) "A valley that has kept the hours of a vanished empire for eleven hundred years, and at the end of the road, a tired man in a plain chair, waiting to be answered.".

  Discovery ropeway_known "The Cohort's engineers will string a rope-way across the fifth arch of the Viaduct, from the north pier to the south abutment, for anyone the Cohort counts a friend.".
  Relation dispatchSent(group). Relation delegationCame(group). Relation elpisTallied(group).
  Topic hobday_dispatch with cattermole "Give the reeve the Prefect's dispatch" when holding(actor, dispatch) and not dispatchSent(party) once {
    Says "The reeve breaks no seal. He turns it over and reads the superscription, twice, and goes the colour of the dish he is standing by. 'There is a bishop at Hale who keeps the old archives,' he says. 'He will want this more than he has ever wanted anything. I shall send it by the next carrier, and I shall tell no one what it says, because I do not know what it says, and I should like to keep it so.' He counts out forty coin from the village purse. 'The Ford's thanks. It isn't much. It's what we have.'".
    On discuss { Spend dispatch from actor. Increase quantity(actor, gold) by 40. Assert dispatchSent(party). }
  }
  Observe dispatch_news_inn at taproom when dispatchSent(party) "Greta Hennick has put a second lamp in the window.".
  Observe dispatch_news_shrine at shrine when dispatchSent(party) "A new wax tablet has been pushed into the cracks, in a courier's hand: THE LETTER WENT NORTH. AWAIT THE ANSWER.".
  Observe ropeway_seen at via_n when knows(party, ropeway_known) "A pair of iron staples is driven into the north pier, new, bright, with a rope's worn groove.".
  Observe ropeway_seen_s at via_s when knows(party, ropeway_known) "Across the gap, the engineers' rope-way hangs from two staples, taut as a bowstring.".
  Observe valley_news_kell at green when scoutGiven(party) and travelsWith(dunya, party) "Dunya of the Last Cohort is standing at Kell trough looking at the thirty houses with every sign of delight.".

  // ── What each telling does, and where it can be seen ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // told the Prefect: the standard struck, a valley in mourning, the Eagles and the Hearth each in their own grief.
  Observe fate_struck_forum at forum when told_prefect(party) and not state(standard, golden) "Under the empty pole, on a plank, the standard lies wrapped. A bareheaded crowd stands round it in silence, the Hearth on one side, the Eagles on the other, a yard of paving between them where nobody puts a foot.".
  Observe fate_struck_barracks at barracks when told_prefect(party) "The First Century stands in ranks facing the empty pole, shoulder to shoulder, and does not drill. The Centurion walks the line, and says something to each.".
  Observe fate_struck_granary at granary when told_prefect(party) "Elpis Varo has chalked a new line on the board by the door, over the sixth: SENT, and under it, small, NO MORE.".
  // told the Archivist: the standard kept; a slow telling; a rope-way; a delegation after some days.
  Observe fate_kept_forum at forum when told_ostrander(party) and not state(standard, golden) "A black cloth hangs on the standard's pole, and nobody has said why. In the forum people go about in lowered voices, as the valley does when a physician is in the Prefect's house.".
  Observe fate_kept_archive at archive when told_ostrander(party) "The Archivist and the Prefect sit together at the cedar table with the Annals open between them and a lamp, and have been there since the noon call. Neither looks up.".
  Person delegates "the Cohort's delegation" nowhere {
    Role "three soldiers of the First Century, with a wheel on their packs". Ancestry human. Calling ranger. Level 3. Numbers 3. Peaceable.
    Arrives at green when told_ostrander(party) and watch(clock) >= toldAt(party) + 600.
    Arrives "Three soldiers in red cloaks come down the north road to the trough at Kell Ford with the whole village standing in its doors. The leader takes off her helmet and says, in careful plain-speech: 'We are from the end of the road. We are told the lamps here are lit. May we see?'".
  }
  // told the Centurion: a century that knows what it is for; a column north.
  Observe fate_march_barracks at barracks when told_merula(party) "The First Century is in full marching order in the yard, packs on, spears up, and no one will say why. The Centurion stands at the head with her cane under her arm. She nods to you once.".
  Person column "the First Century's column" nowhere {
    Role "six soldiers of the Last Cohort in red cloaks, with the Centurion's cane at their head". Ancestry human. Calling warrior. Level 3. Numbers 6. Peaceable.
    Arrives at green when told_merula(party) and watch(clock) >= toldAt(party) + 900.
    Arrives "A column of red cloaks comes down the north road in ranks, six strong, with a horn sounding at the head of it, and Kell Ford's dogs go mad. The woman at the front halts them at the trough, sets down her cane, and says in plain speech: 'I am a Centurion of the Last Cohort. We have come to see whether anyone is there.' Greta Hennick, in her inn door, says she supposes they will want feeding.".
  }
  // told the Hearth: the sixth withheld; the Eagles' answer; a quarrel in the forum.
  Rule elpis_tallied_rule when told_elpis(party) and watch(clock) >= toldAt(party) + 200 and not elpisTallied(party) {
    Assert elpisTallied(party). Retract at(elpis, granary). Assert at(elpis, tally_yard). }
  Observe fate_quarrel_granary at granary when told_elpis(party) "The granary is shut and chalked across the door: NO SIXTH. The Hearth stands about it in knots, with sacks at their feet and an air of people at the start of a very long argument.".
  Observe fate_quarrel_tally at tally_yard when elpisTallied(party) "Elpis Varo is on the worn flag counting, in her flat granary-reeve's voice, a Tally of a year, and the Hearth has gathered outside the yard-gate to count with her, a murmur that rises and falls like a field of barley. The Eagles stand across the lane with their arms folded.".
  // traded and said nothing.
  Observe fate_silent_forum at forum when traded_only(party) "The parade goes on at the fourth hour. A girl at the front of the schola's line is crying.".
  Observe fate_silent_shrine at shrine when traded_only(party) "Old Gaius is sitting by the lamp with the Prefect's pouch ready. In the spring he will go again.".

  Objective cross_road when not been(party, septimus_hall) "Three days of road lead over the Hesper Fells from Kell Ford, and the board in the village says the far end is held.".
  Objective find_cohort when been(party, septimus_hall) and not been(party, gate) "The road is the legion's, and the legion's road leads somewhere. The stones count it down in cables to a number the village does not mention.".
  Objective read_graffiti when been(party, septimus_hall) and not knows(party, rufus_5) "A soldier called Rufus has scratched his name on every wall of the road, and the walls remember him.".
  Objective tell_valley when been(party, gate) and not valleyTold(party) and not traded_only(party) "The Cohort holds its gate against an empire that is dust. Someone should be told. Or not.".
  Objective carry_dispatch when dispatchTaken(party) and not dispatchSent(party) "The Prefect has given the company a dispatch for the Emperor. The reeve at Kell Ford knows a bishop who keeps the old archives.".
  Objective aurel_letter when holding(party, aurel_letter_kind) and not merulaKnowsSon(party) "A pouch on the Eagle's stack is addressed to a Centurion of the Cohort, in a young man's hand. It has waited nine springs.".

  Milestone m_septimus "reached the Mansio Septimus" worth 100 when been(party, septimus_hall).
  Milestone m_octavius "reached the Mansio Octavius" worth 150 when been(party, octavius_hall).
  Milestone m_viaduct "crossed the fifth arch of the Great Viaduct" worth 300 when been(party, via_s).
  Milestone m_eagle "stood in the roofless Mansio of the Eagle" worth 150 when been(party, eagle).
  Milestone m_pass "passed the giant in the Giant's Pass" worth 250 when been(party, pass_s).
  Milestone m_gate "came down to the gate of the Last Cohort and was let in" worth 300 when been(party, forum) and admitted(party).
  Milestone m_rufus "read Rufus on every wall of the road" worth 300 when knows(party, rufus_1) and knows(party, rufus_2) and knows(party, rufus_3) and knows(party, rufus_4).
  Milestone m_aurel "met the man who left the Sending" worth 250 when aurelMet(party).
  Milestone m_letter "brought a son's letter to his mother" worth 300 when merulaKnowsSon(party).
  Milestone m_pontus "brought the lost courier's tag home" worth 250 when gaiusPontus(party).
  Milestone m_gold "found the gold wing of the standard" worth 400 when holding(party, golden_idol) or goldReturned(party).
  Milestone m_gold_home "laid the gold eagle's wing before the standard" worth 400 when goldReturned(party).
  Milestone m_annals "heard the Annals' red years" worth 250 when knows(party, second_wife_known) and knows(party, plague_winter_known) and knows(party, schism_known).
  Milestone m_told "told the Last Cohort what became of the empire" worth 300 when valleyTold(party).
  Milestone m_sent "sent the Prefect's dispatch north" worth 250 when dispatchSent(party).
  Milestone m_wyvern "robbed the wyvern's nest while it hunted" worth 250 when holding(party, courier_tag) or gaiusPontus(party).
}
data/adventures/parliament-of-books/cala:
Module calamy "A Parliament of Books" {
  Description "Calamy, a tidal city of paper at the mouth of the Calam: its wards and streets, its houses and trades, its tide and its days.".

  // The Calam mouth: the walled city on the north bank (Stitchgate, the Close, Gannet Hill), the new town of the
  // presses outside the wall, the Gardens, the Penny Bridge, the Hithe on the south bank, and the reed-beds downriver.
  Place calam "the Calam mouth" is region.
  Initially Assert terrain(calam, marsh).
  Place gannet "Gannet Hill" is settlement within calam at 0, 0.
  Place gardens "the Gardens" is settlement within calam at 2, 0.
  Place stitchgate "Stitchgate" is settlement within calam at 0, 1.
  Place close "the Close" is settlement within calam at 1, 1.
  Place presses "Newmarket" is settlement within calam at 2, 1.
  Place pennybridge "the Penny Bridge" is settlement within calam at 1, 2.
  Place hithe "the Hithe" is settlement within calam at 1, 3.
  Place calamies "the Calamies" is wilderness within calam at 3, 3.
  Initially Assert landform(calamies, land_lake).
  Initially Assert townSize(hithe, size_town). Initially Assert townSize(stitchgate, size_town). Initially Assert townSize(close, size_town).

  // ── The Hithe: the south bank, the river port. ──
  Place causey "the causeway over the saltings" is room within hithe at 0, 0 outdoors.
  Place quay "the Hithe quay" is room within hithe at 1, 0 outdoors.
  Place rag_market "the rag market" is room within hithe at 2, 0 outdoors.
  Place millrace "the millrace walk" is room within hithe at 3, 0 outdoors.
  Place customs_yard "the Customs yard" is room within hithe at 1, 1 outdoors.
  Place ferry_stairs "the ferry stairs" is room within hithe at 0, 1 outdoors.
  Place pudding_lane "Pudding Lane" is room within hithe at 2, 1 outdoors.
  Place mudbank "the mudbank under the mills" is room within hithe at 3, 1 outdoors.
  Place lamb "the Lamb and Lantern" is building within hithe seen as "a tavern under a painted lantern" until lamb_known.
  Discovery lamb_known "The tavern under the painted lantern on the Hithe quay is the Lamb and Lantern, Moll Garrow's.".
  Place taproom "the Lamb's taproom" is room within lamb at 1, 2.
  Place lamb_upper "the Lamb's upper floor" is level within lamb.
  Place lamb_loft "the Lamb's loft" is room within lamb_upper at 1, 3.
  Observe taproom_named at taproom when true "Over the bar a board says THE LAMB AND LANTERN, M. GARROW, and under it in smaller letters NO BOOKS READ ALOUD AFTER TEN." teaches lamb_known.
  Place old_mill "the old mill" is building within hithe.
  Place brannock_floor "Brannock's mill floor" is room within old_mill at 3, 2.
  Place new_mill "the new mill" is building within hithe.
  Place teague_floor "the Widow Teague's mill floor" is room within new_mill at 4, 0.
  Place bond "the bonded warehouse" is building within hithe.
  Place bond_floor "the bond floor" is room within bond at 0, 2.
  Place bond_upper "the bond's upper floor" is level within bond.
  Place bond_loft "the upper bond" is room within bond_upper at 0, 3.
  Place garrets "the garret house" is building within hithe.
  Place garret_top "the top of the garret house" is level within garrets.
  Place jonquil_garret "a garret under the leads" is room within garret_top at 2, 2.
  Place nance_house "the midwife's house" is building within hithe seen as "a house with a green door and a horseshoe" until nance_named.
  Discovery nance_named "The house with the green door in Pudding Lane is Goody Nance's, the midwife of the Hithe.".
  Place nance_room "Goody Nance's front room" is room within nance_house at 2, 3.
  Place coddy_hut "Coddy Fitch's hut" is room within hithe at 4, 1 outdoors.

  Passage causey_quay "the causeway into the Hithe" is road between causey and quay taking 5 minutes.
  Passage quay_rags "the way along the quay" is road between quay and rag_market taking 3 minutes.
  Passage rags_race "the walk up to the mills" is path between rag_market and millrace taking 3 minutes.
  Passage quay_customs "the lane to the Customs" is road between quay and customs_yard taking 2 minutes.
  Passage quay_ferry "the steps down to the ferry" is steps between quay and ferry_stairs.
  Passage rags_pudding "the alley into Pudding Lane" is path between rag_market and pudding_lane taking 2 minutes.
  Passage race_mud "the slipway down to the mud" is path between millrace and mudbank taking 2 minutes.
  Passage mud_hut "the plank walk to the hut" is path between mudbank and coddy_hut taking 3 minutes.
  Passage lamb_door "the door under the lantern" is door between quay and taproom.
  Passage lamb_stair "the Lamb's back stair" is stair between taproom and lamb_loft.
  Passage brannock_door "the old mill's door" is door between millrace and brannock_floor.
  Passage teague_door "the new mill's door" is door between millrace and teague_floor.
  Passage bond_gate "the bond gate" is gate between customs_yard and bond_floor.
  Passage bond_stair "the bond stair" is stair between bond_floor and bond_loft.
  Passage garret_stair "the garret stair" is stair between pudding_lane and jonquil_garret taking 3 minutes.
  Passage nance_door "the green door" is door between pudding_lane and nance_room.

  // ── The Penny Bridge: nineteen arches, and on every pier a stall. ──
  Place bridge_south "the south end of the Penny Bridge" is room within pennybridge at 0, 2 outdoors.
  Place bridge_middle "the chapel pier" is room within pennybridge at 0, 1 outdoors.
  Place bridge_north "the north end of the Penny Bridge" is room within pennybridge at 0, 0 outdoors.
  Passage hithe_bridge "the bridge foot" is road between quay and bridge_south taking 3 minutes.
  Passage bridge_span_south "the southern arches" is bridge between bridge_south and bridge_middle taking 4 minutes.
  Passage bridge_span_north "the northern arches" is bridge between bridge_middle and bridge_north taking 4 minutes.

  // ── Stitchgate: the old craft quarter inside the wall. ──
  Place old_gate "the Stitch Gate" is room within stitchgate at 1, 3 outdoors.
  Place needle_street "Needle Street" is room within stitchgate at 1, 2 outdoors.
  Place ink_lane "Inkhorn Lane" is room within stitchgate at 0, 2 outdoors.
  Place scriveners "Copyists' Row" is room within stitchgate at 1, 1 outdoors.
  Place gutter_lane "Gutter Lane" is room within stitchgate at 2, 3 outdoors.
  Place lantern_yard "Lantern Yard" is room within stitchgate at 3, 3 outdoors.
  Place binders_hall "the Binders' Hall" is building within stitchgate seen as "a hall with an iron needle over the door" until binders_named.
  Discovery binders_named "The hall with the great iron needle over its door is the Binders' Hall, of the Worshipful Company of Binders.".
  Place hall_floor "the Binders' great room" is room within binders_hall at 2, 2.
  Place sewing_room "the sewing room" is room within binders_hall at 2, 1.
  Place gallon_house "the ink shop" is building within stitchgate.
  Place gallon_shop "Gallon's ink shop" is room within gallon_house at 0, 1.
  Place gallon_upper "the ink shop's attic floor" is level within gallon_house.
  Place gallon_attic "the attic over the ink shop" is room within gallon_upper at 0, 0.
  Place dame_house "the house with the shut school" is building within stitchgate.
  Place dame_school "the empty schoolroom" is room within dame_house at 0, 3.
  Place crakes "the Two Hands" is building within stitchgate.
  Place crake_front "the front of Crake's shop" is room within crakes at 3, 2.
  Place crake_stacks "the back stacks" is room within crakes at 3, 1.
  Place crake_parlour "Crake's parlour" is room within crakes at 4, 2.

  Passage bridge_gate "the river stair to the Stitch Gate" is steps between bridge_north and old_gate taking 4 minutes.
  Passage gate_needle "the way under the gate" is road between old_gate and needle_street taking 2 minutes.
  Passage needle_ink "the turning into Inkhorn Lane" is road between needle_street and ink_lane taking 2 minutes.
  Passage needle_scriveners "the way up to Copyists' Row" is road between needle_street and scriveners taking 2 minutes.
  Passage gate_gutter "the gap beside the gate" is path between old_gate and gutter_lane taking 2 minutes.
  Passage gutter_yard "the crooked end of Gutter Lane" is path between gutter_lane and lantern_yard taking 2 minutes.

  // ── The Close: the civic island of the old city. ──
  Place ashpit "the Ashpit" is room within close at 1, 1 outdoors.
  Place close_green "the Close green" is room within close at 0, 1 outdoors.
  Place pleas_steps "the Court steps" is room within close at 1, 0 outdoors.
  Place church "the Church of the Lamp" is building within close seen as "a low old church with a light inside" until church_named.
  Discovery church_named "The low old church on the Close is the Church of the Lamp, whose lamp has burned since the first Kindling.".
  Place nave "the nave of the Lamp" is room within church at 0, 0.
  Place vestry "the vestry" is room within church at 0, 2.
  Place court "the Court of Pleas" is building within close.
  Place court_hall "the hall of the Court of Pleas" is room within court at 2, 0.
  Place guildhall "the Stationers' Hall" is building within close.
  Place guild_chamber "the aldermen's chamber" is room within guildhall at 2, 1.
  Place imprimatur "the Imprimatur" is building within close seen as "a grey building with a lamp carved over its door" until imprimatur_named.
  Discovery imprimatur_named "The grey building with the lamp carved over its door is the Imprimatur, where Calamy's books are licensed, refused, and burned.".
  Place imp_office "the outer office of the Imprimatur" is room within imprimatur at 1, 2.
  Place rhule_room "the Deputy Censor's room" is room within imprimatur at 2, 2.
  Place imp_kitchen "the Imprimatur's kitchen" is room within imprimatur at 1, 3.
  Place excisions "a locked room off the Censor's" is room within imprimatur at 2, 3 seen as "a locked door" until cupboard_known.
  Discovery cupboard_known "Behind the locked door in the Deputy Censor's room is the Cupboard of Excisions: every page the Imprimatur has cut from a book in three hundred years.".

  Passage scriveners_close "the Clerks' Gate" is gate between scriveners and close_green taking 4 minutes.
  Passage green_ashpit "the walk across the Close" is path between close_green and ashpit taking 2 minutes.
  Passage ashpit_steps "the way to the Court steps" is road between ashpit and pleas_steps taking 2 minutes.
  Passage church_door "the great door of the Lamp" is door between close_green and nave.
  Passage vestry_door "the vestry door" is door between nave and vestry.

  Passage guild_door "the Stationers' Hall door" is door between ashpit and guild_chamber.

  Passage rhule_door "the door behind the counter" is door between imp_office and rhule_room.

  // ── Gannet Hill: the Lyceum. ──
  Place gannet_steps "the Gannet Steps" is room within gannet at 1, 2 outdoors.
  Place quad "the Lyceum quad" is room within gannet at 1, 1 outdoors.
  Place schools "the Schools" is building within gannet.
  Place schoolroom "the great schoolroom" is room within schools at 2, 1.
  Place buttery "the buttery" is room within schools at 2, 2.
  Place rounds_tower "the Tower of Rounds" is building within gannet seen as "a thin old tower" until tower_named.
  Discovery tower_named "The thin old tower at the corner of the Lyceum is the Tower of Rounds, where the Archivist lives.".
  Place tower_foot "the foot of the Tower of Rounds" is room within rounds_tower at 0, 1.
  Place tower_top "the head of the tower" is level within rounds_tower.
  Place quarles_room "the top of the Tower of Rounds" is room within tower_top at 0, 0.
  Place chained_house "the Chained Room" is building within gannet seen as "a squat building with an iron-bound door" until chained_named.
  Discovery chained_named "The squat building with the iron-bound door is the Lyceum's Chained Room.".
  Place chained_room "the Chained Room" is room within chained_house at 1, 0.
  Place provost_lodge "the Provost's Lodging" is building within gannet seen as "a pleasant house with a brass knocker" until lodge_named.
  Discovery lodge_named "The pleasant house with the brass knocker is the Provost's Lodging.".
  Place provost_room "the Provost's study" is room within provost_lodge at 2, 0.

  Passage close_gannet "the Gannet Steps up from the Close" is steps between pleas_steps and gannet_steps taking 6 minutes.
  Passage steps_quad "the Lyceum gate" is gate between gannet_steps and quad.
  Passage schools_door "the door of the Schools" is door between quad and schoolroom.
  Passage buttery_hatch "the buttery hatch" is doorway between schoolroom and buttery.
  Passage tower_door "the tower door" is door between quad and tower_foot.
  Passage tower_stair "the tower's turning stair" is stair between tower_foot and quarles_room taking 4 minutes.
  Passage chained_door "the iron-bound door" is door between quad and chained_room.
  Passage provost_door "the Lodging door" is door between quad and provost_room.

  // ── Newmarket: the presses, outside the wall. ──
  Place newmarket "Newmarket" is room within presses at 0, 1 outdoors.
  Place press_yard "Doble's yard" is room within presses at 1, 1 outdoors.
  Place doble_press "Doble's Press" is building within presses.
  Place press_room "the press room" is room within doble_press at 1, 0.
  Place doble_office "Doble's counting-room" is room within doble_press at 2, 0.
  Place paper_store "the paper store" is room within doble_press at 2, 1.

  Passage bridge_newmarket "the road along the river wall" is road between bridge_north and newmarket taking 6 minutes.
  Passage ashpit_newmarket "the Close's east gate" is gate between ashpit and newmarket taking 5 minutes.
  Passage newmarket_yard "the cart arch into Doble's yard" is arch between newmarket and press_yard.
  Passage press_door "the press-room door" is door between press_yard and press_room.
  Passage doble_door "the counting-room door" is door between press_room and doble_office.
  Passage store_door "the paper store door" is door between press_yard and paper_store.

  // ── The Gardens: walled orchards and the houses of the rich. ──
  Place orchard_walk "Orchard Walk" is room within gardens at 1, 1 outdoors.
  Place physic_garden "the physic garden" is room within gardens at 2, 1 outdoors.
  Place corvell_house "Corvell House" is building within gardens seen as "a house with a portico, shuttered on one side" until corvell_named.
  Discovery corvell_named "The house with the portico on Orchard Walk is Corvell House, Sir Gideon Corvell's.".
  Place corvell_hall "the hall of Corvell House" is room within corvell_house at 0, 0.
  Place corvell_library "Sir Gideon's library" is room within corvell_house at 1, 0.
  Place quennell_lib "Mrs. Quennell's library" is building within gardens seen as "a narrow shop with gilt letters and lace curtains" until quennell_named.
  Discovery quennell_named "The narrow shop with lace curtains on Orchard Walk is Mrs. Quennell's subscription library.".
  Place quennell_room "the subscription room" is room within quennell_lib at 0, 1.

  Passage newmarket_gardens "Orchard Walk from Newmarket" is road between newmarket and orchard_walk taking 6 minutes.
  Passage walk_physic "the gate into the physic garden" is gate between orchard_walk and physic_garden.
  Passage corvell_door "the door of Corvell House" is door between orchard_walk and corvell_hall.
  Passage library_door "the library doors" is door between corvell_hall and corvell_library.
  Passage quennell_door "the subscription library door" is door between orchard_walk and quennell_room.

  // ── The Calamies: the reed-beds downriver, out over the flats at low water. ──
  Place reed_edge "the edge of the reed-beds" is room within calamies at 0, 0 outdoors.
  Place saltings "the saltings" is room within calamies at 1, 0 outdoors.
  Place reed_heart "the heart of the reeds" is room within calamies at 0, 1 outdoors.
  Passage flats_path "the path out over the flats" is path between mudbank and reed_edge taking 40 minutes
    opening when ebbing() or following(coddy, party) "The tide is in over the flats. Grey water stands where the path was, and the reed-tops show above it like stubble.".
  Passage reed_saltings "the bank along the saltings" is path between reed_edge and saltings taking 15 minutes.
  Passage reed_channel "the cut into the reeds" is path between reed_edge and reed_heart taking 20 minutes
    opening when deadLow() or following(coddy, party) "The cut into the reeds is a brown channel running fast. At dead low water it drains; not before.".

  // The tide: in twice a day, out twice a day. It is ebbing from four to ten, and from four to ten again, and dead
  // low at seven.
  Query ebbing() means (hour(clock) >= 4 and hour(clock) < 10) or (hour(clock) >= 16 and hour(clock) < 22).
  Query deadLow() means hour(clock) == 6 or hour(clock) == 7 or hour(clock) == 18 or hour(clock) == 19.

  // A place the company has been and left is familiar: it is told again in a line, not in full.
  Relation familiar(place).
  Rule familiar_place when been(party, ?p) and not at(party, ?p) and not familiar(?p) { Assert familiar(?p). }

  // Where one can sleep: the Lamb's loft, for its price; Coddy's hut, if he will have you.
  Initially Assert restful(lamb_loft).
}
data/adventures/parliament-of-books/comm:
Module calamy "A Parliament of Books" {
  Description "The Commonplace: the country where Calamy's Sewn books go home. Its ground is the marginalia of every reader; its light is attention; its blight is the foxing of the unread; its roads are sentences.".

  Place commonplace "the Commonplace" is region elsewhere.
  Place near_stacks "the Near Stacks" is wilderness within commonplace at 1, 0 elsewhere.
  Place margin_country "the Fore-edge" is wilderness within commonplace at 1, 1 elsewhere.
  Place housebook_site "the Annery Housebook" is site within commonplace at 0, 1.
  Place orme_site "Mother Orme's garden" is site within commonplace at 2, 1.
  Place foxing "the Foxing" is wilderness within commonplace at 1, 2 elsewhere.
  Place wellhead_site "the Wellhead" is site within commonplace at 1, 3.
  Place vask_site "the Tower of Oddny Vask" is site within commonplace at 2, 2.
  Place roll_site "the Roll" is site within commonplace at 0, 0.

  Place reading_room "the Reading Room of the Catalogue" is room within near_stacks at 0, 0.
  Place remainder_market "the Remainder Market" is room within near_stacks at 2, 0.
  Place draft_fields "the Draft-Fields" is room within near_stacks at 3, 0.
  Place margin "the white country of the Fore-edge" is room within margin_country at 0, 0.
  Place gloss_wood "the wood of glosses" is room within margin_country at 1, 0.
  Place margin_edge "the outer edge of the Fore-edge" is room within margin_country at 2, 0.
  Place hb_below "below the footnote" is level within housebook_site.
  Place hb_porch "the porch of the Annery Housebook" is room within hb_below at 0, 0.
  Place hb_kitchen "the Housebook's kitchen" is room within hb_below at 0, 1.
  Place hb_nursery "the Housebook's nursery" is room within hb_below at 1, 1.
  Place hb_cellar "the Housebook's cellar" is room within hb_below at 0, 2.
  Place orme_garden "Mother Orme's garden" is room within orme_site at 0, 0.
  Place foxing_edge "the edge of the Foxing" is room within foxing at 0, 0.
  Place foxing_deep "the deep Foxing" is room within foxing at 0, 1.
  Place wellhead "the Wellhead" is room within wellhead_site at 0, 0.
  Place vask_foot "the foot of the Tower of Oddny Vask" is room within vask_site at 0, 1.
  Place vask_upper "the head of the tower" is level within vask_site.
  Place vask_top "the top of the Tower of Oddny Vask" is room within vask_upper at 0, 0.
  Place chamber "the Chamber of the Parliament" is room within roll_site at 0, 0.

  Initially Assert planeRoom(reading_room). Initially Assert planeRoom(remainder_market). Initially Assert planeRoom(draft_fields).
  Initially Assert planeRoom(margin). Initially Assert planeRoom(gloss_wood). Initially Assert planeRoom(margin_edge).
  Initially Assert planeRoom(hb_porch). Initially Assert planeRoom(hb_kitchen). Initially Assert planeRoom(hb_nursery). Initially Assert planeRoom(hb_cellar).
  Initially Assert planeRoom(orme_garden). Initially Assert planeRoom(foxing_edge). Initially Assert planeRoom(foxing_deep).
  Initially Assert planeRoom(wellhead). Initially Assert planeRoom(vask_foot). Initially Assert planeRoom(vask_top). Initially Assert planeRoom(chamber).

  // Its roads are made of what books are made of.
  Passage long_sentence "a long sentence" is causeway between reading_room and remainder_market taking 30 minutes.
  Passage market_back "the back of the market" is path between remainder_market and draft_fields taking 10 minutes.
  Passage clerks_stair "the Order of Business" is path between reading_room and chamber taking 5 minutes.
  Passage the_gutter "the gutter" is path between remainder_market and margin taking 20 minutes.
  Passage gangway "the gangway from the floor of the chamber" is path between chamber and margin taking 15 minutes.
  Passage marginal_path "a path of marginal notes" is path between margin and gloss_wood taking 15 minutes.
  Passage gloss_through "the far side of the glosses" is path between gloss_wood and margin_edge taking 15 minutes.
  Passage footnote "a footnote" is ladder between margin and hb_porch taking 5 minutes.
  Passage hb_door "the Housebook's front door" is door between hb_porch and hb_kitchen.
  Passage hb_nursery_door "the stair to the nursery" is doorway between hb_kitchen and hb_nursery.
  Passage hb_cellar_door "the cellar door" is door between hb_kitchen and hb_cellar.
  Passage manicule "a pointing hand" is path between margin and orme_garden taking 15 minutes.
  Passage ellipsis "an ellipsis" is causeway between margin and foxing_edge taking 20 minutes.
  Passage foxing_in "the brown country" is path between foxing_edge and foxing_deep taking 20 minutes.
  Passage parenthesis "a parenthesis" is tunnel between foxing_deep and wellhead taking 15 minutes.
  Passage black_letter "a road of black letter" is road between margin_edge and vask_foot taking 20 minutes.
  Passage vask_stair "the tower stair" is stair between vask_foot and vask_top taking 5 minutes.

  // Light is attention: wherever someone in Calamy is reading a Calamy book, a beam comes down here.
  Observe light_here at reading_room when not familiar(reading_room) "You are standing on a floor of paper, in light. Not lamplight and not daylight: a pale clear light that comes down in beams from very high up, the way sun comes through cloud, and every beam is a little different in colour. A few of them are very bright. Most are thin. Here and there one goes out as you watch, and another comes on somewhere else. It takes you a long time to understand what you are seeing: every beam is someone in Calamy, now, reading.".
  Observe reading_room_scene at reading_room when true "A reading room without walls, under the beams: a floor of paper going away on every side, and in the middle of it a cliff of little drawers, thousands upon thousands of them, rising up out of sight, each with a brass handle and a card. Index cards flutter about the cliff like moths, settling, rising, filing. A voice comes from the drawers, from all of them, dry and patient and not unkind: the Catalogue.".
  Observe quarles_beam at reading_room when true "One beam, thin and old and steady, comes down from the direction you think of as the hill. It does not fall on any book. It falls on the light itself, as if someone were reading by ear, with their eyes shut.".
  Observe market_scene at remainder_market when true "A market under the beams, stalls and awnings and trestles going away in crooked rows, and on every trestle books: remaindered, unsold, forgotten, out of print, half-burned, water-damaged, and a great many that you are sure were never written at all. Stall-keepers call their wares. Some of the stall-keepers are books. Some are people drawn in pencil, lightly, their outlines breaking off in the air at the waist or the shoulder or the knee. A painted board: THE REMAINDER MARKET. ALL PRICES IN READINGS.".
  Observe drafts_scene at draft_fields when true "Beyond the market a wide pale field under a wind you cannot feel, and drifting across it, like thistledown, sheets of paper with a few lines on them, or a title and nothing else, or a single crossed-out word: drafts. Things begun. Here and there among them, sitting or walking or lying in the grass, figures drawn in pencil, unfinished, talking in low voices: the Unwritten.".
  Observe margin_scene at margin when true "White country. A great plain of blank paper running away under the beams, ruled at the edge by one faint red line, and across it, in long trickling columns like ants, move the marginalia: little notes and marks and hands and stars, scraps of readers' handwriting going about their business, arguing in tiny voices. NB, says one, passing. SIC, says another. NO, says a third, very firmly, and is gone.".
  Observe glosses_scene at gloss_wood when true "The marginalia are thicker here, piled up into a sort of wood: notes upon notes upon notes, glosses on glosses, a thicket of tiny dense handwriting so close it is nearly black. Things move in it.".
  Observe margin_edge_scene at margin_edge when true "The outer edge of the Fore-edge, where the white runs out and the paper is torn, and beyond the tear there is nothing at all. Someone has sat down here, against the last of the glosses, and is sulking.".
  Observe porch_scene at hb_porch when true "At the foot of the footnote, a narrow house of old brown brick, three storeys and a cellar, with a door painted green and a brass knocker shaped like a hand holding a pen. Over the door, cut in the lintel, in a hand you have seen on a garret wall in Pudding Lane: ANNERY. The windows are lit. Somebody inside is cooking herring.".
  Observe orme_scene at orme_garden when not ormeRestored(physick) "A walled garden of square beds, and in every bed the plants are writing: stems of script, leaves of letters, roots of long sentences going down into the paper. Feverfew, written. Woundwort, written.
