  Observe fate_picks_yielded near party when dawned(party) and grainGiven(party) "The granary door is open and the floor is swept. Tib Elland is counting the empty sacks twice.".
  Observe fate_picks_took near party when dawned(party) and picksTook(party) "Nobody was asked. The granary door was open when the light came, and the floor is swept, and the winter is going to be a long one.".
  Observe fate_helpless near party when dawned(party) and helplessLost(party) "Old Mistress Haworth's chair is in the road with nobody in it, and a cradle is lying on its side in the ash of the inn yard.".
  Observe fate_bell near party when dawned(party) and bellSilenced(party) "The bell-rope has been cut at the hole in the roof and hangs a yard short of the floor.".
  Observe fate_plate near party when dawned(party) and plateKept(party) "The plate-chest is bolted to the chapel floor, and Father Mowbray is sitting on it, and has the look of a man who has been asked for it twice.".
  Observe fate_captain_ash near party when dawned(party) and fothergillTurned(party) and greenBurns(party) "The green is still smoking, and Fothergill rode out through it with his hat in his hand, and the horse picked its own way through the embers.".
  Observe fate_coach at east_road when dawned(party) and coachGone(party) "The coach is the ford wall, and the wall is a heap of char. Teasdale is sitting on a wheel in the sun. 'It was a good coach,' he says, without rancour, to the river.".
  Observe fate_lowes at taproom when dawned(party) and heldScout(lowes) and lowesHard(party) "The boy in the cellar has not eaten. He pulls his boots in when you come down.".

  // Endings, most particular first.
  Ending company_fell "What the Steel Said" when p4done(party) and (companyBroken(party) or not able(party)) and not picksWithdrawn(party) "The three do not hurry. One of them sits on the plate-chest afterward, with his helm on his knee, and watches the others go through the chapel. The strangers from the coach stood and fought, and the picked men were civil about it, and did not stop. The bell does not ring again that night. Whether the village stood, or sat down in the dark and waited for the captain's terms, there is nobody left to ask.".
  Ending company_down "The Road Takes Its Toll" when (companyBroken(party) or not able(party)) and not p4done(party) "Nobody comes to look. When the village does come, in the morning, it finds the strangers from the coach where the road gave out, and the coach people's cases, and sends a boy to Marden with the names.".
  Ending walked_late "The Road South, by Firelight" when walkedOn(party) and battleOn() "You are four miles down the south road when the sky behind you goes the colour of a forge. You do not stop. Some of the people you spoke to are in it. You tell yourself, for a mile, that they had a good chance, and you stop telling yourself.".
  Ending walked_on_ending "The Road South" when walkedOn(party) and not battleOn() and (not coachMended(party) or coachGone(party) or watch(clock) < 288) "You walk until dark. In the morning you are further, and the morning after, further still. At an inn on the Marden road a carter says that Sallowfield had a bad week, and does not say which way it went, and you do not ask. The reeve had your names on a list. It was a short list. It was headed with yours.".
  Ending coach_goes "The Coach Goes On" when walkedOn(party) and coachMended(party) and not coachGone(party) and watch(clock) >= 288 "Teasdale's axle holds. By noon the coach is a dot on the south road, and nobody on it says a word about the village, or the smith who mended the strap, or the boy at the ford who waved. There are eleven passengers. They arrive. In the spring one of them reads a notice in a market town, with a list of the dead, and does not finish it.".
  Ending alone_ending "Nobody Left" when morning(party) and not pact(party) and count(villager(?v) and not felled(?v) and not travelsWith(?v, party)) == 0 "You are alive, and so are the ones who came with you. Of the village there is nobody, and the morning is fine. The river runs, and the geese have come back, and are cropping the green round the dead as if they had always been there.".
  Ending bought_peace_broken "Sixty Coin, and the Mill" when pact(party) and not fothergillTurned(party) "Wyre keeps his word to the letter. Fothergill does not. At first light a score of the lieutenant's men go round the back of the village with torches, because a pact is not a thing they signed, and the mill is the nearest roof. Quarmby is on the wheel when it takes. The purse is gone, the plate is gone, the winter is short, and the mill is a black wheel in a ford. Wyre rides back up the road and sends a boy to say that he is sorry about the mill, and that the sixty stands.".
  Ending bought_peace "A Peace of Sixty Coin" when pact(party) and fothergillTurned(party) "Wyre keeps his word to the letter, and his lieutenant, who has been bought, keeps Wyre's. The company goes down the east road at noon with the wagons full and the plate-chest empty, in good order. The reeve counts the sacks that are left. There are not enough, and the purse is empty of the sixty it was taken from, and old Mistress Haworth is the first in February. In the spring Wyre will have another thing to ask.".
  Ending stalemate_ending "The Next Granary" when wyreWithdraws(party) and grainSpoiled(party) and fothergillTurned(party) "By the time the light goes the east road is empty. The word went up the column in the night, and half of it is on its way to Marden, where the tithe-barn is dry. The night passes without a shot. The granary stinks of lamp-oil and brine, and the reeve has begun a list of the households that will not see March, and old Mistress Haworth is the first name on it. You do not read it.".
  Ending stalemate_burn "The Next Granary, After the Mill" when wyreWithdraws(party) and grainSpoiled(party) and not fothergillTurned(party) "The east road is empty by dusk. The word went up the column, and half of it is on its way to Marden. Fothergill's score are not. They go round the back of the village in the last of the light with torches, because a thing that was ruined for them to smell is a thing that wants paying for, and the mill is the nearest roof. Quarmby is on the wheel. The granary stinks of lamp-oil and brine, and the reeve has begun a list, and old Mistress Haworth is the first name on it.".
  Ending captain_ending "The Captain's Own" when fothergillTurned(party) and picksWithdrawn(party) and morning(party) and not greenBurns(party) and (barricadeUp(party) or bridgeCut(party)) "The picked men go down the east road before light, and Fothergill rides at the head of them with the lancers' colours on his saddle. Wyre sits his horse by the bridge with his helm off and does not say anything to anyone. Nobody argues. They have been waiting for someone to say it.".
  Ending held_lean "Held, and the Winter Short" when morning(party) and not greenBurns(party) and overrunCount(party) <= 1 and winterShort(party) "The sun comes up on a village standing. Whatever stood at the ford is wreckage. Sixty people are in the lane, counting each other, and some of the counts come out short. The granary door is open, and there is not going to be enough, and the reeve is already drawing up the list of who will go to Marden for the winter and who will stay.".
  Ending held_ending "Held, at a Cost" when morning(party) and not greenBurns(party) and overrunCount(party) <= 1 "The sun comes up on a village standing. Whatever stood at the ford is wreckage. Sixty people are in the lane, counting each other, and some of the counts come out short.".
  Ending half_saved "Half Saved" when morning(party) and greenBurns(party) and evacuated(party) "The green is a floor of black timbers and the chapel is the only roof. The old, the sick and the children are on the high fold with Crowther and two hundred sheep. When the sun gets over the Scar they come down in a line in the cold light, and the count is bad and not the worst.".
  Ending ash_ending "Ash" when morning(party) and greenBurns(party) and not evacuated(party) "The helpless were in their beds when the green went up. The bucket line was a line of women who came to the end of it and found nothing to put the water on.".
  Ending what_was_left "What Was Left" when morning(party) "The roofs are on, and the green is not burned, and there are people at the well who do not look at each other. There are gaps where people stood. Somebody says it will be known by spring.".
}
data/adventures/skeel/growth.kyr:
Module skeel "Fair Weather" {
  // ── What a company grows by here ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // For what is found out, mended, made and decided; nothing for what is killed.
  Milestone m_tide "learned the tide of the Reach" worth 100 when knows(party, tide_known) and knows(party, withy_way_known).
  Milestone m_stern "kept a night on the wreck" worth 200 when knows(party, crew_under).
  Milestone m_dog "won the Constancy's dog" worth 200 when dogFriend(party) or tookDog(party).
  Milestone m_nye "found the boy on the Skerry" worth 250 when knows(party, nye_known).
  Milestone m_eyes "saw how the Lantern went dark" worth 250 when knows(party, loveday_eyes) and knows(party, oil_watered).
  Milestone m_sees "gave Loveday Kitto her eyes" worth 200 when lovedaySees(loveday).
  Milestone m_pulpit "climbed the Pulpit" worth 200 when knows(party, hook_found).
  Milestone m_piran "brought Piran Penhallow to the Pulpit, or home from it" worth 200 when piranUp(piran) or carriedPiran(party).
  Milestone m_supper "sang at the Gannet Supper" worth 100 when sang(party).
  Milestone m_letter "gave Ewan Marrock his wife's letter" worth 200 when letterTruth(ewan) or letterLie(ewan) or letterKept(ewan).
  Milestone m_mark "learned the leading mark" worth 100 when knows(party, leading_mark).
  Milestone m_rutter "wrote up the Pilots' Rutter" worth 500 when rutterWritten(reach).
  Milestone m_who "found out who hung the light" worth 400 when knows(party, hender_did).
  Milestone m_confess "brought Loveday to ask him" worth 400 when henderConfessed(hender) and not confessedAlone(hender).
  Milestone m_confess_alone "sent him to her" worth 300 when confessedAlone(hender).
  Milestone m_matthew "found Matthew Ferrar for his sister" worth 300 when matthewHome(constance).
  Milestone m_names "gave the drowned their names" worth 250 when crewNamed(reach).
  Milestone m_living "showed the Court a living thing" worth 300 when livingShown(reach) and attended(party).
  Milestone m_lantern "kept Loveday Kitto her Lantern" worth 200 when lovedayKept(reach).
  Milestone m_pilots "set the pilots on the Reach again" worth 800 when pilotsAgreed(reach).
}
data/adventures/skeel/reach.kyr:
Module skeel "Fair Weather" {
  Description "Skeel, a wrecking town on the Gannet Reach, a shallow sea of sands and islands that the tide empties twice a day; three days after the merchantman Constancy went onto Scarth Bank in fair weather, and two before the Wreck Court will call her wreck, if nothing living came ashore.".

  // ── The Reach ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // A bight of the western sea nine miles across. At low water it is a desert of ribbed sand with islands standing up
  // out of it and one channel, the Gut, that never drains; at high water it is a sea with islands in it. Skeel is on
  // the north headland. The Craigs are the south arm. The Holm, the Skerry and Inish Gall stand out in the middle.

  Place reach "the Gannet Reach" is region within imbar.
  Initially Assert terrain(reach, marsh).
  Place coast "the coast road" is wilderness within reach at 1, 0.
  Place skeel "Skeel" is settlement within reach at 1, 1.
  Place strand "the Strand" is wilderness within reach at 1, 2.
  Place holm "Hobb's Holm" is site within reach at 0, 2.
  Place craigs "the Craigs" is wilderness within reach at 2, 2.
  Place skerry "Seal Skerry" is wilderness within reach at 0, 3.
  Place inish "Inish Gall" is wilderness within reach at 1, 3.
  Place nowhere "the far sea" is wilderness within reach at 3, 4.

  // ── Buildings ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Place church_bldg "the church of Lir Who Gives" is building within skeel.
  Place inn_bldg "the Admiral" is building within skeel.
  Place wreck_bldg "the Wreck-House" is building within skeel.
  Place reeve_bldg "the Reeve's house" is building within skeel.
  Place cellar_bldg "the fish cellars" is building within skeel.
  Place loft_level "the net-loft over the cellars" is level within cellar_bldg.
  Place huer_bldg "the huer's hut" is building within coast.
  Place tower "the Lantern" is building within holm.
  Place lamp_level "the lamp-room" is level within tower.
  Place cell_bldg "the hermit's cell" is building within holm.
  Place bothy_bldg "Ewan Marrock's bothy" is building within skerry.
  Place pilot_bldg "the pilot-house" is building within inish.

  // ── Rooms ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Place coast_road "the coast road above Skeel" is room within coast at 1, 0 outdoors.
  Place head "Skeel Head" is room within coast at 0, 0 outdoors.
  Place huer_hut "the huer's hut" is room within huer_bldg at 0, 1 indoors.
  Place fore_street "Fore Street" is room within skeel at 1, 0 outdoors.
  Place church "Lir Who Gives" is room within church_bldg at 0, 0 indoors.
  Place taproom "the Admiral's taproom" is room within inn_bldg at 2, 0 indoors.
  Place reeve_parlour "the Reeve's parlour" is room within reeve_bldg at 0, 1 indoors.
  Place ropewalk "Tonkin's ropewalk" is room within skeel at 3, 0 outdoors.
  Place acre "the Strangers' Acre" is room within skeel at 0, 2 outdoors.
  Place quay "the quay" is room within skeel at 2, 2 outdoors.
  Place wreck_house "the Wreck-House" is room within wreck_bldg at 3, 2 indoors.
  Place cellars "the fish cellars" is room within cellar_bldg at 2, 3 indoors.
  Place net_loft "the net-loft" is room within loft_level at 2, 4 indoors.
  Place slip "the Slip" is room within skeel at 1, 3 outdoors.
  Place flats "the open Strand" is room within strand at 1, 0 outdoors.
  Place scarth "Scarth Bank, under the wreck" is room within strand at 2, 1 outdoors.
  Place aboard "aboard the Constancy" is level within strand.
  Place stern "the Constancy's stern" is room within aboard at 3, 1 outdoors.
  Place gut_lip "the lip of the Gut" is room within strand at 1, 2 outdoors.
  Place sill "the Sill, in the Gut" is room within strand at 1, 3 outdoors.
  Place holm_shore "the Holm strand" is room within holm at 1, 0 outdoors.
  Place tower_foot "the foot of the Lantern" is room within tower at 1, 1 indoors.
  Place lamp_room "the lamp-room" is room within lamp_level at 1, 2 indoors.
  Place cell "the hermit's cell" is room within cell_bldg at 0, 1 indoors.
  Place craigs_foot "the foot of the Craigs" is room within craigs at 0, 2 outdoors.
  Place clifftop "the climbers' camp on the Craigs" is room within craigs at 1, 1 outdoors.
  Place face "halfway down the Craigs" is level within craigs.
  Place summit "the high Craigs" is level within craigs.
  Place ledges "the gannet ledges" is room within face at 1, 2 outdoors.
  Place pulpit "the Pulpit" is room within summit at 2, 2 outdoors.
  Place cliff_road "the cliff road round the Reach" is room within craigs at 1, 0 outdoors.
  Place skerry_landing "the Skerry landing" is room within skerry at 1, 0 outdoors.
  Place haulout "the haul-out" is room within skerry at 2, 0 outdoors.
  Place bothy "Ewan Marrock's bothy" is room within bothy_bldg at 1, 1 indoors.
  Place inish_strand "the Inish strand" is room within inish at 0, 0 outdoors.
  Place pilot_house "the pilot-house" is room within pilot_bldg at 1, 0 indoors.
  Place beacon "the beacon on Inish Gall" is room within inish at 1, 1 outdoors.
  Place limbo "the sea" is room within nowhere at 0, 0 outdoors.

  // ── Ways by land ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Passage town_road "the road down into Skeel" is road between coast_road and fore_street taking 20 minutes.
  Passage head_path "the path out to Skeel Head" is path between coast_road and head taking 15 minutes.
  Passage huer_door "the huer's door" is door between head and huer_hut.
  Passage church_door "the church door" is door between fore_street and church.
  Passage inn_door "the Admiral's door" is door between fore_street and taproom.
  Passage reeve_door "the Reeve's door" is door between fore_street and reeve_parlour.
  Passage rope_lane "the ropewalk lane" is path between fore_street and ropewalk taking 5 minutes.
  Passage acre_gate "the lych-gate" is gate between church and acre.
  Passage drang "the Drang" is steps between fore_street and quay taking 5 minutes.
  Passage wreck_door "the Wreck-House door" is door between quay and wreck_house.
  Passage cellar_door "the cellar door" is door between quay and cellars.
  Passage loft_stair "the loft stair" is stair between cellars and net_loft.
  Passage slip_way "the harbour wall" is path between quay and slip taking 5 minutes.
  // The long way to the Craigs: round the head of the Reach by the cliff road, two hours, any tide.
  Passage round_road "the cliff road round the head of the Reach" is road between coast_road and cliff_road taking 2 hours.
  Passage camp_path "the cliff-top path" is path between cliff_road and clifftop taking 20 minutes.
  Passage craigs_path "the goat path down the Craigs" is path between clifftop and craigs_foot taking 30 minutes.
  Passage fixed_rope "the climbers' fixed rope" is ladder between clifftop and ledges taking 10 minutes needing climbing or rope.
  Passage pulpit_climb "the face up to the Pulpit" is ladder between ledges and pulpit taking 20 minutes needing climbing.
  // Or along the edge from the camp: no skill wanted, only nerve, and the wind.
  Passage edge_scramble "the cliff edge out to the Pulpit" is path between clifftop and pulpit taking 20 minutes.
  Passage tower_door "the Lantern door" is door between holm_shore and tower_foot.
  Passage lamp_stair "the lamp stair" is stair between tower_foot and lamp_room.
  Passage cell_door "the cell doorway" is doorway between holm_shore and cell.
  Passage haul_path "the rocks to the haul-out" is path between skerry_landing and haulout taking 10 minutes.
  Passage bothy_door "the bothy door" is door between skerry_landing and bothy.
  Passage pilot_door "the pilot-house door" is door between inish_strand and pilot_house.
  Passage beacon_path "the path up to the beacon" is path between inish_strand and beacon taking 10 minutes.
  Passage stern_ladder "the salvagers' ladder" is ladder between scarth and stern taking 5 minutes.

  // ── Ways over the sands: only at low water, or for whoever is already out there when the sea comes ───────────────
  Passage withy_way "the withy way" is path between slip and flats taking 30 minutes
    opening when sandsOpen() "The Strand is under the sea. The withies stick up out of the water in a line, a hand's breadth showing, and the tide-board says when they will stand on sand again.".
  Passage bank_way "the sand to Scarth Bank" is path between flats and scarth taking 20 minutes
    opening when sandsOpen() "Grey water runs over Scarth Bank. The Constancy's stern stands up out of it like a house in a flood.".
  Passage holm_sands "the sands to the Holm" is path between flats and holm_shore taking 30 minutes
    opening when sandsOpen() "The sea lies between the Strand and the Holm, a mile of it, and a boat would be the way.".
  Passage craigs_sands "the sands to the Craigs" is path between flats and craigs_foot taking 40 minutes
    opening when sandsOpen() "The sea is in under the Craigs, slapping at the rocks.".
  Passage gut_sands "the sand down to the Gut" is path between flats and gut_lip taking 30 minutes
    opening when sandsOpen() "The Gut and the sands either side of it are all one sea now.".
  Passage sill_wade "the Sill" is ford between gut_lip and sill taking 10 minutes
    opening when sandsOpen() "Only the sea, where the Sill was.".
  Passage sill_far "the far side of the Sill" is ford between sill and inish_strand taking 15 minutes
    opening when slack() or at(party, sill) or enRoute(party, ?w) "The Gut is running through the Sill like a river in spate, green and fast and full of sand. It runs slack only in the middle of low water, for an hour or two.".

  // ── Ways by boat: Jinny Rowse's lugger, the Patience, from the quay, while there is water in the harbour ─────────
  Passage holm_boat "the Patience, to the Holm" is ferry between quay and holm_shore taking 30 minutes
    opening when boatsRun() and passage(party) "Jinny Rowse's Patience comes and goes round high water, while there is water at the quay, for whoever has paid her for the day.".
  Passage skerry_boat "the Patience, to the Skerry" is ferry between quay and skerry_landing taking 45 minutes
    opening when boatsRun() and passage(party) "Jinny Rowse's Patience comes and goes round high water, while there is water at the quay, for whoever has paid her for the day.".
  Passage inish_boat "the Patience, to Inish Gall" is ferry between quay and inish_strand taking 1 hour
    opening when boatsRun() and passage(party) "Jinny Rowse's Patience comes and goes round high water, while there is water at the quay, for whoever has paid her for the day.".
  // Ewan's coracle, from the Holm strand to the Skerry, for those he will take.
  Passage coracle "Ewan Marrock's coracle" is ferry between holm_shore and skerry_landing taking 20 minutes
    opening when not lowWater() and ewanRows(party) "Ewan Marrock's coracle is a black hide bowl on the Skerry rocks, a mile off. It does not come for anyone he has not asked.".
}
data/adventures/skerrow/places.kyr:
Module skerrow "The Light on Scarth Holm" {
  Description "Scarth Holm: a lighthouse on a rock at the end of a causeway that dries for three hours at noon, and a night, a day and a night in it.".

  Place coast "The Scarth coast" is region within imbar.
  Place sands "the Scarth sands" is wilderness within coast at 0, 1.
  Place holm "Scarth Holm" is wilderness within coast at 1, 0.
  Place tower "the Scarth light" is building within holm.
  Place l_ground "the ground floor" is level within tower.
  Place l_mid "the keeper's floor" is level within tower.
  Place l_top "the lamp" is level within tower.
  Place l_under "under the tower" is level within tower underground.

  Place shore_road "the landward end of the Scarth causeway" is room within sands at 0, 2 outdoors.
  Place sands_mid "the middle of the causeway" is room within sands at 0, 1 outdoors.
  Place landing "the holm's landing" is room within holm at 1, 1 outdoors.
  Place boat_shed "the boat shed" is room within holm at 2, 1.
  Place bell_hut "the fog-bell hut" is room within holm at 2, 0 outdoors.
  Place kitchen "the keeper's kitchen" is room within l_ground at 0, 1.
  Place store "the oil store" is room within l_ground at 1, 1.
  Place keeper_room "the keeper's room" is room within l_mid at 0, 1.
  Place lamp_room "the lamp room" is room within l_top at 0, 1.
  Place gallery "the gallery" is room within l_top at 1, 1 outdoors.
  Place cistern "the cistern" is room within l_under at 0, 0.

  Initially Assert unlit(store). Initially Assert unlit(keeper_room). Initially Assert unlit(cistern). Initially Assert unlit(boat_shed).

  Passage causeway_a "the causeway, landward half" is path between shore_road and sands_mid taking 1 hour
    opening when state(tide, low) "The sea is over the causeway. A line of black posts goes out into it, and then the posts stop.".
  Passage causeway_b "the causeway, seaward half" is path between sands_mid and landing taking 1 hour
    opening when state(tide, low) "The sea is over the causeway, and the posts end at the water.".
  Passage landing_door "the lighthouse door" is door between landing and kitchen.
  Passage landing_shed "the shed door" is door between landing and boat_shed.
  Passage landing_bell "the path to the fog bell" is path between landing and bell_hut taking 10 minutes.
  Passage kitchen_store "the store door" is door between kitchen and store.
  Passage kitchen_stair "the stair to the keeper's floor" is stair between kitchen and keeper_room taking 10 minutes.

data/adventures/skerrow/scenes.kyr:
Module skerrow "The Light on Scarth Holm" {
  Observe shore_road_scene at shore_road when true "The coast road stops at a slipway and a notice-board. Beyond the slipway there is no sand and no sea, only a flat grey light, and out in it, evenly spaced, black posts going away to a white tower the height of a church. A board under the notice says: THE CAUSEWAY DRIES FROM ELEVEN TO TWO. DO NOT START AFTER TWELVE.".
  Observe sands_mid_scene at sands_mid when true "Posts to either side, each with a number painted on it in white, and mud between them as smooth as a tray. The tower is no nearer. Behind you the land is a low line. Somewhere under the mud something ticks, as water does when it is thinking of coming back.".
  Observe landing_scene at landing when true "A stone landing, slimed to the second step, with iron rings and a winch. The tower stands up out of the rock behind it, whitewashed, streaked rust-red at every seam. A lamp is already lit in the lantern, though it is the middle of the day. A bell hangs from a gallows on the rock to the east.".
  Observe boat_shed_scene at boat_shed when true "A boat shed with no boat in it. A keel-block, oars on pegs, a barrel of tar. The floor slopes to a slip where the sea comes in under the door. It is colder here than outside.".
  Observe bell_hut_scene at bell_hut when true "A roofed frame on the rock's eastern point, open on three sides, with a bronze bell on a beam, and a tarred cord that runs from the beam to a hole in the tower wall at the height of the lamp room. The keeper's logbook lies in a box nailed to the post. Every page of it says the same two words.".
  Observe kitchen_scene at kitchen when true "A kitchen with a range, a table scrubbed white, and a smell of tea and lamp-oil and wet wool. Seven pegs by the door, one coat on each. A clock that has stopped at four. The window looks east at the bell and west at nothing.".
  Observe store_scene at store when true "Oil in drums and in flasks on slatted shelves, lamp-glasses wrapped in sacking, spare wicks in a box, a coil of rope. On the top shelf, by the wicks, a flask stoppered with wax and labelled BLESSED in a clerk's hand. Salt crusts the floor. In the corner, a hatch with an iron ring, and the ring is wet.".
  Observe keeper_room_scene at keeper_room when true "A narrow bed made like a bunk in a ship. A shelf of tide-tables. A woman's glove on the window-sill, put there so long ago that it has taken the shape of the sill, and has never once been dry. The window is open an inch and the sea is in the room.".
  Observe kitchen_lamp_low at kitchen when state(lamp, low) "Through the window the glow of the lantern has gone from white to yellow, and sunk.".
  Observe kitchen_lamp_out at kitchen when state(lamp, out) "Through the window, where the lantern was, there is nothing at all.".
  Observe lamp_room_scene at lamp_room when state(lamp, bright) "The lamp room is a glass cage round a brass lamp taller than a man, and the lens throws a white spoke out over the water once every six seconds, and the glass hums with it. A tarred cord comes in through the wall by the funnel and ends in a wooden handle. It is warm here. Everything else in the world is on the other side of the panes.".
  Observe lamp_room_low at lamp_room when state(lamp, low) "The flame has sunk to a blue bead. The lens throws a yellow smear, and the room is full of shadows that move when you do not.".
  Observe lamp_room_out at lamp_room when state(lamp, out) "The lamp is out. The glass is black on every side and shows the room back to itself, and, behind it, a pale shape on the stair that has not come up yet.".
  Observe gallery_scene at gallery when true "An iron ring of walkway round the lantern, at the top of the world, with a rail to the chest. Wind, and under it the sea, and over it the beam going round. In fog the beam is a wall.".
  Observe cistern_scene at cistern when true "A vaulted tank under the rock, half full. The water is black and perfectly still. It rises and falls with the tide, and the iron ladder to the store has a green high-water line on every rung.".
}
data/adventures/skerrow/wake.kyr:
Module skerrow "The Light on Scarth Holm" {
  Relation crossed(group).
  Rule crossed_back when been(party, landing) and at(party, shore_road) and not crossed(party) { Assert crossed(party). }
  Query elseLost() means dibTaken(party) or gaffTaken(party) or piersLost(party) or corrieLost(party).

  Chapter ch_shore "The Notice-Board" when true "A coast road ends at a slipway and a notice. The causeway dries for three hours at noon. Do not start after twelve.".
  Chapter ch_dusk "The Light in the Day" when been(party, landing) "A lighthouse lit at noon, and a kitchen with seven coats on seven pegs.".
  Chapter ch_night "The Gaps in the Bell" when callN(tide) >= 1 "The tide is in, and the bell has stopped, and out on the water someone has begun to speak.".
  Chapter ch_day "The Day That Isn't" when reachedAt(tide) > 0 and watch(clock) >= reachedAt(tide) + 90 and not crossed(party) "It is morning by the clock. The fog has not noticed. There is a causeway under it that will be there for three hours, and the posts go out into nothing.".
  Chapter ch_second "The Second Night" when reachedAt(tide) > 0 and watch(clock) >= reachedAt(tide) + 180 and not crossed(party) "The window is dark again. The sea is in. In the cistern something has begun, once more, to say a name.".

  Objective cross_by_noon when been(party, landing) and not crossed(party) and reachedAt(tide) > 0 and watch(clock) >= reachedAt(tide) + 50 "The causeway dries from eleven to two. It will not be dry in the dark.".
  Objective keep_the_lamp when orrinChasing(party) or not orrinPost(orrin) "Nobody is keeping the lamp.".

  Milestone m_landing "crossed the sands to Scarth Holm" worth 100 when been(party, landing).
  Milestone m_kept "got through the first night with the lamp lit" worth 200 when reachedAt(tide) > 0 and watch(clock) >= reachedAt(tide) + 90 and not state(lamp, out).
  Milestone m_basket "looked in Hettie's basket" worth 50 when knows(party, basket_looked).
  Milestone m_spoke "heard Seddon say what he never said" worth 300 when orrinDeclared(party).
  Milestone m_held "kept Hettie from the water" worth 300 when hettieKept(party).
  Milestone m_false "lied to the Caller in a voice that frightened it" worth 250 when answeredFalse(party).
  Milestone m_crossed "walked the causeway out again" worth 200 when crossed(party).

  Ending e_together_all "Everyone Out" when crossed(party) and not hettieTaken(party) and not orrinTaken(party) and orrinComes(party) and not elseLost() "You come off the causeway with the tide already turning behind you, every one. Hettie is on the keeper's arm. Behind you the lamp is going round in the daylight for nobody. Seddon does not look back at it. At the slipway he stands looking at the notice-board, and says, to it, 'Well.' Hettie says, 'I've brought too much bread,' and cannot be stopped from talking of it.".
  Ending e_together_lost "Together, and the Rest Lost" when crossed(party) and not hettieTaken(party) and not orrinTaken(party) and orrinComes(party) and elseLost() "You come off the causeway with two people walking close together, and fewer behind you than went out. Hettie is saying something over and over to the keeper, low, and he is nodding. Behind you the lamp goes round. You look back once. On the rock there is a thin line of smoke from the range, and the bell, in the fog, is not ringing.".
  Ending e_together_stay "The Light Goes On" when crossed(party) and not hettieTaken(party) and not orrinTaken(party) and orrinDeclared(party) and not orrinComes(party) "You cross with the tide already turning behind you, and the two of them do not. At the slipway you look back. On the rock a woman in black is standing at the foot of the tower with her bonnet in her hand, and a man beside her is explaining something, with his hands, to the lamp. The lamp is lit. It will be lit eighteen days more. The bell begins in broad day, for no one; then it stops, because there are two people on the east point, and one of them is explaining the cord.".
  Ending e_parted "Alive, and Apart" when crossed(party) and not hettieTaken(party) and not orrinTaken(party) and not orrinDeclared(party) and not orrinComes(party) "You cross at noon. Hettie Marram walks beside you with her basket and says little, and at the slipway she turns and looks out at the white tower. 'I shall come next year,' she says. 'I always do.' Out on the rock a man at a window lifts a hand, and puts it down. She does not wave. The causeway is going under behind you, post by post.".
  Ending e_hettie_down "The Keeper's Light" when crossed(party) and hettieTaken(party) and not orrinTaken(party) "You cross at noon, and the keeper stands on the landing and watches you go. He has not been asked to come. He has a lamp to keep. At the slipway you look back: the bell is ringing, slow and even, though it is broad day, and it goes on ringing until the fog takes the tower. On the rock the black bonnet is still on the winch.".
  Ending e_hettie_down_dated "The Keeper's Last Winter" over e_hettie_down when crossed(party) and hettieTaken(party) and not orrinTaken(party) and noticeGiven(party) and not orrinHeld(party) "You cross at noon, and the keeper stands on the landing and watches you go. He has not been asked to come. He has the Board's letter in his pocket, and a lamp to keep for eighteen days. At the slipway you look back: the bell is ringing though it is broad day, and it goes on ringing until the fog takes the tower. On the rock the black bonnet is still on the winch.".
  Ending e_hettie_held "The Keeper at His Lamp" over e_hettie_down when crossed(party) and hettieTaken(party) and not orrinTaken(party) and orrinDeclared(party) and orrinHeld(party) "You cross at noon. The keeper does not come down to the landing. He kept the lamp because he was asked to, by someone he had just trusted, and he is at the window of the lamp room with his hands flat on the glass. At the slipway you look back. The bell begins in broad day and does not stop until the fog takes the tower. On the rock the black bonnet is still on the winch.".
  Ending e_both_down "Down to the Water" when crossed(party) and hettieTaken(party) and orrinTaken(party) "You cross at noon. The lamp is going round on the rock in the daylight, with nobody to put it out. You wait at the slipway. At two the sea comes over the first of the posts. A woman's bonnet is on the winch, and a man's jersey on the landing, and the bell has stopped. In the evening a boat goes out from the village. It comes back with the lamp still lit, and nobody to ask about it.".
  Ending e_dawn "The Second Dawn" when within(party, holm) and reachedAt(tide) > 0 and watch(clock) >= reachedAt(tide) + 240 and not crossed(party) "You have got through two nights. At dawn the fog lifts off the water in one piece and the sands are bare, grey and wet, a mile of them, with the posts going out, and, a long way off, the roofs of a village. The tide is a long way out. In the cistern the water is perfectly still. Whatever it is has gone down, for now, as it goes down every morning, and will come back with the dark. You are alive.".
}

Module tallow "Tallow Deep" {
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // What grows where it does (the owner's plants, by their records: src/world/region-growth.ts writes the same lines
  // for a generated country).
  // The Swallow rim: the spray keeps a green fringe on the lip of the sink.
  Thing rim_kingsfoil "the kingsfoil" at swallow_rim is scenery {
    State growing "Kingsfoil grows in the lee of the ash roots, a low three-leaved herb with a clean sharp scent where the spray has touched it.".
  }
  Initially Assert grows(rim_kingsfoil).
  Discovery rim_kingsfoil_hid "What grows at the Swallow's rim is gathered, not found.".
  Item rim_kingsfoil_1 "a sprig of kingsfoil" is kingsfoil in rim_kingsfoil hidden until rim_kingsfoil_hid.
  Initially Assert crop(rim_kingsfoil_1, rim_kingsfoil).
  Item rim_kingsfoil_2 "a sprig of kingsfoil" is kingsfoil in rim_kingsfoil hidden until rim_kingsfoil_hid.
  Initially Assert crop(rim_kingsfoil_2, rim_kingsfoil).
  Thing rim_alhuren "the alhuren" at swallow_rim is scenery {
    State growing "Alhuren grows between the roots on the lip of the sink, silver-leaved, with blue flowers that give back a faint light of their own.".
  }
  Initially Assert grows(rim_alhuren).
  Discovery rim_alhuren_hid "The alhuren at the Swallow's rim is gathered, not found.".
  Item rim_alhuren_1 "a spray of alhuren" is alhuren_gathered in rim_alhuren hidden until rim_alhuren_hid.
  Initially Assert crop(rim_alhuren_1, rim_alhuren).
  // The Rising bank: feverwort on the limestone, and gentian where it is stony.
  Thing bank_feverwort "the feverwort" at bank is scenery {
    State growing "Feverwort grows on the limestone by the bank, pale-leaved, with flat heads of small white flowers.".
  }
  Initially Assert grows(bank_feverwort).
  Discovery bank_feverwort_hid "The feverwort at the Rising's bank is gathered, not found.".
  Item bank_feverwort_1 "a bunch of feverwort" is feverwort in bank_feverwort hidden until bank_feverwort_hid.
  Initially Assert crop(bank_feverwort_1, bank_feverwort).
  Item bank_feverwort_2 "a bunch of feverwort" is feverwort in bank_feverwort hidden until bank_feverwort_hid.
  Initially Assert crop(bank_feverwort_2, bank_feverwort).
  Thing track_gentian "the gentian" at upland_track is scenery {
    State growing "Gentian grows in the grikes of the limestone pavement, a trumpet of the deepest blue.".
  }
  Initially Assert grows(track_gentian).
  Discovery track_gentian_hid "The gentian on the upland is gathered, not found.".
  Item track_gentian_1 "a blue gentian" is gentian_gathered in track_gentian hidden until track_gentian_hid.
  Initially Assert crop(track_gentian_1, track_gentian).
  // The Brasiers' garden: what a company's cook kept, run wild. The Tallymen cut the rue.
  Thing garden_foxglove "the foxglove" at garden is scenery {
    State growing "Foxglove stands tall in the wall's shelter, its spire of speckled bells nodding.".
  }
  Initially Assert grows(garden_foxglove).
  Discovery garden_foxglove_hid "The garden's foxglove is gathered, not found.".
  Item garden_foxglove_1 "a spire of foxglove" is foxglove in garden_foxglove hidden until garden_foxglove_hid.
  Initially Assert crop(garden_foxglove_1, garden_foxglove).
  Thing garden_poppy "the poppies" at garden is scenery {
    State growing "Poppies seed themselves in the old beds, red as a cut.".
  }
  Initially Assert grows(garden_poppy).
  Discovery garden_poppy_hid "The garden's poppies are gathered, not found.".
  Item garden_poppy_1 "a handful of poppy heads" is poppy_gathered in garden_poppy hidden until garden_poppy_hid.
  Initially Assert crop(garden_poppy_1, garden_poppy).
  Thing garden_rue "the rue" at garden is scenery {
    State growing "Rue stands in a grey-green bush by the bothy door, cut back hard on one side with a clean knife.".
  }
  Initially Assert grows(garden_rue).
  Discovery garden_rue_hid "The garden's rue is gathered, not found.".
  Item garden_rue_1 "a sprig of rue" is rue_gathered in garden_rue hidden until garden_rue_hid.
  Initially Assert crop(garden_rue_1, garden_rue).
  Thing garden_tansy "the tansy" at garden is scenery {
    State growing "Tansy has run through the beds in yellow buttons.".
  }
  Initially Assert grows(garden_tansy).
  Discovery garden_tansy_hid "The garden's tansy is gathered, not found.".
  Item garden_tansy_1 "a bunch of tansy" is tansy_gathered in garden_tansy hidden until garden_tansy_hid.
  Initially Assert crop(garden_tansy_1, garden_tansy).

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Treasure and gear, from Orsino's inventory: what was left, where the people of each age would have left it.
  // The Day-Level: the Company's, and the Tallymen's.
  Item smithy_oil_a "a flask of lamp oil" is lamp_oil at smithy.
  Item smithy_oil_b "a flask of lamp oil" is lamp_oil at smithy.
  Item smithy_hammer "the smith's hammer" is hammer at smithy.
  Item smithy_spikes "a bag of iron spikes" is iron_spikes at smithy.
  Item counting_gem "a cased rose quartz" is rose_quartz in drawer hidden until counting_known.
  Item counting_jet "a lump of polished jet" is onyx in drawer hidden until counting_known.
  Item counting_map "a surveyor's map of the Day-Level" is map at counting.
  Thing drawer "the specimen drawers" at counting {
    State closed_up "A cabinet of shallow drawers, every one labelled in the Company's assayer's hand: LEAD, ZINC, BLACK, NOT BLACK.".
    State pulled "The drawers are out, and the specimens in them lie sorted: lead, zinc, a dozen black lumps, and a cased red-pink stone.".
    Change pull_drawers "Go through the assayer's drawers" from closed_up to pulled.
  }
  Discovery counting_known "The assayer's drawers are sorted, and the black ore among them is ironglass.".
  Observe drawers_taught at counting when state(drawer, pulled) "The black lumps have a fracture like glass and an edge you can cut yourself on without touching." teaches counting_known.
  Item smithy_chain "a length of chain" is chain at winding.
  // The spiders' larder: what a Tallyman had on him.
  Item vault_pack "a Tallyman's pack" is backpack at spider_vault.
  Item vault_rope "a coil of good rope" is rope at spider_vault.
  Item vault_harness "a climbing harness" is climbing_harness at spider_vault.
  Item vault_whistle "a signal whistle" is signal_whistle at spider_vault.
  Item vault_coin "a dull steel coin" is steel_coin at spider_vault.
  Item vault_collar "a cat's collar with a stopped bell" is bell at spider_gallery.
  // The Aenean works.
  Item settling_toll "a sack of mixed coin and hack-silver" is toll_silver at settling.
  Item service_piton "a bronze piton" is piton at aenean_walk.
  Item sluice_oil "a lamp, filled" is lamp at sluice_house.
  Item sump_bar "a Company crowbar" is crowbar at sump.
  Item sump_lantern "a Company lantern" is lantern at sump.
  
  Item calx_toll "an Aenean toll-sack" is toll_silver at gate_house.
  Item gate_map "a strip-map of the road" is ancient_map in gate_house hidden until gate_known.
  // The Ossuary: fourteen men in their boots, and what they wore.
  Item carr_oilcan "a Company oilcan, full, in a dead hand" is lamp_oil at gate_house.
  Item ossuary_rings "a handful of grave rings" is grave_rings at ossuary.
  Item ossuary_whistle "a foreman's whistle" is signal_whistle at ossuary.
  // The Bore: the makers', which no later age understood.
  Item gear_teeth "bell-teeth, prised from a wheel" is bell_teeth at breach.
  Item dial_orrery "an orrery of grey metal" is ancient_orrery at dial_room.
  Item dial_chart "a chart of the stars, in grey ink on grey" is celestial_chart at dial_room.
  Item dial_lens "a lensing crystal" is lensing_crystal at dial_room.
  Item dial_compass "an antique compass" is antique_compass at dial_room.
}

Module tallow "Tallow Deep" {
  Description "Tallow Edge: a long pale ridge that swallows a river, and what three peoples made of the dark inside it.".

  // The hill, from the village outward and downward. Four ways in: the Day-Level adit and the Rising (the foot), the
  // Swallow (the upland), and the Calx Way (the west road, buried).
  Place edge "Tallow Edge" is region within imbar.
  Place foot "the foot of the Edge" is wilderness within edge at 1, 2.
  Place swallet "Swallet" is settlement within edge at 1, 1.
  Place upland "the Tallow upland" is wilderness within edge at 1, 0.
  Place westway "the west road" is wilderness within edge at 0, 1.
  Place deep "Tallow Deep" is site within edge at 2, 1.
  Place inn "the Chandler's Arms" is building within swallet.
  Place assay "the assay house" is building within swallet.
  Place store "Usk's store" is building within swallet.

  Place l1 "the Day-Level" is level within deep underground.
  Place l2 "the Conduit" is level within deep underground.
  Place l3 "the Cistern" is level within deep underground.
  Place l4 "the Long Stair" is level within deep underground.
  Place l5 "the foot of the Bore" is level within deep underground.

  // Above ground.
  Place road "the Swallet road" is room within foot at 0, 0 outdoors.
  Place lane "Swallet lane" is room within swallet at 0, 1 outdoors.
  Place green "Swallet green" is room within swallet at 1, 1 outdoors.
  Place taproom "the Chandler's Arms" is room within inn at 2, 0.
  Place counter "the assayer's counter" is room within assay at 2, 2.
  Place shop "Usk's store" is room within store at 0, 2.
  Place bank "the bank below the Rising" is room within foot at 1, 0 outdoors.
  Place rising_mouth "the mouth of the Rising" is room within foot at 2, 0 outdoors.
  Place garden "the Brasiers' garden" is room within foot at 1, 1 outdoors.
  Place adit_mouth "the Day-Level portal" is room within foot at 1, 2 outdoors.
  Place upland_track "the upland track" is room within upland at 1, 2 outdoors.
  Place scrub "the heather scrub" is room within upland at 1, 1 outdoors.
  Place swallow_rim "the rim of the Swallow" is room within upland at 1, 0 outdoors.
  Place west_end "the west road's end" is room within westway at 0, 1 outdoors.
  Place calx_portal "the buried portal" is room within westway at 0, 0 outdoors.

  // The Day-Level: the Brasiers' Company's works, sixty years gone.
  Place adit "the adit" is room within l1 at 0, 1.
  Place drift "the long drift" is room within l1 at 1, 1.
  Place tally_room "the Tally-Room" is room within l1 at 2, 1.
  Place smithy "the Company smithy" is room within l1 at 2, 0.
  Place stores "the old stores" is room within l1 at 2, 2.
  Place counting "the Company's counting-house" is room within l1 at 3, 1.
  Place winding "the winding-house" is room within l1 at 4, 1.
  Place rising_gallery "the Rising Gallery" is room within l1 at 0, 3.
  Place bat_chimney "the bat chimney" is room within l1 at 1, 3.

  // The Conduit: the Aenean waterworks.
  Place settling "the Settling Cistern" is room within l2 at 0, 2.
  Place aenean_walk "the Aenean service walk" is room within l2 at 1, 2.
  Place spider_gallery "the Spider Gallery" is room within l2 at 2, 2.
  Place upper_conduit "the Upper Conduit" is room within l2 at 3, 2.
  Place swallow_foot "the foot of the Swallow" is room within l2 at 4, 2.
  Place sluice_house "the sluice-house" is room within l2 at 3, 1.
  Place shaft_head "the head of the Blind Shaft" is room within l2 at 4, 0.

  // The Cistern: a hall for a river to settle in, and what the miners found in it.
  Place sump "the sump of the Blind Shaft" is room within l3 at 4, 0.
  Place north_walk "the north walk" is room within l3 at 3, 0.
  Place foremans_office "the Foreman's office" is room within l3 at 2, 0.
  Place cistern_hall "the Cistern Hall" is room within l3 at 2, 2.

  // The Bore: older than the Cistern, and not for water.

  Place ossuary "the Ossuary" is room within l4 at 4, 0.
  Place gate_house "the gate-house of the Calx Way" is room within l4 at 5, 0.
  Place gear_hall "the Gear-Hall" is room within l5 at 3, 3.
  Place quiet_gallery "the Quiet Gallery" is room within l5 at 2, 4.

  Initially Assert unlit(adit). Initially Assert unlit(drift). Initially Assert unlit(smithy). Initially Assert unlit(stores).
  Initially Assert unlit(counting). Initially Assert unlit(winding). Initially Assert unlit(rising_gallery).
  Initially Assert unlit(bat_chimney). Initially Assert unlit(settling). Initially Assert unlit(aenean_walk).
  Initially Assert unlit(spider_gallery). Initially Assert unlit(upper_conduit). Initially Assert unlit(swallow_foot).
  Initially Assert unlit(sluice_house). Initially Assert unlit(shaft_head). Initially Assert unlit(sump).
  Initially Assert unlit(north_walk). Initially Assert unlit(foremans_office). Initially Assert unlit(cistern_hall).
  Initially Assert unlit(south_landing). Initially Assert unlit(tally_wall). Initially Assert unlit(the_cap).
  Initially Assert unlit(breach). Initially Assert unlit(ossuary). Initially Assert unlit(gate_house).
  Initially Assert unlit(gear_hall). Initially Assert unlit(quiet_gallery). Initially Assert unlit(dial_room).
  Initially Assert unlit(calx_inner). Initially Assert unlit(calx_way).

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Passages above ground.
  Passage swallet_road "the Swallet road" is road between road and lane taking 30 minutes.
  Passage lane_green "the lane" is road between lane and green.
  Passage inn_door "the Chandler's door" is door between green and taproom.
  Passage assay_door "the assay house door" is door between green and counter.
  Passage store_door "Usk's door" is door between green and shop.
  Passage bank_path "the path to the Rising" is path between green and bank taking 20 minutes.
  Passage wend_ford "the Wend at the bank" is ford between bank and rising_mouth taking 10 minutes.
  Passage garden_path "the path to the Brasiers' garden" is path between green and garden taking 20 minutes.
  Passage portal_path "the track to the Day-Level" is path between garden and adit_mouth taking 10 minutes.
  Passage upland_climb "the upland climb" is path between green and upland_track taking 1 hour.
  Passage scrub_path "the track through the scrub" is path between upland_track and scrub taking 30 minutes.
  Passage rim_path "the track to the Swallow" is path between scrub and swallow_rim taking 20 minutes
    opening when tolerates(owlbear, party) or not able(owlbear) "The she-owlbear stands across the track to the Swallow, broad as the heather, and does not intend to be passed.".
  Passage west_track "the west road" is road between lane and west_end taking 1 hour.
  Passage buried_way "the scree below the ridge's end" is path between west_end and calx_portal taking 20 minutes.

  // The Day-Level.
  Passage adit_way "the adit" is tunnel between adit_mouth and adit taking 10 minutes.
  Passage adit_drift "the drift" is passage between adit and drift.
  Passage drift_tally "the Tally-Room arch" is arch between drift and tally_room.
  Passage smithy_door "the smithy door" is door between tally_room and smithy.
  Passage stores_door "the stores door" is door between tally_room and stores.
  Passage counting_door "the counting-house door" is door between tally_room and counting.
  Passage drift_winding "the rail to the winding-house" is passage between tally_room and winding taking 10 minutes.
  Passage rising_hole "the cave mouth of the Rising" is tunnel between rising_mouth and rising_gallery taking 20 minutes.
  Passage gallery_chimney "the gap to the bat chimney" is crawl between rising_gallery and bat_chimney.
  Passage chimney_drift "the miners' stope" is crawl between bat_chimney and stores taking 20 minutes hidden until stope_known.

  // Up the river: the Conduit.
  Passage gallery_settling "the Wend's channel, upstream" is tunnel between rising_gallery and settling taking 30 minutes.
  Passage settling_service "the service walk's lower stair" is steps between settling and aenean_walk.
  Passage service_spiders "the service walk" is passage between aenean_walk and spider_gallery taking 20 minutes.
  Passage spiders_upper "the Upper Conduit" is passage between spider_gallery and upper_conduit taking 20 minutes
    opening when not at(spiders, spider_gallery) or not able(spiders) or tolerates(spiders, party) "Tier on tier of web hangs across the way to the Upper Conduit, and the spiders sit in it.".
  Passage upper_foot "the Aenean channel" is passage between upper_conduit and swallow_foot.
  Passage upper_sluice "the sluice steps" is steps between upper_conduit and sluice_house.
  Passage swallow_climb "the Swallow's throat" is shaft between swallow_foot and swallow_rim taking 2 hours needing rope or climbing.

  // Down: the Blind Shaft and the Cistern.
  Passage winding_shaft "the Blind Shaft" is shaft between winding and shaft_head taking 10 minutes needing rope or climbing.
  Passage shaft_down "the Blind Shaft, below" is shaft between shaft_head and sump taking 30 minutes needing rope.
  Passage upper_hall "the Aenean steps down to the Cistern Hall" is stair between upper_conduit and cistern_hall taking 20 minutes.
  Passage sump_walk "the Foreman's ledge" is passage between sump and north_walk taking 10 minutes.
  Passage walk_office "the office stair" is steps between north_walk and foremans_office.
  Passage walk_hall "the Cistern Hall's north shore" is passage between north_walk and cistern_hall taking 10 minutes.
  Passage hall_landing "the south shore" is passage between cistern_hall and south_landing taking 10 minutes.
  Passage hall_wall "the way along the west wall" is passage between south_landing and tally_wall taking 20 minutes.
  Passage hall_cap "the causeway to the Cap" is passage between cistern_hall and the_cap taking 10 minutes
    opening when state(sluice, wound) or been(party, the_cap) "The causeway to the Cap lies a hand under black water, and the water is deep on either side. Nothing crosses it while the river runs."
    opening when tolerates(slump, party) or not able(slump) "The black water along the causeway stands up in a smooth wall, between you and the Cap.".
  Passage landing_settling "the siphon-house stair" is stair between south_landing and settling taking 20 minutes.

  // The Bore.
  Passage cap_upper "the Long Stair, upper flights" is stair between the_cap and breach taking 30 minutes.
  Passage breach_ossuary "the miners' breach" is passage between breach and ossuary.
  Passage ossuary_gate "the Calx Way, east end" is passage between ossuary and gate_house
    opening when laid(party) or dead(ghouls) or not able(ghouls) or tolerates(ghouls, party) "The ghouls crouch in the way to the Calx Way, long hands flat on the stacked boots.".
  Passage gate_way "the Calx Gate" is gate between gate_house and calx_way.
  Passage way_portal "the Calx Way, west" is tunnel between calx_way and calx_inner taking 1 hour.
  Passage portal_inner "the buried portal's face" is gate between calx_inner and calx_portal.
  Passage breach_gear "the Long Stair, lower flights" is stair between breach and gear_hall taking 30 minutes.
  Passage gear_quiet "the Quiet Gallery's mouth" is passage between gear_hall and quiet_gallery
    opening when not able(custodians) or tolerates(custodians, party) "The custodians stand across the mouth of the Quiet Gallery, side by side, and do not move.".
  Passage quiet_dial "the Quiet Gallery, far end" is passage between quiet_gallery and dial_room
    opening when not able(stalkers) or tolerates(stalkers, party) "Far down the gallery three heads are turned toward you on the ceiling, every pit of them pointed at your mouth.".
}
data/adventures/tallow/scenes.kyr:
Module tallow "Tallow Deep" {
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Above ground.
  Observe road_scene at road when true "The road comes down off the downs to a pale ridge with a village at its foot. The ridge is limestone, bare and grey as tallow, and nothing is cut into it but a river.".
  Observe lane_scene at lane when true "Swallet is one lane of lime-washed cottages with their doors turned from the hill. Every doorstep has a coil of wet rope on it, and nobody looks up the ridge.".
  Observe green_scene at green when true "A green with a horse-trough fed by a pipe from the hill, and three doors: the Chandler's Arms, the assay house, and Usk's store. Paths go out to the Rising, to the old garden, and up on to the upland. The pipe runs a little cloudy, as it has since the water-trouble.".
  Observe taproom_scene at taproom when true "A low taproom where nobody sits with their back to the hill. Brasiers' Company tokens, black with handling, are nailed along the beam.".
  Observe counter_scene at counter when true "A narrow counter with brass scales, a magnet on a string, and a rack of little drawers each labelled in a careful hand: LEAD, ZINC, BLACK, NOT BLACK. Samples of rock lie on every flat place.".
  Observe shop_scene at shop when true "A store that sells what a hill needs: rope, oil, spikes, candles, and the dry biscuit of a place where bread cannot be baked for the damp.".
  Observe bank_scene at bank when true "The Wend comes out of the hill on the east side of the village, in a pale arch of rock the villagers call the Rising, and runs shallow and fast across a gravel bank. Bats are going in and out of the arch in the half-light, and have been all day.".
  Observe rising_mouth_scene at rising_mouth when true "A cave mouth sixty feet wide with the river flowing out of it, so cold that the air smells of stone. A ledge on the west side is dry for now. The gravel is stained with guano, and the draught blows steadily out of the hill.".
  Observe garden_scene at garden when true "A walled garden gone to seed, with a bothy at the back and a path beyond to a hole in the hillside. Foxglove stands in the wall's shelter, and tansy and rue have gone wild between the beds. Someone has cut the rue lately, and the cuts are clean.".
  Observe adit_mouth_scene at adit_mouth when true "A square portal cut into the hill, timbered and rotting, with rails running out of it to nothing. Stubs of rushlight are trodden into the mud, and the boot-prints are a week old at most. A boy sits on a barrel by the portal and looks at nothing, hard.".
  Observe upland_track_scene at upland_track when true "The track climbs out of the village on to open upland: short turf, limestone pavement, and grikes in the rock a man could lose a leg in. Sheep keep away from the north side.".
  Observe scrub_scene at scrub when true "Heather scrub in the lee of a scar, trodden into runs by something heavy. The turf is torn up in long strips and the sheep's bones are scattered, not dropped. Past the scrub the ground drops to the north to a sound like a mill.".
  Observe swallow_rim_scene at swallow_rim when true "The Wend comes down off the downs in a brisk beck and walks over the edge into a hole in the ground forty feet across. The hole is called the Swallow, and the sound it makes is two sounds, one above the other: the fall, and a long rushing under it. A fringe of ash and hazel grows on the lip where the spray keeps it green.".
  Observe west_end_scene at west_end when true "The west road ends where the ridge ends, in a fall of loose white stone. Behind the stone there was once a bank, and in it a square of masonry too fine for any farm.".
  Observe calx_portal_scene at calx_portal when true "A slope of scree has slid down against a wall of squared stone, set without mortar, and the top of an arch shows above it. Carved in the keystone, weathered nearly out: a wheel, and a number.".

  // The Day-Level.
  Observe adit_scene at adit when true "A timbered adit running into the hill, wet underfoot, with a rail down the middle and a lantern burning at a bend. Ahead, a man's cough.".
  Observe drift_scene at drift when true "The long drift is cut square and well, and the Company's timbers are still sound. Smugglers' marks are chalked on them: tallies in fives, and a tub with a line through it.".
  Observe tally_room_scene at tally_room when true "A wide chamber lit by a dozen lamps, with a long table, a ledger, and casks and bales stacked to the timbers. The Tallymen live here: three hammocks, a stove, a dog, and the smell of wet salt and spirits.".
  Observe smithy_scene at smithy when true "The Company's smithy, cold. An anvil, a bellows split with age, and racks of picks with their points worn back to the wood. Someone has set a lamp in a niche over the forge and left it, trimmed.".
  Observe stores_scene at stores when true "The old stores are low and long and smell of rat. Every shelf has been gnawed through and the bags on the floor are rags. Droppings lie in drifts. Something in the dark is moving in short, steady rushes.".
  Observe counting_scene at counting when true "The Company's counting-house: a clerk's desk, a safe with its door off, and drawers of specimens labelled in a hand that never wasted a stroke. A door in the back wall has been bricked shut, and the brick is newer than the room.".
  Observe winding_scene at winding when true "The winding-house stands over a round shaft the width of a cart. A drum of rotted rope, a brake-lever, and a plank cage hung at the top of the shaft by one chain. Cold air breathes up out of the dark, and, a long way down, water.".
  Observe rising_gallery_scene at rising_gallery when true "The river runs through a wide gallery of pale rock the colour of old teeth, knee-deep and fast. The roof is alive with bats. The air is cold and full of the sound of water, and every sound you make is lost in it.".
  Observe bat_chimney_scene at bat_chimney when true "A tall chimney in the rock with a floor of guano a foot deep. A thin draught of air goes up it. The bats leave by it in the evening, and the guano shows the track of something that crawls.".

  // The Conduit.
  Observe settling_scene at settling when true "A great cistern, Aenean, vaulted in brick with a stone weir across it, where the river settled its silt before the Rising. The silt is a bank of grey mud ten feet high, trodden by rats. A walkway of cut stone goes up the east side.".
  Observe service_scene at aenean_walk when true "The service walk is the Aenean engineers' way along their conduit: a stone ledge two paces wide with a handrail socket every ten paces, and a mason's mark at every socket. A lamp-niche is cut every hundred paces, and every one has been cleaned of soot.".
  Observe spider_gallery_scene at spider_gallery when true "The walk widens into a gallery, and the gallery is full of web. Grey sheets hang from the vault to the floor in tiers, thick as sailcloth, and bats hang in them, wrapped. A collar with a bell on it lies in the dust, and the bell is stopped with a bit of web.".
  Observe upper_conduit_scene at upper_conduit when true "A tunnel as wide as a street, arched, with the river running down a stone channel at its middle. The Aeneans lined it in white stone and cut a number at every pace: 800, 799, 798. There is a stair down on the east side, and a stair up to a low door.".
  Observe swallow_foot_scene at swallow_foot when true "The Swallow's throat opens overhead in a round of grey light, and the Wend falls through it into a pool that is already running away. Far above, the sky. The noise is enormous.".
  Observe sluice_house_scene at sluice_house when true "A stone room built over the channel, with a floor of oak planks over the water and a great bronze wheel on the wall, geared to a gate. Aenean letters run round the wheel's rim. Beside it hangs a lamp that has been filled since the Brasiers left.".
  Observe shaft_head_scene at shaft_head when true "The Blind Shaft's second landing: a platform of timber at the middle of a round shaft, with the cage-rails above and below. The air going up carries the smell of wet iron and, faintly, of something sweet.".

  // The Cistern.
  Observe sump_scene at sump when true "The shaft ends in a sump of black water over a floor of broken timber. A ledge runs west into the dark. The Company's last cage lies on its side, and there are boots in it.".
  Observe north_walk_scene at north_walk when true "A narrow ledge along the north wall of an enormous hall. The water below is black and flat, and the other side is out of sight. There are numbers carved in the wall at every pace. A door has been cut in the wall, much later than the numbers, and has a Company's brass plate on it.".
  Observe foremans_office_scene at foremans_office when true "The Foreman's office: a timber room built on a shelf above the hall, with a stove, a desk, a bunk, and a window cut to look down on the water. Every paper in it has been weighted with a stone.".
  Observe cistern_hall_scene at cistern_hall when true "The Cistern Hall is a cathedral's length, and half full of water. Columns of white stone rise out of it in rows, and the river is lost between them. A stair comes down from the Conduit, and a stone causeway runs out toward the middle, to a round of different stone. The hall has no sound except the river and your own steps, and the steps come back late.".
  Observe south_landing_scene at south_landing when true "A dry landing at the south end of the hall where the water goes down a grating into the siphon. The grating is rusted and the water fights it. A stair goes up, and a ledge goes round to the west wall.".
  Observe tally_wall_scene at tally_wall when true "A wall cut flat and covered in Aenean script, in rows, in the clear square letters the legions used for orders. Under it a Company clerk has chalked a translation, wrong in places, and corrected in the same chalk.".
  Observe the_cap_scene at the_cap when true "A round of unlike stone forty feet across, in the middle of the Hall, with a ring of bronze at its centre as big as a cart-wheel. Under the ring the stone is cut with a spiral stair, and a cold, dry draught comes out of the stair. Nothing is written on the Cap but a single line of Aenean, cut deep and recut.".

  // The Bore.
  Observe breach_scene at breach when true "The Long Stair stops at a landing where the wall of the shaft has been smashed in from outside, and a miners' adit comes through it. The stair is made of a grey metal like glass, and the Company's timber ladder against it has rotted to wet fibre.".
  Observe ossuary_scene at ossuary when true "The Ossuary is a long vault with the dead stacked in it like cordwood. The Company laid them here in the winter of the Breakthrough: thirteen men, in their boots. The smell is old and sweet, and there are fresh scratches high on the wall where nothing living reaches.".
  Observe gate_house_scene at gate_house when true "A square Aenean guard-room at the end of a road. The road itself is a paved tunnel running away west, and across its mouth a bronze portcullis hangs in its slot, green with age. Beside it a great wheel is set in the wall, and the pawl that holds it is a lump of rust.".
  Observe calx_way_scene at calx_way when true "A paved road ten paces wide, dead straight, running through the ridge under a vault of squared stone. Every hundred paces a milestone stands by the way with the legion's wheel and a number cut on it. The air moves a little. It smells of grass.".
  Observe calx_inner_scene at calx_inner when true "The road ends in a fall of earth and stone. Through a gap at the top, a hand's breadth wide, a line of daylight lies across the roof of the arch.".
  Observe gear_hall_scene at gear_hall when true "The Long Stair ends in a hall of grey metal, round, lit by nothing, and not dark: the walls are paler than they should be. Wheels with teeth no bigger than your thumb turn against each other in a bank along the wall, and above you the Bore goes up out of sight with a single wire hanging in the middle of it, swinging. A pair of man-high figures of grey metal stand on either side of the wire. They are winding something.".
  Observe quiet_gallery_scene at quiet_gallery when true "A gallery in grey metal, long and level, with a floor that takes no sound at all. Nothing grows or drips or lives in it. Your breath is the loudest thing in the world.".
  Observe dial_room_scene at dial_room when true "A round room with a floor of dark glass, in which, faintly, stars are set. At its centre the wire's point swings over the glass, and at each swing the stars move a hair. A shelf of grey metal runs round the wall, and things have been set on it with care.".
}
data/adventures/the-dorothea/company.kyr:

  Entity ring_coast: group "The ring's man on the coast.".

  Entity lieutenant_named: fact "The ring's man on the coast has been named.".

data/adventures/the-dorothea/isle.kyr:
Module dorothea "The Dorothea" {
  Description "Skerrow: a green island three days out, forty-one souls, a stone jetty, sheep, and a tower with a lamp in it that was old when the roads were young.".

  Place skerrow "Skerrow" is region.
  Place hamlet "Skerrow hamlet" is settlement within skerrow at 0, 0.
  Place hill "Pharos Hill" is wilderness within skerrow at 1, 0.
  Place pharos_site "the Pharos" is site within skerrow at 2, 0.
  Place gull_inn "the Gull" is building within hamlet.
  Place jetty "Skerrow jetty" is room within hamlet at 0, 1.
  Place green "Skerrow green" is room within hamlet at 1, 1.
  Place gull_room "the Gull's kitchen" is room within gull_inn at 1, 0.
  Place hill_path "the path up Pharos Hill" is room within hill at 0, 0.
  Place pharos_foot "the foot of the Pharos" is room within pharos_site at 0, 0.
  Place pharos_lamp "the lamp room" is room within pharos_site at 1, 0.

  Passage jetty_way "the jetty road" is path between jetty and green taking 10 minutes.
  Passage gull_door "the Gull's door" is door between green and gull_room.
  Passage hill_way "the hill path" is path between green and hill_path taking 30 minutes.
  Passage pharos_way "the last of the path" is path between hill_path and pharos_foot taking 10 minutes.
  Passage lamp_stair "the lamp stair" is passage between pharos_foot and pharos_lamp.

  Observe jetty_scene at jetty when not at(hull, jetty) "Skerrow's jetty: a hundred feet of dry-stone wall running out into green water, with a ring in it every ten feet and a rowing boat tied to the third. Nothing else is moored here.".
  Observe jetty_landing at jetty when at(hull, jetty) "Skerrow jetty: dry stone running out into green water, a ring in it every ten feet, and the boy who caught the line sitting on the third ring with his heels over the edge. Up the shingle is the hamlet, its smoke lying flat; above it, alone on the one hill, the white tower. Every face on the island has come to the door to see who the Dorothea has brought, and is pretending to be looking at the weather.".
  Observe green_scene at green when true "Skerrow green: a dozen low houses with their backs to the west, a well, a flagpole with nothing on it, and sheep who do not see why you should be there. Above the roofs, on the island's one hill, a white tower.".
  Observe gull_scene at gull_room when true "The Gull's kitchen is the island's inn, shop, post office and court. A black range, a long scrubbed table, a ledger of debts in a hand that has never forgiven anyone, and on the wall a framed paper nobody has read since the frame was bought.".
  Observe path_scene at hill_path when true "The path climbs between walls of grey stone fitted without mortar, and the sheep keep to the lee of them. Far below, the jetty, and past it the sea to every side of the world.".
  Observe foot_scene at pharos_foot when true "The Pharos: a round tower of black stone, fitted without mortar, rising out of a floor of the same, the joints so fine you cannot find the mark of a knife. A newer door, oak and iron, is set in the old arch, and over the arch a line of letters in the old imperial tongue, much weathered, and under that a line in an older script that has been scrubbed at with sand.".
  Observe lamp_scene at pharos_lamp when true "The lamp room: a great bronze reflector the width of a door, a lens of green glass in an iron frame, a brass lamp with a ring of wicks, and a smell of whale oil and warm metal. All round the room, under the glass, the sea.".

  Person kestle "Marren Kestle" at pharos_lamp {
    Role "keeper of the Pharos". Ancestry human. Peaceable. Pronouns she. Manner proud.
    Likeness "abbess".
    Greets "A tall woman in a seaman's jersey is on her knees at the lamp's brass foot with a rag, polishing a part of it that is already bright. 'Hold the stair rail,' she says, without turning, 'and don't breathe on the lens. My grandfather's grandfather's trimming-knife is on the shelf, if you need to see what I trim with. I have never been asked what the lamp is for. I have always been asked what I will take for it.'".
    Greets again "Marren Kestle does not stop polishing. 'The lens is the same as you left it,' she says. 'Do you think it has changed? Everyone thinks it has changed. They come up the stair expecting a different light, and go down it with the same one.'".
  }
}
data/adventures/the-dorothea/ship.kyr:
Module dorothea "The Dorothea" {
  Description "The ketch Dorothea: her deck, her quarterdeck and wheel, the captain's cabin, the forecastle, the hold. A vessel is a place the company can go about, and a thing that is somewhere.".

  // ── The hull: where she is ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // Where the Dorothea is, is `at(hull, place)`: one of the stations of her passage. Her state says what she is doing.
  // The near stations are the Reach, a sea chart of open water and islands (terrain archipelago), each a stretch of it
  // on the author's grid, a step about a quarter of a day's sail: so the map has her where she is while the company is
  // aboard (decks, below). The Sound and the open water are water; the Combs a line of rocks across the way, with one
  // gap; Skerrow's roads, Port Ness's and the Antlers' race lie off land, drawn as islands.
  Place reach "the Near Reach" is region.
  Initially Assert terrain(reach, archipelago).
  Entity land_sea: landkind "open water". Entity land_reef: landkind "reef".
  Place sound "the Sound" is wilderness within reach at 0, 1.
  Place open_sea "open water" is wilderness within reach at 1, 1.
  Place ness_roads "Port Ness roads" is wilderness within reach at 2, 2.
  Place antler_race "the Antlers' race" is wilderness within reach at 3, 0.
  Place teeth "the Combs" is wilderness within reach at 3, 1.
  Place roads "Skerrow roads" is wilderness within reach at 4, 1.
  Initially Assert landform(sound, land_sea). Initially Assert landform(open_sea, land_sea).
  Initially Assert landform(teeth, land_reef). Initially Assert landform(antler_race, land_peak).
  // The far calls lie off this chart (Ashkeld three days out, Mangrow five: a chart of them would be a hundred and
  // eighty cells wide), in a sea of their own that nobody walks to.
  Place sea "the Skerrow passage" is region.
  Place lane "the passage" is wilderness within sea at 0, 0.
  Place ashkeld_roads "Ashkeld roads" is room within lane at 7, 0.
  Place mangrow_roads "Mangrow roads" is room within lane at 8, 0.

  Place ship_region "the ketch Dorothea" is region.
  Place hull_site "the Dorothea" is site within ship_region at 0, 0.
  Place deck "the Dorothea's waist" is room within hull_site at 1, 1.
  Place helm "the quarterdeck" is room within hull_site at 2, 1.
  Place cabin "the captain's cabin" is room within hull_site at 3, 1.
  Place forecastle "the forecastle" is room within hull_site at 0, 1.
  Place hold "the hold" is room within hull_site at 1, 2.

  Passage ladder_aft "the ladder to the quarterdeck" is ladder between deck and helm.
  Passage cabin_door "the cabin door" is door between helm and cabin.
  Passage fore_hatch "the forecastle hatch" is door between deck and forecastle.
  Passage hold_hatch "the hold hatch" is ladder between deck and hold.
  // The gangways: down to wherever she lies, if she lies anywhere.
  Passage gangway_home "the gangway to the quay" is steps between deck and quay opening when at(hull, quay) and booked(party) "".
  Passage gangway_isle "the gangway to the jetty" is steps between deck and jetty opening when at(hull, jetty) "".
  Passage gangway_ness "the gangway to Port Ness pier" is steps between deck and ness_quay opening when at(hull, ness_quay) "".
  Passage gangway_ashkeld "the boat to the black beach" is steps between deck and ashkeld_beach opening when at(hull, ashkeld_beach) "".
  Passage gangway_mangrow "the plank to the Mangrow pier" is steps between deck and mangrow_pier opening when at(hull, mangrow_pier) "".
  Passage gangway_antlers "the plank to the Antlers' ledge" is steps between deck and antler_ledge opening when at(hull, antler_ledge) "".

  Thing hull "the Dorothea" at quay {
    State alongside "The ketch Dorothea lies alongside Tolleth quay, her gangway down, her hatches off, casks going down into her hold.".
    State underway "The ketch Dorothea is under way.".
    State moored_isle "The ketch Dorothea lies against Skerrow's jetty, lines out, her gangway down, her crew rolling casks along the stone.".
    State moored_ness "The ketch Dorothea lies against Port Ness pier among the salt lighters, lines out, her gangway down.".
    State moored_ashkeld "The ketch Dorothea lies off Ashkeld's black beach with her boat in the surf, and a plume of steam going straight up from the hill behind.".
    State moored_mangrow "The ketch Dorothea lies off the Mangrow pier on two anchors, a plank run out to the black piles, the green coming down to the water on either hand.".
    State moored_antlers "The ketch Dorothea lies off the Antlers' ledge on two anchors, a plank run out to the rock.".
  }
  Initially Assert state(hull, alongside).
  // Her decks are hers: the company aboard is wherever she is, on the map (at the quay, on the country's; under way,
  // on the Reach).
  Initially Assert decks(hull, hull_site).
  // bound(hull) is the call she is making: 1 Skerrow, 2 Port Ness, 3 the Antlers, 4 Ashkeld, 5 Mangrow (set with the fare, port.kyr).
  Measure departedAt(entity). Measure delay(entity). Measure reachedAt(entity). Measure bound(entity).
  Relation sailed(entity). Relation arrived(entity). Relation troubled(entity).
  Initially Set departedAt(hull) to 0. Initially Set delay(hull) to 0. Initially Set bound(hull) to 1.
  Measure sailAfter(entity). Initially Set sailAfter(hull) to 24.

  // ── Aboard ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Observe deck_at_quay at deck when at(hull, quay) "The Dorothea's waist: a hatch, a windlass, a long-boat chocked on the beams, and the quay at your elbow. Casks are going down the hatch on a whip. Gulls are interested.".
  Observe deck_sound at deck when at(hull, sound) and not troubled(hull) "The Sound is a grey road between low headlands, the water brown-green and busy. The Dorothea works down it on the ebb, close-hauled, her wake a white thread behind her. Tolleth falls back until it is a smudge with a smoke on it.".
  Observe deck_open at deck when at(hull, open_sea) and not troubled(hull) "Open water. The land is gone, and nothing has taken its place: grey swell from the west, a line where the sea meets the sky, and the Dorothea going over it with a long slow lift and fall. Every rope aboard has its own note.".
  Observe deck_teeth at deck when at(hull, teeth) and not troubled(hull) "A line of broken water lies across the morning, a mile ahead and from edge to edge of the world: black rocks, a hundred of them, their tops showing as the swell draws off. The Combs. There is a gap in them, if you know where, and the sea runs through it like a mill-race.
