Beyond them, very far and very small, a white tower on a green hill, and on the tower a light that has not been put out though the sun is up.".
  Observe deck_roads at deck when at(hull, roads) "Skerrow roads: a green island with a white tower on it and sheep on its shoulder, smoke from a dozen chimneys, a stone jetty, and a boat putting out. The wind has dropped. For the first time in two days nothing aboard the Dorothea is leaning.".
  Observe helm_scene at helm when true "The quarterdeck: a big wheel with a brass boss worn bright, a compass in a box, a log-slate, a lead-line coiled on a pin. Whoever steers can see everything and be seen from everywhere.".
  Observe cabin_scene at cabin when true "A cabin the size of a wardrobe and kept like a chapel: a chart table, a bunk with the blanket squared, a shelf of ledgers, a sea-chest with a padlock, and above the bunk a woodcut of a woman in a cap, pinned up small by a hand that had wanted to pin it larger.".
  Observe forecastle_scene at forecastle when true "The forecastle: six bunks in two tiers, a stove, a table fixed to the floor, sea-boots on a rack, and the permanent smell of wet wool. Somebody has cut a notch in the beam for every voyage. It is a long beam.".
  Observe hold_scene at hold when true "The hold: casks lashed in tiers, bales of canvas, a ladder, and the sound of the sea very close through the planks, like something breathing in the next room. Forward of the salt, lashed apart, is a short tier of small casks, each branded with a lamp, PHAROS, in the Captain's square hand. The tally chalked on the end of the tier has been rubbed with a thumb. The stow-marks on the planking show where more have stood.".

  // ── Casting off ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // She goes on the noon ebb. A company on the quay at noon is left on it; the hours before are to book a passage, pay
  // or work it, and get aboard.
  Query aboardNow(g: group) means at(g, deck) or at(g, helm) or at(g, cabin) or at(g, forecastle) or at(g, hold).
  Rule hull_sails when state(hull, alongside) and watch(clock) >= sailAfter(hull) and watch(clock) >= holdUntil(hull) and at(hull, quay) and not sailed(hull)
    says "At the foot of the quay Captain Bascom says one word round the stem of her pipe, and the Dorothea's lines come off the bollards as if they had been waiting to. The gangway comes in. The quay slides away astern, and Tolleth with it." {
    Assert state(hull, underway). Assert sailed(hull). Retract at(bascom, quay). Assert at(bascom, helm). Set departedAt(hull) to watch(clock). Retract at(hull, quay). Assert at(hull, sound).
  }
  Observe left_behind at quay when sailed(hull) and not aboardNow(party) "The Dorothea is gone. A last gull sits on the empty bollard. On the chalk-board the next sailing for Skerrow is the Mary Ann, a week from Thursday, and a crown dearer.".
}
data/adventures/the-grand-tour/city.kyr:
Module sennet "The Grand Tour" {
  Description "Sennet, a port city in three storeys: on the bay, the quays and glass-houses and the House of Doors, whose doors open on the elemental planes; over the cloud-line, Cloudgate, a hill of the old city lifted into the sky two hundred years ago; under the water, the Whelm, the drowned lower town where the merfolk live. The Rector of the House of Doors has proclaimed the first Grand Tour in two hundred years.".

  // ── The country ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // The coast road comes over the downs and down to the Landward Gate. The city stands on the east shore of the bay;
  // the House of Doors on the headland north of it. Cloudgate floats over the bay to the west, at the top of the
  // anchor chain, above the hole it came out of; under it, under the water, is the Whelm.
  Place sennet_bay "the Bay of Sennet" is region.
  Initially Assert terrain(sennet_bay, marsh).
  Place downs "the coast road" is wilderness within sennet_bay at 2, 0.
  Place sennet_town "Sennet" is settlement within sennet_bay at 2, 1.
  Place cloudgate "Cloudgate" is settlement within sennet_bay at 1, 0.
  Place whelm "the Whelm" is wilderness within sennet_bay at 1, 1.

  // ── Buildings of Sennet ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Place winch_house "the winch-house" is building within sennet_town.
  Place sounding_line "the Sounding Line" is building within sennet_town.
  Place harbour_office "the Harbourmaster's office" is building within sennet_town.
  Place glasshouse_b "Prue Quickly's glass-house" is building within sennet_town.
  Place murreys "Murrey's" is building within sennet_town.
  Place pargeters "Ollerenshaw's" is building within sennet_town.
  Place sennet_house "the House of Doors" is building within sennet_town.
  // The canon's House of Doors (the College of Dun Rì's restricted precinct), built here (OWN-33).
  Initially Assert seatOf(house_of_doors, sennet_house).
  Place tower "the tower stair" is level within sennet_house.

  // ── Sennet ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Place coast_road "the top of the coast road" is room within downs at 0, 0 outdoors.
  Place landward_gate "the Landward Gate" is room within sennet_town at 2, 0 outdoors.
  Place glass_market "the Glass Market" is room within sennet_town at 2, 1 outdoors.
  Place ascent_yard "the foot of the Ascent" is room within sennet_town at 1, 0 outdoors.
  Place winch_floor "the winch-house" is room within winch_house at 0, 0 indoors.
  Place quay "the Quay" is room within sennet_town at 1, 1 outdoors.
  Place fish_stairs "the Fish Stairs" is room within sennet_town at 0, 1 outdoors.
  Place taproom "the Sounding Line" is room within sounding_line at 0, 2 indoors.
  Place pumphrey_office "the Harbourmaster's office" is room within harbour_office at 1, 2 indoors.
  Place lamp_street "Lamp Street" is room within sennet_town at 3, 1 outdoors.
  Place glasshouse "Prue Quickly's glass-house" is room within glasshouse_b at 4, 1 indoors.
  Place murrey_shop "Murrey's" is room within murreys at 3, 2 indoors.
  Place outfitter "Ollerenshaw's" is room within pargeters at 3, 0 indoors.
  Place college_gate "the gate of the House of Doors" is room within sennet_town at 4, 0 outdoors.
  Place quad "the Quad" is room within sennet_house at 5, 0 outdoors.
  Place hall_of_doors "the Hall of Doors" is room within sennet_house at 5, 1 indoors.
  Place museum "the Museum of the Tour" is room within sennet_house at 6, 0 indoors.
  Place chapel "the chapel of Veyra" is room within sennet_house at 4, 2 indoors.
  Place rector_study "the Rector's study" is room within sennet_house at 6, 1 indoors.
  Place tower_stair "the tower stair" is room within tower at 6, 2 indoors.
  Place nexus "the Nexus" is room within tower at 6, 3 indoors.

  // ── Cloudgate ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Place halyard_house "Halyard House" is building within cloudgate.
  Place cellars "the cellars of Halyard House" is level within halyard_house.
  Place ascension_chapel_b "the Ascension Chapel" is building within cloudgate.
  Place landing_stage "the Landing Stage" is room within cloudgate at 1, 2 outdoors.
  Place promenade "the Promenade" is room within cloudgate at 1, 1 outdoors.
  Place balustrade "the Balustrade" is room within cloudgate at 0, 1 outdoors.
  Place wind_court "the Wind Court" is room within cloudgate at 2, 2 outdoors.
  Place ascension_chapel "the Ascension Chapel" is room within ascension_chapel_b at 2, 1 indoors.
  Place drawing_room "the drawing room of Halyard House" is room within halyard_house at 1, 0 indoors.
  Place aubrey_rooms "Aubrey Halyard's rooms" is room within halyard_house at 2, 0 indoors.
  Place servants_hall "the servants' hall" is room within halyard_house at 0, 0 indoors.
  Place wine_cellar "the wine cellar" is room within cellars at 0, 3 indoors.
  Place keel "the keel of Cloudgate" is room within cloudgate at 0, 4 outdoors.

  // ── The Whelm ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Place drowned_stair "the foot of the Fish Stairs, under the water" is room within whelm at 2, 0 outdoors.
  Place drowned_street "Chandlers' Row, under the water" is room within whelm at 1, 0 outdoors.
  Place drowned_church "Lir's church, under the water" is room within whelm at 0, 0 outdoors.
  Place belfry "the belfry of Lir's church, under the water" is room within whelm at 0, 1 indoors.
  Place guildhall "the drowned Guildhall" is room within whelm at 1, 1 outdoors.
  Place air_bell "the air-bell" is room within whelm at 2, 1 indoors.
  Place undercroft "the Aenean Undercroft" is room within whelm at 1, 2 underground.
  Place engine_room "the tide-engine" is room within whelm at 2, 2 underground.
  Place shaft_foot "the foot of the Aenean shaft" is room within whelm at 0, 2 underground.

  // ── The planes ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // Each door of the Tour opens on a plane: the world's own (the canon, data/imbar), of which the Tour holds a reach
  // apiece, not the whole (the owner's one universe, OWN-31, OWN-36). The Water door is in the Whelm, and nobody
  // uses it.
  Place fire_land "the Hour Court's reaches of the Fire" is region within inner_fire elsewhere.
  Place hour_land "the Hour Court" is wilderness within fire_land at 0, 0 elsewhere.
  Place fire_threshold "the far side of the Fire Door" is room within hour_land at 0, 1.
  Place hour_court "the Hour Court" is room within hour_land at 1, 1.
  Place ash_market "the Ash Market" is room within hour_land at 1, 0.
  Place lists "the Lists of the Salamanders" is room within hour_land at 2, 1.
  Place earth_land "the Slow Assembly's reaches of the Earth" is region within inner_earth elsewhere.
  Place strata_land "the Slow Assembly" is wilderness within earth_land at 0, 0 elsewhere.
  Place earth_threshold "the far side of the Earth Door" is room within strata_land at 0, 0.
  Place assembly "the chamber of the Slow Assembly" is room within strata_land at 1, 0.
  Place minutes "the Gallery of the Minutes" is room within strata_land at 2, 0.
  Place air_land "the Gallery's reaches of the Air" is region within inner_air elsewhere.
  Place wind_land "the Gallery of Winds" is wilderness within air_land at 0, 0 elsewhere.
  Place air_threshold "the far side of the Air Door" is room within wind_land at 0, 1.
  Place gallery "the Gallery of Winds" is room within wind_land at 1, 1.
  Place eyrie "the eyrie of the North Wind" is room within wind_land at 1, 0.

  // Where those who are not about go: home to bed, out on business, down below.
  Place offstage "elsewhere in Sennet" is room within downs at 5, 5.

  // What has to be known before two of the ways are seen: a ladder down through the floor of Halyard House's cellar,
  // and the merfolk's guest-room, where Mercy keeps what she caught.
  Discovery keel_ladder_known "A ladder goes down from the wine cellar of Halyard House through the rock of Cloudgate to its keel, where nobody goes." {
    Found by searching wine_cellar "Behind the last rack, in the bare rock, your hand finds iron: rungs, let into the stone, going down into the dark, with a cold wind coming up them.".
  }
  Discovery air_bell_known "Off the drowned Guildhall a passage goes up into one of the Aenean air-bells, a room of dry air under the sea, where Mercy keeps what she caught.".

  // ── Ways: Sennet ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Passage coast_way "the coast road" is road between coast_road and landward_gate taking 30 minutes.
  Passage gate_street "Gate Street" is path between landward_gate and glass_market taking 5 minutes.
  Passage chain_street "Chain Street" is path between glass_market and ascent_yard taking 5 minutes.
  Passage winch_door "the winch-house door" is door between ascent_yard and winch_floor.
  Passage the_haul "the Haul" is path between glass_market and quay taking 5 minutes.
  Passage quay_walk "the quay wall" is path between quay and fish_stairs taking 3 minutes.
  Passage line_door "the Sounding Line's door" is door between quay and taproom.
  Passage office_door "the Harbourmaster's door" is door between quay and pumphrey_office.
  Passage lamp_way "Lamp Street" is path between glass_market and lamp_street taking 5 minutes.
  Passage glass_door "the glass-house door" is door between lamp_street and glasshouse.
  Passage murrey_door "Murrey's door" is door between lamp_street and murrey_shop.
  Passage pargeter_door "Ollerenshaw's door" is door between lamp_street and outfitter.
  Passage headland_steps "the Headland Steps" is steps between lamp_street and college_gate.
  Passage college_arch "the gate of the House of Doors" is gate between college_gate and quad.
  Passage hall_door "the doors of the Hall" is door between quad and hall_of_doors.
  Passage museum_door "the Museum door" is door between quad and museum.
  Passage chapel_door "the chapel door" is door between quad and chapel.
  Passage lodging_door "the Rector's door" is door between quad and rector_study.
  Passage tower_way "the tower stair" is stair between rector_study and tower_stair.
  Passage nexus_way "the tower door" is door between tower_stair and nexus.

  // ── Ways: up and down ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // The basket is the winch-gang's to give (ascent.kyr). The chain is anyone's who can climb it: two hours, hand
  // over hand, up through the cloud.
  Passage anchor_chain "the anchor chain" is ladder between ascent_yard and landing_stage taking 2 hours needing climbing
    opening when not cloudgateFell(sennet_bay) and not descending(sennet_bay) "The anchor chain lies slack in great loops across the yard and into the bay.".
  // Under the water. The way down needs breath; the way up is anyone's, since anybody can swim up (whelm.kyr).
  Passage stairs_down "the Fish Stairs, under the water" is steps between fish_stairs and drowned_stair one way needing breath.
  Passage stairs_up "the Fish Stairs, to the air" is steps between drowned_stair and fish_stairs one way.

  // ── Ways: Cloudgate ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Passage stage_walk "the walk from the Landing Stage" is path between landing_stage and promenade taking 3 minutes.
  Passage promenade_end "the end of the Promenade" is path between promenade and balustrade taking 3 minutes.
  Passage court_walk "the colonnade" is path between promenade and wind_court taking 3 minutes.
  Passage chapel_porch "the Ascension Chapel's porch" is door between promenade and ascension_chapel.
  Passage halyard_door "the door of Halyard House" is door between promenade and drawing_room.
  Passage aubrey_door "Aubrey Halyard's door" is door between drawing_room and aubrey_rooms.
  Passage baize_door "the baize door" is door between drawing_room and servants_hall.
  Passage cellar_stair "the cellar stair" is stair between servants_hall and wine_cellar.
  Passage keel_ladder "the keel ladder" is ladder between wine_cellar and keel taking 10 minutes hidden until keel_ladder_known
    opening when not cloudgateFell(sennet_bay) "The keel ladder goes down into black water.".

  // ── Ways: the Whelm ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Passage row_way "Chandlers' Row" is path between drowned_stair and drowned_street taking 5 minutes.
  Passage church_way "the church door, under the water" is doorway between drowned_street and drowned_church.
  Passage tower_inside "the inside of the tower" is passage between drowned_church and belfry taking 5 minutes.
  Passage guild_way "the Guildhall steps" is steps between drowned_street and guildhall.
  Passage bell_way "the neck of the air-bell" is passage between guildhall and air_bell hidden until air_bell_known.
  Passage undercroft_stair "the Undercroft steps" is steps between guildhall and undercroft.
  Passage engine_arch "the engine arch" is arch between undercroft and engine_room.
  Passage shaft_way "the shaft passage" is passage between undercroft and shaft_foot.

  // ── Ways: the planes ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Passage fire_door "the Fire Door" is door between hall_of_doors and fire_threshold.
  Passage earth_door "the Earth Door" is door between hall_of_doors and earth_threshold.
  Passage air_door "the Air Door" is gate between wind_court and air_threshold.
  Passage court_way "the way to the Hour Court" is path between fire_threshold and hour_court taking 5 minutes.
  Passage market_way "the way to the Ash Market" is path between hour_court and ash_market taking 5 minutes.
  Passage lists_way "the way to the Lists" is path between hour_court and lists taking 5 minutes.
  Passage assembly_way "the long tunnel" is tunnel between earth_threshold and assembly taking 10 minutes.
  Passage minutes_way "the Gallery of the Minutes" is passage between assembly and minutes taking 5 minutes.
  Passage gallery_way "the wind" is path between air_threshold and gallery taking 5 minutes.
}
data/adventures/the-grand-tour/growth.ky:
Module sennet "The Grand Tour" {
  // ── What the company grows by ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // A company grows in Sennet by what it does for its people and its courts, not only by fights: the small stories
  // are worth as much as a petal, and setting the city right is worth most. Seeing the book through is worth the
  // module's own experience on top (module.json).
  Milestone m_entered "entered for the Grand Tour" worth 25 when enrolled(party).
  Milestone m_gang "walked a shift on the winch-gang's capstans" worth 25 when gangFriend(party).
  Milestone m_step "brought Ha'penny above the third step to buy a present" worth 50 when hapennyShopped(hapenny).
  Milestone m_bell "gave Old Bethan a night's sleep" worth 50 when bethanAtPeace(bethan).
  Milestone m_prue "kept Prue Quickly's heat on" worth 50 when prueSaved(prue).
  Milestone m_jem "found Jem Tuttle a place below the cloud" worth 50 when jemFree(jem).
  Milestone m_tolley "gave Edwin Tolley his own sentences back" worth 50 when tolleyFriend(tolley).
  Milestone m_chert "showed a delegate of the Slow Assembly the sky" worth 50 when chertSaw(chert).
  Milestone m_ember "took the ember in Cabinet Fourteen home" worth 75 when emberHome(fire_land).
  Milestone m_fire "was crowned in the Hour Court" worth 75 when everCrowned(party).
  Milestone m_earth "carried the Earth petal out of the Slow Assembly" worth 75 when carries(party, earth_petal).
  Milestone m_laughed "made No Admittance laugh" worth 50 when admittanceLaughed(admittance).
  Milestone m_water "was given the Water petal for the asking" worth 75 when carries(party, water_petal).
  Milestone m_north "was let up to the North Wind" worth 75 when tramontaneHeard(tramontane).
  Milestone m_alive "found the dead man alive" worth 50 when knows(party, perrin_alive).
  Milestone m_leg "set Perrin Halyard's leg" worth 25 when legSet(perrin).
  Milestone m_brothers "brought the Halyard brothers face to face" worth 75 when brothersMet(party).
  Milestone m_case "knew who pushed Perrin Halyard" worth 100 when knows(party, quance_pushed).
  Milestone m_lanterns "took a mermaid to the Night of Lanterns" worth 100 when mercySawLanterns(mercy).
  Milestone m_raid "stood with the Whelm against the House's divers" worth 75 when raidRepulsed(quance).
  Milestone m_warned "warned the Whelm in time" worth 100 when whelmEmptied(sennet_bay).
  Milestone m_found "put the Rector of the House of Doors before the Watch" worth 150 when rectorTaken(quance).
  Milestone m_made "set Lamp Street glass in the keel of Cloudgate" worth 150 when madeSet(sennet_bay).
  Milestone m_renewed "had the North Wind's gift renewed" worth 150 when giftRenewed(sennet_bay).
  Milestone m_undertow "opened the Door of Doors from below, by the Whelm's leave" worth 150 when openedBelow(sennet_bay) and engineLeave(party).
  Milestone m_first "went first through the Door of Doors in two hundred years" worth 100 when firstThrough(party).
  Milestone m_fabian "brought Fabian Murrey home" worth 75 when fabianHome(party).
  Milestone m_bell_kept "let Old Bethan sleep, and the bell ring" worth 75 when bethanAtPeace(bethan) and (knows(party, sexton_known) or knows(party, sexton_hint)) and not bellSilent().
  Milestone m_sexton_fed "fed the Sexton of Lir's from Old Bethan's barrow" worth 50 when sextonFed(party).
  Milestone m_sexton_slain "killed the Sexton of Lir's" worth 150 when sextonKilled(party).
  Milestone m_printed_lie "caught the Rector's memoirs in a lie" worth 75 when knows(party, thresholds_nine) and knows(party, late_basket).
}
Module sennet "The Grand Tour" {
  // ── Two editions ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // The sixth edition of Murrey's Handbook says what Dame Philippa thought forty years ago, of a city and planes she
  // went through nine times and never once asked anybody about. Carried, it speaks at the places it has an opinion on.
  // The seventh is Fabian's, written as he goes, and is read out to the company the first time he is anywhere with it.
  Query handbook() means holding(party, handbook_kind) or holding(party, philippa_kind).
  Observe hb_coast at coast_road as sign when handbook() and not visitedBefore(coast_road) "Murrey's Handbook, sixth edition: 'SENNET. A port of the second class, with a House of Doors of the first. The traveller is advised to arrive by day, to engage a bear-leader at the Landward Gate, and on no account to drink the water.'".
  Observe hb_market at glass_market as sign when handbook() and not visitedBefore(glass_market) "Murrey's Handbook, sixth edition: 'The Glass Market is noisome and should be passed through briskly. The night-lights offered by hawkers hold an hour of the Fire Door's heat and should not be carried in the breast pocket.'".
  Observe hb_quay at quay as sign when handbook() and not visitedBefore(quay) "Murrey's Handbook, sixth edition: 'From the Quay the traveller may watch the merfolk at their barter on the Fish Stairs, a spectacle of some charm. They are entirely harmless, and should not be fed.'".
  Observe hb_stairs at fish_stairs as sign when handbook() and not visitedBefore(fish_stairs) "Murrey's Handbook, sixth edition: 'The merfolk do not come above the third step, by an excellent bylaw. The traveller who wishes to visit the Whelm should not.'".
  Observe hb_line at taproom as sign when handbook() and not visitedBefore(taproom) "Murrey's Handbook, sixth edition: 'Not recommended.'".
  Observe hb_lamp at lamp_street as sign when handbook() and not visitedBefore(lamp_street) "Murrey's Handbook, sixth edition: 'The glass-houses of Lamp Street may be visited for a small consideration. Messrs. Ollerenshaw, outfitters, are reliable, and moderate.' The second adjective has been crossed out in green ink.".
  Observe hb_quad at quad as sign when handbook() and not visitedBefore(quad) "Murrey's Handbook, sixth edition: 'THE HOUSE OF DOORS. Founded in the reign of the Aeneans, rebuilt after, and kept since by the Collegium of Veyra. The Rector receives Tourists of good family on Tuesdays.'".
  Observe hb_hall at hall_of_doors as sign when handbook() and not visitedBefore(hall_of_doors) "Murrey's Handbook, sixth edition: 'The Hall of Doors. A Doorward will see the Tourist through either door for a crown; it is customary to give him a shilling more on returning, and a crown more on not.'".
  Observe hb_museum at museum as sign when handbook() and not visitedBefore(museum) "Murrey's Handbook, sixth edition: 'The Museum of the Tour, the finest of its kind, is the fruit of two centuries of enterprise by Tourists of good family. Cabinet Fourteen, an Ember of the Hour Court still burning, should not be missed.'".
  Observe hb_stage at landing_stage as sign when handbook() and not visitedBefore(landing_stage) "Murrey's Handbook, sixth edition: 'CLOUDGATE. The traveller fortunate enough to obtain an introduction will find society here the most agreeable in the world, and the air incomparable. It is always afternoon.'".
  Observe hb_balustrade at balustrade as sign when handbook() and not visitedBefore(balustrade) "Murrey's Handbook, sixth edition: 'The prospect from the Balustrade at sunset is justly celebrated. The traveller is advised not to lean.'".
  Observe hb_court at wind_court as sign when handbook() and not visitedBefore(wind_court) "Murrey's Handbook, sixth edition: 'The Air Door is kept by the family of Halyard, to whom application should be made in writing, and in good time.'".
  Observe hb_keel at keel as sign when handbook() and not visitedBefore(keel) "Murrey's Handbook, sixth edition: 'The keel of Cloudgate is solid rock, and of no interest.'".
  Observe hb_whelm at drowned_street as sign when handbook() and not visitedBefore(drowned_street) "Murrey's Handbook, sixth edition, its pages wet through: 'The lower town, drowned in the regrettable events of the year 1090, is of no interest to the general traveller.'".
  Observe hb_fire at hour_court as sign when handbook() and not visitedBefore(hour_court) "Murrey's Handbook, sixth edition, its pages curling in the heat: 'THE PLANE OF FIRE. The Hour Court cannot be missed. It is vulgar. Nothing said there is remembered, which is a comfort to the traveller.'".
  Observe hb_earth at assembly as sign when handbook() and not visitedBefore(assembly) "Murrey's Handbook, sixth edition, which you read by lamplight: 'THE PLANE OF EARTH. The Slow Assembly may be observed from the gallery. A visit of less than a week is pointless, and of more than a week, dull.'".
  Observe hb_air at gallery as sign when handbook() and not visitedBefore(gallery) "Murrey's Handbook, sixth edition, its pages riffling in the wind: 'THE PLANE OF AIR. The sylphs are charming, and a pack of fishwives. Do not tell them anything.'".
  Observe hb_eyrie at eyrie as sign when handbook() and not visitedBefore(eyrie) "Murrey's Handbook, sixth edition: 'The North Wind does not receive.'".

  // ── The seventh, as he writes it ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Relation writing(place). Relation wrote(place). Relation entry(place).
  Initially Assert entry(fish_stairs). Initially Assert entry(hour_court). Initially Assert entry(assembly).
  Initially Assert entry(gallery). Initially Assert entry(drowned_street). Initially Assert entry(keel).
  Initially Assert entry(promenade). Initially Assert entry(museum). Initially Assert entry(guildhall).
  Rule begins_writing when travelsWith(fabian, party) and at(party, ?p) and entry(?p) and not writing(?p) and not wrote(?p) { Assert writing(?p). }
  Rule done_writing when writing(?p) and not at(party, ?p) { Retract writing(?p). Assert wrote(?p). }
  Observe s7_stairs at fish_stairs as sound when writing(fish_stairs) and hapennyShopped(hapenny) "Fabian frowns over the notebook, and reads it you: 'The merfolk come up the Fish Stairs as far as they are let. Ask one of the children what the Glass Market is for. You will not have thought of it that way.'".
  Observe s7_stairs_plain at fish_stairs as sound when writing(fish_stairs) and not hapennyShopped(hapenny) "Fabian licks his pencil, writes, and reads it you: 'The merfolk come up the Fish Stairs to a brass plate, and no further. Nobody in Sennet could tell me why, except that it was written down.'".
  Observe s7_fire at hour_court as sound when writing(hour_court) "Fabian's pencil is smoking at the tip. He scrawls, and shouts it you over the roar: 'Nothing in the Fire lasts an hour. Bring something old. Bring something you will miss.'".
  Observe s7_earth at assembly as sound when writing(assembly) "Fabian bends over the notebook in the circle of your light, and reads it you in a whisper: 'The Assembly is slow because it is careful. The youngest of them is six hundred and forty, and I liked him best.'".
  Observe s7_air at gallery as sound when writing(gallery) "Fabian holds the notebook against his chest with one arm, against the wind, and reads it you: 'They will tell you everything. Tell them one true thing about yourself, and listen to what comes back.'".
  Observe s7_whelm at drowned_street as sound when writing(drowned_street) "Fabian tries to write through the glass of his helm, and holds the page up to show you, the pencil already running: 'The Whelm should be visited.'".
  Observe s7_guildhall at guildhall as sound when writing(guildhall) "Fabian has got the notebook out, wet, and is writing in it with a stick of the merfolk's chalk: 'Eat what you are given.'".
  Observe s7_keel at keel as sound when writing(keel) "Fabian, flat on his face on the rock with one arm round the ladder, writes without looking at the page: 'The keel of Cloudgate is not solid rock, and is of interest.'".
  Observe s7_promenade at promenade as sound when writing(promenade) "Fabian murmurs as he writes, and reads it you under his breath: 'It is always afternoon in Cloudgate. Nobody there has ever had to wait for the morning.'".
  Observe s7_museum at museum as sound when writing(museum) "Fabian writes, looking at the cabinets, and does not read it to you. When you look, it says: 'Everything in this room was somebody's.'".
}
data/adventures/the-lull/linger.kyr:
Module lull "The Lull" {
  // ── The valley's places ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Place open_hand_inn "the Open Hand" is building within linger.
  Place chapel_b "the Chapel of the Birds" is building within linger.
  Place glossary_b "the Glossary" is building within linger.
  Place gift_hall_b "the Gift Hall" is building within linger.
  Place almshouse_b "the Almshouse of the Old Shift" is building within linger.
  Place spurling_b "Spurling's chandlery" is building within linger.
  Place lindsell_b "the Lindsells' house" is building within linger.
  Place pryce_b "the Pryces' house" is building within linger.
  Place piran_b "Piran Trewin's workshop" is building within linger.
  Place mill_b "the mill" is building within mill.
  Place mill_upper "the loom floor" is level within mill_b.
  Place mill_roof "the roof" is level within mill_b.
  Place hand_upper "the floor above" is level within open_hand_inn.
  Place mill_under "the cellars of the Mill" is level within mill_b.

  Place tump_shoulder "the Tump's shoulder" is room within tump at 1, 1.
  Place strike_post "the top of the Tump" is room within tump at 1, 0.
  Place green "Linger green" is room within linger at 1, 1.
  Place open_hand "the Open Hand" is room within open_hand_inn at 0, 1.
  Place linnet_loft "the music room over the Open Hand" is room within hand_upper at 0, 0.
  Place chapel "the Chapel of the Birds" is room within chapel_b at 1, 0.
  Place glossary "the Glossary" is room within glossary_b at 2, 0.
  Place gift_hall "the Gift Hall" is room within gift_hall_b at 2, 1.
  Place almshouse "the Almshouse of the Old Shift" is room within almshouse_b at 3, 1.
  Place spurling_shop "Spurling's chandlery" is room within spurling_b at 0, 2.
  Place lindsell_kitchen "the Lindsells' kitchen" is room within lindsell_b at 1, 2.
  Place hester_room "Hester Lindsell's room" is room within lindsell_b at 1, 3.
  Place pryce_parlour "the Pryces' parlour" is room within pryce_b at 2, 2.
  Place piran_shop "Piran Trewin's workshop" is room within piran_b at 0, 3.
  Place gardens "the Pleasure Gardens" is room within linger at 3, 2.
  Place weavers_row "Weavers' Row" is room within linger at 2, 3.
  Place mill_bridge "the end of the Shift Bridge" is room within mill at 0, 1.
  Place mill_yard "the Mill yard" is room within mill at 1, 1.
  Place mill_floor "the mill's ground floor" is room within mill_b at 1, 0.
  Place loom_floor "the loom floor" is room within mill_upper at 1, 0.
  Place bell_loft "the bell loft" is room within mill_roof at 2, 0.
  Place wheel_pit "the wheel-pit" is room within mill_under at 0, 0.
  Place tarn_shore "the shore of Lammas Tarn" is room within tarn at 0, 0.
  Place hanger_path "the path through the Hangers" is room within hangers at 0, 1.
  Place brock_sett "the Old Brock's sett" is room within hangers at 0, 0.
  Place weir "the weir above the Swallow" is room within swallow at 0, 0.
  Place gap "the Weaver's Gap" is room within swallow at 1, 0 underground.

  Initially Assert lullRoom(tump_shoulder). Initially Assert lullRoom(strike_post). Initially Assert lullRoom(green).
  Initially Assert lullRoom(open_hand). Initially Assert lullRoom(linnet_loft). Initially Assert lullRoom(chapel).
  Initially Assert lullRoom(glossary). Initially Assert lullRoom(gift_hall). Initially Assert lullRoom(almshouse).
  Initially Assert lullRoom(spurling_shop). Initially Assert lullRoom(lindsell_kitchen). Initially Assert lullRoom(hester_room).
  Initially Assert lullRoom(pryce_parlour). Initially Assert lullRoom(piran_shop). Initially Assert lullRoom(gardens).
  Initially Assert lullRoom(weavers_row). Initially Assert lullRoom(mill_bridge). Initially Assert lullRoom(mill_yard).
  Initially Assert lullRoom(mill_floor). Initially Assert lullRoom(loom_floor). Initially Assert lullRoom(bell_loft).
  Initially Assert lullRoom(wheel_pit). Initially Assert lullRoom(tarn_shore). Initially Assert lullRoom(hanger_path).
  Initially Assert lullRoom(brock_sett). Initially Assert lullRoom(weir). Initially Assert lullRoom(gap).
  Initially Assert alwaysDark(gap). Initially Assert alwaysDark(wheel_pit).
  Initially Assert unlit(gap). Initially Assert unlit(wheel_pit).

  Passage lull_road "the Lull road" is road between fold_stone and tump_shoulder taking 30 minutes opening when lullOpen() "Today the road goes round the bare hill and comes back to where it began.".
  Passage post_path "the path up the Tump" is path between tump_shoulder and strike_post taking 15 minutes.
  Passage tump_road "the Tump road" is road between tump_shoulder and green taking 20 minutes.
  Passage hand_door "the Open Hand's door" is door between green and open_hand.
  Passage loft_stair "the stair to the music room" is stair between open_hand and linnet_loft.
  Passage chapel_arch "the chapel's arch" is arch between green and chapel.
  Passage glossary_door "the Glossary's door" is door between green and glossary.
  Passage hall_arch "the Gift Hall's great arch" is arch between green and gift_hall.
  Passage alms_door "the Almshouse door" is door between green and almshouse.
  Passage spurling_door "the chandlery door" is door between green and spurling_shop.
  Passage lindsell_door "the Lindsells' door" is door between green and lindsell_kitchen.
  Passage hester_door "Hester's door" is door between lindsell_kitchen and hester_room.
  Passage pryce_door "the Pryces' door" is door between green and pryce_parlour.
  Passage piran_door "Piran's door" is door between weavers_row and piran_shop.
  Passage gardens_path "the path to the Gardens" is path between green and gardens taking 5 minutes.
  Passage row_way "Weavers' Row" is path between green and weavers_row taking 5 minutes.
  Passage bridge_path "the path to the Shift Bridge" is path between green and mill_bridge taking 5 minutes.
  Passage shift_bridge "the Shift Bridge" is bridge between mill_bridge and mill_yard.
  Passage leat_path "the leat path" is path between gardens and mill_yard taking 30 minutes.
  Passage strikers_window "the strikers' window" is crawl between mill_yard and mill_floor.
  Passage mill_stair "the mill stair" is stair between mill_floor and loom_floor.
  Passage bell_ladder "the ladder to the bell loft" is ladder between loom_floor and bell_loft.
  Passage pit_stair "the steps down to the wheel" is stair between mill_floor and wheel_pit.
  Passage tarn_path "the leat path to the tarn" is path between mill_yard and tarn_shore taking 40 minutes.
  Passage hanger_way "the path into the Hangers" is path between green and hanger_path taking 30 minutes.
  Passage sett_path "a badger-road through the beeches" is path between hanger_path and brock_sett taking 15 minutes.
  Passage hanger_tarn "the high path along the Hangers" is path between hanger_path and tarn_shore taking 40 minutes.
  Passage idle_path "the Idle path" is path between green and weir taking 30 minutes.
  Passage tail_race "the tail-race" is tunnel between wheel_pit and gap taking 30 minutes.
  Passage gap_way "the Weaver's Gap" is crawl between weir and gap taking 20 minutes hidden until gap_known.
  Passage gap_out "the Gap, outward" is culvert between gap and sx_spring taking 40 minutes hidden until gap_known opening when folded() "The Gap goes in under the hill a little way, and stops at a face of wet rock. Water comes through it, and a draught, and the smell of wool. Whatever the Gap is, today it is not a way.".
  Discovery gap_known "Under the Swallow, where the Idle goes into the hill, there is a way through: the Weaver's Gap, an old tail-race the river took, which comes out behind the Waiting Woman in Sixways. It goes through on the six days the Lull does not keep, and on its own day it is shut." {
    Found by searching weir "Where the Idle goes down into the hill under the weir, a ledge goes in beside the water, and above the ledge somebody long ago cut steps.".
  }

  // ── The first sight of the valley ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Observe shoulder_first at tump_shoulder when lullOpen() and not sawValley(party) "The road comes over the shoulder of a round green hill and the whole valley is below you at once: beech woods on both slopes going copper, a tarn at the head of it like a dropped coin, a river, a grey town of long-windowed houses, and above the town a mill of seven storeys with every window dark. Smoke goes straight up from the chimneys. Nothing moves fast. The noise that comes up to you is birds, and a fiddle, and somebody laughing a long way off, and under it all, so faint you have to stop to hear it, nothing at all: no hammer, no wheel, no cart.".
  Observe shoulder_scene at tump_shoulder when lullOpen() and sawValley(party) "The shoulder of the Tump, where the Lull road comes over and the valley opens below: the woods, the tarn, the town, the dark mill. A path goes up to the Strike Post on the top.".
  Observe shoulder_dark at tump_shoulder when folded() "The shoulder of the Tump in a dark with no stars in it. Below, where the town is, there is no light at all. Behind you the road goes up into the dark and does not come down anywhere.".
  Observe post_scene at strike_post when lullOpen() "The top of the Tump: short turf, a ring of sky, and the Strike Post, an old loom-beam set upright in the ground and hung from top to foot with ribbons, hundreds of them, red and blue and faded to no colour, one for every child born in the Lull, tied on the Lullday they were born. The newest are at the bottom, within a child's reach. Somebody has carved into the beam, very deep, WE ASKED.".
  Observe post_dark at strike_post when folded() "The Strike Post on the dark top of the Tump. The ribbons move, though there is no wind.".
  Observe post_asked at strike_post as feature when lullOpen() "The grass round the post is worn bare in a ring, where people stand to tell the story.".

  Relation sawValley(group).
  Rule saw_valley when cameIn(party) and not at(party, tump_shoulder) and not sawValley(party) { Assert sawValley(party). }

  // ── Linger green and the Long Table ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Observe green_morning at green when lullOpen() and hour(clock) < 12 "Down the middle of Linger green runs the Long Table, two hundred yards of trestles end to end, and people are wandering out with cloths and bowls to lay it, in no order, as the fancy takes them. Round the green stand grey weavers' houses whose top floors are all window, the long loom-lights of the old trade, now hung with plants and curtains and, in one, a cello. Nobody is hurrying. A man is asleep on a bench in the sun with his hat over his face and a child asleep on him.".
  Observe green_afternoon at green when lullOpen() and hour(clock) >= 12 and hour(clock) < 19 "The Long Table runs the length of the green, half-laid, with bowls of fruit on it and a cat walking down it. People sit about in the sun, talking, mending, playing draughts on the table's end; somebody is teaching a small boy to whistle, and the boy is not getting it, and nobody minds. On the Gift Hall steps a Glosser in a white apron is reading out something from a board, to a small crowd that keeps interrupting.".
  Observe green_evening at green when lullOpen() and lawDay() and hour(clock) >= 19 and hour(clock) < 21 "The whole town is at the Long Table: four hundred people on benches the length of the green, under lanterns strung on poles, with the food going up and down it hand to hand. The Old Shift sit at the top, by the chapel. At the bottom the children have a table of their own and are under it more than at it. Everybody's eyes keep going to the things set out on the grass in front of the Table, a little apart: a chair, a quilt, a cake, a clock.".
  Observe green_night at green when lullOpen() and hour(clock) >= 21 "The Long Table is being cleared by whoever is nearest, and the lanterns are going out one by one along the poles. A few people are still talking at the far end. Somebody plays a last tune in the music room over the Open Hand, and people stop on their way home to hear the end of it.".
  Observe green_dark at green when folded() "Linger green in a dark without stars. The Long Table is a shape. The houses are shapes, every window black. Something grey and fine drifts across the grass at the height of your knee, like lint off a loom, or fog; it parts round your legs and closes again behind you without a sound.".
  Observe green_birds at green as ambience when lullOpen() and hour(clock) < 19 "Starlings everywhere: on the ridges, on the Table, on the ropes of the lanterns, talking.".

  // The Long Table feeds anyone who sits at it.
  Relation fedToday(group).
  Action sit_at_table(actor: group, site: place) "Sit down at the Long Table and eat" {
    Description "Whatever comes down the table to you is given; take what you like and pass the rest on.".
    Requires able(actor) and company(actor) and at(actor, site) and at(actor, green) and lullOpen() and hour(clock) >= 19 and hour(clock) < 21 and not fedToday(actor).
    Time 3.
    On success { Assert fedToday(actor). Increase quantity(actor, rations) by 2. Retract hungry(actor). }
    Result "You sit where there is a space, which is anywhere, and the food comes down the table to you hand over hand: pease pottage, new bread, trout from the tarn, a plum duff with a face drawn in it, honey, a jug of something cold. The woman beside you puts two loaves in your pack without asking, 'for the road', and goes on talking to someone else. Nobody asks what you came for. Somebody asks your name, and repeats it down the table, and it comes back up to you twenty yards later, mispronounced, with a cup of cider.".
  }
  // Sitting the Watching out on purpose: the sun's going is something to wait for.
  Measure untilDusk(clock).
  Rule dusk_counts when lullOpen() and hour(clock) < 20 and untilDusk(clock) != (20 - hour(clock)) * 6 { Set untilDusk(clock) to (20 - hour(clock)) * 6. }
  Action keep_watching(actor: group, site: place) "Sit at the Long Table and watch the makings until the sun goes" {
    Description "Everyone does. It is the Lull's theatre, and its court, and its news.".
    Requires able(actor) and company(actor) and at(actor, site) and at(actor, green) and lawDay() and lullOpen() and hour(clock) >= 18 and hour(clock) < 20.
    Time untilDusk(clock).
    Result "You find a place on a bench and watch, the way the town watches: not the makings, at first, but the light on the Tump, going up it.".
  }
  // The Watching begins, for whoever is at the Table.
  Rule watching_opens at green when lullDusk() and at(party, green) and not watchingToday(lull_country)
    says "The sun goes down behind the Hangers and the light goes up the Tump, the way water goes out of a basin, and leaves the top of it last. Along the Long Table people stop eating. On the grass in front of the Table the day's makings stand in a row, each with its card, and four hundred people look at them." { Assert watchingToday(lull_country). }
  Rule watching_resets when hour(clock) == 0 and watchingToday(lull_country) { Retract watchingToday(lull_country). }
  Relation watchingToday(place).
  Rule unfed_daily when hour(clock) == 0 and fedToday(?g) { Retract fedToday(?g). }

  // ── The people of Linger, together ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Person folk "the people of Linger" at gardens {
    Role "townsfolk of the Lull, in grey-gold coats fifty years old and good as new". Ancestry human. Numbers 6. Peaceable.
    Greets "Half a dozen people look round and smile, the way people smile who have nowhere to be.".
  }
  Initially Assert lullFolk(folk). Initially Assert dayAt(folk, green).
  Rule folk_afternoon when lullOpen() and hour(clock) >= 12 and hour(clock) < 19 and dayAt(folk, green) { Retract dayAt(folk, green). Assert dayAt(folk, gardens). }
  Rule folk_morning when lullOpen() and hour(clock) < 12 and dayAt(folk, gardens) { Retract dayAt(folk, gardens). Assert dayAt(folk, green). } Initially Assert bedAt(folk, weavers_row).
  Topic folk_work with folk "Ask the people of Linger what they do" when lullOpen() once {
    Says "They look at each other, amused. 'Do?' says a woman with a basket of beans. 'Today I'm picking beans, because I like picking beans. Yesterday I made a hat.' 'It was a terrible hat,' says somebody. 'It held,' she says, with dignity. A man says, 'You mean what's my trade. I'm a weaver. My father was a weaver. I've woven four lengths in my life and every one of them for somebody I liked.' He shrugs. 'You can't do a thing here you don't mean, so you only do what you mean. It's not so hard, once you get the knack.' 'Some never get the knack,' says the woman with the beans, not looking at anyone.".
  }
  Topic folk_watching with folk "Ask the people of Linger about the Watching" when lullOpen() once {
    Says "'At dusk,' says the man. 'At the Long Table. Whatever's been made that day, for somebody, gets set out on the grass, and we eat, and we watch it, and the sun goes, and either it holds or it ravels.' 'Mostly it holds,' says the woman. 'When it doesn't, everybody knows you've stopped loving something. Or never did.' She looks down. 'It's kinder than it sounds. Mostly.' 'Not for Abel Rooke,' says somebody, and they all laugh, and then look sorry.".
  }
  Topic folk_strike with folk "Ask the people of Linger how the Lull began" when lullOpen() once {
    Says "'Ask the Old Shift,' they say, all at once, and laugh. Then the woman with the beans says: 'The Wroughts had the Mill, and the war wanted cloth, and they ran the looms seven days, and people died at them. And our grandparents stopped. Seven days they sat on the Tump and didn't go in. And on the seventh day they asked for it to be the holy day, and never another day.' 'Asked who?' says a child. 'Her,' says the woman, and nods at the starlings. 'Rhiannon. Her birds lull the living. Ask Tobias Lindsell, he tells it best.' 'He tells it longest,' says the man.".
    On discuss { Assert knows(actor, strike_told). }
  }
  Discovery strike_told "Fifty-seven years ago in the Lull's count, when the Wroughts' mill ran its looms seven days a week for a war's cloth, the weavers struck. On the seventh day of the strike they climbed the Tump and asked Rhiannon that the valley might keep its holy day and never another, and it was so.".
  Topic folk_ribbons with folk "Ask the people of Linger about the ribbons on the Tump" when lullOpen() once {
    Says "'One for every child born,' says the woman. 'Tied on the Lullday they come. You can count us on it.' She counts on her fingers. 'Two hundred and thirty-one born in the Lull. That's more than half of Linger, now.' A boy says, 'I'm at the bottom,' and is shushed. 'None of the Lull-born have ever seen a week,' says the man. 'They've only got Lulldays. They don't know any different.' 'Some of them want to,' says the woman, and the man says, 'Hush.'".
    On discuss { Assert knows(actor, club_rumour). }
  }
  Discovery club_rumour "Some of the Lull-born young of Linger, who have never seen a week, want to.".

  // ── The Open Hand ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Observe open_hand_scene at open_hand when lullOpen() "A big low room with the fire going and every table laid, though it is nobody's mealtime. There is no counter, and no tap, and no slate of prices. There is a great deal of food, and a man in an apron whose whole face lights up when you come in, which is slightly alarming.".
  Observe open_hand_dark at open_hand when folded() "The Open Hand's room is dark and cold, and the fire is out. Somebody is asleep in a chair by it, with his apron on.".
  Person matthias "Matthias Gale" at open_hand {
    Role "who keeps the Open Hand, for love". Ancestry human. Peaceable. Pronouns he. Manner jovial.
    Likeness "innkeeper".
    Greets "'A guest!' says the man in the apron, and comes at you with his arms out. 'A guest, a guest. Sit. No, here, by the fire. Have you eaten? You haven't eaten. Mabyn! A guest!' He has your coat off you before you have agreed to anything. 'Matthias Gale, the Open Hand, and I want you to know before anything else that I adore you. I adore all guests. It's a weakness. Sit.'".
    Greets again "'You came back!' says Matthias Gale, with real joy, and then at once, anxiously: 'Have you eaten?'".
  }
  Initially Assert lullFolk(matthias). Initially Assert dayAt(matthias, open_hand). Initially Assert bedAt(matthias, open_hand).
  Topic matthias_pay with matthias "Ask Matthias Gale what you owe him" when lullOpen() once {
    Says "Matthias goes white. Then red. 'Owe,' he says. 'Owe.' He sits down heavily. 'Don't. Please. If you paid me it'd come undone at sunset, the bed and the supper and all, and you'd be sitting on the floor with nothing in you, and I'd have your coin in my hand going back to your pocket like a bird.' He pats your arm. 'Love me back, that's all. Or don't, I'll love you anyway. Have a pie.'".
  }
  Topic matthias_rivals with matthias "Ask Matthias Gale about the Pryces" when lullOpen() once {
    Says "Matthias's face does something complicated. 'Lovely people,' he says. 'Lovely, generous people.' He lowers his voice. 'Lettice Pryce gave the Glossary a new roof last spring. Gave it. So Mabyn gave it a bell. So Lettice gave the bell a rope. A silk rope.' He breathes. 'You'll be invited to the Pryces'. When you are, and they give you something, you come back here and tell me what it was. Not for Mabyn. For me. I'm interested.' He is not interested; he is in agony.".
    On discuss { Assert knows(actor, houses_rivals). }
  }
  Discovery houses_rivals "The Pryces and the Gales of Linger, two Open Houses, are at war in generosity: what one gives, the other must outgive.".

  // ── The Chapel of the Birds ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Observe chapel_scene at chapel when lullOpen() "The Chapel of the Birds has no roof. It never had one: it has rafters, black with age and white with birds, and the sky through them. There is no altar. There is a long bench round the walls, and in the middle of the flagged floor a stone basin full of rainwater where the starlings bathe and argue. Carved over the arch on the inside: SHE LULLS THE LIVING.".
  Observe chapel_dark at chapel when folded() "The roofless chapel in the dark. The rafters are full of birds that do not move or make any sound. The basin is very still.".
  Observe chapel_dusk at chapel as ambience when lullOpen() and hour(clock) >= 19 "At dusk the starlings leave the rafters all at once, with a noise like a sheet shaken out, and go over the Tump in a cloud that turns on itself, black, then grey, then black.".

  // ── The Almshouse of the Old Shift ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Observe alms_scene at almshouse when lullOpen() "A long low room with a fire at each end and a row of high-backed chairs between, and in the chairs the Old Shift: the strikers, the eleven of them that are left, in their seventies and eighties, in coats of the first Lull-cloth ever woven. On the wall over the fire at one end, framed, is a weaver's shirt, torn at the shoulder; over the other, a shuttle. They are arguing, comfortably, about something that happened fifty-seven years ago.".
  Observe alms_dark at almshouse when folded() "The Almshouse in the dark, the row of high-backed chairs, and in every one of them an old man or woman asleep upright, with their hands open on their knees.".
  Person old_shift "the Old Shift" at almshouse {
    Role "the eleven strikers who are left, in their chairs". Ancestry human. Numbers 11. Peaceable.
    Greets "Eleven old faces turn to look at you, and an old woman at the near end says: 'Another one come to hear about the Strike. Sit down. We'll tell it you, and then we'll tell it you right.'".
  }
  Initially Assert lullFolk(old_shift). Initially Assert dayAt(old_shift, almshouse). Initially Assert bedAt(old_shift, almshouse).
  Topic shift_words with old_shift "Ask the Old Shift what was said on the Tump" when lullOpen() once {
    Says "'Holy day and never another,' says the old woman at once. 'Those were the words.' 'They were not,' says a man with one eye. 'It was Let it be the holy day, and the rest of the week can go hang. I was there.' 'We were all there, Amos.' 'Agnes Crane sang it,' says a third, 'and it was a hymn, and the words were the hymn's, Rest and be thankful.' They argue. It is clearly a very old argument, and a happy one. After a while the old woman leans to you and says, low: 'It was a child that said it, in the end. Little Nell Lumb, that's dead. She said, Can't it just stay Sunday? And it did.' She sits back. 'Don't tell them I said.'".
    On discuss { Assert knows(actor, words_disputed). }
  }
  Action learn_hymn(actor: group, site: place) "Ask the Old Shift to teach you Agnes Crane's hymn, Rest and be thankful" {
    Description "An hour of singing with eleven old people who disagree about every word.".
    Requires able(actor) and company(actor) and at(actor, site) and at(actor, almshouse) and at(old_shift, almshouse) and lullOpen() and knows(actor, words_disputed) and not granted(actor, performance).
    Time 6.
    On success { Assert granted(actor, performance). Assert knows(actor, hymn_learned). }
    Result "They teach it you the way the old teach anything: all at once, in three keys, with the words in dispute. An old woman at the far end, who you gather is Agnes Crane, beats time on the arm of her chair with a shuttle and stops them every second line. It is not a good hymn. It goes up where you expect it to go down, and the last verse is only the first one again, slower, the way you would sing it to a child you were putting to sleep. By the end of the hour you have it, and so, somehow, does the cat.".
  }
  Discovery hymn_learned "The Old Shift taught you Agnes Crane's hymn, Rest and be thankful, which the strikers sang on the Tump. It goes up where you expect it to go down.".
  Discovery words_disputed "The Old Shift do not agree what was said on the Tump: 'holy day and never another', 'the rest of the week can go hang', a hymn's 'rest and be thankful', or a child's 'can't it just stay Sunday?'".
  Topic shift_tobias with old_shift "Ask the Old Shift about Tobias Lindsell" when lullOpen() once {
    Says "'Tobias tells it best,' they say. 'He was at the window when we came out. He saw it all.' 'He was the last down off the Tump,' says the one-eyed man. 'Carried Nell Lumb on his back.' 'He's not been himself,' says the old woman. 'Since Hester took bad. He sits with her. He'll not come to the Table.' A silence. 'Not like him,' someone says. 'Not like him at all.'".
    On discuss { Assert knows(actor, tobias_at_window). }
  }
  Discovery tobias_at_window "The Old Shift say Tobias Lindsell tells the strike best, because he was at the Mill window when the strikers came out, and saw it all.".

  // ── Weavers' Row, the chandlery, the Gardens ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Observe row_scene at weavers_row when lullOpen() "A lane of weavers' cottages, each with its long window at the top, each window open. Out of one comes the sound of a loom going, slowly, stopping, going again: somebody weaving something for somebody. Out of another, an argument about a cake.".
  Observe row_dark at weavers_row when folded() "Weavers' Row in the dark. Through the long windows, if you put a light up to them, you see people asleep in their beds with their hands open on the covers, and they do not wake when the light goes over their faces.".
  Observe spurling_scene at spurling_shop when lullOpen() "A chandlery that has nothing to sell and is full: candles hung in bunches from the beams by their wicks, spurling and beeswax and some green ones that smell of bay, and a girl at a bench dipping them, very slowly, with her tongue between her teeth.".
  Observe spurling_dark at spurling_shop when folded() "The chandlery in the dark, the candles hanging in their bunches. Somebody is asleep at the bench with her head on her arms.".
  Observe piran_scene at piran_shop when lullOpen() "A carver's workshop with the shavings swept into a heap for the gardens, and on every shelf small animals in limewood: hares, a heron, an owl, a woman's head, the same woman's head, again, again, at different ages.".
  Observe piran_dark at piran_shop when folded() "The carver's workshop in the dark. The little carved heads on the shelves, a row of them, all one woman.".
  Observe gardens_spring at gardens when lullOpen() and season(clock) <= 1 "The Pleasure Gardens slope down to the Idle in strips, each strip somebody's: beans up poles, early peas, cabbages in rows so straight they must be a joke. There are more than the town could eat. Children are racing wheelbarrows down the main path, which is apparently the harvest, and an old man is keeping score.".
  Observe gardens_summer at gardens when lullOpen() and season(clock) == 2 "The Pleasure Gardens in high summer, heavy with it: beans, marrows, currants, everything a week further on than it was last Lullday, as it always is. Children are picking for a prize nobody has named. Somebody's strip has gone to seed and been left to, and has a board in it saying RESTING.".
  Observe gardens_autumn at gardens when lullOpen() and season(clock) == 3 "The Pleasure Gardens in autumn: the last beans, apples on the espaliers, the potatoes up and lying out to dry in rows, and every week further on than it was. The Lull-born talk of the year as if it were weather: 'it was blossom on Tuesday', meaning seven Lulldays ago, which is seven weeks of the world's.".
  Observe gardens_winter at gardens when lullOpen() and season(clock) >= 4 "The Pleasure Gardens under frost: leeks, kale, a row of cloches made of old window-glass. A child is breaking the ice on the water-butt with great seriousness, and a woman is watching her as if it were the theatre.".
  Observe gardens_dark at gardens when folded() "The Gardens in the dark. You can hear them growing: a creak, a tick, a leaf turning over. Things are a week further on every time the Lull opens; this is when.".

  // ── The Gift Hall ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Observe hall_scene at gift_hall when lullOpen() "The old Cloth Hall: a long room under a hammer-beam roof, with the wool-weighing beam still hanging from the middle of it on its chains, now used to swing children. Along the walls are shelves, and on the shelves are things that held: a pair of boots, a cake under a glass, a quilt of strikers' shirts, a child's clay horse, a lute, each with a card in a careful hand saying who made it, and for whom, and when. At a table by the door people exchange courtesies, two at a time, with a Glosser in a white apron sitting between them like a referee.".
  Observe hall_dark at gift_hall when folded() "The Gift Hall in the dark. On the shelves, everything that held, in rows. The beam hangs on its chains, quite still.".
  Person mabyn "Mabyn Gale" at gift_hall {
    Role "who keeps the courtesy table at the Gift Hall". Ancestry human. Peaceable. Pronouns she. Manner cheerful.
    Likeness "farmer".
    Greets "A broad woman with flour on her forearms and a pencil behind her ear waves you over to the table by the door. 'Courtesies? You'll want courtesies. You give me something, I give you something, at the same moment, and neither of us asks; Glosser Mote sees it's fair, and then it's not trade, it's two presents.' She beams. 'Mabyn Gale. Linnet's mother. Matthias's wife, God help me. What do you need?'".
    Greets again "'There you are,' says Mabyn Gale, and pushes a honey-cake at you before you can speak.".
  }
  Initially Assert lullFolk(mabyn). Initially Assert dayAt(mabyn, gift_hall). Initially Assert bedAt(mabyn, open_hand).
  // Courtesies: two gifts at once. They hold, because the Lull gives meaning to: what the company gives, it gives.
  Action courtesy_bread(actor: group, site: place) "Exchange courtesies with Mabyn Gale: two coin and a loaf of bread for the road each way" {
    Requires able(actor) and company(actor) and at(actor, site) and at(mabyn, site) and lullOpen() and quantity(actor, gold) >= 2 and hour(clock) < 19.
    On success { Decrease quantity(actor, gold) by 2. Increase quantity(mabyn, gold) by 2. Increase quantity(actor, rations) by 3. }
    Result "You put two coins on the table and Mabyn puts down three loaves wrapped in a cloth, at the same moment, and the Glosser looks from one to the other and says, 'Courtesy,' and Mabyn says, 'Thank you,' and so, you find, do you.".
  }
  Action courtesy_candles(actor: group, site: place) "Exchange courtesies with Mabyn Gale: a coin and a bundle of Spurling's candles each way" {
    Requires able(actor) and company(actor) and at(actor, site) and at(mabyn, site) and lullOpen() and quantity(actor, gold) >= 1 and hour(clock) < 19 and not candlesGiven(actor).
    On success { Decrease quantity(actor, gold) by 1. Increase quantity(mabyn, gold) by 1. Give spurling_candles to actor. Assert candlesGiven(actor). }
    Result "Mabyn puts down a bunch of green bay-scented candles, tied by their wicks, as you put down your coin. 'Wenna Spurling's,' she says. 'She dips them for whoever's going into the dark. You'd be surprised who does.'".
  }
  Relation candlesGiven(group).
  Item spurling_candles "a bunch of Spurling's candles" is candle at limbo.
  Topic mabyn_courtesy with mabyn "Ask Mabyn Gale why the Glosser watches every courtesy" when lullOpen() once {
    Says "'Because if I gave you a loaf meaning to get your coin,' says Mabyn, 'and you gave me a coin meaning to get my loaf, that's a sale, and at sunset the loaf's back on my table and the coin's back in your purse and we've both had a wasted afternoon. So we give. Properly. And the Glosser sees we gave properly, so nobody can say after.' She lowers her voice. 'Half of it's for show. You can't fool the sunset. But it makes people feel better, and Glosser Mote's a nice girl and needs something to do.'".
  }

  // ── The Glossary ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Observe glossary_scene at glossary when lullOpen() "The Glossary is a tall narrow house full of boards: wooden boards, painted white, each lettered with a Gloss and its number and hung on pegs, floor to ceiling, room after room, like a library written on doors. Gloss 1: THAT REST IS NOT IDLENESS. Gloss 7: THAT A KINDNESS EXPECTING THANKS IS A LOAN. Gloss 1,104: THAT WHISTLING WHILE ONE SWEEPS MAKES THE SWEEPING PLAY, IF THE TUNE BE ONE'S OWN. Gloss 2,213, newly painted: THAT A CAT WHICH BRINGS A MOUSE IS NOT IN SERVICE. A young woman in a white apron stands on a ladder, painting.".
  Observe glossary_dark at glossary when folded() "The Glossary in the dark: board after board, and the young Glosser asleep at the foot of her ladder with the brush still in her open hand.".
  Observe glossary_912 at glossary as feature when lullOpen() "In a corner one board hangs face to the wall.".
  Observe glossary_912_seen at glossary as feature when lullOpen() and knows(party, simeon_banned) "The board turned to the wall will be nine hundred and twelve.".
  Person aldith "Aldith Mote" at glossary {
    Role "a young Glosser in a white apron with no pockets". Ancestry human. Calling cleric. Level 1. Trait vitalist. Peaceable. Pronouns she. Manner compassionate.
    Likeness "scholar".
    Greets "The young woman on the ladder looks down, with paint on her nose. 'Oh! A Sixer. Hello. I'm Aldith Mote, I'm a Glosser, the most junior one, they give me the painting.' She climbs down. 'Could I ask you something? You don't have to answer. Do things come undone outside? At sunset? Ever?'".
    Greets again "Aldith Mote turns on her ladder with paint on her nose and a second colour on her ear. 'The same wall,' she says. 'I painted it blue yesterday, and in the morning it was the colour it was. I am now painting it a colour I do not like, to see if that holds.'".
  }
  Initially Assert lullFolk(aldith). Initially Assert dayAt(aldith, glossary). Initially Assert bedAt(aldith, glossary).
  Topic aldith_doctrine with aldith "Ask Aldith Mote what the Glossers hold the law to be" when lullOpen() once {
    Says "'Gloss twelve,' says Aldith promptly. 'That what is done for wages, or under compulsion, is undone at the going down of the sun. And everything else is a footnote to it.' She looks at the boards, and lowers her voice. 'Two thousand two hundred footnotes. I paint them. And sometimes I think if you need two thousand two hundred footnotes, perhaps the text is wrong.' She looks horrified at herself. 'Don't tell the Reeve.'".
    On discuss { Assert knows(actor, glosser_doctrine). }
  }
  Discovery glosser_doctrine "The Glossers of the Lull hold, by their twelfth Gloss, that what is done for wages or under compulsion is undone at sunset.".
  Observe hall_watching at gift_hall as ambience when lullOpen() and hour(clock) < 19 "A child swings on the old weighing-beam, very high, and the Glosser at the table says 'Mind,' without looking up.".
}
data/adventures/thrume/between.kyr:
Module thrume "Thrume" {
  Description "The Between: under every sleeping thing, where forgotten dreams fall, and the Mouth that eats them.".

  Place between "the Between" is region.
  Place grey_waste "the grey waste" is wilderness within between at 0, 0.

  Place grey_plain "the grey plain" is room within grey_waste at 0, 0.
  Place archive "the Archive of Forgotten Things" is room within grey_waste at 1, 0.
  Place unremembering "the Shore of Unremembering" is room within grey_waste at 0, 1.
  Place mouth_edge "the edge of the Mouth" is room within grey_waste at 1, 1.

  Passage archive_walk "the grey walk" is path between grey_plain and archive taking 1 hour.
  Passage shore_walk "the long grey" is path between grey_plain and unremembering taking 1 hour.
  Passage mouth_walk "the last of the grey" is path between unremembering and mouth_edge taking 1 hour.
  Passage archive_mouth "the archive's end" is path between archive and mouth_edge taking 2 hours.
  Passage way_home "the way back up" is passage between mouth_edge and heart_chamber one way taking 1 hour
    opening when sungClean(fells) or sealed(fells) or woken(fells) "Above the Mouth there is no up.".

  Observe plain_scene at grey_plain when true "A plain of grey, flat to the end of the world. It is made of things: you are walking on dreams that nobody remembers, packed down like ash. Sometimes, under your foot, one of them is briefly a face, or a room, or a song, and then it is grey again.".
  Observe archive_scene at archive when true "Shelves, in the grey, going away in rows to the horizon. On them, everything ever forgotten, set out neatly, waiting: a key, a name, a kiss, the way home from somewhere. Among them, with a little shock, you find things of your own. You had forgotten them. You cannot now remember what they were.".
  Observe shore_scene at unremembering when true "The grey ends at a shore, and beyond it the grey is liquid, and lapping, and it has no far side. Standing here, you find it hard to remember why you came.".
  Hazard forgetting "The Shore of Unremembering" means "Deal (1d6) necrotic damage to ally unless wisdom save against (13).".
  Rule shore_takes when at(party, unremembering) and not knows(party, song_known)
    says "Something goes out of you like breath. You are not sure what it was." { Assert strikes(forgetting, party). }
  Observe mouth_scene at mouth_edge when not sungClean(fells) "The grey goes down here, all of it, in a slope that steepens and steepens into a darkness that is not dark but empty. It is the Mouth. It has no teeth, no tongue, no throat; it is only the place where things stop being remembered. It is eating, always, slowly, and the plain is sliding into it, a grain at a time.".
  Observe mouth_refused at mouth_edge when sungClean(fells) "The slope into the Mouth is still. Nothing is sliding. On the grey at its edge, a little green has come up, like the first grass on a burnt field.".

  Thing the_mouth "the Mouth" at mouth_edge is scenery {
    State eating "The Mouth eats.".
    State refused "The Mouth is shut.".
  }
  Action sing_song(actor: group, site: place) "Sing the keepers' song into the Mouth" {
    Description "Every name of the old ones, and Thrume's last. A song is a thing remembered by the living.".
    Requires able(actor) and company(actor) and at(actor, site) and at(actor, mouth_edge) and knows(actor, song_known) and not sungClean(fells) and not woken(fells).
    Time 6.
    On success { Assert sungClean(fells). Assert state(the_mouth, refused). Set stirring(fells) to 0. }
    Result "You sing. Your voices make no sound here, and you sing anyway: every name, the hills that walked, one by one, as the Rememberer sang them. The Mouth takes the first name, and cannot swallow it; somebody far away is still remembering it. It takes the second, and cannot. By Thrume's name the whole slope is shuddering. Then, very slowly, the Mouth closes. Far above you, up through the grey and the dream and the bone, you feel the Quiet Court go quiet for ever.".
  }
  Action shout_awake(actor: group, site: place) "Shout Thrume awake, so his dream ends and the Mouth starves" {
    Description "If he wakes, there is no dream to eat. There is also no Saltgrave, and no Ebb.".
    Requires able(actor) and company(actor) and at(actor, site) and at(actor, mouth_edge) and not sungClean(fells) and not woken(fells).
    Time 1.
    On success { Set stirring(fells) to 10. }
    Result "You turn your back on the Mouth and shout his name up into the grey, all of you, as loud as you can, and the grey shakes, and the dream above you tears like paper.".
  }
  Observe hush_stilled at hand_street when sungClean(fells) "The people of the Court stand in the Street of Hands with their long hands still, quite grey, like statues of themselves. The human thralls are walking up the long way out, blinking.".
}
data/adventures/thrume/dream.kyr:
Module thrume "Thrume" {
  Description "The Palace of Before: Thrume's dream of the sky he walked under a thousand years ago.".

  Place dreamsky "the sky of Before" is region.
  Place palace "the Palace of Before" is site within dreamsky at 0, 0.
  Place courts_low "the lower courts" is level within palace.
  Place courts_high "the high courts" is level within palace.

  Place cloud_landing "the cloud landing" is room within courts_low at 0, 0.
  Place slaying_gallery "the Gallery of the Slaying" is room within courts_low at 1, 0.
  Place grey_orchard "the Grey Orchard" is room within courts_low at 0, 1.
  Place feast_hall "the Hall of the Feast" is room within courts_high at 0, 0.
  Place eye_tower "the Eye-Tower" is room within courts_high at 1, 0.

  Passage gallery_cloud "the cloud walk" is passage between cloud_landing and slaying_gallery taking 10 minutes.
  Passage orchard_cloud "the orchard walk" is passage between cloud_landing and grey_orchard taking 10 minutes.
  Passage cloud_stair "the cloud-stair" is stair between cloud_landing and feast_hall taking 20 minutes
    opening when exhaling(fells) "The cloud-stair goes up into the palace in long white flights, and as you watch, it thins, and frays, and the treads drift apart like smoke. It holds only on his out-breath.".
  Passage tower_bridge "the tower walk" is passage between feast_hall and eye_tower taking 10 minutes.

  Observe landing_dream at cloud_landing when true "You stand on cloud, and it holds you like turf. Above, the Palace of Before: white stone, many-towered, riding the sky. The sky is so near you can see the grain of it, and through the cloud below, far down, a range of hills is walking slowly across the world.".
  Observe gallery_dream at slaying_gallery when true "A colonnade of white stone whose walls are not painted but remembered: the scenes move. Men in leather aprons with hammers of starmetal climb a hill that is breathing. They strike, and the hill screams, and the smiths die in dozens, and climb again. Above them in the sky, small and bright, figures in crowns are watching and counting.".
  Discovery smiths_paid "The Hollow Smiths were paid by the young gods to kill the titans and make room for the world. Thrume remembers them weeping as they climbed.".
  Observe gallery_teaches at slaying_gallery when true "In the last scene a smith sits on the hill's flank with his hammer across his knees, weeping, and the hill puts its great hand over him like a roof." teaches smiths_paid.
  Observe orchard_dream at grey_orchard when not sungClean(fells) "An orchard of white trees, heavy with fruit like lamps. From the far side the grey is coming: trees, grass and light all eaten to the same soft grey. Among the grey trees, tall soft-faced shapes stand with their faces in the fruit.".
  Person orchard_court "the feeders in the orchard" at grey_orchard {
    Role "the Court, feeding on the dream". Species court_kin. Level 9. Numbers 2.
    Temperament territorial.
    Warns "The soft faces lift out of the fruit and turn to you, and their long hands open.".
  }
  Observe feast_dream at feast_hall when true "A hall without a roof, open to the near sky, and in it the old ones at their feast: titans, the hills that walked, each as big as a village, sitting at a table of cloud. They are remembered, not alive; when you look straight at one, it is a hill. At the far end, the youngest, smaller than the rest, laughing.".
  Person old_ones "the old ones" at feast_hall {
    Role "the titans of Before, as Thrume remembers them". Species titan. Numbers 3. Peaceable.
  }
  Topic old_ones_talk with old_ones "Speak to the old ones at the feast" when true once {
    Says "The nearest turns its great head toward you, slowly, as weather turns. 'Little one,' it says, and the cloud under you shakes. 'He was the youngest. He dreams us, now we are gone. When he stops dreaming, we stop.' It looks down the hall, past the youngest, to where a tower stands at the end of a bridge. 'Something is eating his sleep. Go and tell it no.'".
  }
  Observe tower_dream at eye_tower when true "A slender tower of white stone, and from its top a bridge goes out over nothing: no cloud, no sky, no hills below, only grey, going down and down.".
  Person dream_abbess "the Abbess, dreaming" at eye_tower {
    Role "the Abbess of Hush, as she is in his dream: tall, grey, crowned with sleep". Species court_kin. Level 14. Peaceable.
  }
  Topic abbess_offer with dream_abbess "Speak to the Abbess at the bridge" when true once {
    Says "She speaks aloud. In the dream, the Court can. Her voice is patient; it has never once been in a hurry. 'Go back,' she says. 'Sit by the heart and let him sleep, and I will give you a dream of your own, the best one, for ever. Your father alive. Your home not burned. Whatever you lost.' Her long hand opens toward the bridge. 'Or go down there, and meet what I serve, and be forgotten.' She steps aside. She does not need to stop you.".
  }
  Passage to_between "the bridge to the Between" is passage between eye_tower and grey_plain taking 1 hour.
}
data/adventures/thrume/inward.kyr:
Module thrume "Thrume" {
  Description "The Inward Roads: the workings, the Veins, the Lungs, the Smiths' Last Delving and the Dream-Hollows, inside the body of Thrume.".

  Place body "the inward roads" is site within fells at 2, 1.
  Place workings "the workings" is level within body.
  Place veins "the Veins" is level within body.
  Place lungs "the Lungs" is level within body.
  Place delving "the Smiths' Last Delving" is level within body.
  Place hollows "the Dream-Hollows" is level within body.

  Place adit_head "the old adit" is room within workings at 0, 0.
  Place number_four "the Number Four gallery" is room within workings at 1, 0.
  Place brannoc_camp "Brannoc's deep camp" is room within workings at 2, 0.
  Place cutting_face "the cutting face" is room within workings at 3, 0.
  Place carvers "the carvers' drift" is room within workings at 1, 1.
  Place sump "the Number Four sump" is room within workings at 2, 1.
  Place quiet_door "the Quiet Door" is room within workings at 3, 1.

  Place vein_foot "the foot of the sump ladder" is room within veins at 0, 0.
  Place red_gallery "the red gallery" is room within veins at 1, 0.
  Place vein_wound "the Wound" is room within veins at 2, 0.
  Place vein_crossing "the crossing of the veins" is room within veins at 1, 1.

  Place stair_foot "the foot of the Keepers' Stair" is room within lungs at 0, 0.
  Place lung_mouth "the mouth of the Lungs" is room within lungs at 1, 0.
  Place hall_of_wind "the Hall of Wind" is room within lungs at 2, 0.
  Place rib_lee "the lee of the great rib" is room within lungs at 2, 1.

  Place delving_gate "the Smiths' gate" is room within delving at 0, 0.
  Place cold_forge "the cold forge" is room within delving at 1, 0.
  Place iron_library "the iron library" is room within delving at 2, 0.
  Place gauge_room "the Gauge of Sleep" is room within delving at 1, 1.
  Place master_cell "the Master's cell" is room within delving at 2, 1.

  Place hollow_mouth "the mouth of the Hollows" is room within hollows at 0, 0.
  Place dream_field "the dreamed field" is room within hollows at 1, 0.
  Place hunger_shaft "the cold shaft" is room within hollows at 0, 1.
  Place hush_approach "the long quiet" is room within hollows at 2, 0.

  Initially Assert unlit(adit_head). Initially Assert unlit(number_four). Initially Assert unlit(carvers). Initially Assert unlit(sump).
  Initially Assert unlit(quiet_door). Initially Assert unlit(stair_foot). Initially Assert unlit(lung_mouth).
