  Initially Assert unlit(delving_gate). Initially Assert unlit(cold_forge). Initially Assert unlit(iron_library). Initially Assert unlit(master_cell).
  Initially Assert unlit(hollow_mouth). Initially Assert unlit(hunger_shaft).

  Passage adit "the old adit" is tunnel between cart_road and adit_head taking 20 minutes.
  Passage four_drift "the main drift" is passage between adit_head and number_four taking 10 minutes.
  Passage camp_drift "the deep drift" is passage between number_four and brannoc_camp taking 10 minutes.
  Passage face_drift "the drift to the face" is passage between brannoc_camp and cutting_face.
  Passage carvers_drift "the side drift" is passage between number_four and carvers.
  Passage sump_drift "the sump drift" is passage between brannoc_camp and sump.
  Passage quiet_drift "the cart drift" is passage between sump and quiet_door.
  Passage sump_rope "the ladder in the sump" is ladder between sump and vein_foot taking 30 minutes hidden until sump_ladder.
  Passage red_way "the red way" is passage between vein_foot and red_gallery.
  Passage wound_way "the warm way" is passage between red_gallery and vein_wound.
  Passage crossing_way "the branching" is passage between red_gallery and vein_crossing.
  Passage keepers_stair "the Keepers' Stair" is stair between stair_head and stair_foot taking 2 hours.
  Passage lung_way "the windpipe" is passage between stair_foot and lung_mouth taking 20 minutes.
  Passage wind_floor "the floor of the Lungs" is passage between lung_mouth and hall_of_wind taking 30 minutes.
  Passage lee_way "the shelter of the rib" is passage between hall_of_wind and rib_lee.
  Passage wind_gate "the Wind Gate" is passage between hall_of_wind and vein_crossing taking 20 minutes
    opening when exhaling(fells) "The Wind Gate is a gap between two ribs of white stone, and the wind is pouring into it so hard that it would take a horse.".
  Passage delving_way "the smiths' road" is passage between vein_crossing and delving_gate taking 30 minutes.
  Passage smith_door "the Smiths' door" is door between delving_gate and cold_forge.
  Passage library_arch "the library arch" is arch between cold_forge and iron_library.
  Passage gauge_door "the gauge door" is door between cold_forge and gauge_room.
  Passage cell_door "the Master's door" is door between iron_library and master_cell.
  Passage quiet_slab_way "the Quiet Door" is passage between quiet_door and hollow_mouth.
  Passage dream_seam "the dream seam" is crawl between vein_crossing and hollow_mouth taking 1 hour needing climbing or rope.
  Passage field_way "the warm way down" is passage between hollow_mouth and dream_field.
  Passage shaft_way "the cold way down" is passage between hollow_mouth and hunger_shaft.
  Passage quiet_way "the long quiet" is passage between dream_field and hush_approach taking 1 hour.

  // The workings.
  Observe adit_scene at adit_head when true "An old adit, timbered, the props furred with white. Fresh cart-ruts run down it into the dark, and beside the ruts the marks of many boots, all going one way.".
  Observe four_scene at number_four when true "The main gallery of the Number Four. The walls are white salt, then pink, then, as the gallery goes down, a red like meat. The air is warm and wet as breath.".
  Observe camp_scene at brannoc_camp when cutting(brannoc) "A camp in a widened drift: bedrolls, a brazier, picks racked like spears, and a tally board with a quota chalked on it, crossed out, and a bigger one chalked under it. From further down comes the sound of picks, steady as a clock.".
  Observe camp_quiet at brannoc_camp when not cutting(brannoc) "The camp is quiet. The picks are racked. Somebody has wiped the tally board clean.".
  Observe face_scene at cutting_face when cutting(brannoc) "The face is red crystal, wet, and warm as skin. Where the picks have bitten into it the cuts weep a thin red brine that runs down into the gutter and away. When you put your hand flat against the face, something under it, a long way under, moves.".
  Observe face_quiet at cutting_face when not cutting(brannoc) "The red face is scarred with pick-marks. The weeping has slowed. Someone has packed the deepest cut with clay.".
  Observe carvers_scene at carvers when true "Three miners sit in a side drift with chisels, carving faces into the salt wall. They have carved dozens. Every face is the same: long, smooth, grey, with no mouth and eyes like closed doors. The miners do not look up.".
  Observe sump_scene at sump when true "The sump of the Number Four: a pool of red brine, and a black hole going down beside it.".
  Observe sump_ladder_seen at sump when knows(party, sump_ladder) "A ladder of grey rope, too fine and too strong for any ropewalk you know, hangs down the hole beside the sump.".
  Observe quiet_scene at quiet_door when true "The cart drift ends at a wall of grey stone, smooth as a pebble, with no handle and no hinge. The cart-ruts go straight into it. Beside it, a heap of blankets.".

  // Brannoc and his crew.
  Person brannoc "Overseer Brannoc" at brannoc_camp {
    Role "the Margravine's overseer, with a quota". Ancestry human. Calling warrior. Level 7. Peaceable.
    Greets "Overseer Brannoc stands at the lip of the cut with a tally-board in one hand and a lantern in the other, and looks at the lantern more than at you. 'Quota,' he says. 'You will want to ask about the quota. Everyone asks about the quota. It is the Margravine's, not mine. I have never met anyone who thought it was his.'".
    Greets again "Overseer Brannoc has marked the board since you left; there are more strokes in the fourth column than there were. 'The Wound gives what it gives,' he says. 'The Margravine asks for what she asks for. I am the man between, and the hole in the middle of the sum is getting wider.'".
    Wants margrave_seal.
    Objects "'Put that down,' says Brannoc, without raising his voice. He does not need to.".
  }
  Person crew "Brannoc's crew" at cutting_face {
    Role "miners, cutting". Ancestry human. Calling commoner. Numbers 6. Peaceable.
  }
  Relation cutting(group). Initially Assert cutting(brannoc).
  Relation stopped(group).
  Topic brannoc_quota with brannoc "Ask Overseer Brannoc to stop cutting" when cutting(brannoc) once {
    Says "Brannoc looks at you as if you were a fall of rock he had not planned for. 'I have a quota,' he says. 'The Margravine has a war. Harle has a host. When the quota is met, I stop. When the seal says stop, I stop.' He turns back to his tally board. 'Not before.'".
  }
  Topic brannoc_blood with brannoc "Tell Overseer Brannoc what he is cutting" when cutting(brannoc) and knows(actor, salt_is_blood) and stirring(fells) < 6 once {
    Says "Brannoc hears you out. 'Blood,' he says. 'Salt is salt. A mountain is a mountain. I've cut through ghosts before, in Ebb, and the ghosts were miners' wives with lanterns.' He chalks a new line on the tally board. 'Go home.'".
  }
  Topic brannoc_shaken with brannoc "Tell Overseer Brannoc what moved under the face" when cutting(brannoc) and knows(actor, salt_is_blood) and shaken(fells) {
    Says "Brannoc does not answer for a long time. There is salt-dust in his beard from the roof, from when the mountain turned over. 'I felt it,' he says at last. 'Under my hand. Like a horse under you when it's going to bolt.' He picks up the chalk, and looks at the tally board, and puts the chalk down. 'Crew,' he shouts down the drift. 'Down tools.'".
    On discuss { Retract cutting(brannoc). Assert stopped(brannoc). Decrease stirring(fells) by 1. }
  }
  Event sealed_order near brannoc when keeps(brannoc, ?l) and itemKind(?l, margrave_seal) and cutting(brannoc)
    "Brannoc breaks the blue seal, reads, reads again, and folds the letter into his coat. 'Down tools,' he shouts down the drift. Then, to you, quietly: 'If this is forged, I'll find you.'" then {
    Retract cutting(brannoc). Assert stopped(brannoc). Decrease stirring(fells) by 1.
  }
  Rule brannoc_dead when dead(brannoc) and cutting(brannoc) { Retract cutting(brannoc). Decrease stirring(fells) by 1. }
  Topic crew_dreams with crew "Ask the crew how they sleep" when true once {
    Says "'We don't,' says a young one. 'Not down here. You lie down and you're somewhere else, somewhere high up, and the floor's beating.' An older one hits him with a glove. 'Shut up. Brannoc hears that, you're on the face till you drop.'".
    On discuss { Assert knows(actor, dream_shared). }
  }
  Topic carvers_face with carvers_folk "Ask the carvers whose face they are carving" when true once {
    Says "One of them stops. He turns his chisel over in his fingers. 'Hers,' he says. 'The Abbess. She looks at you when you sleep.' He goes back to carving. 'She's very kind.'".
    On discuss { Assert knows(actor, abbess_named). }
  }
  Person carvers_folk "the carvers" at carvers {
    Role "dream-sick miners with chisels". Ancestry human. Calling commoner. Numbers 3. Peaceable.
  }
  Discovery abbess_named "The dream-sick miners carve the face of 'the Abbess', who looks at them when they sleep.".

  // The Quiet Door opens to the humming stone of the Court.
  Thing quiet_slab "the grey door" on quiet_slab_way {
    State seamless blocking "The grey door is shut. It has no handle, no hinge, and no seam.".
    State open "The grey door stands open on a dark, warm way down. There is no sound from below. None at all.".
    Change hum "Hold the humming pebble against the grey door" from seamless to open needing hush_stone.
  }

  // The Veins.
  Observe veinfoot_scene at vein_foot when true "The ladder comes down into a cave of red crystal that gives off its own light, dim and warm, brightening and dimming, brightening and dimming, slowly.".
  Observe red_scene at red_gallery when exhaling(fells) "A gallery of red crystal the colour of a lamp through a hand. The light is dim now, ebbing, and the crystal is cool.".
  Observe red_bright at red_gallery when not exhaling(fells) "A gallery of red crystal, and the crystal is bright, brighter, nearly too bright to look at, and warm, and the light is pulsing, slow and strong.".
  Observe wound_scene at vein_wound when cutting(brannoc) "The Wound. Above you, through a ragged hole, the pick-marks of the cutting face; here below, the crystal is cracked in a great star, and the cracks are weeping. The floor is a pool of warm red brine. It is very hot.".
  Observe wound_quiet at vein_wound when not cutting(brannoc) "The Wound has stopped weeping. The red pool is crusting at its edges, white.".
  Observe crossing_scene at vein_crossing when true "A cave where four ways meet. One climbs toward a gap between ribs of white stone, where a wind blows; one goes down along a smiths' road, paved; one is a crack in the wall that smells of hay; one is the way you came.".
  Person warden_jewel "the Wound's warden" at vein_wound {
    Role "a shape of red crystal that guards the cut". Species jewel_elemental. Level 8.
    Temperament territorial.
    Warns "The red crystal at the edge of the pool stands up. It has the shape of a man, more or less, and the light pulses in it. It does not come closer. It waits to see whether you will.".
  }

  // The Lungs.
  Observe stairfoot_scene at stair_foot when true "The Keepers' Stair ends in a round chamber. Ahead, a passage as wide as a road goes on, and wind comes down it in long gusts, in and out, in and out.".
  Observe lungmouth_scene at lung_mouth when exhaling(fells) "The windpipe opens onto a cavern so vast you cannot see its far side. A warm wind blows past you, out of it, steady.".
  Observe lungmouth_in at lung_mouth when not exhaling(fells) "The windpipe opens onto a cavern so vast you cannot see its far side. The wind is going into it, hard, tugging at your clothes.".
  Observe wind_scene at hall_of_wind when exhaling(fells) "The Hall of Wind: a floor of white stone ribbed like sand, and above, far above, a roof that rises and falls. The wind blows outward now, warm. In the far wall a gap between two ribs of stone stands open.".
  Observe wind_in at hall_of_wind when not exhaling(fells) "The roof of the Hall of Wind is coming down, slowly, and the wind is going in: everything loose on the floor is sliding toward the far wall, where the gap between two ribs is shrieking.".
  Hazard wind_drag "The in-breath" means "Deal (2d6) physical damage to ally unless strength save against (13).".
  Rule wind_takes when at(party, hall_of_wind) and not exhaling(fells)
    says "The wind takes you off your feet and rolls you across the ribbed floor like a leaf." { Assert strikes(wind_drag, party). }
  Observe lee_scene at rib_lee when true "Behind a rib of white stone as tall as a church, the wind does not reach. Others have sheltered here: the ash of a fire, and scratched on the rib in a smith's hand, OUT IS OPEN.".

  // The Smiths' Last Delving.
  Observe gate_scene at delving_gate when true "A gate of black iron in a wall of grey stone, and over it, cut deep, a line of letters: WHAT WAKES, KILLS. WHAT KILLS, WAKES.".
  Discovery doctrine_known "The doctrine of the Hollow Smiths: what wakes, kills; what kills, wakes. They could not kill Thrume, because every killing blow woke him; so they made him sleep, and built the tomb around his heart so that nothing would wake him or kill him again.".
  Observe forge_scene at cold_forge when true "A forge the size of a chapel, and as cold. Anvils, tongs as long as oars, and hammers racked on the wall: iron, bronze, and one of red salt, glassy, unused.".
  Observe library_scene at iron_library when true "A room of shelves, and on the shelves books made of iron leaves, hinged, the letters punched through. Most are too heavy to lift alone.".
  Discovery tomb_stair_known "From the smiths' building-book: 'The third tread of the salt stair is no tread. Prod before you trust.'" {
    Source building_book "the building-book of the Heart-Tomb" at iron_library readable by party.
  }
  Discovery hammers_known "From the smiths' riddle-book: 'Iron wakes the sleeper. Bronze wakes the dead. Strike with what is sleeping, and pass instead.' Beside it, in another hand: 'The salt is his blood, and his blood sleeps.'" {
    Source riddle_book "the riddle-book of the Gate" at iron_library readable by party.
  }
  Discovery face_known "From the smiths' building-book: 'The Sleeper's mouth is open, and his eyes are closed. Go by the eye that is on your left as you face him. Never go where he is awake.'" {
    Source face_leaf "a loose iron leaf about the Sleeper's Face" at iron_library readable by party.
  }
  Discovery doors_known "From the smiths' building-book: 'In the hall of doors, the door is the one that is not there. Every door you can see is a death.'" {
    Source doors_leaf "an iron leaf about the hall of doors" at iron_library readable by party.
  }
  Discovery breaths_known "Scratched on the great rib, and again in the building-book: 'Out is open.' The Room of Three Breaths, and the Wind Gate, are crossed on his out-breath.".
  Observe lee_teaches at rib_lee when true "OUT IS OPEN, says the rib, in a smith's square hand." teaches breaths_known.
  Observe gauge_scene at gauge_room when true "A round room. In the middle, on a pillar, an instrument of brass and grey stone: a needle on a dial, and the dial marked in the smiths' square letters from DEEP to WAKING. Behind it, a tube of glass running up into the rock is full of something red that rises and falls.".
  Observe gauge_low at gauge_room when stirring(fells) < 6 "The needle stands a little below the middle of the dial, where the letters say DREAMING. While you watch it, it ticks once toward WAKING.".
  Observe gauge_high at gauge_room when stirring(fells) >= 6 and not woken(fells) "The needle stands well over toward WAKING, and trembles.".
  Discovery salt_is_blood "The Smiths' Gauge of Sleep measures Thrume's sleep by his blood, which is the red salt in the glass. Every cut in the workings moves the needle toward WAKING.".
  Observe gauge_teaches at gauge_room when true "Under the dial, punched in iron: THIS IS HIS BLOOD. WHERE IT IS CUT, HE STIRS." teaches salt_is_blood.
  Observe cell_scene at master_cell when true "A smith's cell: a cot, a chair, a shelf. In the chair, the bones of a big man in a leather apron, his hands folded on a hammer of grey iron no longer than a hand. On the shelf, a journal of iron leaves.".
  Discovery wheels_known "From the Smith-Master's journal: 'The Gearworks I set so: iron at rest, salt awake, bone at rest. The painters in the Hall of Doctrine have it otherwise, at my order. Let a thief who trusts pictures be scalded.'" {
    Source master_journal "the Smith-Master's journal" at master_cell readable by party.
  }
  Discovery ardath_known "From the Smith-Master's journal: 'Ardath stays with the false heart. He has asked to. He says someone must keep the lie, so that nobody looks for the truth. If you come to him, say the doctrine, and he will know you for ours.'" {
    Source master_journal_end "the last leaves of the Smith-Master's journal" at master_cell readable by party.
  }
  Kind smith_token "the Smith-Master's hammer, grey iron no longer than a hand" is treasure worth 0 weighing 1.
  Item master_hammer "the Smith-Master's little hammer" is smith_token at master_cell.
  Observe gate_teaches at delving_gate when true "WHAT WAKES, KILLS. WHAT KILLS, WAKES." teaches doctrine_known.

  // The Dream-Hollows.
  Observe hmouth_scene at hollow_mouth when true "A soft dark. The walls are not stone here; they give a little under the hand, and are warm. Somewhere below, you can smell hay and summer.".
  Observe field_scene at dream_field when true "A meadow, inside the mountain, under a sky. The sky is too close: you could throw a stone into the clouds. Sheep graze, and do not cast shadows. A shepherd boy sleeps against a stone with his crook across his knees. The meadow is Thrume's dream, and the grass wets your boots all the same.".
  Person dream_boy "the dreamed shepherd" at dream_field {
    Role "a boy asleep against a stone". Ancestry human. Peaceable.
    Seen when dreamt(viewer).
  }
  Topic dream_boy_talk with dream_boy "Wake the dreamed shepherd" when true once {
    Says "The boy opens his eyes. They are the colour of red salt. 'He was happy here,' he says. 'Before. The sky was close and the grass was warm and we walked.' He looks up the meadow, to where the grass ends in grey, like ash. 'They eat it,' he says. 'From the edges. Every night there is less of it.' He shuts his eyes again.".
    On discuss { Assert knows(actor, court_feeds). }
  }
  Discovery court_feeds "Something is eating Thrume's dreams from the edges.".
  Observe field_edge at dream_field when true "At the top of the meadow the grass goes grey, then greyer, then simply stops, as if it had been eaten.".
  Observe hunger_scene at hunger_shaft when true "A shaft going down into cold. Frost on the walls, in a warm mountain. Long scratches in the frost, too far apart for any hand.".
  Person hunger "the hunger" at hunger_shaft {
    Role "a long, starved shape in the frost: Thrume's dream of a hard winter". Species wendigo. Level 9.
    Temperament ambush.
    Warns "Something unfolds out of the frost at the bottom of the shaft, too tall and too thin, and turns a face toward you that is mostly teeth.".
    Comes "The hunger comes up the shaft at you on its long arms, faster than anything that thin should move.".
  }
  Observe approach_scene at hush_approach when true "The way goes on down through the soft dark, and the sound goes out of the world. Your footsteps make none. Your voice, when you try it, makes none. Ahead there is a grey light, and a city.".

  Objective stop_cutting when cutting(brannoc) and knows(party, salt_is_blood) "Every day Brannoc cuts, Thrume stirs. The Margravine's seal would stop him, or the mountain itself.".
  Objective go_down when knows(party, hush_named) and not freed(col) "The sleepers from the Red Lantern were taken down to Hush.".
}
data/adventures/what-tessary-owes/city.k:
Module tessary "What Tessary Owes" {
  Description "Tessary on the Ossel, a city of salt and paper built on piles over a drowned Aenean city, in the fortnight before the Feast of Settlement: the Long Muster has come home from eleven years' war, and some of its soldiers are walking into the sea.".

  // ── The delta ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // The Ossel comes down out of the marsh country in a dozen channels and meets the sea at Tessary. The city stands on
  // piles and fill along the last ridge of dry ground; north of its Tidewall is the outer basin, where the old city lies
  // under the water and comes up at the ebb.
  Place ossel "the Ossel delta" is region within imbar.
  Place saltmarsh "the salt-marsh" is wilderness within ossel at 0, 1.
  Place tessary "Tessary" is settlement within ossel at 1, 1.
  Place lowtide "Lowtide" is site within ossel at 1, 0.
  Initially Assert terrain(ossel, marsh).

  Place causeway_end "the Causeway, at the marsh's edge" is room within saltmarsh at 0, 0.
  Passage causeway "the Causeway" is causeway between causeway_end and landgate taking 1 hour.
  Observe causeway_scene at causeway_end when not dark() "The marsh road comes out of the reeds onto a causeway of fitted stone, older than the road, raised a man's height above the saltings. It runs straight for a league to a wall on a low ridge: Tessary, a long grey city with its back to the sea, a smoke of salt-boiling over its eastern end and the masts of its harbour standing up behind it like reeds. The tide is a sound you hear before you see it, a long breath on the far side of everything.".
  Observe causeway_night at causeway_end when dark() "The causeway runs out ahead of you into the dark, a pale stone line over black saltings. A league off, Tessary is a row of lamps along a ridge, and above the lamps, very faintly, the masts.".
  Observe causeway_carts at causeway_end when not dark() "Carts of peat and rushes are coming in ahead of you, and one going out, empty, with a soldier asleep in the back of it in a red coat gone brown.".

  // ── Tessary ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // Streets, on the city's own grid: the Tidewall and the Yard along the sea, the Lettered Quarter and the Terraces in
  // the middle, the Withies, the Landgate and Panhythe along the landward side.
  Place throat_head "the head of the Swatch Stair" is room within tessary at 0, 0 outdoors.
  Place tidewall "the Tidewall" is room within tessary at 1, 0 outdoors.
  Place legion_yard "the Legion Yard" is room within tessary at 2, 0 outdoors.
  Place tideline_steps "the Watersteps" is room within tessary at 0, 1 outdoors.
  Place scriveners_row "Scriveners' Row" is room within tessary at 1, 1 outdoors.
  Place terraces "the Terraces" is room within tessary at 2, 1 outdoors.
  Place withies "the Withies" is room within tessary at 0, 2 outdoors.
  Place landgate "the Landgate" is room within tessary at 1, 2 outdoors.
  Place saltgate "Panhythe" is room within tessary at 2, 2 outdoors.
  Place pans "the Pans" is room within tessary at 3, 2 outdoors.

  Passage withy_walk "the Withy boardwalk" is bridge between landgate and withies taking 5 minutes.
  Passage inkhorn_street "Inkhorn Street" is path between landgate and scriveners_row taking 5 minutes.
  Passage salt_street "the Salt Road" is path between landgate and saltgate taking 5 minutes.
  Passage pan_dykes "the pan-dykes" is path between saltgate and pans taking 10 minutes.
  Passage steps_walk "the boardwalk to the Steps" is bridge between withies and tideline_steps taking 5 minutes.
  Passage sea_lane "the sea-lane" is path between tideline_steps and throat_head taking 5 minutes.
  Passage wall_stair "the Wall Stair" is steps between scriveners_row and tidewall.
  Passage wall_walk "the wall-walk" is path between tidewall and throat_head taking 5 minutes.
  Passage yard_gate "the Yard gate" is gate between tidewall and legion_yard.
  Passage terrace_steps "the Terrace Steps" is steps between scriveners_row and terraces.
  Passage terrace_lane "the lane behind the Yard" is path between terraces and legion_yard taking 5 minutes.
  Passage salt_lane "Brine Lane" is path between terraces and saltgate taking 10 minutes.

  // The Landgate: where the Causeway comes in, and everyone who comes in reads the board.
  Observe landgate_scene at landgate when not dark() and not visitedBefore(landgate) "Inside the gate is a three-cornered square of trodden shell, loud with carts. A board on the gatehouse wall is shingled with bills, three deep: the Feast of Settlement, a fortnight hence; a reward for a stolen goose; rooms; a hiring hall in Panhythe that pays veterans by the day; the eel-fair postponed; a lecture at the Notaries' Hall on the Aenean subjunctive, admission one penny, discussion after. In the corner a little chapel to Saint Evenhand has a pair of brass scales over its door. Somebody has polished the scales.".
  Observe landgate_scene_again at landgate when not dark() and visitedBefore(landgate) "The Landgate's square: carts, the shingled bill-board, Saint Evenhand's polished scales over the chapel door.".
  Observe landgate_night at landgate when dark() "The square is empty but for a watchman with a lantern and a cat on the bill-board. The bills move a little in the wind off the sea.".
  Observe landgate_bunting at landgate when not dark() and not feastEve() and night(ossel) < 5 "Red bunting for the Muster's homecoming is still up over the gate, a week old and sagging. Under it a man with a bucket is pasting a new bill over the old: THE BOARD OF MOIETIES WILL HEAR THE QUESTION OF THE VETERANS' SETTLEMENT ON THE THIRTEENTH DAY, FROM TEN IN THE MORNING.".
  Observe landgate_bunting_down at landgate when not dark() and not feastEve() and night(ossel) >= 5 and not voted(ossel) "The homecoming bunting has come down, or blown down; a length of it is trodden into the shell by the gate. The bills on the board are four deep now, and nobody is pasting any more.".

  // The Withies: stilt houses over the backwater, where the rank and file came home to.
  Observe withies_scene at withies when not dark() and not visitedBefore(withies) "The Withies stand on piles over a backwater of the Ossel: tarred houses on stilts, joined by boardwalks that sway, every one with a ladder down to a boat and a row of eel-traps drying on the rail. Washing hangs between the houses. So do red coats, a good many of them, airing. A girl is mending a net with a soldier's bayonet.".
  Observe withies_scene_again at withies when not dark() and visitedBefore(withies) "The Withies: swaying boardwalks, eel-traps on the rails, red coats airing between the stilt-houses.".
  Observe withies_night at withies when dark() "Lamps in the stilt-houses, and the backwater black under the boardwalks. Somebody is singing a marching song very slowly in one of the houses, and stops, and starts again.".

  // The Watersteps: the sea-stair at the end of the Withies, where the called leave their boots.
  Observe steps_scene at tideline_steps when not visitedBefore(tideline_steps) "Broad stone steps go down from the end of the boardwalk into the sea, twenty of them above the high-water mark and nobody knows how many below. They are older than everything around them. The stone is cut with something like letters, worn to dimples.".
  Observe steps_scene_again at tideline_steps when visitedBefore(tideline_steps) "The Watersteps, old and worn to dimples, going down into the sea.".
  Observe steps_boots at tideline_steps when bootsOnSteps(ossel) "On the top step stand pairs of boots, set neatly side by side, toes to the water, the way a soldier sets them by his cot. Nobody has moved them. Nobody will.".
  Observe steps_water at tideline_steps when lowWater() "The sea has drawn back a long way, and the steps go down and down into weed and wet sand, and out there in the grey, very low, the tops of walls.".
  Observe steps_full at tideline_steps when not lowWater() "The tide is in, green and slopping at the seventh step. A child is fishing off the bottom rail with a bent pin and no line.".

  // The Swatch Stair, and the Swatch: the channel the basin drains by.
  Observe throat_scene at throat_head when not visitedBefore(throat_head) "At the west end of the Tidewall the wall-walk breaks off at a stair that goes straight down the face of the wall into the basin. A chain hangs beside it for a handrail. Below, the Swatch: the one deep channel through which the outer basin fills and empties twice a day, with a noise like a slow mill.".
  Observe throat_scene_again at throat_head when visitedBefore(throat_head) "The head of the Swatch Stair, where the wall-walk breaks off, with its chain for a handrail and the Swatch milling below.".
  Observe throat_low_dark at throat_head when lowWater() and dark() "The basin is out. Below the stair the drowned city lies in the dark, and you can hear it draining, a thousand small waters running off stone. Far out, one lantern moves, low to the ground, and stops, and moves again.".
  Observe throat_low at throat_head when lowWater() and not dark() "The basin is out. Below the stair lies a city of wet stone: roofs, a colonnade, the dome of something, streets with weed lying flat in them like combed hair. Figures are moving down there, small, bent over, looking for things.".

  // The Tidewall: the barrage on Aenean footings.
  Observe tidewall_scene at tidewall when not visitedBefore(tidewall) "The Tidewall runs the whole length of the city between the houses and the sea, broad enough on top for two carts. Its lower courses are not the city's: great blocks, tight-fitted, with no mortar, carved at intervals with a pair of scales. The city built its wall on top of someone else's. On the landward side a stair goes down into the Lettered Quarter.".
  Observe tidewall_scene_again at tidewall when visitedBefore(tidewall) "The Tidewall, broad as a road, with the sea on one side and the city on the other.".
  Observe tidewall_day at tidewall when not dark() "Fishermen sit along the parapet with lines, and the smell of vinegar comes down the wall from a brazier on a barrow.".

  // The Legion Yard and the Oath Stone.
  Observe yard_scene at legion_yard when true "A parade ground of beaten shell inside the Tidewall, ringed with empty barracks. In the middle of it, on a plinth, stands the Oath Stone: a slab of black stone as tall as a man, salvaged from the drowned city two hundred years ago, smooth as a hearthstone where eleven thousand hands have been laid on it. Cut into its face, small and fine, are lines that are not writing and not ornament: ruled lines, like a ledger's.".
  Observe yard_empty at legion_yard when not feastEve() and night(ossel) < 5 "The barracks doors stand open. The Muster was paid off a week ago and told to go home, and the Yard has nobody in it but the gulls.".
  Observe yard_empty_later at legion_yard when not feastEve() and night(ossel) >= 5 "The barracks doors stand open on nothing. Somebody has chalked a name on one of them, and somebody else has washed it off, and the gulls have the Yard.".

  // Scriveners' Row, the heart of the Lettered Quarter.
  Observe row_scene at scriveners_row when not dark() and not visitedBefore(scriveners_row) "The Lettered Quarter smells of wet pulp and lamp-black. The Row is all stalls: scriveners at sloped desks under awnings, writing letters for those who cannot, contracts for those who can, and arguing with both. Reed-paper hangs drying from every balcony like laundry. At the north end, the Office of Seals has a queue outside it that goes round the corner and, people say, has not been shorter in living memory. Opposite, the Exchequer is a narrow house with barred windows and one lit lamp.".
  Observe row_scene_again at scriveners_row when not dark() and visitedBefore(scriveners_row) "Scriveners' Row: stalls and sloped desks, paper drying on the balconies, the queue at the Office of Seals, the Exchequer's one lit window.".
  Observe row_night at scriveners_row when dark() "The stalls are shuttered and the paper taken in. The Office of Seals is dark. In the Exchequer one window is lit, as it is every night.".

  // The Terraces: the old houses, above the flood line.
  Observe terraces_scene at terraces when not visitedBefore(terraces) "The ground rises here to the city's one hill, and the old houses of the Moieties stand along it in terraces of walled garden (three of them claim descent from the Aenean magistrates, and have the portraits to prove it, all painted in the last century), with salt-bitten fig trees and doors painted the colours of their families. The Council House has a portico and a bell. Further along, a tall house with a soldier on its steps is where the city keeps the King of Hethra, courteously, until his ransom is paid.".
  Observe terraces_scene_again at terraces when visitedBefore(terraces) "The Terraces: walled gardens, painted doors, the Council House with its bell, the King's lodging with its soldier on the steps.".

  // Panhythe and the Pans.
  Observe saltgate_scene at saltgate when not dark() and not visitedBefore(saltgate) "Panhythe is the city's working end: carts, sacks, a smell of brine and peat-smoke. Factor Sault's countinghouse has a brass plate polished like a mirror. Beside it her warehouses run back to the water, and next to those is a long hall with its doors open and a crowd of men in old red coats outside it, waiting to be picked for the day's work.".
  Observe saltgate_scene_again at saltgate when not dark() and visitedBefore(saltgate) "Panhythe: carts and brine, the Factor's brass plate, red coats waiting outside the hiring hall.".
  Observe saltgate_night at saltgate when dark() "The countinghouse is shuttered. A lantern burns over the warehouse door, and under it two of Factor Sault's men are playing dice on a salt-sack.".
  Observe pans_scene at pans when true "East of the city the salt-pans run out into the marsh in a chequer of shallow squares, white at the edges, each with its sluice. Women in wooden pattens rake the crust. Steam rises from the boiling-houses. The tide that comes through the Swatch runs out here too, under the dykes, and what it carries out it leaves: weed, timber, a shoe.".

  // ── Buildings ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Place teazle_house "Nan Teazle's house" is building within tessary.
  Place teazle_room "Nan Teazle's house" is room within teazle_house at 0, 0.
  Passage teazle_ladder "the Teazles' ladder" is steps between withies and teazle_room.
  Observe teazle_scene at teazle_room when true "One room on stilts, and everything in it hung up out of the damp: eel-traps, nets, a smoked side of something, a soldier's coat on a peg that nobody wears. A brazier, a bed in a cupboard, a shelf of crockery and on it, in a frame, a recruiting bill eleven years old: LAND AND A PENSION FOR EVERY MAN WHO COMES HOME.".

  Place drum_house "the Muffled Drum" is building within tessary.
  Place drum_taproom "the Muffled Drum's taproom" is room within drum_house at 0, 0.
  Passage drum_door "the Drum's door" is door between withies and drum_taproom.
  Observe drum_scene at drum_taproom when not visitedBefore(drum_taproom) "A low taproom built out over the backwater, so that the floor moves a little when the tide is running. Soldiers' coats on every peg, soldiers' boots under every bench. Over the bar hangs a regimental drum with a black cloth tied over its head.".
  Observe drum_scene_again at drum_taproom when visitedBefore(drum_taproom) "The Muffled Drum: soldiers' coats on every peg, the floor shifting a little with the tide.".
  Observe drum_noise at drum_taproom when not dark() "It is loud in here, and the noise is the noise of men who have nothing to do: dice, an argument about pay, someone telling the story of Sedge Ford for the hundredth time and getting it wrong.".

  Place countinghouse "Factor Sault's countinghouse" is building within tessary.
  Place sault_office "Factor Sault's countinghouse" is room within countinghouse at 0, 0.
  Passage countinghouse_door "the countinghouse door" is door between saltgate and sault_office.
  Observe office_scene at sault_office when true "Clerks at high desks, a stove, a wall of pigeonholes, a salt-crusted map of the delta with the Factor's ships pinned on it. A cone of hot eels in paper sits on the ledgers, half eaten.".

  Place warehouse "Sault's warehouse" is building within tessary.
  Place warehouse_floor "the warehouse floor" is room within warehouse at 0, 0.
  Place warehouse_below "the warehouse cellars" is level within warehouse.
  Place cistern "the old cistern" is room within warehouse_below at 0, 0.
  Passage warehouse_door "the warehouse door" is door between saltgate and warehouse_floor.
  Passage cistern_stair "the cistern stair" is stair between warehouse_floor and cistern.
  Observe warehouse_scene at warehouse_floor when true "Salt in sacks to the rafters, stacked in blocks with lanes between, and a smell that dries your mouth. At the back, behind a stack that has not been moved in a long while, a trap-door with a ring.".
  Observe cistern_scene at cistern when true "A vaulted cistern, older than the warehouse over it, dry now, its floor scuffed into paths. A tunnel goes off northward, low and wet, toward the sea; there are lamp-hooks along it.".

  Place muster_house "Sault's Muster" is building within tessary.
  Place muster_hall "Sault's Muster" is room within muster_house at 0, 0.
  Passage muster_door "the hiring hall door" is doorway between saltgate and muster_hall.
  Person hiring_clerk "Sault's hiring clerk" at muster_hall {
    Role "who keeps the book of the Factor's Muster". Ancestry human. Peaceable. Pronouns he. Manner stoic.
    Greets "The hiring clerk has the Muster's book open at a clean line and the pen already wet, and holds it a half-inch off the paper for exactly as long as it takes him to decide that you are not a soldier. 'Not enlisting,' he says, and sets the pen down with something like regret. 'Then you are here for the wages. Everyone is here for the wages.'".
    Greets again "The hiring clerk finds the clean line again without looking, and the pen comes up out of the ink on its own. 'Still not enlisting,' he says, 'I see. There is a second book, for those who have come to ask where the first one went.'".
  }
  Topic clerk_book with hiring_clerk "Ask the hiring clerk who is on the Factor's books" when true once {
    Says "'Forty-one this morning,' says the clerk, and turns the book round so you can see. The names go down in a clear round hand, and six of them have been struck through with a ruler, neatly, each with a date beside it in the margin, each date a spring ebb. 'The Factor says strike them through when they go,' he says. 'Not out. Through. So the name can still be read.'".
  }
  Topic clerk_night with hiring_clerk "Ask the hiring clerk about the night work" when true once {
    Says "'Carrying,' says the clerk. 'Down under the warehouse at the ebb, for Mistress Slake. Double pay, and the Factor's word nobody asks.' He dips his pen. 'I don't write those in the book. I'm not asked to.'".
  }
  Observe muster_scene at muster_hall when true "A long bare hall with benches down both walls and a table at the end where a clerk writes names in a book. Over the table, in new paint: SAULT'S MUSTER. A DAY'S PAY FOR A DAY'S WORK. NO MAN TURNED AWAY WHO WORE THE COAT.".

  Place seals_house "the Office of Seals" is building within tessary.
  Place seals_hall "the hall of the Office of Seals" is room within seals_house at 0, 0.
  Place seals_inner "the Keeper's room" is room within seals_house at 1, 0.
  Passage seals_door "the Office door" is doorway between scriveners_row and seals_hall.
  Passage seals_grille "the Keeper's grille" is door between seals_hall and seals_inner.
  Observe seals_scene at seals_hall when true "A high hall with a rail across it and the queue folded back and forth along the rail like a rope in a locker. Everybody in it is holding a document. At the head of the queue, behind a grille, a door.".
  Observe inner_scene at seals_inner when true "A small panelled room with no window. On a table under a glass bell lies the Great Seal of Tessary, a disc of dark bronze the size of a plate, and beside it the wax, the ribbon, the ledger of everything ever sealed.".

  Place exchequer_house "the Exchequer" is building within tessary.
  Place exchequer_room "the Treasurer's room" is room within exchequer_house at 0, 0.
  Passage exchequer_door "the Exchequer door" is door between scriveners_row and exchequer_room.
  Observe exchequer_scene at exchequer_room when true "A narrow room at the top of a narrow house, all ledgers. The strongboxes along the wall stand open, and are empty, and have been for some time; dust lies inside them. A cot behind a screen. A bottle.".

  Place pounce_house "Pounce's stall" is building within tessary.
  Place pounce_stall "Pounce's stall" is room within pounce_house at 0, 0.
  Passage pounce_door "Pounce's door" is doorway between scriveners_row and pounce_stall.
  Observe pounce_scene at pounce_stall when true "A scrivener's shop the width of a cupboard, with a sloped desk in the window, pens in a jar of sand, and every surface papered with drafts. A notice: CONTRACTS DRAWN. CONTRACTS READ. CONTRACTS EXPLAINED (EXTRA).".

  Place council_house "the Council House" is building within tessary.
  Place council_chamber "the council chamber" is room within council_house at 0, 0.
  Passage council_door "the Council House door" is door between terraces and council_chamber.
  Observe chamber_empty at council_chamber when not inSession() and not voted(ossel) "Between sittings nobody is here but a boy filling the inkwells at each seat. A bill by the door gives the next: the thirteenth day, from ten in the morning, the question of the Veterans' Settlement, the public bench open.".
  Observe chamber_scene at council_chamber when true "A round chamber with a ring of carved seats, one for each Moiety: Salt, Paper, Rope, Eel, Ship, and the three old houses. On the wall behind the Speaker's chair hangs the war's banner, and under it a painting of the Kneeling at Sedge Ford, in which King Amaury of Hethra is very small and the Tessarine captain very large.".

  Place kings_house "the King's lodging" is building within tessary.
  Place kings_rooms "the King's rooms" is room within kings_house at 0, 0.
  Passage kings_door "the King's door" is door between terraces and kings_rooms.
  Observe kings_scene at kings_rooms when true "Good rooms, kept by a city that wants to be seen to keep its prisoner well: a fire, books, a window on the sea. A board of Hethran draughts is set out by the fire with a game half played. The guard on the steps sits outside the door, not in.".

  Place marrable_house "Councillor Marrable's house" is building within tessary.
  Place marrable_room "Councillor Marrable's house" is room within marrable_house at 0, 0.
  Passage marrable_door "Marrable's door" is door between terraces and marrable_room.
  Observe marrable_scene at marrable_room when true "A small house of the Terraces, the smallest, with no garden to speak of. Inside it is a soldier's house: everything square, everything put away. On a table, a pile of papers weighted down with a pistol-butt with no pistol.".

  Place chapel_house "Saint Evenhand's" is building within tessary.
  Place chapel "Saint Evenhand's chapel" is room within chapel_house at 0, 0.
  Passage chapel_door "the chapel door" is doorway between landgate and chapel.
  Observe chapel_scene at chapel when true "A whitewashed chapel the size of a boat-shed. Over the altar the saint is painted holding a pair of scales level, very carefully, with the face of someone who has been asked to hold them for a long time. Votive weights hang on cords from the ceiling, brass and lead and stone, hundreds of them, each the weight of a promise someone wanted kept.".

  Place chandlery_house "Pitch's chandlery" is building within tessary.
  Place chandlery "Pitch's chandlery" is room within chandlery_house at 0, 0.
  Passage chandlery_door "the chandlery door" is door between landgate and chandlery.
  Observe chandlery_scene at chandlery when true "Rope in coils from the rafters like sleeping eels, and the whole shop smells of tar and wet hemp. Lanterns, oilskins, hooks, rations in tins; and behind a counter worn into a dip by elbows, a chandler in a leather apron, splicing something and not looking at his hands.".
}
data/adventures/what-tessary-owes/growth:
Module tessary "What Tessary Owes" {
  // ── What a company grows by here ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // Experience for what is found out and what is done, not only for what is fought: a thorough fortnight in Tessary is
  // worth two levels or a little more to someone who came in at the first.
  Milestone m_held "found out where the called go" worth 250 when knows(party, held_alive).
  Milestone m_terms "read the terms of the War Note" worth 300 when knows(party, note_terms).
  Milestone m_weight "worked out what would pay the War Note" worth 250 when knows(party, promise_weight).
  Milestone m_compact "read the drowned city's compact" worth 300 when knows(party, compact_read).
  Milestone m_letter "read the Factor's letter" worth 300 when knows(party, sault_bid).
  Milestone m_below "went down into the Strongrooms" worth 400 when at(party, antechamber).
  Milestone m_designed "found out why the War Note was drawn" worth 600 when knows(party, note_designed).
  Milestone m_goose "brought Mistress Plum home" worth 150 when plumHome(ossel).
  Milestone m_durrance "kept Sergeant Durrance from the sea" worth 400 when night(ossel) >= 8 and not heldNow(durrance) and (heldBack(durrance) or durranceSpared(ossel) or durranceKnowsFraud(durrance)).
  Milestone m_riot "kept the Muster off the Terraces" worth 300 when riotCalmed(ossel) or night(ossel) >= 13 and fiskTurned(fisk) and not riotHappened(ossel).
  Milestone m_vote "saw the Settlement carried" worth 500 when votePassed(ossel).
  Milestone m_seal "kept the Great Seal" worth 250 when sealRaidFoiled(ossel) or sealTried(ossel) and not sealStolen(ossel) and night(ossel) >= 14.
  Milestone m_marrable "kept Councillor Marrable from harm" worth 200 when attemptFoiled(ossel) or attemptMade(ossel) and not marrableHurt(ossel) and night(ossel) >= 11.
  Milestone m_quire "gave the Treasurer a reason to live" worth 300 when quireHope(quire).
  Milestone m_deeds "put the deeds into the hands of the called" worth 800 when deedsDelivered(ossel).
  Milestone m_release "stood with the Muster at the Oath Stone" worth 800 when released(ossel).
  Milestone m_assembly "testified before the Assembly of the Scruples" worth 700 when assemblyHeard(ossel).
  Milestone m_warden "made the Factor a Warden" worth 500 when saultWarden(ossel).
  Milestone m_davy "brought Davy Teazle home" worth 300 when cameHome(davy) and at(davy, teazle_room).
}
Module gaunt "A Winter in Carth" {
  Description "Gaunt, a walled cathedral city on a white plain three days before the Fast, where every fault has its price in penance and any penance may be borne by another; the fell road that comes down to it past a farm keeping, for wages, a vigil of no fire; and a barefoot man walking to his trial.".

  // ── The country ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // A flat white country, the Levels, with the fell road coming up out of the south over Carth Fell and down to the
  // city; the city in three rings, the warmest in the middle; and to the east the Bishop's Wood, whose firewood is
  // licensed.
  Place gaunt_country "the Levels of Gaunt" is region within imbar.
  Initially Assert terrain(gaunt_country, frost).
  Place fell_road "the fell road" is wilderness within gaunt_country at 0, 3.
  Place carth "Carth" is site within gaunt_country at 0, 2.
  Place levels "the Levels" is wilderness within gaunt_country at 0, 1.
  Place gaunt_town "Gaunt" is settlement within gaunt_country at 0, 0.
  Place bishops_wood "the Bishop's Wood" is wilderness within gaunt_country at 1, 1.

  // ── Buildings ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Place reeve_house "the vigil-house at the Cross" is building within fell_road.
  Place carth_house "the house at Carth" is building within carth.
  Place minster "the Minster" is building within gaunt_town.
  Place penitentiary_house "the Penitentiary" is building within gaunt_town.
  Place schools_house "the Divinity Schools" is building within gaunt_town.
  Place lodge_house "the masons' lodge" is building within gaunt_town.
  Place gaol_house "the Consistory gaol" is building within gaunt_town.
  Place exchange_house "the Wood Exchange" is building within gaunt_town.
  Place lamb_house "the Fat Lamb" is building within gaunt_town.
  Place pickersgill_house "Mistress Pickersgill's house" is building within gaunt_town.
  Place brewhouse "Dinsdale's brewhouse" is building within gaunt_town.
  Place drapery "Sowerby's drapery" is building within gaunt_town.
  Place bakery "Mother Sugden's bakehouse" is building within gaunt_town.
  Place hall_house "the Barefoot Hall" is building within gaunt_town.
  Place heb_house "Heb's cellar" is building within gaunt_town.

  // ── Rooms ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // The fell road, from the march northward
  Place cross_road "the road at the Penitent's Cross" is room within fell_road at 0, 3 outdoors.
  Place reeve_hut "the vigil-house" is room within reeve_house at 1, 3 indoors.
  Place proxy_stone "the Proxy's Stone" is room within fell_road at 0, 2 outdoors.
  Place drove_fork "the Drove Fork" is room within fell_road at 0, 1 outdoors.
  Place drovers_way "the drovers' road" is room within fell_road at 1, 1 outdoors.
  Place fell_top "the top of Carth Fell" is room within fell_road at 0, 0 outdoors.
  // Carth: a longhouse, house and byre under one roof, with the yard before it
  Place carth_yard "the yard at Carth" is room within carth at 0, 1 outdoors.
  Place house_place "the house-place at Carth" is room within carth_house at 0, 0 indoors.
  Place carth_byre "the byre at Carth" is room within carth_house at 1, 0 indoors.
  // The Levels, and the wood
  Place levels_road "the road across the Levels" is room within levels at 0, 0 outdoors.
  Place wood_edge "the edge of the Bishop's Wood" is room within bishops_wood at 0, 0 outdoors.
  Place deadfall "the deadfall in the Bishop's Wood" is room within bishops_wood at 1, 0 outdoors.
  // Gaunt: the Close (the inner ring)
  Place penitentiary "the Penitentiary" is room within penitentiary_house at 0, 0 indoors.
  Place chapter_house "the Chapter House" is room within minster at 1, 0 indoors.
  Place minster_nave "the nave of the Minster" is room within minster at 2, 0 indoors.
  Place gaol_cell "the Consistory gaol" is room within gaol_house at 3, 0 indoors.
  Place schools "the Divinity Schools" is room within schools_house at 0, 1 indoors.
  Place close_green "the Close of Saint Oswy" is room within gaunt_town at 1, 1 outdoors.
  Place minster_porch "the Minster porch" is room within minster at 2, 1 outdoors.
  Place tower_foot "the foot of the north tower" is room within gaunt_town at 3, 1 outdoors.
  Place masons_lodge "the masons' lodge" is room within lodge_house at 4, 1 indoors.
  // The Middle Town (the second ring)
  Place wood_exchange "the Wood Exchange" is room within exchange_house at 0, 2 indoors.
  Place close_gate_street "the Bearer's Steps, before the Close Gate" is room within gaunt_town at 2, 2 outdoors.
  Place gaol_lane "Gaol Lane, under the gaol window" is room within gaunt_town at 3, 2 outdoors.
  Place the_stand "the Stand" is room within gaunt_town at 1, 3 outdoors.
  Place shambles "the Long Shambles" is room within gaunt_town at 2, 3 outdoors.
  Place fat_lamb "the Fat Lamb" is room within lamb_house at 3, 3 indoors.
  Place tanners_row "Tanners' Row" is room within gaunt_town at 4, 3 outdoors.
  Place pickersgill_parlour "Mistress Pickersgill's parlour" is room within pickersgill_house at 5, 3 indoors.
  Place dinsdale_brewhouse "Dinsdale's brewhouse" is room within brewhouse at 1, 4 indoors.
  Place sowerby_shop "Sowerby's drapery" is room within drapery at 4, 4 indoors.
  Place bakehouse "Mother Sugden's bakehouse" is room within bakery at 5, 4 indoors.
  // The Row (the outer ring, between the old wall and the new)
  Place gate_of_ash "the Gate of Ash" is room within gaunt_town at 0, 5 outdoors.
  Place barefoot_hall "the Barefoot Hall" is room within hall_house at 1, 5 indoors.
  Place row_lane "the Row" is room within gaunt_town at 2, 5 outdoors.
  Place heb_cellar "Heb's cellar" is room within heb_house at 3, 5 underground.
  Place row_ditch "the Row ditch" is room within gaunt_town at 2, 6 outdoors.
  Place fell_gate "the Fell Gate" is room within gaunt_town at 2, 7 outdoors.
  // Where what is not yet anywhere waits.
  Place limbo "nowhere" is room within levels at 9, 9.

  // Carth's house has had no flame in it for twenty-three nights.
  Initially Assert unlit(house_place). Initially Assert unlit(carth_byre).

  Initially Assert countryRoom(cross_road). Initially Assert countryRoom(reeve_hut). Initially Assert countryRoom(proxy_stone).
  Initially Assert countryRoom(drove_fork). Initially Assert countryRoom(drovers_way). Initially Assert countryRoom(fell_top).
  Initially Assert countryRoom(carth_yard). Initially Assert countryRoom(house_place). Initially Assert countryRoom(carth_byre).
  Initially Assert countryRoom(levels_road). Initially Assert countryRoom(wood_edge). Initially Assert countryRoom(deadfall). Initially Assert countryRoom(fold).
  Initially Assert countryRoom(penitentiary). Initially Assert countryRoom(chapter_house). Initially Assert countryRoom(minster_nave).
  Initially Assert countryRoom(gaol_cell). Initially Assert countryRoom(schools). Initially Assert countryRoom(close_green).
  Initially Assert countryRoom(minster_porch). Initially Assert countryRoom(tower_foot). Initially Assert countryRoom(masons_lodge).
  Initially Assert countryRoom(wood_exchange). Initially Assert countryRoom(close_gate_street).
  Initially Assert countryRoom(gaol_lane). Initially Assert countryRoom(the_stand). Initially Assert countryRoom(shambles).
  Initially Assert countryRoom(fat_lamb). Initially Assert countryRoom(tanners_row). Initially Assert countryRoom(pickersgill_parlour).
  Initially Assert countryRoom(dinsdale_brewhouse). Initially Assert countryRoom(sowerby_shop). Initially Assert countryRoom(bakehouse).
  Initially Assert countryRoom(gate_of_ash). Initially Assert countryRoom(barefoot_hall). Initially Assert countryRoom(row_lane).
  Initially Assert countryRoom(heb_cellar). Initially Assert countryRoom(row_ditch). Initially Assert countryRoom(fell_gate).
  Initially Assert townRoom(penitentiary). Initially Assert townRoom(chapter_house). Initially Assert townRoom(minster_nave).
  Initially Assert townRoom(gaol_cell). Initially Assert townRoom(schools). Initially Assert townRoom(close_green).
  Initially Assert townRoom(minster_porch). Initially Assert townRoom(tower_foot). Initially Assert townRoom(masons_lodge).
  Initially Assert townRoom(wood_exchange). Initially Assert townRoom(close_gate_street).
  Initially Assert townRoom(gaol_lane). Initially Assert townRoom(the_stand). Initially Assert townRoom(shambles).
  Initially Assert townRoom(fat_lamb). Initially Assert townRoom(tanners_row). Initially Assert townRoom(pickersgill_parlour).
  Initially Assert townRoom(dinsdale_brewhouse). Initially Assert townRoom(sowerby_shop). Initially Assert townRoom(bakehouse).
  Initially Assert townRoom(gate_of_ash). Initially Assert townRoom(barefoot_hall). Initially Assert townRoom(row_lane).
  Initially Assert townRoom(heb_cellar). Initially Assert townRoom(row_ditch). Initially Assert townRoom(fell_gate).
  Relation closeRoom(place).
  Initially Assert closeRoom(penitentiary). Initially Assert closeRoom(chapter_house). Initially Assert closeRoom(minster_nave).
  Initially Assert closeRoom(gaol_cell). Initially Assert closeRoom(schools). Initially Assert closeRoom(close_green).
  Initially Assert closeRoom(minster_porch). Initially Assert closeRoom(tower_foot). Initially Assert closeRoom(masons_lodge).
  Query inClose() means at(party, ?p) and closeRoom(?p).
  Query atCarth() means at(party, carth_yard) or at(party, house_place) or at(party, carth_byre).
  Query inHouse() means at(party, house_place) or at(party, carth_byre).

  // ── The weather ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // The snow has been coming all morning, and comes in earnest when the company first stands on the top of the fell; it
  // shuts the fell until seven the next morning at the earliest.
  Thing fell_snow "the snow on Carth Fell" at fell_top is scenery {
    State waiting "The sky to the north is the colour of a slate roof, and lower than it should be.".
    State falling "The snow is coming sideways off the top of the fell, so thick that the road is gone a yard in front of you. Below, in a fold of the hill to the left, there is a darker shape in the white, and a smell of cattle: a farm.".
    State lying "Snow lies on Carth Fell to the knee, blue in the hollows, with the road a long dent in it going down.".
  }
  Initially Assert state(fell_snow, waiting).
  // The sky the way across country is told under (data/voice/journey.json): frozen, and snowing while the snow falls.
  Thing sky "the sky over the Levels" at limbo is scenery {
    State weather_freezing "Hard frost.".
    State weather_snowy "Snow.".
  }
  Initially Assert state(sky, weather_freezing).
  Rule sky_snows when snowing() and state(sky, weather_freezing) { Assert state(sky, weather_snowy). }
  Rule sky_clears when not snowing() and state(sky, weather_snowy) { Assert state(sky, weather_freezing). }
  Measure snowFrom(place).
  Rule snow_comes at fell_top when at(party, fell_top) and state(fell_snow, waiting)
    says "The snow comes in all at once, the way it does on a fell: one moment the road and the long white country beyond it, and the next nothing, a roaring grey, and your own breath going away sideways. You cannot see the road down." {
    Assert state(fell_snow, falling). Set snowFrom(fell_top) to watch(clock). }
  Query snowing() means state(fell_snow, falling).
  Rule snow_stops when snowing() and hour(clock) == 7 and watch(clock) >= snowFrom(fell_top) + 36 { Assert state(fell_snow, lying). }
