data/imbar/planes.kyr:
Module canon "Imbar and the planes" {
  Description "What every world holds before any adventure is in it: Imbar, the planes beyond it and the threshold of each, the College of Dun Rì and its House of Doors, and what may befall them.".

  // ── Imbar ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // The material world. Every country is a region of it; the canon builds nothing in it, since there is no one place
  // in Imbar that every door from elsewhere opens on.
  Place imbar "Imbar" is plane.

  // ── The inner planes ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // Each plane is one region and, in it, a threshold, where doors from elsewhere arrive and an author's own places
  // join it. Its courts, cities and wastes are whatever authors set in it, each a region of its own within the plane.
  // A plane's law is written here, for every author, and holds in every place within it: the Fire's and the Air's so
  // far (the Grand Tour's Hour Court and its winds); Earth and Water carry none yet.
  Entity plane_fire: law "the law of the Fire". Entity plane_air: law "the law of the Air".
  Place inner_fire "the Plane of Fire" is plane.
  Place inner_fire_region "the Plane of Fire" is region within inner_fire elsewhere.
  Place inner_fire_land "the threshold of Fire" is wilderness within inner_fire_region at 0, 0 elsewhere.
  Place inner_fire_threshold "the threshold of Fire" is room within inner_fire_land at 0, 0.
  Observe inner_fire_seen at inner_fire_threshold when true "Heat and light on every side, and nothing in sight that is not burning.".

  Place inner_air "the Plane of Air" is plane.
  Place inner_air_region "the Plane of Air" is region within inner_air elsewhere.
  Place inner_air_land "the threshold of Air" is wilderness within inner_air_region at 0, 0 elsewhere.
  Place inner_air_threshold "the threshold of Air" is room within inner_air_land at 0, 0.
  Observe inner_air_seen at inner_air_threshold when true "Open sky on every side, below as well as above, and a wind that does not stop.".

  Place inner_earth "the Plane of Earth" is plane.
  Place inner_earth_region "the Plane of Earth" is region within inner_earth elsewhere.
  Place inner_earth_land "the threshold of Earth" is wilderness within inner_earth_region at 0, 0 elsewhere.
  Place inner_earth_threshold "the threshold of Earth" is room within inner_earth_land at 0, 0.
  Observe inner_earth_seen at inner_earth_threshold when true "Rock on every side, close and dark, and the weight of it pressing in.".

  // The Court of Waters is a place of the plane that authors name before any has built it (the merfolk's
  // grandmothers left it, the Grand Tour says): a part of the plane of its own, beside the threshold.
  Place inner_water "the Plane of Water" is plane.
  Place inner_water_region "the Plane of Water" is region within inner_water elsewhere.
  Place inner_water_land "the threshold of Water" is wilderness within inner_water_region at 0, 0 elsewhere.
  Place inner_water_threshold "the threshold of Water" is room within inner_water_land at 0, 0.
  Place court_of_waters "the Court of Waters" is wilderness within inner_water_region at 1, 0 elsewhere.
  Observe inner_water_seen at inner_water_threshold when true "Water on every side, green and deep, with no surface above it.".

  Place inner_positive "the Positive Energy Plane" is plane.
  Place inner_positive_region "the Positive Energy Plane" is region within inner_positive elsewhere.
  Place inner_positive_land "the threshold of the Positive Plane" is wilderness within inner_positive_region at 0, 0 elsewhere.
  Place inner_positive_threshold "the threshold of the Positive Plane" is room within inner_positive_land at 0, 0.
  Observe inner_positive_seen at inner_positive_threshold when true "Light on every side with nothing that casts it, and a warmth that runs into you like strength.".

  Place inner_negative "the Negative Energy Plane" is plane.
  Place inner_negative_region "the Negative Energy Plane" is region within inner_negative elsewhere.
  Place inner_negative_land "the threshold of the Negative Plane" is wilderness within inner_negative_region at 0, 0 elsewhere.
  Place inner_negative_threshold "the threshold of the Negative Plane" is room within inner_negative_land at 0, 0.
  Observe inner_negative_seen at inner_negative_threshold when true "Dark on every side, and a cold that draws the warmth out of you.".
  Initially Assert law(inner_fire, plane_fire). Initially Assert law(inner_air, plane_air).
}
data/kits/raider-hold/cave/hold.kyr:
Module cave_hold "A cave hold" {
  Description "A cave in a hillside behind a screen of brambles: a mouth where the watch sits, a smoky cavern, a ledge up a notched log where the chief sleeps, a pit for captives, a dry side-cave for plunder, a crack that looks out over the road, and a chimney that comes out on the hillside above.".
  Entity party: group "Your company".
  Place land "The region" is region.
  Place outside "The approach" is room.

  // Its rooms past the mouth are under the hill: painted from within, and no sky told (the side-cave had been shown as
  // a sunlit cave-mouth seen from outside, by torchlight: Mission 20's reference tour).
  Place lair "the cave" is site within land.
  Place mouth "the cave mouth" is room within lair at 0, 1.
  Place cavern "the smoky cavern" is room within lair at 1, 1 underground.
  Place ledge "the high ledge" is room within lair at 1, 0 underground.
  Place pit "the captives' pit" is room within lair at 2, 1 underground.
  Place cache "a dry side-cave" is room within lair at 2, 0 underground.
  Place crack "the spy-crack" is room within lair at 0, 0 underground.
  Place hillside "the hillside above the cave" is room within lair at 1, 2.
  Initially Assert unlit(pit). Initially Assert unlit(cache). Initially Assert unlit(crack). Initially Assert indoors(cavern).

  Passage brambles "the brambles across the cave mouth" is passage between outside and mouth taking 10 minutes.
  Passage cave_throat "the throat of the cave" is passage between mouth and cavern.
  Passage notched_log "a notched log" is climb between cavern and ledge.
  Passage pit_rope "a rope ladder down into the pit" is climb between cavern and pit.
  Passage cache_crawl "a crawl into the side-cave" is crawl between cavern and cache.
  Passage crack_way "a cleft in the wall" is passage between mouth and crack.
  Passage chimney "the chimney" is climb between cavern and hillside taking 30 minutes hidden until backway_known needing climbing or rope.
  Passage hill_path "a goat-track down the hillside" is path between hillside and outside taking 20 minutes.

  Observe mouth_scene at mouth when true "The cave mouth, behind its brambles: a fire-blackened ceiling, gnawed bones, and a stool for whoever keeps watch.".
  Observe cavern_scene at cavern when true "A big smoky cavern with a fire in the middle and the smoke going up into a black hole in the roof. A notched log leans against the wall up to a ledge; a rope ladder hangs into a pit.".
  Observe ledge_scene at ledge when true "A ledge high in the cavern wall, out of the smoke: a bed of skins, and a chest.".
  Observe pit_scene at pit when true "A pit with sheer sides and a muck floor. You would not climb out of it without the rope.".
  Observe cache_scene at cache when true "A dry side-cave stacked with plunder.".
  Observe crack_scene at crack when true "A cleft in the rock that looks straight down on the road below.".
  Observe hillside_scene at hillside when true "The open hillside above the cave. Smoke comes out of a hole among the rocks.".
  // The smoke-hole the cavern speaks of is a thing to look at, not only a place to search (PT-08: the drover's ruts,
  // and the holds' smoke-hole and draught, were found only by searching).
  Thing smoke_hole "the smoke-hole in the roof" at cavern {
    Tries looking.
    State still "The smoke goes up the hole in the roof as if it had somewhere to go.".
  }
  Observe smoke_hole_up near smoke_hole when tried(smoke_hole, looking) "Up the smoke-hole there is daylight, and a crack worn by hands and feet: a chimney, and someone climbs it." teaches backway_known.

  Thing chest "a chest on the ledge" at ledge {
    Holds.
    State locked closed "A chest stands on the ledge, locked.".
    State open "The chest on the ledge stands open.".
    Change pick "Pick the chest's lock" from locked to open needing lockwork.
    Change smash "Break the chest open" from locked to open needing brawn.
  }
  Thing heap "a heap of plunder" at cache {
    Holds.
  }
  Discovery backway_known "The smoke-hole in the cave's roof is a chimney that comes out on the hillside above; a climber could go up or down it." {
    Found by searching cavern "Up the smoke-hole there is daylight, and a crack worn by hands and feet: a chimney, and someone climbs it.".
    Found by searching outside with woodcraft "Up the hillside, smoke comes out of a hole among the rocks, and there is a goat-track to it.".
    Found by searching hillside "Among the rocks the smoke comes out of a crack you could climb down, with a rope or a good grip.".
  }
  Goal false.
}
data/kits/raider-hold/ringfort/hold.kyr:
Module ringfort "A ring-fort" {
  Description "An old earth ring on a rise: a ditch and a bank topped with stakes, a stake gate, a yard, a long hall roofed with turf over a store-pit, a lookout mound, and a souterrain from the pit that comes out among the gorse below.".
  Entity party: group "Your company".
  Place land "The region" is region.
  Place outside "The approach" is room.

  Place fort "the ring-fort" is site within land.
  Place under "Under the hall" is level within fort.
  Place ditch "the ditch under the bank" is room within fort at 0, 2.
  Place yard "the yard inside the ring" is room within fort at 1, 1.
  Place hall "the long hall" is room within fort at 1, 0.
  Place den "the far end of the hall" is room within fort at 2, 0.
  Place pens "the pens" is room within fort at 2, 1.
  Place mound "the lookout mound" is room within fort at 0, 1.
  Place gorse "a hole among the gorse" is room within fort at 2, 2.
  Place pit "the store-pit" is room within under at 1, 0.
  Initially Assert unlit(pit). Initially Assert indoors(hall). Initially Assert indoors(den).

  Passage bank_path "the path up the bank" is path between outside and ditch taking 20 minutes.
  Passage stake_gate "the stake gate" is gate between ditch and yard.
  Passage hall_door "the hall door" is door between yard and hall.
  Passage hide_curtain "a curtain of hides" is doorway between hall and den.
  Passage pen_hurdle "the pen hurdle" is gate between yard and pens.
  Passage mound_steps "the steps up the mound" is steps between yard and mound.
  Passage pit_ladder "the ladder down into the store-pit" is ladder between hall and pit.
  Passage souterrain "the souterrain" is crawl between pit and gorse taking 30 minutes hidden until backway_known.
  Passage gorse_path "a way out through the gorse" is path between gorse and outside taking 20 minutes hidden until backway_known.

  Observe ditch_scene at ditch when true "A deep ditch under a bank of turf, and along the top of the bank a fence of stakes as tall as a man. Things hang from the stakes and turn in the wind: bones, rags, a doll.".
  Observe yard_scene at yard when true "The yard inside the ring is trodden mud, with a long turf-roofed hall, a hurdle pen, and a mound with a lookout's seat on top.".
  Observe hall_scene at hall when true "The long hall is low and smoky, with a fire in a pit down the middle and sleeping-straw along the walls. A ladder goes down through a hole in the floor at one end.".
  Observe den_scene at den when true "The far end of the hall, behind hides: a heap of fleeces like a throne, and a chest.".
  Observe pens_scene at pens when true "Hurdle pens, mucky, full of somebody else's sheep.".
  Observe mound_scene at mound when true "From the top of the mound you can see the road for miles, and anyone on it.".
  Observe pit_scene at pit when true "A pit under the hall, roofed with timber, full of plunder. In the far wall a low stone-lined passage goes off into the dark, and a draught comes down it that smells of gorse.".
  Observe gorse_scene at gorse when true "A hole among the gorse below the ring, half hidden, worn smooth at the lip.".

  Thing chest "a chest under the fleeces" at den {
    Holds.
    State locked closed "The chest under the fleeces is locked, with a padlock as big as a fist.".
    State open "The chest under the fleeces stands open.".
    Change pick "Pick the chest's padlock" from locked to open needing lockwork.
    Change smash "Smash the chest's padlock" from locked to open needing brawn.
  }
  Thing heap "a heap of plunder" at pit {
    Holds.
  }
  // The draught the pit speaks of is a thing to look at, not only a place to search (PT-08).
  Thing draught "the draught from the far wall" at pit {
    Tries looking.
    State still "A draught comes down the low passage in the far wall, smelling of gorse.".
  }
  Observe draught_found near draught when tried(draught, looking) "The draught comes from a souterrain, a stone-lined crawl going off under the bank." teaches backway_known.
  Discovery backway_known "A passage leaves the ring-fort's store-pit and comes out in a hole among the gorse below the ring." {
    Found by searching pit "The draught comes from a souterrain, a stone-lined crawl going off under the bank.".
    Found by searching outside with woodcraft "Among the gorse below the ring, a hole worn smooth at the lip, and the smell of smoke coming out of it.".
  }
  Goal false.
}

data/kits/word/naming/naming.kyr:
Module kit_naming "What the place is called" {
  Description "Those who tell where a placement is call the place by its name, as people who live by it do: knowing what they say, the company knows the name, and the place is no longer only what it looks like to a stranger (a smooth doorway in a crag, until someone says what it is called). Learned in the same moment as the word, so the word is told with the name in it. The composer installs this where the place a kit claims is known by its look until a fact names it (see KitWord).".
  Entity party: group "Your company".
  Entity word: fact "What people say of it".
  Entity name: fact "What the place is called".
  Observe named near party when knows(party, word) and not knows(party, name) "Hereabouts the place has a name, and whoever speaks of it uses it." teaches name.
  Goal false.
}

Module arcology "The Numbered House" {
  Description "A house older than the Empire stands in a hillside beside the old road, and counts everything that passes under its arches. Its keepers are bookkeepers that have outlived their books. Be counted, or go round; learn what weighs, what rings and what hums; and decide what the town below is to be told.".

data/situations/bound-howe/situation.kyr:
Module bound_howe "The Bound Howe" {
  Description "A king's howe on a wind-scoured ridge, half robbed already. A salvage crew digs in its lee for the gold; an old woman keeps the dead's rest with a hearth and a tally-stick; the shire-reeve's clerk wants the king's torc; and beneath the Barrow-Kin's floor lies what the Kin were put there to keep. Go in prepared, go in quietly, go in by the robbers' shaft, or seal it, and decide what the country pays.".
  Entity party: group "Your company".
  Place land "The ridge country" is region.
  Place outside "The foot of the ridge" is room.
  Place town "The town below" is settlement.
  Place green "The green" is room.
  Place taproom "The taproom" is room.
  Place shrine "The shrine" is room.
  Place first_taproom "The first town's taproom" is room.
  Entity first_keeper: group "The first town's innkeeper".
  Entity keeper: group "The innkeeper".
  Entity priest: group "The priest".

  // ---- What Deem draws for the country (templates.json): how the howe was left, what the ridge's weather is, and which
  // of the three flutes is the king's. The king, the captain, the warden, the clerk and the surgeon are named from it.
  Kind fatekind. Entity fate_sealed: fatekind "sealed". Entity fate_broken: fatekind "broken".
  Kind howe_airkind. Entity air_mist: howe_airkind "mist". Entity air_rain: howe_airkind "rain". Entity air_wind: howe_airkind "wind".
  Entity air_snow: howe_airkind "snow". Entity air_dust: howe_airkind "dust".
  Relation fate(place, fatekind). Relation airs(place, howe_airkind). Relation kinflute(entity).

  // ---- The ridge, the howe and what lies under it.
  Place hearth "the warden's hearth" is room within ridge at 0, 0 outdoors.
  Place fold "the old sheepfold" is room within ridge at 0, 1 outdoors.
  Place lookout "the salvagers' lookout" is room within ridge at 1, 0 outdoors.
  Place rise "the heather rise" is room within ridge at 2, 0 outdoors.
  Place lee "the camp in the lee" is room within ridge at 3, 0 outdoors.
  Place trench "the robbers' trench" is room within ridge at 4, 0 outdoors.
  Place shaft_head "the head of the robbers' shaft" is room within ridge at 4, 1 outdoors.
  Place ring "the ring of standing stones" is room within ridge at 2, 2 outdoors.
  Place survey "the survey cairn" is room within ridge at 3, 2 outdoors.
  Place howe "The king-howe" is site within land at 3, 1.
  Place ridge "The Long Ridge" is site within land at 3, 3.
  Place front "Before the howe" is level within howe.
  Place inner "The howe" is level within howe.
  Place below "Under the howe" is level within howe.
  Place forecourt "the forecourt of the howe" is room within front at 0, 0 outdoors.
  Place gallery "the gallery of kings" is room within inner at 1, 0 underground.
  Place horses "the horse-hall" is room within inner at 1, 1 underground.
  Place harness "the harness-store" is room within inner at 0, 1 underground.
  Place bench "the riders' bench" is room within inner at 2, 1 underground.
  Place flutes "the chamber of flutes" is room within inner at 2, 0 underground.
  Place throne "the high chamber" is room within inner at 3, 0 underground.
  Place behind "the room behind the seat" is room within inner at 3, 1 underground.
  Place shaft_foot "the foot of the robbers' shaft" is room within below at 0, 0 underground.
  Place dig "the robbers' dig-camp" is room within below at 1, 0 underground.
  Place sump "the sump" is room within below at 2, 0 underground.
  Place ancient "the older chamber" is room within below at 3, 0 underground.
  Place well "the listening well" is room within below at 3, 1 underground.
  Initially Assert unlit(gallery). Initially Assert unlit(horses). Initially Assert unlit(harness). Initially Assert unlit(bench).
  Initially Assert unlit(flutes). Initially Assert unlit(throne). Initially Assert unlit(behind). Initially Assert unlit(shaft_foot).
  Initially Assert unlit(dig). Initially Assert unlit(sump). Initially Assert unlit(ancient). Initially Assert unlit(well).
  Initially Assert restful(hearth). Initially Assert restful(harness).

  Passage steep "the steep path" is path between outside and lookout taking 30 minutes.
  Passage sheepway "the sheep-way" is track between outside and fold taking 40 minutes.
  Passage fold_up "the gap in the fold wall" is path between fold and rise taking 20 minutes.
  Passage post_on "the path past the lookout" is path between lookout and rise taking 10 minutes.
  Passage goat_track "the goat-track" is path between rise and hearth taking 20 minutes.
  Passage camp_way "the way down to the lee" is path between rise and lee taking 10 minutes.
  Passage ring_way "the path to the stones" is path between rise and ring taking 20 minutes.
  Passage lee_ring "the track from the camp to the stones" is path between lee and ring taking 20 minutes.
  Passage cutting "the cutting" is path between lee and trench taking 10 minutes.
  Passage trench_floor "the trench floor" is path between trench and shaft_head taking 10 minutes.
  Passage shaft "the robbers' shaft" is shaft between shaft_head and shaft_foot needing rope or climbing.
  Passage flank "the path along the flank" is path between ring and survey taking 20 minutes.
  Passage sunwise "the sunwise way round the stones" is path between ring and forecourt taking 20 minutes.
  Passage across "the straight way across the grey grass" is path between ring and forecourt taking 5 minutes.
  Passage door "the howe's door" is door between forecourt and gallery.
  Passage stalls "the stall-arch" is arch between gallery and horses.
  Passage store_door "the harness-store door" is door between horses and harness.
  Passage riders_arch "the riders' recess" is arch between horses and bench.
  Passage gallery_end "the gallery's end" is passage between gallery and flutes.
  Passage steps "the steps up" is steps between flutes and throne.
  Passage behind_way "the way behind the seat" is crawl between throne and behind.
  Passage foot_way "the robbers' crawl" is crawl between shaft_foot and dig.
  Passage robbers_hole "the robbers' hole" is crawl between dig and harness.
  Passage drift "the low drift" is crawl between dig and sump.
  Passage sump_way "the flooded passage" is crawl between sump and ancient.
  Passage well_steps "the well-steps" is steps between ancient and well.
  Passage first_stair "the first folk's stair" is stair between ancient and behind hidden until plan_whole.

  // ---- Hazards.
  Hazard ridge_cold "The weather on the ridge" means "Deal (1d8) cold damage to ally unless constitution save against (15).".
  Hazard grey_chill "The grey grass" means "Deal (2d6) cold damage to ally unless constitution save against (16). Apply weakened to ally for 6 hours unless constitution save against (16).".
  Hazard spoil_slide "A slide of spoil" means "Deal (2d6) physical damage to ally unless dexterity save against (13).".
  Hazard tread_pit "The middle tread" means "Deal (2d6) physical damage to ally unless dexterity save against (13).".
  Hazard shriek "The wrong flute" means "Deal (1d8) physical damage to ally unless constitution save against (13).".
  Hazard foul_air "The foul air" means "Deal (1d6) poison damage to ally unless constitution save against (13).".
  Hazard black_water "Black water" means "Deal (1d6) physical damage to ally unless constitution save against (12).".
  Hazard mouth_pull "The voice from the well" means "Deal (1d6) physical damage to ally unless wisdom save against (13).".

  // ---- Things that are carried, and the plan that is put together from three finds.
  Kind howe_salt_kind "a twist of salt" is gear worth 1 weighing 1 described "Coarse grey salt in a twist of cloth. Shepherds lay it down for the sheep; the Barrow-Kin's dead, it is said, will not cross it.".
  Entity barley: good "sack of barley".
  Kind kin_torc "a torc of the Barrow-Kin" is treasure worth 120 weighing 5 described "A twisted collar of iron and bronze as thick as a wrist. The Kin buried their lesser kings in them.".
  Kind king_torc "the king's torc" is treasure worth 600 weighing 14 described "A torc of braided gold and iron wire, heavy as a child. Cut into its terminal is a line of the Kin's marks: WHILE THIS IS WORN THE BOUND IS KEPT.".
  Kind sketch_kind "a salvager's sketch of the workings" is document teaching sketch_read described "A scrap of hide scratched with a nail: a shaft, a low drift, a drowned working, and a line of dots that goes in under the howe.".
  Kind howe_tally_kind "the warden's tally-stick" is document teaching tally_read described "An ash stick notched in threes down its length, with three signs burnt into the head and one ringed.".
  Kind plate_kind "a bronze plate from the survey cairn" is document teaching plate_read described "A thumb-thick plate of bronze, squared and flat, cut with a wheel and a wing and a ladder of fine lines. It fits no measure you know.".
  Kind banner_kind "a bound-banner of horsehair" is treasure worth 40 weighing 1 described "A bunch of plaited horsehair on an ash staff, the Kin's sign of a mount fed and a rider at rest.".
  Discovery sketch_read "The diggers' sketch: a shaft down from the trench, a robbers' hole up into the harness-store, a low drift beyond the dig-camp with foul air in it, and a sump beyond that, drowned.".
  Discovery tally_read "The warden's tally-stick: three signs for the three flutes in the chamber of flutes, and the ringed one is the king's.".
  Discovery plate_read "The bronze plate's ladder of lines, laid against the howe, gives the depth of a chamber far below the Kin's floor, and a stair that goes up from it.".
  Item salt_lick "a twist of salt" is howe_salt_kind at fold.
  Item lesser_a "a torc of the Barrow-Kin" is kin_torc at harness.
  Item lesser_b "a torc of the Barrow-Kin" is kin_torc at gallery.
  Item bronze_bits "a bridle of green bronze" is bronze_bearing at harness.
  Item king_torc_item "the king's torc" is king_torc at throne.
  Item sketch "a salvager's sketch of the workings" is sketch_kind at dig.
  Item tally "the warden's tally-stick" is howe_tally_kind nowhere.
  Item plate "a bronze plate from the survey cairn" is plate_kind nowhere.
  Item crew_rope "a coil of robbers' rope" is rope at shaft_head.

  // ---- Persons.
  Person king "Someone" at throne {
    Role "the last king of the Barrow-Kin". Species revenant. Level 13. Temperament territorial. Lair throne. Pronouns he.
    Warns "On the seat the king lifts his skull from his chest. The dark in his eyes finds you. He stands, and the sword comes up off his knees, and the air in the high chamber turns as cold as the inside of a bell.".
  }
  Initially Set encounterXp(king) to 600.
  Person sworn "the king's sworn" at throne {
    Role "two of the king's sworn men". Species revenant. Numbers 2. Level 6. Temperament obedient. Lair throne.
    Warns "Two figures in rotted mail stand from either side of the seat, where you took them for part of the stone, and set their spears.".
  }
  Initially Set encounterXp(sworn) to 300.
  Initially Assert serves(sworn, king).
  Person household "the household of the king" at gallery {
    Role "the king's dead household". Species ghoul. Numbers 3. Level 3. Temperament obedient. Lair gallery.
    Warns "Along the gallery the seated dead turn their heads toward you, one after another, all the way to the end. The nearest rises from its niche with a sound like a sack of knuckles.".
  }
  Initially Set encounterXp(household) to 150.
  Initially Assert serves(household, king).
  Person mounts "the king's dead horses" at horses {
    Role "the king's mounts, picketed in bone and bronze". Species horse. Undead skeletal. Numbers 3. Level 4. Temperament territorial. Lair horses.
    State starved "Three horses stand picketed along the hall in full harness, nothing left of them but bone and the green bronze of their bits. Their long heads have turned toward the door. Before each is an empty manger, and they are pawing at the stone.".
    State fed "The dead horses stand quiet at their mangers, their heads lowered over the barley. Their jaws do not move. The bells on the pickets hang still.".
    State down "Three heaps of horse-bones lie in their harness along the hall, and the bells on the pickets are still.".
    Warns "As you come in, the three dead horses lift their heads together. The bells on their pickets stir, and the nearest sets its forefoot on the stone and drags it back, once, empty trough before it, as a horse does that has been left without.".
    Change feed "Pour barley into the empty mangers" from starved to fed consuming barley.
  }
  Initially Set encounterXp(mounts) to 200.
  Rule mounts_fed when state(mounts, fed) and not tolerates(mounts, party) { Assert tolerates(mounts, party). }
  Person riders "the king's riders" at bench {
    Role "the king's two riders". Species revenant. Numbers 2. Level 6. Temperament ambush. Lair bench.
    Warns "On the bench the two dead riders sit up together, as men do who have been woken by a trumpet and know what it means. Their spears come down.".
  }
  Initially Set encounterXp(riders) to 300.

  Person watchers "the salvagers' watch" at lookout {
    Role "two of the Spade-Company, on the hill's knuckle". Ancestry human. Calling warrior. Level 3. Numbers 2. Temperament territorial. Lair lookout.
    Warns "Two people in patched leather rise from behind the lookout wall, one with a crossbow resting on the stones and one with a horn at her belt. 'That's far enough,' says the one with the horn. 'You're on the Spade-Company's hill. Say what you've come for, or get down off it.'".
  }
  Initially Set encounterXp(watchers) to 100.
  Person crew "the Spade-Company's hands" at lee {
    Role "four diggers of the Spade-Company". Ancestry human. Calling warrior. Level 3. Numbers 4. Temperament territorial. Lair lee.
    Warns "Spades go down all along the camp as the diggers straighten. 'Hold,' says someone, and four hands in canvas and iron caps move between you and the trench, not drawing yet. They are looking over your shoulder for who else is with you.".
  }
  Initially Set encounterXp(crew) to 200.
  Initially Assert breaks(crew).
  Person captain "Someone" at lee {
    Role "the captain of the Spade-Company". Ancestry human. Level 4. Temperament territorial. Lair lee. Pronouns she.
    Warns "The captain comes out of the biggest tent with a ledger under her arm and does not put it down. 'Company,' she says, to your face and to the hands behind her, 'what do you want? Because the licence I hold says nobody digs here but us, and it says it in the shire-reeve's own hand.'".
  }
  Initially Set encounterXp(captain) to 250.
  Initially Assert serves(crew, captain). Initially Assert serves(watchers, captain). Initially Assert serves(captain, clerk).
  Person surgeon "Someone" at lee {
    Role "the camp's cook and surgeon". Ancestry human. Peaceable. Pronouns he.
    Sells rations for 2 coin from 8.
    Sells torch for 1 coin from 8.
    Sells lamp_oil for 2 coin from 4.
    Sells rope for 2 coin from 3.
    Sells barley for 3 coin from 3.
    Sells howe_salt_kind for 1 coin from 4.
    Sells bandages for 1 coin from 4.
    Sells candle for 1 coin from 6.
    Sells shovel for 3 coin from 2.
    Sells iron_spikes for 1 coin from 6.
    Sells oil_flask for 3 coin from 3.
    Greets "The camp's cook and surgeon looks up from a pot with a bone spoon in one hand and a needle in the other. 'If it is blood you want stopped, sit. If it is anything else, I do not make the decisions.'".
  }
  Initially Assert serves(surgeon, captain).
  Person sentry "the pit sentry" at shaft_head {
    Role "a salvager on the shaft winch". Ancestry human. Calling warrior. Level 3. Temperament territorial. Lair shaft_head.
    Warns "The man on the winch stands up and puts his hand on the bell-cord. 'Not down there,' he says. 'Captain's orders. There's nothing down there but our dead, and we mean to keep it quiet.'".
  }
  Initially Set encounterXp(sentry) to 100.
  Initially Assert serves(sentry, captain).
  Person warden "Someone" at hearth {
    Role "the warden of the ridge". Ancestry human. Peaceable. Pronouns she.
    Greets "The old woman on the stone seat does not rise. 'I know why you have come,' she says. 'Everyone comes for the same reason, and goes away with a different one. Sit by the fire. The fire is the only thing on this ridge that has never lied.'".
  }
  Person clerk "Someone" at green {
    Role "the shire-reeve's clerk". Ancestry human. Peaceable. Pronouns he.
    Greets "The shire-reeve's clerk looks up from a writing-board and a stack of tallies. 'You are not here to pay the levy,' he says, 'so you must be here about the torc. Everyone is.'".
  }
  Person mouth "the Mouth" at well {
    Role "what lies in the well". Species mouther. Level 7. Temperament ambush. Lair well.
    State lurking "The water in the well-mouth is black and still, and listens.".
    State burned "A skin of burning oil lies on the water, and under it something vast turns over and sinks. The voices have stopped.".
    Change burn "Pour oil on the black water and set it alight" from lurking to burned needing lamp_oil consuming lamp_oil.
    Warns "The black water in the well-mouth shivers and folds, and a voice speaks out of it in a voice you know: your own, a little behind, saying the last thing you said. Then it laughs, in no voice at all.".
  }
  Initially Set encounterXp(mouth) to 500.
  Person drowned "the drowned crew" at sump {
    Role "robbers who drowned in the sump". Species zombie. Numbers 3. Level 3. Lair sump.
    Warns "The black water at the sump's edge moves where nothing is, and then three figures in rotted canvas and iron caps stand up out of it, streaming, and turn their faces to the light.".
  }
  Initially Set encounterXp(drowned) to 120.
  Person iron_caps "the iron-capped dead" at forecourt {
    Role "robbers the king's night left on the grass". Species zombie. Numbers 2. Level 2. Temperament ambush. Lair forecourt.
    Warns "Two figures that were lying face down in the grey grass get up without using their hands. They wear iron caps, and picks are still tied to their wrists.".
  }
  Initially Set encounterXp(iron_caps) to 80.
  Person last "the last of the Barrow-Kin" at behind {
    Role "a dozen of the Kin, lying together". Species spirit. Numbers 4. Level 3. Peaceable.
    Greets "Of the dozen on the floor, one lifts a hand from the one beside it, as a sleeper does when the door is opened a little. The hand lowers again.".
  }

  // ---- Weather on the steep path: a path that is easy in clear air, and an edge in the white.
  Thing weather "the weather on the steep path" on steep is scenery {
    State clear "The steep path climbs the ridge in the clear, a pale scar through heather and scree.".
    State brewing "Cloud is feeling its way down the ridge from the howe, in long grey strokes; the path is clear, for now.".
    State white dangerous "Cloud lies down on the steep path, white and wet. The path is a ledge of wet scree in it, and the drop beside it is not to be seen.".
    Hurts with ridge_cold when white then white.
  }
  Rule weather_brews when state(weather, clear) and dice(clock) <= 8 { Assert state(weather, brewing). }
  Rule weather_closes when state(weather, brewing) and dice(clock) <= 35 { Assert state(weather, white). }
  Rule weather_lifts when state(weather, white) and dice(clock) <= 20 { Assert state(weather, clear). }
  Observe weather_sign at outside as sign when state(weather, brewing) "Cloud has begun to come down the ridge from the howe in long grey strokes. The smoke from the lookout, which stood straight up, now lies along the hill." teaches weather_known.
  Discovery weather_known "A white-out comes down the steep path out of the howe's cloud, and the path is no place to be in it.".
  Observe air_mist at outside when airs(howe, air_mist) "A mist lies in the low ground below the ridge and thins as it climbs, so that the howe on the skyline appears and goes in it like something breathing.".
  Observe air_rain at outside when airs(howe, air_rain) "Rain has been on the ridge for an hour and is coming down the hill in grey sheets, and the howe stands under it, black on the skyline, unmoved.".
  Observe air_wind at outside when airs(howe, air_wind) "The wind on the ridge is steady and cold and smells of rock. It has combed the grass on the howe flat in one direction.".
  Observe air_snow at outside when airs(howe, air_snow) "Snow lies in the lee of every wall and none on the howe, which stands black and bare on the skyline as if the cold went round it.".
  Observe air_dust at outside when airs(howe, air_dust) "Dust moves along the ridge in sheets, and the howe stands up out of it, long and pale.".
  Observe foot_ridge at outside as feature when true "Above the mound a long ridge climbs to the east, bare and brown, and along its crest, three times the height of any mound below it, a great howe lies against the sky. This low one at your feet is a marker, set where the Barrow-Kin's land began.".
  Observe foot_smoke at outside as sign when true "Two columns of smoke stand on the ridge above you: one thick and black, from some digging on the near side, and one thin and white and steady, from higher ground to the north.".
  Observe foot_wall at outside when true "A drystone wall climbs the slope beside the mound, and the steep path goes up along it, a pale scar in the heather.".

  // ---- The lookout, the fold, and the cans.
  Observe lookout_scene at lookout when true "The lookout is a ring of dry stone on the ridge's knuckle with a roof of turf, and from it a person with a horn can see the steep path from foot to crest.".
  Observe lookout_view at lookout as feature when true "From here the whole western approach is open, the ring of stones black and small on the high ground and the howe long and grassed behind it. A line of smoke rises from the camp in the lee of the hill, to the south-east.".
  Observe watchers_there at lookout when able(watchers) and not tolerates(watchers, party) "The ground in front of the wall is trodden bare. Anyone coming up the steep path would be in plain view for half an hour.".
  Action pay_watch(actor: group, site: place) "Pay the watch four coin and give your name to the captain" {
    Requires able(actor) and at(actor, site) and at(watchers, site) and able(watchers) and not tolerates(watchers, actor) and quantity(actor, gold) >= 4.
    On success { Decrease quantity(actor, gold) by 4. Increase quantity(watchers, gold) by 4. Assert tolerates(watchers, actor). }
    Result "The one with the horn counts the coin into her palm without looking at it. 'Go by the post,' she says, 'and mind where you put your feet. The captain will want a word.'".
  }
  Topic watch_levy with watchers "Tell the watch you have come about the shire-reeve's levy" when knows(actor, levy_told) once {
    Says "The one with the crossbow looks at the one with the horn. 'The levy,' says the one with the horn. 'You're from the clerk, then.' She does not believe it, but she lowers the horn. 'Go down to the lee and say it to the captain. If it is a lie, she will know before you do.'".
    On discuss { Assert tolerates(watchers, actor). }
  }
  Thing cans "the line of tins across the gap" on fold_up {
    State strung blocking "Where the fold wall has fallen in, a gap leads up to the heather. Across it at ankle height runs a line of rusted tins, each with a pebble in it, strung from stake to stake on a thread of gut.".
    State cut "The line of tins hangs slack across the gap, the thread cut.".
    State rung "The tins lie scattered in the gap, where the line was torn down.".
    Change cut_line "Cut the thread, tin by tin" from strung to cut needing lockwork or trapwork.
    Tries looking, pushing.
  }
  Action step_over_cans(actor: group, site: place) "Lift your feet over the line of tins, one at a time" {
    Requires able(actor) and at(actor, site) and at(actor, fold) and state(cans, strung).
    Resolve check(actor, stealth, dc_fair).
    On success { Assert state(cans, cut). }
    On failure { Assert state(cans, rung). Assert alerted(). Retract at(watchers, lookout). Assert at(watchers, fold). }
    Result "You go over the line with the tins ticking against your boots, and the thread slackens behind you. Nothing sounds.".
    Otherwise "A toe finds the thread. The tins go off all at once, rattling away over the heather like a handful of thrown gravel, and from the knuckle of the hill a horn answers.".
  }
  Observe cans_seen at fold as sign noticed by woodcraft when state(cans, strung) "A line of rusted tins is strung across the gap in the wall above you, low, where it would take a foot. The grass beneath it is not trodden.".
  Observe cans_pole at fold as sign when tried(cans, pushing) and state(cans, strung) "The tins clatter as the pole touches the line, and the sound goes away over the heather like a handful of thrown gravel.".
  Rule cans_clatter when state(cans, strung) and at(party, rise) and not tolerates(watchers, party) and not alerted() says "Behind you the tins on the wall go off like a flock of birds. Over the heather a horn answers, once." { Assert alerted(). Assert state(cans, rung). Retract at(watchers, lookout). Assert at(watchers, rise). }
  Relation alerted().
  Observe fold_scene at fold when true "The fold is a ring of tumbled drystone in the lee of the ridge, grassed over inside, with a hay-rack of grey wood and a flat stone worn hollow by sheep's tongues. A track comes up the wall from the sheep-way.".
  Observe fold_salt at fold when true "A flat stone worn into a hollow by sheep holds the white crust of what they have licked from it: salt. Beside it lies a twist of the stuff in a cloth, left by a shepherd who did not come back for it.".

  // ---- The heather rise, the warden's hearth, and what she knows.
  Observe rise_scene at rise when true "The rise is a plain of heather and pale grass with the wind on it, the highest ground before the howe. Paths go off from it: north on a goat-track, down to the diggers' camp, and out toward the black stones of the ring.".
  Observe rise_howe at rise as feature when true "The howe lies a long bowshot to the east, three times the height of any mound you have seen, steep-sided and green. The grass on it does not move in the wind.".
  Observe hearth_scene at hearth when true "A turf hut stands in the hollow of the hill with a fire before it, and a goat tethered to a stake. The smoke is thin and white and goes straight up.".
  Observe hearth_ash at hearth when true "Around the hut a pale ring has been laid on the ground in salt, unbroken, and in every opening of the hut a bundle of iron nails is tied with red wool.".
  Topic warden_howe with warden "Ask {warden} about the howe" when true once {
    Says "'It is a king's,' says {warden}. 'The last king of the Kin: {king}. They laid him on his seat with his sword across his knees and set the stone behind him, and what they believed was this: that the dead keep the bounds of the land, and a people that has no barrows has no country. So the dead keep the bound. They do not like to be disturbed. I have kept a fire in sight of the door for forty years, so that they should remember there is a living kind that still does.'".
    On discuss { Assert knows(actor, warden_lore). }
  }
  Discovery warden_lore "The Kin held that the dead keep the bounds of the land. The warden keeps a fire in sight of the howe's door so the dead remember the living.".
  Topic warden_salvagers with warden "Ask {warden} about the people in the lee" when true once {
    Says "'The Spade-Company,' says {warden}, as another woman might say a plague of wasps. 'They hold the shire-reeve's licence and a bad conscience. They dug a trench into the king's flank for his gold and broke through into something under the howe that was not the king's at all, and eight of them went down after the gold and none came up. They have not been under since. They are afraid, and I do not blame them. But they are going to take the torc, and I do blame them for that.'".
  }
  Topic warden_torc with warden "Ask {warden} about the torc" when knows(actor, warden_lore) once {
    Says "'It is cut,' says {warden}. 'Read it, if you can read. While this is worn the bound is kept. It is the same word as the one on the stone behind the seat. The Kin were not fools, child. They knew the dead walk when the bound breaks. They put the torc on the king so there should be one thing in the howe worth stealing, and it should be the one thing that cannot be stolen without telling everyone for a hundred miles why they should have left it.'".
    On discuss { Assert knows(actor, torc_price). }
  }
  Discovery torc_price "While the king's torc is worn, the bound is kept. Taken, the dead walk.".
  Topic warden_other with warden "Ask {warden} whether anything else would meet the levy" when knows(actor, levy_told) and knows(actor, torc_price) once {
    Says "{warden} is quiet a while. 'The lesser kings wore torcs too,' she says. 'They lie in the harness-store and in the gallery's niches, the iron and bronze ones, three or four of them. They are heavier than they look. If the shire-reeve only wants metal, there is metal there. It would still be a theft. But it would be a theft that does not bring the dead down the lane.'".
    On discuss { Assert knows(actor, lesser_torc_known). }
  }
  Discovery lesser_torc_known "The lesser kings' torcs, in the harness-store and the gallery, would meet the levy as well as the king's, and would not break the bound.".
  Topic warden_greeting with warden "Ask {warden} how a living kin is greeted at the king's door" when knows(actor, warden_lore) and trusted(warden, actor) once {
    Says "'The lintel says whose house it is,' says {warden}. 'Say his name to the stone, and say that you come for the bound and not the gold, and the stone will hear it, because the Kin's stone was made to hear one thing. If your hands are too clean for a rite, say it anyway: the dead are not particular about what you are, only that you ask.'".
    On discuss { Assert knows(actor, kin_greeting). }
  }
  Discovery kin_greeting "At the king's door, to ask in his name for the bound's sake, and not for gold, is the greeting the Kin's stone was made to hear.".
  Action give_salt(actor: group, site: place) "Give {warden} a twist of salt for her ring" {
    Requires able(actor) and at(actor, site) and at(warden, site) and holding(actor, howe_salt_kind) and not trusted(warden, actor).
    On success { Spend howe_salt_kind from actor. Assert trusted(warden, actor). Give tally to actor. }
    Result "{warden} takes the twist in two fingers, smells it, and for the first time looks at you. 'Somebody has taught you something,' she says. She goes into the hut and comes back with an ash stick notched in threes. 'My mother's, and her mother's. Do not lose it. It is the only map there is.'".
  }
  Relation trusted(group, group).
  Topic warden_tally with warden "Ask {warden} what the tally-stick says" when trusted(warden, actor) and holding(actor, howe_tally_kind) once {
    Says "{warden} runs a thumbnail down the notches. 'It is the way down to the flutes, and what is in them. Three signs, and the one that is ringed. That is the flute the king played: the others are for the household and the horses, and if you play them the howe will answer you in the wrong voice. I cannot say which sign is the low and which the high. I never went in. But one of the three flutes is worn smooth by hands, and a hand knows.'".
  }
  Topic warden_mind with warden "Ask {warden} what she would have you do" when knows(actor, warden_lore) once {
    Says "'Nothing,' she says. 'I would have you leave it, and be thanked by nobody. But you are not going to, because someone has told you there is gold. So: take salt; take barley, for the horses are the first thing the Kin fed and the last thing they forgot; take rope, and a pole, and more light than you think. And when you come out, close the door behind you. A door left open is the most dangerous thing in the world.'".
  }

  // ---- The camp in the lee, the captain, and the trench.
  Observe lee_scene at lee when true "The camp is pitched in the lee of the howe's shoulder where the wind cannot reach it, a dozen canvas shelters round a fire-ring, with the spoil of a great cutting heaped to the south. A line of salt has been laid across every track in.".
  Observe lee_salt at lee as sign when true "Every path into the camp has a white line across it. Beyond it, the heather is bare in a half-ring, as if something comes down to it at night and goes no further.".
  Observe lee_ledger at lee when not tolerates(captain, party) and able(captain) "The captain stands with the ledger open on her forearm, ticking something off with a pencil.".
  Topic captain_ask with captain "Ask {captain} what the company is digging for" when true once {
    Says "'What do you think?' says {captain}. 'Gold. The king was buried with twenty horse-loads of it, if you believe the shepherds, and a torc you could pay a regiment with, if you believe the shire-reeve. The licence is ours. I will not pretend there isn't a price. But I'll tell you something free: I have lost eight hands under the hill, and nothing has paid for them yet.'".
    On discuss { Assert knows(actor, captain_lost). }
  }
  Discovery captain_lost "The Spade-Company lost eight hands under the howe, in the flooded works below the robbers' shaft, and has not been below since.".
  Action buy_leave(actor: group, site: place) "Pay {captain} twelve coin for the freedom of the camp" {
    Requires able(actor) and at(actor, site) and at(captain, site) and able(captain) and not tolerates(captain, actor) and quantity(actor, gold) >= 12.
    On success { Decrease quantity(actor, gold) by 12. Increase quantity(captain, gold) by 12. Assert tolerates(captain, actor). }
    Result "{captain} makes a mark in the ledger. 'Twelve,' she says. 'You are welcome in my camp and on my hill. You are not welcome to what we find. The winch is the sentry's, and the sentry is mine. Ask him nicely.'".
  }
  Action turn_captain(actor: group, site: place) "Tell {captain} what the torc will cost the country" {
    Speaker captain.
    Requires able(actor) and at(actor, site) and at(captain, site) and able(captain) and knows(actor, torc_price) and not turned(captain).
    Resolve check(actor, persuasion, dc_hard).
    On success { Assert tolerates(captain, actor). Assert turned(captain). Assert at(captain, taproom). Retract at(captain, site). }
    Result "{captain} is silent so long that the hands behind her stop pretending to dig. Then she shuts the ledger. 'The shire-reeve's licence,' she says, 'does not cover the dead walking down the lane to the town where my sister lives.' She calls the hands in, one at a time, by name, and gives each of them a coin from her own purse. By dusk the tents are down. 'I'll be in the taproom,' she says, 'if anyone wants to ask me about it.'".
    Otherwise "{captain} hears you out with her pencil still. 'A very fine story,' she says. 'Now say it to the shire-reeve, who pays for this.'".
  }
  Relation turned(group).
  Rule camp_welcome when tolerates(captain, party) and able(captain) { Assert tolerates(crew, party). Assert tolerates(watchers, party). Assert tolerates(sentry, party). Assert restful(lee). }
  Rule camp_broken when turned(captain) { Assert tolerates(crew, party). Assert tolerates(sentry, party). Assert tolerates(watchers, party). Assert restful(lee). Retract at(crew, lee). Assert at(crew, taproom). }
  Observe trench_scene at trench when true "The trench is a raw cutting driven into the howe's flank, twenty paces long and the height of two men, shored with split timber and sheared at the end into a slope of broken stone. Water seeps from the walls.".
  Thing props "the props of the trench" on trench_floor {
    State loose dangerous "Half the props along the trench floor are splintered and slewed over, and a lip of wet spoil hangs above them, ready to come down. Whoever is working here has plainly been working elsewhere.".
    State shored "The props have been wedged and spiked into line, and the spoil above them hangs quiet.".
    State slipped "The spoil has come down off the wall in a long tongue across the floor. What is left of the roof is hard as a ceiling.".
    Hurts with spoil_slide when loose then slipped.
    Change shore "Wedge the props and spike them back into line" from loose to shored needing iron_spikes.
    Change brace "Brace the leaning props with a pole and wedge them hard" from loose to shored needing pole.
    Tries pushing.
  }
  Observe props_sign at trench as sign when state(props, loose) "A fresh tongue of spoil lies at the foot of the trench wall, and the timber above it has been slewed sideways. A spade stands upright in it, as if it were put there as a marker.".
  Observe shaft_scene at shaft_head when true "The shaft is a round hole as wide as a cart, timbered at the lip and fitted with a winch and a boom. The winch drum is wound with a hundred feet of rope. A bell hangs on a cord from the boom to the camp.".
  Observe shaft_voices at shaft_head as sound when true "From the shaft, very faint, a voice calls up out of the dark: 'Rope! Drop the rope! Hob, are you there?' It calls again, always the same, and always a little higher in the throat.".
  Topic sentry_down with sentry "Ask {sentry} to let the company down the shaft" when tolerates(captain, actor) once {
    Says "'The captain says to,' says {sentry}. He turns the winch-handle once, and the boom swings out. 'Mind the voice. Down there it calls for Hob. Hob was my brother. If you find a man who answers to Hob, that's not Hob.'".
    On discuss { Assert tolerates(sentry, actor). }
  }

  // ---- The ring, the grey grass, the survey cairn.
  Observe ring_scene at ring when true "The ring stands on the shoulder of the ridge, fourteen stones taller than a man on a horse, grey and lichened and set in a circle that has not given a hand's breadth in all the years since. Inside it the grass is long and pale, and does not move in the wind.".
  Observe ring_bones at ring as sign when true "In the grey grass a few paces in, the bones of a mule lie in harness, its pack-saddle slumped beside it. The deer-track, trodden hard into the heather, goes the long way round the outside of the stones.".
  Thing grass "the grey grass inside the stones" on across {
    State quiet dangerous "The grass here is the grey of ashes, and the cold comes up out of it like a breath from a cellar. Nothing grazes on it. Your feet will leave marks that do not spring back.".
    Hurts with grey_chill when quiet then quiet.
    Tries looking, pushing.
  }
  Observe ring_caps at ring as sign when not dead(iron_caps) and not iron_caps_risen() "Beyond the stones, on the paving of the forecourt, two shapes in iron caps lie face down in the pale grass, as men lie who have been there a long time and meant to go on lying.".
  Observe grass_tried at ring as sign when tried(grass, looking) "Looking closely, you see that nothing lives in the grass: no beetle, no spider, no seed. The deer have kept the whole circuit of the stones trodden to dust, and not once put a hoof inside.".
  Observe survey_scene at survey when true "A squared block of dressed stone stands in the howe's flank where the turf has slumped away from it, set deep and level as no shepherd's cairn is. A groove has been chiselled into its top, and a ladder of fine lines runs down one face.".
  Thing cairn "the survey cairn" at survey {
    State sealed "A bronze plate is let into the block's face, green with age, cut with a wheel and a wing and a ladder of fine lines. Someone has tried to prise it out with a chisel and given up.".
    State plateless "The bronze plate has been prised out of the block's face, leaving a squared hollow.".
    Change prise "Prise the bronze plate out of the cairn" from sealed to plateless needing brawn or crowbar.
    Tries looking.
  }
  Observe cairn_wheel at survey as sign noticed by lore when state(cairn, sealed) "The wheel on the plate has a wing cut into its rim, and the ladder beside it measures something in units that are not yours. Whoever set it here set it before the Kin raised the howe over the place, or after: the howe's flank has slumped around it, and either could be so." teaches survey_known.
  Discovery survey_known "A stone of dressed work stands in the howe's flank, cut with a wheel and a wing and a ladder of lines. It is either far older than the Kin or far newer, and no one living can say which.".
  Rule plate_given when state(cairn, plateless) and not holding(party, plate_kind) and not plate_taken() { Give plate to party. Assert plate_taken(). }
  Relation plate_taken().

  // ---- The forecourt, the seal-stone, and the household.
  Observe forecourt_scene at forecourt when true "A forecourt paved with flat stones, open to the sky, walled by the horns of the howe's mound. The bones of oxen lie along the walls, where feasts were left for the dead. At the back, a door of three great stones: two uprights and a lintel, with a stone like a wheel standing in it.".
  Observe forecourt_lintel at forecourt when true "On the lintel, cut deep and filled with something dark, run the Barrow-Kin's marks. They say: HERE SITS {king}, AND THE KINGS BEFORE HIM. THE STONE KEEPS THEM. LET IT BE." teaches king_named.
  Discovery king_named "The howe is the seat of the last king of the Barrow-Kin, {king}, and of the kings before him.".
  Observe forecourt_quiet at forecourt as sign when able(household) and at(household, gallery) and state(seal, set) "Nothing grows in the cracks between the paving stones, and no bird has settled on the howe's grass. The air is as still as the inside of a jar.".
  Thing seal "the great seal-stone" on door {
    State set blocking "A round stone twice the height of a man fills the doorway, in a groove cut for it. Its face has been worn smooth by hands at shoulder height, and around the rim run the same marks as on the lintel. The groove's lip is scored where something has been pried at it, and given up on.".
    State rolled "The seal-stone stands rolled aside in its groove, and the dark of the howe breathes out past it, smelling of cold earth and old oil.".
    State forced "The seal-stone lies half out of its groove where it was heaved, a long white scar on the pavement behind it. The dark beyond smells of cold earth.".
    Change rite "Speak the rites of the dead at the seal-stone and ask, in the king's name, to be let in" from set to rolled needing rites.
    Change hail "Give the king's greeting to the seal-stone" from set to rolled after learning kin_greeting.
    Change roll "Put your shoulders to the seal-stone and heave it aside" from set to forced needing brawn.
    Change shut_rolled "Heave the seal-stone back into its groove" from rolled to set needing brawn.
    Change shut_forced "Heave the seal-stone back into its groove" from forced to set needing brawn.
    Tries pushing.
  }
  Rule seal_known_broken when fate(howe, fate_broken) and state(seal, set) and not seal_fate_applied() { Assert state(seal, forced). Assert seal_fate_applied(). }
  Relation seal_fate_applied().
  Rule seal_welcome when state(seal, rolled) and not tolerates(household, party) { Assert tolerates(household, party). }
  Rule seal_roused when state(seal, forced) and tolerates(household, party) and fate(howe, fate_sealed) { Retract tolerates(household, party). }
  Event seal_forced_noise at forecourt when state(seal, forced) and at(party, forecourt) and fate(howe, fate_sealed) and not forced_told() "As the stone grinds out of its groove, something inside the howe answers: a long dry sound, like the turning of many pages." then { Assert forced_told(). }
  Relation forced_told().
  Relation salted().
  Action salt_door(actor: group, site: place) "Lay a line of salt across the howe's door" {

    On success { Spend howe_salt_kind from actor. Assert salted(). }

  Rule household_out when dark() and not state(seal, set) and not salted() and at(household, gallery) and able(household) and not tolerates(household, party) { Retract at(household, gallery). Assert at(household, forecourt). }
  Rule household_in when not dark() and at(household, forecourt) and able(household) { Retract at(household, forecourt). Assert at(household, gallery). }
  Observe household_walks at forecourt as sign when at(household, forecourt) and able(household) "The dead household stands on the paving in the dark, swaying a little, as the dead do who are waiting for their orders.".
  Observe household_gone at forecourt as sign when not at(household, gallery) and not at(household, forecourt) and able(household) "The grass about the stones is trodden flat in a ring, as if something had walked round it all night.".
  Observe walks_trodden at ring as sign noticed by woodcraft when fate(howe, fate_broken) and state(seal, forced) "A path of bare, trodden earth goes round the outside of the stones and back, and the dew has not lifted it.   Rule iron_caps_up when dark() and at(party, forecourt) and not state(seal, set) and not iron_caps_risen() says "The dark has the weight of a hand laid on the back of the neck." { Assert iron_caps_risen(). }
  Relation iron_caps_risen().
  Observe caps_lie at forecourt as sign when not iron_caps_risen() and not dead(iron_caps) "Two figures lie face down in the pale grass at the foot of the wall, in iron caps, with picks tied to their wrists. They have lain there long enough for the grass to grow through them.".

  // ---- The gallery of kings.
  Observe gallery_scene at gallery when true "A long gallery of great stones roofed with greater. In niches along both walls the kings of the Barrow-Kin sit as they were set, their skulls bowed over their knees. The newest are nearest the door. The household of the last king sits among them.".
  Observe gallery_names at gallery as feature when true "Under each niche the name of the king who sits in it is cut in the Kin's marks, and the last name, nearest the door, is {king}'s." teaches king_named.
  Observe gallery_torcs at gallery when at(lesser_b, gallery) "In the third niche from the door a torc of iron and bronze hangs on the king's neck, tarnished, a smaller thing than you would expect.".
  Action answer_roll(actor: group, site: place) "Call the roll of kings into the open door, and answer it for the king" {
    Requires able(actor) and at(actor, site) and at(actor, forecourt) and not state(seal, set) and at(household, gallery) and able(household) and not tolerates(household, actor) and knows(actor, king_named).
    On success { Assert tolerates(household, actor). }
    Result "You stand in the door and say the king's name into the long dark, and then the names of the kings before him, one after another, as they are cut under their niches. Down the gallery the seated dead lower their faces, and are still.".
  }

  // ---- The horse-hall, the harness-store, and the riders.
  Observe horses_scene at horses when true "A low hall to one side of the gallery, longer than the gallery, with a stone manger along the whole of one wall.
