  Observe horses_bells at horses as sound when true "At each picket-post a small bronze bell hangs from a cord of plaited horsehair, stirring on the air from somewhere, almost silent, almost.".
  Observe store_scene at harness when true "A narrow room off the horse-hall where the harness is kept, hung in rows from pegs: bridles, saddle-trees, breast-collars of studded leather, all of it gone brown and stiff. Sacks are stacked against the far wall.".
  Relation sacks_taken().
  Action take_barley(actor: group, site: place) "Shoulder the old sacks of barley" {
    Requires able(actor) and at(actor, site) and at(actor, harness) and not sacks_taken().
    On success { Increase quantity(actor, barley) by 2. Assert sacks_taken(). }
    Result "You lift two of the sacks. They are heavy, and sound, and smell of nothing: the barley has been kept dry for a century in a place where nothing grows. Somebody fed these horses, once, every day, and the last sacks were left against need.".
  }
  Observe store_robbed at harness when true "In the floor, under the sacks, a hole has been broken through the flagstones from below, with a crowbar. The edges are fresh.".
  Observe bench_scene at bench when true "A recess off the horse-hall, half the width of the hall, with a long bench of stone along its back wall. On the bench two men lie with their spears across their chests, in the leather of the king's riders.".
  Thing bells "the bells on the pickets" at horses {
    State hung "Bells on cords of horsehair hang by every manger, shaking on the draught.".
    State ringing "The bells on the pickets are ringing, all of them, a thin bright sound that goes on and on.".
    State stilled "Every bell on the pickets has been packed with wax and rag, and hangs mute.".
    Change still "Pack wax and rag round the bell-clappers" from hung to stilled needing candle consuming candle.
    Tries listening, looking.
  }
  Rule bells_ring when state(bells, hung) and at(party, horses) and not tolerates(mounts, party) and able(mounts) and lingered(party) >= 1 says "The nearest horse sets its forefoot down hard on the stone, and every bell on every picket answers it at once." { Assert state(bells, ringing). }
  Rule riders_wake when state(bells, ringing) and at(riders, bench) and able(riders) { Retract at(riders, bench). Assert at(riders, horses). Assert assails(riders, party). }
  Rule bells_stop when state(bells, ringing) and not at(party, horses) and not at(party, bench) { Assert state(bells, hung). }

  // ---- The chamber of flutes: sound as hazard, and a key.
  Observe flutes_scene at flutes when true "A round chamber whose walls are set with bones of the arm and the leg, cut and bored, hundreds of them: flutes. Air moves through the howe from somewhere, and they sound, faintly, all the time, too low to call a note. Three of them, set at the height of a hand, are larger than the rest.".
  Observe flutes_dark at flutes as sound when true "In the black, a sound like many people breathing slowly together, from all sides, as if the walls were asleep.".
  Thing flute_low "the low flute" at flutes {
    State idle "The low flute is a long bone, set at hip height.".
    State sounded "The low flute is sounding.".
    Change play_low "Play the low flute" from idle to sounded.
  }
  Thing flute_mid "the middle flute" at flutes {
    State idle "The middle flute is a bone of the leg, set at the height of the heart.".
    State sounded "The middle flute is sounding.".
    Change play_mid "Play the middle flute" from idle to sounded.
  }
  Thing flute_high "the high flute" at flutes {
    State idle "The high flute is a slender bone, set at the height of the mouth.".
    State sounded "The high flute is sounding.".
    Change play_high "Play the high flute" from idle to sounded.
  }
  Observe flutes_worn_low at flutes as felt when kinflute(flute_low) "Of the three larger flutes, two are rough with dust under the hand. The lowest is smooth as a handle, worn by hands that played it year on year.".
  Observe flutes_worn_mid at flutes as felt when kinflute(flute_mid) "Of the three larger flutes, two are rough with dust under the hand. The middle is smooth as a handle, worn by hands that played it year on year.".
  Observe flutes_worn_high at flutes as felt when kinflute(flute_high) "Of the three larger flutes, two are rough with dust under the hand. The highest is smooth as a handle, worn by hands that played it year on year.".
  Rule low_right when state(flute_low, sounded) and kinflute(flute_low) { Assert state(flute_low, idle). Assert voice_answered(). }
  Rule mid_right when state(flute_mid, sounded) and kinflute(flute_mid) { Assert state(flute_mid, idle). Assert voice_answered(). }
  Rule high_right when state(flute_high, sounded) and kinflute(flute_high) { Assert state(flute_high, idle). Assert voice_answered(). }
  Rule low_wrong when state(flute_low, sounded) and not kinflute(flute_low) says "The low flute speaks in a voice that is not a flute's. All the walls of the chamber answer it." { Assert state(flute_low, idle). Assert strikes(shriek, party). Assert flute_roused(). }
  Rule mid_wrong when state(flute_mid, sounded) and not kinflute(flute_mid) says "The middle flute speaks in a voice that is not a flute's. All the walls of the chamber answer it." { Assert state(flute_mid, idle). Assert strikes(shriek, party). Assert flute_roused(). }
  Rule high_wrong when state(flute_high, sounded) and not kinflute(flute_high) says "The high flute speaks in a voice that is not a flute's. All the walls of the chamber answer it." { Assert state(flute_high, idle). Assert strikes(shriek, party). Assert flute_roused(). }
  Relation voice_answered(). Relation flute_roused().
  Rule flute_rouses when flute_roused() and at(party, flutes) and able(household) and not tolerates(household, party) and at(household, gallery) { Bring household to party. Assert assails(household, party). Retract flute_roused(). }
  Rule flute_calm when flute_roused() { Retract flute_roused(). }
  Event voice_answers at flutes when voice_answered() and not king_asks() "Through the flutes, very faint, comes the sound of many people breathing slowly together, and then one voice, near your ear: 'Who keeps the bound now?'" teaches asked_bound then { Assert king_asks(). Assert tolerates(king, party). Assert tolerates(sworn, party). }
  Relation king_asks().
  Discovery asked_bound "The dead of the howe asked, through the flute, who keeps the bound now.".
  Observe stave_low at flutes as feature when kinflute(flute_low) "On the lintel of the steps, three signs are cut in a row, from the lowest up: a ring, a short bar, a long bar. The ring is the king's." teaches stave_known.
  Observe stave_mid at flutes as feature when kinflute(flute_mid) "On the lintel of the steps, three signs are cut in a row, from the lowest up: a short bar, a ring, a long bar. The ring is the king's." teaches stave_known.
  Observe stave_high at flutes as feature when kinflute(flute_high) "On the lintel of the steps, three signs are cut in a row, from the lowest up: a short bar, a long bar, a ring. The ring is the king's." teaches stave_known.
  Discovery stave_known "On the lintel of the steps up from the chamber of flutes, three signs are cut, and the king's flute is ringed.".

  // ---- The steps up: a stair that lies to the careless.
  Thing tread "the middle tread of the steps" on steps {
    State armed dangerous "The steps up to the high chamber are seven wide stairs of grey stone. The middle one has the bright, polished edge of a stone that is stepped on, and the others have the dull edge of stones that are not. At the foot of the steps lie the bones of a man in an iron cap, his spade beside him.".
    State shored "The middle tread has been wedged with iron where it hangs, and will hold.".
    State sprung "The middle tread has tipped away and hangs, black, over a drop into the dark.".
    Hurts with tread_pit when armed then sprung.
    Change wedge "Wedge the middle tread with iron" from armed to shored needing iron_spikes.
    Change prod "Prod the middle tread with a pole until it tips, and step over" from armed to sprung needing pole.
    Tries looking, pushing.
  }
  Observe tread_tell at flutes as sign when tried(tread, pushing) and state(tread, armed) "The pole pushes the middle tread and it moves, a hand's breadth, on a pin you cannot see, and a draught comes out of the gap that smells of a deep place.".
  Observe tread_robber at flutes as sign when state(tread, armed) "At the foot of the steps a man lies on his face in an iron cap, one hand stretched toward the third stair. The bones of his other hand are bent into the stone as if he had hung from it.".

  // ---- The high chamber and the king.
  Observe throne_scene at throne when true "The high chamber is the heart of the howe. A seat of stone stands at its end, and behind the seat a single stone makes the wall.".
  Observe king_seated at throne when able(king) and at(king, throne) "On the seat sits a king larger than the others, in a cloak gone to dust, with a sword laid across his knees. His skull is bowed.".
  Observe king_torc_seen at throne when able(king) and at(king, throne) and at(king_torc_item, throne) "A torc of braided gold and iron lies around his neck, bright as the day it was made.".
  Observe king_gone at throne when dead(king) "The king lies in the dust before his seat, where he fell, and his sword beside him.".
  Event torc_lifted at throne when ownedItem(king_torc_item, ?m) and memberOf(?m, party) and not bound_broken(party) "The torc comes away from the cold, with a sound like a breath drawn in. In the high chamber behind you, something sits up." then { Assert bound_broken(party). Retract tolerates(king, party). Retract tolerates(sworn, party). Retract tolerates(household, party). Retract peaceable(last). Assert assails(king, party). }
  Relation bound_broken(group). Relation howe_kept(group). Relation oath_sworn(group). Relation levy_met(group).
  Topic king_answer with king "Answer {king}: the company keeps the bound" when tolerates(king, actor) and knows(actor, asked_bound) once {
    Grave "A promise made to the dead is held to by them.".
    Says "The king bows his skull. The dark in his eyes is not hostile. 'Then keep it,' he says, in a voice that has no tongue in it. 'Close the door behind you. Take what the bound can spare. Do not take what holds it.' He takes his sword off his knees and lays it by his foot.".
    On discuss { Assert oath_sworn(actor). Assert peaceable(king). }
  }
  Event oath_broken at throne when oath_sworn(party) and bound_broken(party) "A voice comes out of the stone, from nowhere, from the whole howe at once: 'You said you would keep it.'" then { Retract oath_sworn(party). }

  // ---- The room behind the seat: sealed from within, or broken.
  Thing lastseal "the stone behind the seat" on behind_way {
    State set blocking "The stone behind the seat is cut with a seal, the Kin's marks running round it in a ring. There is no groove and no handle: it was set from the other side.".
    State open "The stone behind the seat has been drawn aside, and the little room beyond is open.".
    State broken "The stone behind the seat has been broken through.".
    Change draw_aside "Draw the stone aside from this side" from set to open at behind.
    Change break "Break through the stone behind the seat" from set to broken needing brawn.
  }
  Rule last_fate_broken when fate(howe, fate_broken) and state(lastseal, set) and not last_fate_applied() { Assert state(lastseal, broken). Assert last_fate_applied(). Retract at(last, behind). }
  Relation last_fate_applied().
  Rule last_broken_unkept when state(lastseal, broken) and not bound_broken(party) and fate(howe, fate_sealed) { Assert bound_broken(party). }
  Observe last_sealed at behind when fate(howe, fate_sealed) and at(last, behind) "In the little room beyond, the last of the Barrow-Kin lie together on the floor, a dozen of them, old and young, their arms about each other as they lay down. On the back of the stone they set behind them, cut by someone working in the dark: WE HAVE KEPT THE BOUND AS LONG AS THERE WERE LIVING TO KEEP IT FOR. NOW WE ARE THE BOUND." teaches last_known.
  Observe last_broken at behind when fate(howe, fate_broken) "The stone into this little room was broken through with picks, a long time ago, and the room beyond is empty. On every wall, cut deep, three words over and over: LET THEM WALK." teaches last_known.
  Discovery last_known "The last of the Barrow-Kin went into the room behind the seat and set the stone from within, or strangers broke it open before the Kin were at rest.".
  Rule first_stair_dis when knows(party, sketch_read) and knows(party, tally_read) and knows(party, plate_read) and not plan_made() says "You lay the three finds side by side: the diggers' sketch of the shaft and the drift, the warden's tally of the flutes, the bronze plate's ladder of lines. They are the same plan, drawn by three hands in three ages. It shows a stair that goes up from the older chamber, under the howe's floor, to a little room behind the king's seat." teaches plan_whole { Assert plan_made(). }
  Relation plan_made().
  Discovery plan_whole "A stair of the first folk goes up from the older chamber under the howe to the room behind the king's seat.".

  // ---- Under the howe: the shaft foot, the dig-camp, the foul drift, the sump, the older chamber, the well.
  Observe shaft_foot_scene at shaft_foot when true "The shaft lets you down into a rough-cut chamber where the robbers' work gave out: a round of dressed stone broken through with picks, a heap of spoil, and a winch-rope that swings from above and does not quite reach the floor.".
  Observe foot_cage at shaft_foot as sign when true "A wicker cage hangs from a hook in the wall, and in it a jay lies on its back with its feet in the air.".
  Observe dig_scene at dig when true "The robbers' lower works: a low chamber blasted out of the rock, with props, a rickety table, a lantern-hook, and the stink of damp men. A plan has been nailed to a post. Two dozen picks lie where they were dropped.".
  Observe dig_dead at dig as sign when true "Against the far wall lie the dead of the Spade-Company, laid in a row, with their picks across their chests. Somebody tended them. Somebody, afterwards, did not come back.".
  Observe dig_hole at dig as feature when true "A hole as wide as a door has been broken upward through the roof, into a room above.".
  Observe drift_scene at dig as sign when state(drift_air, foul) "The drift that goes on from here is low and dry and breathes out a sweetness like old fruit. A candle flame stands up in it blue, and dies.".
  Thing drift_air "the air in the low drift" on drift {
    State foul dangerous "The low drift runs on into the dark. The air in it is thick and sweet, and there is a chill of damp earth that has never seen a draught.".
    State sweet "The air in the low drift moves, cold and clean. A thin stream of daylight comes in from a vent in the roof.".
    Hurts with foul_air when foul then foul.
    Change open_vent "Dig out the choked vent at the drift's head" from foul to sweet needing shovel or digging.
    Tries looking.
  }
  Observe sump_scene at sump when true "The sump is a drowned working, a long low chamber half under black water, the roof sagging, the ribs of fallen props standing out of the surface like the bones of a boat. A ledge of dry rock runs along one wall.".
  Observe sump_voices at sump as sound when true "Out of the black water, from somewhere ahead and below, a voice calls: 'Hob? Is that you, Hob? Drop the rope.' The voice is very tired. It calls again, exactly as before.".
  Thing flood "the black water in the flooded passage" on sump_way {
    State deep dangerous "Black water fills the passage to within a hand of its roof. Whoever goes through goes under, in the dark, for as long as it takes.".
    State lined "A line runs through the black water from end to end, fixed to ring-bolts in the roof. Anyone can haul through on it now, holding their breath.".
    State drained "The passage is drained to a mud floor, slick and stinking.".
    Hurts with black_water when deep then lined.
    Change haul "Make fast the robbers' line and haul through" from deep to lined needing rope.
    Change drain_it "Open the old sluice and let the passage drain" from deep to drained after learning sluice_known.
    Tries looking.
  }
  Discovery sluice_known "A sluice under the dig-camp's floor drains the flooded passage to the older chamber." {
    Source plan_post "a plan nailed to a post" at dig readable by party.
  }
  Observe ancient_scene at ancient when true "The older chamber is round, and roofed with a single dome of pale stone that is not the Kin's, with no joint in it. In the middle of the floor a stone basin as wide as a table stands empty, and from its rim a flight of narrow steps goes down into a well.".
  Observe ancient_pale at ancient as feature when true "The stone here is not grey like the howe's, but white as bone, and cut so true that a knife will not go between the courses. Nothing the Kin made was ever finished like this.".
  Thing basin "the stone basin" at ancient {
    State cold "A stone basin as wide as a table stands in the middle of the chamber. Its bowl is dry, and has been dry a long time.".
    State alight "The basin burns with a steady yellow flame that fills the chamber to the dome.".
    Change fuel "Pour lamp oil into the basin and light it" from cold to alight needing lamp_oil consuming lamp_oil.
  }
  Rule basin_lit when state(basin, alight) and unlit(ancient) { Retract unlit(ancient). Retract unlit(well). }
  Observe well_scene at well when true "The well is a shaft in the floor, rimmed in the same white stone, going down into water that has no bottom. The water is still. Steps run down into it, and under it.".
  Observe well_voices at well as sound when not state(mouth, burned) "From the water, close, a voice says: 'Hob, drop the rope.' Then, in a different voice, a woman's, 'Mind the step.' Then your own, saying the last thing you said.".
  Observe well_lip at well as sign when true "On the white stone round the well's lip, deep scratches run down into the water, from outside, as if things had tried to climb out and been taken back.".
  Rule mouth_voice when at(party, ancient) and dice(clock) <= 12 says "From the well comes a voice you have heard, calling for a rope." { Assert strikes(mouth_pull, party). }
  Rule mouth_sinks when state(mouth, burned) and not peaceable(mouth) says "The skin of fire on the water goes out. Nothing rises through it." { Assert peaceable(mouth). }
  Item well_crown "a crown of the first folk" is ancient_crown at well.
  Rule mouth_fed when dead(mouth) and not mouth_down() says "The water in the well goes still for the last time, and stays still." { Assert mouth_down(). }
  Relation mouth_down().

  // ---- The town: the clerk, the levy, the walking dead, and what the country is told.
  Observe green_levy at green when not levy_met(party) and not bound_broken(party) "A notice is nailed to the clerk's trestle by the well, under the shire-reeve's mark: THE TALLY OF IRON AND GOLD IS TO BE MADE UP BY MIDWINTER. FOR THE WEIGHT OF IRON AND GOLD WANTING, SEE THE CLERK.".
  Observe green_levy_met at green when levy_met(party) "The clerk's notice by the well has been struck through, and the clerk's writing-board stands empty on the trestle.".
  Observe green_walkers at green when bound_broken(party) and dark() and able(household) "Down the lane, in the dark, come dead folk in grave-clothes, who stand about the green swaying, with their faces to the north. They are the dead of the ridge, and they have come to see what became of the bound.".
  Rule walk_town when bound_broken(party) and dark() and not at(household, green) and able(household) and not tolerates(household, party) { Retract at(household, gallery). Retract at(household, forecourt). Assert at(household, green). }
  Rule walk_back when bound_broken(party) and not dark() and at(household, green) { Retract at(household, green). Assert at(household, gallery). }
  Topic clerk_levy with clerk "Ask {clerk} what iron and gold he is short of" when true once {
    Says "'The shire-reeve,' says {clerk}, 'is short of a hundred weight of iron and gold by midwinter. The king's torc would do. It would melt down to a good third of it, and the shire-reeve would put the rest in a ditch. I would not ask you to fetch it for love. I will pay by the weight: eighty for the king's, and thirty for any other torc of the Kin that is brought to me whole.'".
    On discuss { Assert knows(actor, levy_told). }
  }
  Topic clerk_howe with clerk "Ask {clerk} what he knows of the howe" when knows(actor, levy_told) once {
    Says "'Less than I'd like,' says {clerk}. 'The Spade-Company holds a licence signed in my office. I did not read the small print. The howe is older than the county. There is a stone in its flank, on the south side, squared like a mason's work, with the shire-reeve's own predecessor's mark on it, and some other mark beneath that I cannot read. I am told it is a shepherd's cairn. It is not a shepherd's cairn.'".
  }
  Topic clerk_cairn with clerk "Show {clerk} the plate from the survey cairn" when knows(actor, plate_read) once {
    Says "{clerk} turns the plate over twice and sets it down on his board as if it were hot. 'I have seen that wheel,' he says. 'On a milestone, and on the seal of a bailiff who is not what he says. Whether it is the road's mark or the Kin's, I would not put it in a report. I would put it in a drawer.' He pushes it back across the board. 'Do not show it to the shire-reeve. He will build something.'".
  }
  Action hand_king_torc(actor: group, site: place) "Hand {clerk} the king's torc" {
    Requires able(actor) and at(actor, site) and at(clerk, site) and holding(actor, king_torc) and not levy_met(actor).
    On success { Spend king_torc from actor. Increase quantity(actor, gold) by 80. Assert levy_met(actor). }
    Result "{clerk} weighs it in both hands, and sets it on the board, and for the first time does not look at the tally. 'That is the levy,' he says, 'and a good deal over.' He counts out eighty coin.".
  }
  Action hand_kin_torc(actor: group, site: place) "Hand {clerk} a torc of the Barrow-Kin" {
    Requires able(actor) and at(actor, site) and at(clerk, site) and holding(actor, kin_torc) and not levy_met(actor).
    On success { Spend kin_torc from actor. Increase quantity(actor, gold) by 30. Increase torcs_given(clerk) by 1. }
    Result "{clerk} weighs it in his hand and nods once. He makes a mark on a tally and counts out thirty coin.".
  }
  Measure torcs_given(group).
  Rule levy_by_lesser when torcs_given(clerk) >= 3 and not levy_met(party) { Assert levy_met(party). }
  Topic priest_kin with priest "Ask {priest} about the howe on the ridge" when true once {
    Says "'The Barrow-Kin,' says {priest}, 'said that the dead keep the bounds, and I have heard worse theology from bishops. I do not like to hear that the shire-reeve's people are digging at a king's door. I like less that they have not told the shrine. If the dead do walk, I shall hear it first, because they will come to the churchyard to see whether it is still kept.'".
    On discuss { Assert knows(actor, priest_told). }
  }
  Entity priest_told: fact "The priest of the town fears the dead of the ridge will walk if the king's rest is broken.".
  Topic priest_thanks with priest "Tell {priest} the howe is shut and the king's rest is kept" when howe_kept(actor) and not thanked(priest, actor) once {
    Says "{priest} bows to you, as one does to a thing of long standing. 'Then we shall sleep tonight,' says {priest}, and gives you the shrine's holy water, two flasks, and a blessing that is meant.".
    On discuss { Give 2 holy_water to actor. Assert thanked(priest, actor). }
  }
  Relation thanked(group, group).
  Observe green_kept at green when howe_kept(party) and not dark() "People say the ridge has been quiet since the Spade-Company went off it, and that the clerk has stopped counting.".

  // ---- Rumours, said by the people the world gives them to.
  // The first town hears of the diggers too, from the drovers who use the ridge road: a line in the taproom from the
  // second day, once, and gone when it is known. (The scenario's own word reaches only the town nearest the howe and
  // its neighbour on the road, which a company beginning elsewhere has never visited.)
  Observe drovers_tell at first_taproom as hearsay when day(clock) >= 2 and not knows(party, ridge_told) "Two drovers at the end of the bench are comparing the ridge road. One says there are two columns of smoke on the skyline above the old mound where last year there was one, and that the second is no shepherd's. The other says it is the shire-reeve's licence-men digging into the barrow, that they keep a watch on the steep path now, and that they have been burying men." teaches ridge_told.
  Topic drovers_ask with first_keeper "Ask {first_keeper} about the drovers' talk of the ridge road" when knows(actor, ridge_told) once {
    Says "'Drovers,' says {first_keeper}, and shrugs. 'They use the ridge road, and what they say of it is mostly weather. But they have the digging right, I think. The shire-reeve's licence-men have camped at {outside}, in {land}, and you will see their smoke from the road. It is some days along the roads from here, out of town by the ford and on towards the hills. Keep to the road, and if they ask your business, have an answer ready.'".
  }
  Entity ridge_told: fact "A salvage crew, the Spade-Company, has made a camp on the ridge above {outside} and is digging into the flank of a great howe, under the shire-reeve's licence. They keep a watch on the steep path, and they have lost men under the hill.".
  Entity levy_told: fact "The shire-reeve's clerk is raising a levy and is short of iron and gold. He will pay by the weight for the torc of the king of the great howe on the ridge, or for any torc of the Barrow-Kin.".
  Entity warden_told: fact "An old woman keeps a fire on the ridge above {outside}, in sight of the king's howe. The priest says she is the last who still keeps the dead's rest.".
  Initially Assert established(ridge_told). Initially Assert established(levy_told). Initially Assert established(warden_told).
  Initially Assert established(weather_known). Initially Assert established(king_named).
  Initially Assert established(survey_known).

  // ---- What is said and seen in the town after.
  Observe taproom_captain at taproom when turned(captain) and at(captain, taproom) "The captain of the Spade-Company sits at the corner table with her ledger shut under her hand, and her diggers are at the far end of the room, as far from a spade as she could seat them.".
  Topic captain_tap with captain "Ask {captain} what she makes of the ridge now" when turned(captain) and at(captain, taproom) once {
    Says "'Quiet,' says {captain}, and does not drink. 'The clerk has asked me twice what I did with his licence. I told him I used it to light the fire.' She pushes a scrap of hide across the table: a nail-scratched drawing of a shaft, a drift and a drowned working. 'It is not much. But it is what is under there, and I would sooner someone had it who would not dig.'".
    On discuss { Give sketch to actor. }
  }
  Observe green_licence at green when dead(captain) and not levy_met(party) "The shire-reeve's clerk has crossed a name out of his tally with some force: the Spade-Company's licence, now there is no one left to hold it.".
  Observe green_turned at green when turned(captain) and not dark() "The diggers who came down from the ridge are drinking in the taproom, and have taken the clerk's licence-notice off the post to light their pipes.".
  Observe taproom_walkers at taproom when bound_broken(party) and not dark() "Someone has scratched a line of salt across the threshold of the taproom, and nobody will say who.".

  // ---- Aims.
  Objective ridge_aim when knows(party, ridge_told) and not been(party, lee) and not been(party, hearth) toward outside "A salvage crew is digging into a king's howe on the ridge above {outside}; the shire-reeve's clerk wants its torc; and an old woman keeps the dead's rest from a hearth to the north.".
  Objective warden_aim when knows(party, warden_told) and not trusted(warden, party) toward hearth "An old woman keeps a fire on the ridge in sight of the howe. She knows what the dead will bear, and she wants salt.".
  Objective levy_aim when knows(party, levy_told) and not levy_met(party) and not bound_broken(party) toward clerk "The shire-reeve's clerk will pay by the weight for the torc of the king of the howe, or for any torc of the Barrow-Kin.".
  Objective howe_aim when been(party, forecourt) and not been(party, throne) toward forecourt "The king of the Barrow-Kin sits on his seat at the heart of the howe, with his sword across his knees. The way in is the great stone, the gallery, and the steps up.".
  Objective plan_aim when (knows(party, sketch_read) or knows(party, tally_read) or knows(party, plate_read)) and not knows(party, plan_whole) toward outside "Three hands drew the plan of the howe: the diggers' sketch, the warden's tally, the cairn's plate. Put them together.".
  Objective close_aim when been(party, throne) and not howe_kept(party) and not bound_broken(party) toward forecourt "Whatever was taken, shut the door behind you.".
  Objective report_aim when (holding(party, king_torc) or holding(party, kin_torc)) and not levy_met(party) toward clerk "Take the torc to the shire-reeve's clerk, who will pay by the weight.".

  // ---- Milestones.
  Milestone m_ridge "came up onto the ridge" worth 40 when been(party, rise).
  Milestone m_forecourt "stood before the king's door" worth 60 when been(party, forecourt).
  Milestone m_horses "passed the dead horses" worth 120 when state(mounts, fed) or dead(mounts).
  Milestone m_flute "played the king's flute" worth 120 when voice_answered().
  Milestone m_throne "stood before the king" worth 150 when been(party, throne).
  Milestone m_plan "put the plan together" worth 150 when knows(party, plan_whole).
  Milestone m_well "stood at the well" worth 200 when been(party, well).
  Milestone m_kept "shut the howe behind them" worth 150 when howe_kept(party).
  Rule kept_rule when state(seal, set) and been(party, gallery) and not bound_broken(party) and not howe_kept(party) says "The stone settles into its groove with the sound of a door closing in a house that has been quiet for a long time." { Assert howe_kept(party). }
  Rule unkept_rule when howe_kept(party) and not state(seal, set) { Retract howe_kept(party). }
  Goal howe_kept(party) or levy_met(party).
}
