data/situations/silent-lord/keep.kyr:
Module silent_lord "The silent lord" {
  Description "A keep whose lord has not been seen in eleven days, a herald with a levy-writ, and a man in the oubliette who says he is the king's rider.".
  Entity party: group "Your company".
  Place land "The region" is region.
  Place outside "The road below the keep" is room.
  Place gossip "The green" is room.
  Place taproom "The taproom" is room.
  Place shrine "The shrine" is room.
  Place far_green "The next green" is room.
  Entity keeper: group "The innkeeper".
  Entity priest: group "The priest".
  Entity trader: group "The merchant".
  Entity house: group "The household of the keep".
  Entity patron: group "the herald's master".

  // ---- What the country says of it (the scenario's hooks), and what the household is, as a whole.
  Entity levy_called: fact "A crier in the castellan's colours has read a levy on the green: spears and grain, to be at the keep on the twelfth day, for the king's muster.".
  Entity lord_unseen: fact "The lord of {outside} has not been seen in eleven days. His castellan signs for him.".
  Initially Assert established(levy_called). Initially Assert established(lord_unseen).

  // ---- Vocabulary of the module.
  Kind period. Kind cause. Kind builder.
  Entity p_dawn: period "dawn". Entity p_morning: period "morning". Entity p_noon: period "noon".
  Entity p_afternoon: period "afternoon". Entity p_eve: period "evening". Entity p_night: period "night".
  Entity p_dead: period "the dead watch". Entity p_feast: period "the feast".
  Relation now(period) exclusive. Relation duty(group, period, place).
  Entity fall: cause "a fall". Entity fever: cause "a fever". Entity seizure: cause "a seizure".
  Relation death(cause).
  Entity office_made: builder "the Office". Entity founders_made: builder "the warlords". Entity makers_made: builder "the makers".
  Relation vault_built(builder).
  Relation leaguer(group).
  Relation proclaimed(group). Relation unmasked(group). Relation paid_off(group). Relation reckoned(group).
  Relation hunted(group). Relation night_open(group). Relation entered(group). Relation warms_to(group, group).
  Relation occupied(group). Relation heard_out(group, group). Relation befriended(group, group). Relation seized(group). Relation rider_sent(group).
  Measure feastDay(group). Measure crierDay(group).
  Initially Set feastDay(house) to 12.

  // ---- The keep: three levels, nineteen rooms.
  Place hold "The keep" is site within land at 2, 1.
  Place ward_l "The outer ward" is level within hold.
  Place keep_l "The keep itself" is level within hold.
  Place below_l "Below the keep" is level within hold.

  Place gatehouse "the gatehouse" is room within ward_l at 1, 2 indoors.
  Place ward "the ward" is room within ward_l at 1, 1 outdoors.
  Place kennels "the kennels and mews" is room within ward_l at 0, 0 outdoors.
  Place walk "the wall-walk" is room within ward_l at 1, 0 outdoors.
  Place stables "the stables" is room within ward_l at 2, 0 indoors.
  Place armoury "the armoury" is room within ward_l at 0, 1 indoors.
  Place granary "the granary" is room within ward_l at 2, 1 indoors.

  Place hall "the great hall" is room within keep_l at 1, 1 indoors.
  Place kitchen "the kitchen" is room within keep_l at 0, 1 indoors.
  Place chapel "the chapel" is room within keep_l at 2, 1 indoors.
  Place chancery "the chancery" is room within keep_l at 2, 0 indoors.
  Place solar "the lord's solar" is room within keep_l at 1, 0 indoors.
  Place guest "the guest chamber" is room within keep_l at 0, 0 indoors.

  Place undercroft "the undercroft" is room within below_l at 1, 1 underground.
  Place strongroom "the strong-room" is room within below_l at 0, 1 underground.
  Place crypt "the crypt" is room within below_l at 2, 1 underground.
  Place oubliette "the oubliette" is room within below_l at 1, 0 underground.
  Place vault "the old vault" is room within below_l at 2, 0 underground.
  Place drain "the drain" is room within below_l at 3, 0 underground.
  Initially Assert unlit(undercroft). Initially Assert unlit(strongroom). Initially Assert unlit(crypt).
  Initially Assert unlit(oubliette). Initially Assert unlit(vault). Initially Assert unlit(drain).

  // ---- Ways. The gate is shut from nine at night until six; a porter can be asked, or paid.
  Passage gate "the gate" is gate between outside and gatehouse
    opening when (hour(clock) >= 6 and hour(clock) < 21) or night_open(house) "The gate is shut for the night: oak and iron under a lamp, a wicket in the leaf and a bell-rope hanging beside it.".
  Passage inner_arch "the inner arch" is arch between gatehouse and ward.
  Passage kennel_gate "the kennel-yard gate" is doorway between ward and kennels.
  Passage stable_arch "the stable arch" is arch between ward and stables.
  Passage armoury_door "the armoury door" is door between ward and armoury.
  Passage granary_door "the granary door" is door between ward and granary.
  Passage wall_steps "the steps to the wall-walk" is steps between ward and walk.
  Passage hall_steps "the hall steps" is steps between ward and hall.
  Passage screens "the screens passage" is doorway between hall and kitchen.
  Passage chapel_arch "the chapel arch" is arch between hall and chapel.
  Passage chancery_door "the chancery door" is door between hall and chancery.
  Passage solar_stair "the solar stair" is stair between hall and solar.
  Passage guest_stair "the guest stair" is stair between hall and guest.
  Passage window "the solar window" is climb between walk and solar needing climbing or rope hidden until window_known.
  Passage buttery_steps "the buttery steps" is steps between kitchen and undercroft.
  Passage crypt_stair "the crypt stair" is stair between chapel and crypt.
  Passage strong_door "the strong-room door" is door between undercroft and strongroom.
  Passage hatch "the oubliette hatch" is ladder between undercroft and oubliette.
  Passage old_door "the old door" is door between oubliette and vault hidden until old_door_known needing brawn.
  Passage vault_crawl "the low crawl" is crawl between vault and drain.
  Passage culvert "the outfall culvert" is culvert between drain and outside taking 20 minutes hidden until drain_known.

  // ---- How the keep looks from the road, and what its banner says of who holds it.
  Thing banner "the banner over the gate" at outside {
    State as_was "A banner hangs over the gate, a tower with a star over it in white on green, and under it, lower, a black cloth the width of a hand that has been there some days.".
    State regency "The banner hangs at half its staff, tower and star on green, and the black cloth under it is new and wide.".
    State hushed "The banner hangs at the staff's head as on any day, and the gate-lamp has been left burning in daylight.".
    State usurped "A banner that is not the keep's hangs over the gate, {patron}'s colours. The tower and star lie folded under a ladder against the wall.".
    State mutinous "No banner hangs over the gate. A spear is bound upright to the staff with a belt.".
  }
  Initially Assert state(banner, as_was).
  Observe outside_shut at outside as sign when hunted(house) "The gate is shut to you, and a lamp burns in the gatehouse window all through the day. They know your faces.".
  Observe outside_ditch at outside as sign when not knows(party, drain_known) "Below the north wall the ditch has been scythed clean in one place, and a stone outfall there breathes out a thread of cold air that smells of old water. Nothing else on the wall has been tended.".
  Discovery drain_known "A stone outfall in the ditch below the north wall carries the keep's old drain out under the wall; a crawl through it comes up beneath the undercroft." {
    Found by searching outside "Pulling the weed back from the outfall, you find the arch behind it is no drain-mouth but a culvert cut for a man to crawl, and the air coming out of it is cold.".
  }
  Discovery window_known "A shuttered window in the lord's solar gives onto the wall-walk, a long step from the parapet." {
    Found by searching walk "Where the walk runs against the tower's flank, one shutter has a latch you could lift from outside, and a ledge below it that would carry a person.".
  }
  Discovery old_door_known "The oubliette's back wall is dry where every other wall weeps, and a slot at shoulder height takes an iron lever." {
    Found by searching vault "At the end of the vault, behind a fall of stone, a door as old as the vault is bolted from this side by a lever in a slot.".
    Found by searching oubliette "Behind the captive's pallet the wall is dry and warm to the hand. A slot is cut in it at shoulder height, and in the slot, a lever.".
  }

  // ---- The gate's hours, and a word with the porter.
  Observe gate_bell at outside as feature when hour(clock) >= 21 or hour(clock) < 6 "A bell-rope hangs by the wicket.".
  Observe gatehouse_scene at gatehouse when true "The gatehouse is a vaulted passage with a guardroom on either side, a murder-hole in the roof over your head and a lamp in a niche. The portcullis is wound up in its slot; below it the porter's stool stands against the wall.".
  Observe gatehouse_names at gatehouse when true "Names and tallies are scratched into the plaster by men who waited out their watches here, and under the lamp one hand has written, over and over, in a good clerk's letters: not yet.".
  Observe ward_scene at ward when true "The ward is trodden earth round a well-head, with the stables to the east and the granary to the west, the hall steps going up on the far side and a mounting-block that has been used more than anything else here.".
  Observe ward_dawn at ward when now(p_dawn) or now(p_morning) "The garrison drills in two ranks by the well, and the marshal walks the line with a stick, saying the step.".
  Observe ward_noon at ward when now(p_noon) "The yard is nearly empty. Smoke rises from the kitchen, and a dog sleeps in the shade of the mounting-block.".
  Observe ward_afternoon at ward when now(p_afternoon) "The castellan crosses the ward from the walls to the hall, slowly, and everybody she passes stops what they are doing until she has gone by.".
  Observe ward_eve at ward when now(p_eve) "The ward is full of men going in to supper, and nobody goes in alone.".
  Observe ward_night at ward when now(p_night) or now(p_dead) "The ward is dark but for the lamp over the hall steps. Chains are dragged in the yard by the kennels, and a low sound goes with them.".
  Observe ward_feast at ward when now(p_feast) "Every window in the hall is lit and the doors stand open. The noise comes out into the ward in waves, and the ward is empty of everyone who matters.".
  Observe kennels_scene at kennels when true "The kennels run along the north wall, a row of pens with straw and chains and a long trough, and at the end of them the mews, where hooded hawks sit in the dark. It smells of dog, tar and old blood.".
  Observe kennels_pens at kennels when not now(p_night) and not now(p_dead) "A dozen hounds lie in the pens, heavy-headed in the straw, and lift their lips at strangers without troubling to stand. The big mastiffs are chained to the wall. At dusk, the houndsman says, someone has to unchain them.".
  Observe kennels_howl at kennels as sound when now(p_night) or now(p_dead) "Behind the dogs' noise, one voice goes on: an old dog, howling at the wall toward the chapel, over and over, the way a dog calls for someone who has not come.".
  Observe stables_scene at stables when true "The stables are warm and dim and smell of horse. Stalls down both sides, a loft over, a row of saddles on a rail. Two horses stand a little apart from the rest: one groomed to a shine, one with a rough dry coat and a sweat-scar.".
  Observe armoury_scene at armoury when true "The armoury is a long low room with spears racked along one wall and bows in a press along the other, and a bench under the window where someone has been mending mail. A tally is chalked on the door-frame: thirty-one men, and the days since they were paid.".
  Observe granary_scene at granary when true "The granary is raised on staddles against the damp, floored in planks, and smells of dust and mice. The sacks stand in rows of ten, and a board is nailed to the door with the steward's tally in his square hand.".
  Observe walk_scene at walk when true "From the wall-walk you can see the road a morning each way, as the keep was built to. The parapet is chest-high and worn smooth by elbows; a brazier burns at the gatehouse end.".
  Observe walk_view at walk as ambience when true "Smoke from the hamlet beyond the fields. A wagon on the road, small as a toy. The wind is from the south and carries the sound of the bell at the shrine.".
  Observe hall_scene at hall when true "The great hall is a long room under a black roof, with the high table on a dais at one end and two lower tables running down it. A hearth wide enough to stand in takes up one wall; screens hide the kitchen passage at the other.".
  Observe hall_seat at hall when true "The high seat is empty. A cup is set before it and filled at every meal, and cleared untouched.".
  Observe kitchen_scene at kitchen when true "The kitchen is all steam and iron: a hearth you could roast an ox on, a dresser of pewter, a table scarred by a hundred years of knives. Herbs hang from the beams, and a shelf by the door holds jars with paper tied over their necks.".
  Observe chapel_scene at chapel when true "The chapel is small and cold and kept very clean. The altar is bare stone on a step of paler stone with letters on it, worn nearly smooth by knees. A stair goes down at the back, behind an iron door, and the candles at the foot of it are never allowed to go out.".
  Observe chancery_scene at chancery when true "The chancery is the keep's memory: a long table under a window, a wall of pigeon-holes tagged with the names of manors, a press of black oak bound in iron, and the smell of ink and of a great deal of vellum kept dry for a long time.".
  Observe solar_scene at solar when true "The lord's solar has a tall bed, a table, a chair with arms and a window with its shutters closed. The bed has not been slept in. Letters lie in a tray on the table, and every one of them is in the same hand.".
  Observe guest_scene at guest when true "The guest chamber is the best room on the stair: a bed with hangings, a washstand, a window on the ward. A trunk bound with brass stands at the foot of the bed, and two pallets are laid by the door for men who do not undress.".
  Observe undercroft_scene at undercroft when true "The undercroft is a long vaulted cellar under the hall, stacked with casks and bins of roots. The air is cold and smells of earth, and the vault rings with your steps. In the far wall, an iron-bound door; in the floor, a square trap with a bar across it.".
  Observe strongroom_scene at strongroom when true "The strong-room is a stone cell with a low roof, an iron-bound chest, a shelf of plate and a desk with its ledgers stacked. The door has three locks, and the wall beside it has been scratched, by someone with nothing else to do, with tally marks in fives.".
  Observe crypt_scene at crypt when true "The crypt is a low vault of the keep's first lords, the slabs of their tombs let into the floor under a row of niches. At the nearest, a bier has been set on trestles and a cloth laid over it, and a hundred candle-ends have burned down round it in a ring.".
  Observe oubliette_scene at oubliette when true "A square pit, stone-lined, a man's height and a half to the hatch. It is damp and cold, and the straw is fresh.".
  Observe vault_scene at vault when true "The old vault is a long chamber of dressed stone, much older than the keep above it, and dry as bread. Whoever made it made it to last, and to be locked, and to be forgotten.".
  Observe drain_scene at drain when true "The drain is a round-roofed passage no higher than a kneeling man, a hand of black water in the bottom of it, and the cold air from the outfall moving along it like a hand along a wall.".
}
data/situations/silent-lord/papers.kyr:
Module silent_lord "The silent lord" {
  // ---- What can be learned in the keep, as the journal will say it.
  Discovery lord_trays "Meals go up to the lord's solar twice a day and come down as heavy as they went. The high seat's cup is filled at every meal and cleared untouched. The household behaves as though he lives." { Known by cook. }
  Discovery dog_howls "The lord's old dog has howled toward the chapel every night for nine nights." { Known by houndsman. }
  Discovery lord_dead "The lord of the keep is dead. He lies on a bier in the crypt under the chapel, and the household has agreed not to say so.".
  Discovery seal_plain "The herald's writ is sealed with a plain crown.".
  Discovery seal_ears "The court's present seal is a crown between two ears of wheat. The old one, from before the coronation, was a plain crown.".
  Discovery herald_false "The herald's writ is sealed with the court's old seal. No court has issued a paper under it since the coronation, and the king's rider's writ, and the court's own letter in the chancery, are sealed with the new one.".
  Discovery captive_story "The prisoner says he rode from the court with the king's writ for the lord, that the herald's men took his satchel at the ford and the herald brought him in 'as a thief', and that he has been in the oubliette nine days.".
  Discovery granary_short "The granary holds forty bushels less than the steward's tally board says.".
  Discovery ledger_sold "The steward's ledger shows forty bushels of the levy-corn sold to a factor in the autumn, and the garrison's wages for a month paid out of the money.".
  Discovery arrears "The garrison is owed eighty crowns, which the marshal will take as pay for thirty-one men and no more questions.".
  Discovery will_read "The lord's will names his ward {heir}, aged fourteen, at the abbey, as his heir; the castellan as her regent until she is sixteen; and begs the king's assent. It is signed by the chaplain and two witnesses. The date is the day before he died.".
  Discovery heir_sought "The lord's ward {heir} is at the abbey, and the chaplain has written for her; she has not been told her uncle is dead.".
  Discovery bailiff_dues "A woman with a lead seal is collecting 'dues for the keeping of the road' from three settlements in the castellan's name. The castellan never granted it, and the clerk has written to her three times about a hayrick.".
  Discovery dead_watch "The sentries come off the walls to the gatehouse brazier between two and three in the morning, and the wall-walk stands empty for the hour.".
  Discovery hounds_bone "The kennel hounds are loosed in the ward at curfew and will take a marrow-bone from a stranger's hand; they will not take a stranger.".
  Discovery poison_known "The jar on the cook's shelf, tied with paper, is monkshood, kept for the rats and counted every week.".
  Discovery vault_known "A vault older than the keep lies behind the oubliette's back wall; a crawl from it comes out in the ditch.".
  Discovery reading_chapel "The chaplain reads the end of the Empire as a judgement: a proud thing that was told to stop, and stopped.".
  Discovery reading_garrison "The marshal reads the end of the Empire as a pay-day that did not come: the legions went home when the money did not, and nobody gave the order.".
  Discovery reading_chancery "The clerk reads the end of the Empire as a closing: the Office of the Road dissolved itself by its own rule, and its papers were sealed 'until called for'.".
  Discovery quirk_tally "The steward writes his sevens with a bar through them.".
  Discovery quirk_roll "The marshal counts his tens in fives and strokes, as a man does who learned his figures on a tally-stick.".
  Discovery quirk_index "The clerk ends every line with a blot, and draws the tail of his d long.".
  Discovery letter_marks_steward "The letter in the herald's trunk writes its sevens with a bar through them.".
  Discovery letter_marks_marshal "The letter in the herald's trunk counts its tens in fives and strokes.".
  Discovery letter_marks_clerk "The letter in the herald's trunk ends its lines with a blot and draws its d with a long tail.".
  Discovery hand_steward "The herald's friend inside the keep is the steward: the sevens are his.".
  Discovery hand_marshal "The herald's friend inside the keep is the marshal: the tens are his.".
  Discovery hand_clerk "The herald's friend inside the keep is the clerk: the blots and the tails are his.".

  // ---- The papers themselves. Each is read where it lies, and says what it says.
  Thing tally "the steward's tally board" at granary {
    State unread "A board nailed to the granary door carries the steward's tally in chalk and ink, in a square, careful hand.".
    State read "TWO HUNDRED AND TWELVE BUSHELS, wheat and barley, the autumn's stores, and under it the levy's share, in lines. The sevens have a bar through them.".
    Change read "Read the tally board" from unread to read.
  }
  Observe tally_learned at granary of tally as reading when state(tally, read) "The figures are neat, and the steward has leant on the nib at every seven." teaches quirk_tally.
  Action count_sacks(actor: group, site: place) "Count the sacks, row by row" {
    Requires able(actor) and at(actor, site) and at(actor, granary) and state(tally, read) and not knows(actor, granary_short).
    Time 6.
    On success { Assert knows(actor, granary_short). }
    Result "You count them twice, because the second count has to agree with the first: seventeen rows of ten and a row of two. A hundred and seventy-two. The board says two hundred and twelve.".
  }
  Thing ledger "the steward's ledger" at strongroom {
    State shut "A tall ledger lies on the desk with a strip of leather round it.".
    State read "The ledger is a fair copy of the keep's year. Under the autumn, forty bushels of the levy-corn are entered as sold to a factor at the fair, for forty crowns, and a month of the garrison's wages as paid out of it the same week. The sevens have a bar through them.".
    Change read "Unbuckle the ledger and read it" from shut to read.
  }
  Observe ledger_learned at strongroom of ledger as reading when state(ledger, read) "The steward has been spending the levy to pay the men whose lord the levy is for, and has put every penny in a column." teaches ledger_sold.
  Observe ledger_hand at strongroom of ledger as reading when state(ledger, read) "He has written it all in the same square, careful hand as the granary board." teaches quirk_tally.

  Thing receipt "a factor's receipt spiked on the undercroft desk" at undercroft {
    State spiked "A narrow desk stands against the far wall of the undercroft, with a spike on it, and on the spike a slip of paper.".
    State read "Received of the steward of the keep forty bushels of the autumn corn, at the fair, forty crowns in good silver, for the factor's house. The mark is a ship, and the steward's name is under it, with a bar through every seven.".
    Change read "Read the slip on the spike" from spiked to read.
  }
  Observe receipt_learned at undercroft of receipt as reading when state(receipt, read) "The levy corn was sold, and he kept the receipt." teaches ledger_sold.
  Thing pay_roll "the garrison's pay-roll" at armoury {
    State shut "A roll of vellum lies under a stone on the bench, ruled in columns.".
    State read "Thirty-one names, and against each, a row of marks: paid, paid, paid, and then nothing since midsummer. The marshal has kept the tally in fives and strokes. At the foot, in the same hand: EIGHTY, and under it, struck through twice, NOT ASKED.".
    Change read "Read the pay-roll" from shut to read.
  }
  Observe roll_learned at armoury of pay_roll as reading when state(pay_roll, read) "He has asked for nothing, and written down to the penny what that has cost." teaches arrears.
  Observe roll_hand at armoury of pay_roll as reading when state(pay_roll, read) "His tens are drawn in fives and strokes." teaches quirk_roll.

  Thing index "the press index" at chancery {
    State shut "A narrow book lies open at the end of the long table, a list of what the press holds, in a quick hand.".
    State read "Wills, grants, the court's letters, the matrices. The press is the first of the heads. Every line ends in a blot, and every d has a tail like a fishing-line.".
    Change read "Read the index of the press" from shut to read.
  }
  Observe index_hand at chancery of index as reading when state(index, read) "The clerk's blots, and his long-tailed d." teaches quirk_index.

  Thing plan "a plan of the undercroft pinned to the wall" at chancery {
    State pinned "An old plan of the undercroft is pinned over the pigeon-holes, drawn by a surveyor with a fine pen: the casks and bins, and, at the north-east corner, a dotted line that runs off the edge of the sheet toward the ditch.".
    State studied "The dotted line is a drain from a chamber behind the oubliette, out under the north wall to the ditch, and the surveyor has written beside it, in a fine small hand: SOUND. DO NOT STOP.".
    Change study "Study the plan of the undercroft" from pinned to studied.
  }
  Observe plan_learned at chancery of plan as reading when state(plan, studied) "A chamber behind the oubliette, a drain under the north wall, and an outfall in the ditch. Whoever surveyed it could not say what the chamber was for." teaches vault_known.
  Observe plan_learned_drain at chancery of plan as reading when state(plan, studied) "The outfall is on the road side, in the ditch below the north wall." teaches drain_known.

  Thing chapel_step "the altar step" at chapel {
    State worn "The step before the altar is paler than the rest of the floor, with a band of cut letters on it worn nearly smooth.".
    State read "The letters are the Empire's: a line in praise of an officer of the Road, and below it, scored out by a different hand with a chisel, a single word. The chaplain says it is JUDGED. It is hard to tell.".
    Change read "Read the letters on the altar step" from worn to read needing lore.
  }

  Thing shield_boss "the old shield-boss over the armoury door" at armoury {
    State hung "A round boss of bronze, green with age, is nailed over the door, with a mark stamped in it.".
    State read "The stamp is a small square counter: PAID TO THE CALENDS. Whoever carried this shield was paid up to a day, and then, the marshal says, was not.".
    Change read "Look at the stamp on the shield-boss" from hung to read.
  }

  Thing closing_fragment "a torn leaf in the seal-chest" at chancery {
    State folded "A leaf of ancient vellum lies folded at the bottom of the seal-chest, the writing run into a brown stain along the fold.".
    State read "A fragment. ' … in accordance with the third article, the Office is closed, and its papers sealed until called for.' Below it, the stamp: a wheel with a wing.".
    Change read "Unfold the torn leaf and read it" from folded to read needing lore.
  }

  // ---- The herald's trunk and what is in it.
  Thing trunk "the herald's brass-bound trunk" at guest {
    Holds.
    State locked closed "A brass-bound trunk stands at the foot of the bed. The lock is a good one, and the herald wears the key on a cord.".
    State open "The trunk stands open.".
    Change pick "Pick the trunk's lock" from locked to open needing lockwork.
    Change force "Break the trunk's lock with a crowbar" from locked to open needing crowbar.
  }
  Thing letter "a letter folded in the trunk" in trunk {
    State folded "A letter lies folded under the herald's linen, with a green wax seal, broken.".
    State read "The letter is to {patron}: the writer will see that the gate is opened to the herald, the garrison's loyalty counted for what it is worth, and the castellan 'found wanting at the feast'. It is unsigned. It is not in a hand that was taught to disguise itself.".
    Change read "Unfold and read the letter" from folded to read.
  }
  Observe letter_steward at guest of letter as reading when state(letter, read) and leaguer(steward) "The sevens in the date have a bar through them." teaches letter_marks_steward.
  Observe letter_marshal at guest of letter as reading when state(letter, read) and leaguer(marshal) "The sums of the garrison's strength are counted in fives and strokes." teaches letter_marks_marshal.
  Observe letter_clerk at guest of letter as reading when state(letter, read) and leaguer(clerk) "Every line ends in a blot, and the d's have tails like fishing-lines." teaches letter_marks_clerk.
  Thing purse "the herald's purse" in trunk {
    State lying "A purse of fifty crowns in the court's new coin lies under the linen.".
    State taken "The herald's purse is gone from the trunk.".
    Change take_purse "Take the herald's purse" from lying to taken.
  }
  Event purse_pays near purse when state(purse, taken) "The purse is heavy: fifty crowns, all in the new coin of the court." then { Increase quantity(party, gold) by 50. }
  Thing writ "the herald's writ" in trunk {
    State rolled "A scroll in a leather case, with a plain crown pressed in the wax, lies on top of the linen.".
    State read "The king's writ commands the lord of the keep to bring twenty spears and a hundred bushels to the muster of the March on the twelfth day, or to send his heir, 'and to present himself or his heir at the king's court at the feast of the coronation, in the second year of the reign'. The seal is a crown, plain.".
    Change read "Read the herald's writ" from rolled to read.
  }
  Observe writ_seal at guest of writ as reading when state(writ, read) "A plain crown in red wax, struck from a good die." teaches seal_plain.

  // ---- What the strong-room holds, and what the chancery's press does.
  Thing strong_lock_a "the steward's lock" on strong_door {
    State locked "The strong-room door has three locks, one above another. The first is plain and heavy.".
    State turned "The first lock stands turned.".
    Change key_a "Turn the steward's key in the first lock" from locked to turned needing steward_key_kind.
    Change pick_a "Pick the first lock" from locked to turned needing lockwork.
  }
  Thing strong_lock_b "the castellan's lock" on strong_door {
    State locked "The second lock is finer than the first and has been oiled lately.".
    State turned "The second lock stands turned.".
    Change key_b "Turn the castellan's key in the second lock" from locked to turned needing castellan_key_kind.
    Change pick_b "Pick the second lock" from locked to turned needing lockwork.
  }
  Thing strong_lock_c "the chaplain's lock" on strong_door {
    State locked "The third lock is small, a chapel lock, with a cross cut in the plate.".
    State turned "The third lock stands turned.".
    Change key_c "Turn the chaplain's key in the third lock" from locked to turned needing chaplain_key_kind.
    Change pick_c "Pick the third lock" from locked to turned needing lockwork.
  }
  Rule strong_open when state(strong_lock_a, turned) and state(strong_lock_b, turned) and state(strong_lock_c, turned)
    and not state(strong_door_leaf, ajar) says "The third lock gives, and the door can be pushed." { Assert state(strong_door_leaf, ajar). }
  Thing strong_door_leaf "the strong-room door" on strong_door {
    State shut blocking "The door itself is oak sheeted in iron, and the three locks hold it.".
    State ajar "The door stands ajar.".
    Change force "Force the strong-room door with a crowbar, locks and all" from shut to ajar needing crowbar.
  }
  Rule strong_forced when state(strong_door_leaf, ajar) and state(strong_lock_a, locked) and not hunted(house) says "The door gives with a crack that rings through the undercroft and up the buttery steps." { Assert hunted(house). }

  Thing strongbox "the keep's strongbox" at strongroom {
    Holds.
    State locked closed "An iron chest, bolted to the floor, with a hasp and a padlock.".
    State open "The strongbox stands open.".
    Change pick "Pick the strongbox's padlock" from locked to open needing lockwork.
    Change smash "Break the padlock with a crowbar" from locked to open needing crowbar.
    Change key "Open the strongbox with the steward's key" from locked to open needing steward_key_kind.
  }
  Event strongbox_pays near strongbox when state(strongbox, open) "In the bottom, under a folded cloth, forty crowns in a leather bag, and nothing else." then { Increase quantity(party, gold) by 40. }
  Thing satchel "a rider's satchel" at strongroom {
    Holds.
    State lying "A rider's satchel with a worn strap lies on the shelf beside the plate, its buckle torn.".
    State empty "The satchel lies empty on the shelf.".
    Change take_writ "Take the writ from the rider's satchel" from lying to empty.
  }
  Event satchel_gives near satchel when state(satchel, empty) "Inside the lining, where a rider would sew what he cannot afford to lose, is a roll in an oiled case. You take it." then { Give true_writ_kind to party. }
  Kind true_writ_kind "the king's writ, from the satchel" is document teaching seal_ears described "A roll in an oiled case: the king's writ for the lord of the keep, in the second year of the reign, sealed with a crown between two ears of wheat. It summons the lord or his heir to the coronation court; the muster, it says, is 'for the matter of the March'.".
  Kind steward_key_kind "the steward's key" is treasure worth 1 weighing 1 described "A long iron key worn bright where a thumb has held it.".
  Kind castellan_key_kind "the castellan's key" is treasure worth 1 weighing 1 described "A slender steel key on a loop of red cord.".
  Kind chaplain_key_kind "the chaplain's key" is treasure worth 1 weighing 1 described "A small brass key with a cross for a bow.".
  Kind press_key_kind "the press key" is treasure worth 1 weighing 1 described "A black key as long as a hand.".
  Kind hatch_key_kind "the oubliette key" is treasure worth 1 weighing 1 described "A heavy key with a ring of stained leather.".
  Kind armoury_key_kind "the armoury key" is treasure worth 1 weighing 1 described "A flat steel key stamped with a tower.".
  Kind bone_kind "a marrow-bone" is gear worth 1 weighing 1 described "A great beef bone, cracked and full, wrapped in a cloth.".
  Kind monkshood_kind "a jar of monkshood" is gear worth 4 weighing 1 described "A small stoneware jar with paper tied over the neck. In it, dark roots, dry and wrinkled. The cook's hand has written on the paper: RATS. DO NOT.".
  Kind will_kind "the lord's will" is document teaching will_read described "A sheet of good vellum, folded in three, the lord's seal on the tail, the signatures of a chaplain and two others.".
  Kind spring_kind "the court's letter of spring" is document teaching seal_ears described "A letter from the court in the lord's last spring, the king's own, thanking him for his loyalty; it is the only paper in the keep with the new seal on it.".
  Kind die_kind "a bronze die" is treasure worth 40 weighing 1 described "A bronze die as long as a thumb with a handle, cut for pressing into wax. The face is worn but clear.".
  Kind remission_kind "a remission in the lord's hand" is document described "A paper, sealed with the keep's tower and star, in the lord's own writing: the lord remits the levy of men to the towns of his march this year, 'on account of the winter', and asks the king's indulgence.".
  Kind order_kind "a pay-order in the lord's hand" is document described "A paper, sealed with the keep's tower and star, in the lord's own writing: the steward is to pay the garrison its arrears from the strongbox, forthwith.".
  Kind keep_writ_kind "a writ against the bailiff" is document described "A paper in the castellan's name, sealed with the keep's tower and star: no dues are asked of any hearth in the march for the keeping of any road, and any who collect them in the keep's name do so against its law.".
  Item will_item "the lord's will" is will_kind in muniment_press.
  Item spring_item "the court's letter of spring" is spring_kind in muniment_press.
  Item vault_die "a bronze die" is die_kind at vault.
  Thing muniment_press "the muniment press" at chancery {
    Holds.
    State locked closed "A press of black oak bound in iron stands against the wall, its double doors shut with a lock the size of a book.".
    State open "The muniment press stands open on its shelves.".
    Change key "Open the press with the clerk's key" from locked to open needing press_key_kind.
    Change pick "Pick the press's lock" from locked to open needing lockwork.
    Change force "Break the press's doors with a crowbar" from locked to open needing crowbar.
  }
}
data/voice/farewell.json:
{
  "about": "The company takes its leave of someone it was speaking with: how they let it go, by their manner, who the company is to them, and the hour. Not said when the company simply walks off.",
  "kinds": ["farewell"],
  "lines": [
    { "id": "farewell.1", "text": "{Actor} nods, and goes back to what {they} [were|was] doing." },
    { "id": "farewell.2", "text": "‘Go well,’ [say|says] {actor}." },
    { "id": "farewell.3", "text": "{Actor} watches you go for a moment, then turns away." },
    { "id": "farewell.night", "when": { "time": "night" }, "text": "‘Mind how you go in the dark,’ [say|says] {actor}." },
    { "id": "farewell.cheerful", "when": { "manner": "cheerful" }, "text": "‘Come back and tell me how it goes!’ [call|calls] {actor} after you." },
    { "id": "farewell.grim", "when": { "manner": "grim" }, "text": "{Actor} has gone back to work before you have turned round." },
    { "id": "farewell.stoic", "when": { "manner": "stoic" }, "text": "{Actor} lifts a hand, once." },
    { "id": "farewell.jovial", "when": { "manner": "jovial" }, "text": "‘Off you go, then,’ [say|says] {actor}, ‘and don’t do anything I’d be ashamed to hear about. Or do, and tell me.’" },
    { "id": "farewell.compassionate", "when": { "manner": "compassionate" }, "text": "‘Look after yourself,’ [say|says] {actor}. ‘I mean it.’" },
    { "id": "farewell.proud", "when": { "manner": "proud" }, "text": "{Actor} considers the conversation over some moments before you do." },
    { "id": "farewell.acerbic", "when": { "manner": "acerbic" }, "text": "‘Don’t let me keep you,’ [say|says] {actor}, who was not trying to." },
    { "id": "farewell.kin", "when": { "bond": "kin" }, "text": "‘Be careful,’ [say|says] {actor}. ‘I know you won’t, but be careful.’" },
    { "id": "farewell.friend", "when": { "bond": "friend" }, "text": "{Actor} claps you on the shoulder. ‘You know where I am.’" },
    { "id": "farewell.creditor", "when": { "bond": "creditor" }, "text": "‘Market day,’ [say|says] {actor}, to your back." },
    { "id": "farewell.neighbour", "when": { "bond": "neighbour" }, "text": "‘Don’t be a stranger,’ [say|says] {actor}, ‘now you’re back.’" }
  ]
}
data/voice/greet.json:
{
  "about": "A tame creature notices the company for the first time: by species, by the time of day, and by whether it is under a roof. A creature's own words (Greets \"...\" in Kyr) are said instead.",
  "kinds": ["greet"],
  "lines": [
    { "id": "greet.dog.1", "when": { "species": "dog" }, "text": "{Actor} gets up, stretches, and comes over to push {their} nose into your hand." },
    { "id": "greet.dog.2", "when": { "species": "dog" }, "text": "{Actor} thumps {their} tail on the ground without getting up, which is as much welcome as you are going to get." },
    { "id": "greet.dog.3", "when": { "species": "dog" }, "text": "{Actor} barks twice, for form's sake, then comes to see who you are." },
    { "id": "greet.dog.night", "when": { "species": "dog", "time": "night" }, "text": "{Actor} lifts {their} head, decides you are no business of {theirs}, and puts it down again." },
    { "id": "greet.cat.1", "when": { "species": "cat" }, "text": "{Actor} watches you from somewhere high, unblinking, and does not come down." },
    { "id": "greet.cat.2", "when": { "species": "cat" }, "text": "{Actor} comes to wind once round your ankles, and goes back to {their} place." },
    { "id": "greet.horse.1", "when": { "species": "horse" }, "text": "{Actor} blows through {their} nose at you, and puts {their} head out to be noticed." },
    { "id": "greet.goat.1", "when": { "species": ["goat", "sheep"] }, "text": "{Actor} stops chewing long enough to look at you." },
    { "id": "greet.hen.1", "when": { "species": "hen" }, "text": "{Actor} complains about you to the others." },
    { "id": "greet.pig.1", "when": { "species": "pig" }, "text": "{Actor} grunts, hopefully, in case you have brought something." },
    { "id": "greet.cow.1", "when": { "species": "cow" }, "text": "{Actor} turns {their} great head to look at you, and goes on chewing." },
    { "id": "greet.animal.1", "text": "{Actor} comes to see who you are." }
  ]
}
data/voice/join.json:
{
  "about": "Someone joins the company: what they say or do, by what they are to the one who plays (bond: kin, expected, friend, hire, escort, fellow, stranger) and, where it shows, their manner. A line that names more of the moment is chosen over one that names less. A person's own words (Joins \"...\" in Kyr) are said instead.",
  "kinds": ["join"],
  "lines": [
    { "id": "join.kin.1", "when": { "bond": "kin" }, "text": "{Actor} is already reaching for {their} coat. 'I was going to go anyway,' {actor} says. 'Now I don't have to go alone.'" },
    { "id": "join.kin.2", "when": { "bond": "kin" }, "text": "'About time,' [say|says] {actor}, and takes the heavier bag without being asked." },
    { "id": "join.kin.3", "when": { "bond": "kin" }, "text": "{Actor} looks at you a long moment, then nods. Neither of you says anything about why." },
    { "id": "join.kin.grim", "when": { "bond": "kin", "manner": ["grim", "stoic"] }, "text": "{Actor} gets up without a word and goes for {their} boots. Whatever is out there, you will face it together." },
    { "id": "join.kin.cheerful", "when": { "bond": "kin", "manner": ["cheerful", "jovial"] }, "text": "'I was hoping you'd ask,' [say|says] {actor}, grinning for the first time since you came home. 'Give me a minute to find my other boot.'" },
    { "id": "join.kin.compassionate", "when": { "bond": "kin", "manner": "compassionate" }, "text": "'Of course,' [say|says] {actor}, and puts a hand on your arm. 'We'll find out together.'" },
    { "id": "join.friend.1", "when": { "bond": "friend" }, "text": "'Then I'm coming,' [say|says] {actor}. 'Someone has to keep you out of trouble.'" },
    { "id": "join.friend.2", "when": { "bond": "friend" }, "text": "{Actor} laughs. 'I wondered how long you'd take to ask.'" },
    { "id": "join.hire.1", "when": { "bond": "hire" }, "text": "{Actor} counts the coin twice, puts it away, and shoulders {their} pack. 'Where are we going, then?'" },
    { "id": "join.hire.2", "when": { "bond": "hire" }, "text": "{Actor} weighs the coin in one hand, then nods. 'For that, I'll go as far as you like. Within reason.'" },
    { "id": "join.hire.proud", "when": { "bond": "hire", "manner": "proud" }, "text": "{Actor} takes the coin as if it were a little less than {they} [are|is] worth. 'You'll not regret it.'" },
    { "id": "join.hire.acerbic", "when": { "bond": "hire", "manner": "acerbic" }, "text": "'It's your money,' [say|says] {actor}, pocketing it. 'Try not to get me killed for it.'" },
    { "id": "join.fellow.1", "when": { "bond": "fellow" }, "text": "'I was going that way,' [say|says] {actor}. 'Better two on the road than one.'" },
    { "id": "join.fellow.2", "when": { "bond": "fellow" }, "text": "{Actor} falls in beside you without making much of it." },
    { "id": "join.fellow.jovial", "when": { "bond": "fellow", "manner": ["jovial", "cheerful"] }, "text": "'Company!' [say|says] {actor}. 'There's nothing worse than a long road and nobody to complain to.'" },
    { "id": "join.fellow.grim", "when": { "bond": "fellow", "manner": ["grim", "stoic"] }, "text": "{Actor} considers you, then the road. 'As far as it suits us both.'" },
    { "id": "join.escort.1", "when": { "bond": "escort" }, "text": "{Actor} falls in beside you, keeping close." },
    { "id": "join.escort.2", "when": { "bond": "escort" }, "text": "{Actor} comes, and stays near enough to touch." },
    { "id": "join.animal.1", "when": { "kind": "animal" }, "text": "{Actor} lets you take the end of {their} tether, and comes, complaining all the way." },
    { "id": "join.animal.2", "when": { "kind": "animal" }, "text": "{Actor} decides you are worth following, for now." },
    { "id": "join.stranger.1", "when": { "bond": "stranger" }, "text": "{Actor} thinks about it, then nods. 'For a while, then.'" },
    { "id": "join.stranger.2", "when": { "bond": "stranger" }, "text": "'Why not,' [say|says] {actor}. 'It's not as if anything is keeping me here.'" }
  ]
}
data/voice/journey.json:
{
  "about": "A way across country, told as it goes, a sentence or two and no more: setting out (by the hour and the sky: fair, grey, rain, fog, wind, cold, hot, ash), the land the way runs through (by what its cells are: water crossed, fen, wood, open fields, moor, a pass; water crossed by the bridge, ford or ferry the way comes to, when it comes to one), the light going on the way, and coming in sight of where it ends (by the size of the settlement). {from} and {to} are where the way begins and ends; {way} is what it is, a road or a path (a track over the fells is not a road). The road across a march runs between two countries: its land is \"march\", or \"march-alike\" where both are of one kind, and {behind} and {ahead} are what they are (fen, forest, upland, frozen, desert, hill). When every line that fits has been said, the one said longest ago is said again.",
  "kinds": ["journey-depart", "journey-land", "journey-dark", "journey-arrive", "journey-long"],
  "lines": [
    { "id": "journey-depart.morning.fair.1", "when": { "time": "morning", "sky": "fair", "light": "early" }, "text": "You leave {from} with the sun low behind you and the dew still on the grass." },
    { "id": "journey-depart.morning.fair.2", "when": { "time": "morning", "sky": "fair", "light": "early" }, "text": "You set out from {from} early, with your shadow long in front of you on the {way}." },
    { "id": "journey-depart.morning.fair.3", "when": { "time": "morning", "sky": "fair" }, "text": "You leave {from} in the full of the morning, with the sun climbing and the {way} dry underfoot." },
    { "id": "journey-depart.morning.fog.1", "when": { "time": "morning", "sky": "fog" }, "text": "You leave {from} in a white fog that turns the hedges to ghosts at ten paces." },
    { "id": "journey-depart.rain.1", "when": { "sky": "rain" }, "text": "You leave {from} with your hood up and the rain in your face." },
    { "id": "journey-depart.rain.2", "when": { "sky": "rain" }, "text": "It rains on and off the whole way, the soft rain that gets in everywhere." },
    { "id": "journey-depart.rain.3", "when": { "sky": "rain" }, "text": "Rain comes over in grey curtains, one after another, and between them the country shines." },
    { "id": "journey-depart.afternoon.rain", "when": { "time": "afternoon", "sky": "rain" }, "text": "You set out from {from} in the middle of the afternoon, and the rain sets out with you." },
    { "id": "journey-depart.evening.rain", "when": { "time": "evening", "sky": "rain" }, "text": "You leave {from} late, in rain, with the light going early under the cloud." },
    { "id": "journey-depart.cold.1", "when": { "sky": "cold" }, "text": "It is cold enough to see your breath, and the ruts are hard with frost." },
    { "id": "journey-depart.cold.2", "when": { "sky": "cold" }, "text": "You walk fast to keep warm, and it does not help much." },
    { "id": "journey-depart.wind.1", "when": { "sky": "wind" }, "text": "A wind comes across the open country and leans on you the whole way." },
    { "id": "journey-depart.fog.1", "when": { "sky": "fog" }, "text": "Fog lies on the {way}, and things come out of it one at a time: a gate, a tree, a stone." },
    { "id": "journey-depart.grey.1", "when": { "sky": "grey" }, "text": "You leave {from} under a low lid of cloud that never quite comes to rain." },
    { "id": "journey-depart.grey.2", "when": { "sky": "grey" }, "text": "The sky is one grey from edge to edge, and the light is the same at every hour of the way." },
    { "id": "journey-depart.hot.1", "when": { "sky": "hot" }, "text": "The heat sits on the {way} like a weight, and you walk slower than you meant to." },
    { "id": "journey-depart.ash.1", "when": { "sky": "ash" }, "text": "Ash comes down soft as snow the whole way, and greys everything it settles on, you included." },
    { "id": "journey-depart.afternoon.1", "when": { "time": "afternoon", "sky": "fair" }, "text": "You set out from {from} in the full of the afternoon, the {way} pale with dust." },
    { "id": "journey-depart.evening.1", "when": { "time": "evening" }, "text": "You leave {from} late, with the light already going yellow." },
    { "id": "journey-depart.evening.2", "when": { "time": "evening" }, "text": "The shadows are long when you leave {from}, and getting longer." },
    { "id": "journey-depart.night.1", "when": { "time": "night" }, "text": "You go out of {from} into the dark, by what light there is." },
    { "id": "journey-depart.any.1", "text": "You set out from {from}." },
    { "id": "journey-depart.underground.1", "when": { "shelter": "underground", "light": "carried" }, "text": "You go on from {from} in the dark, by the light you carry, and the dark closes behind you." },
    { "id": "journey-depart.underground.2", "when": { "shelter": "underground" }, "text": "Under the ground there is no hour and no weather; only the way, and the sound of your own feet coming back off the stone." },
    { "id": "journey-depart.underground.3", "when": { "shelter": "underground", "light": "carried" }, "text": "You leave {from} by the light you carry. The air is still and cold, and smells of stone and old water." },
    { "id": "journey-depart.underground.dark.1", "when": { "shelter": "underground", "light": "none" }, "text": "You go on from {from} with no light, a hand on the wall, and the dark closes behind you." },

    { "id": "journey-land.river.1", "when": { "land": "river", "crossing": "ford" }, "text": "Partway, the {way} goes down to the water and through it, and up the far bank with your boots full." },
    { "id": "journey-land.river.2", "when": { "land": "river", "crossing": "ford" }, "text": "The {way} follows the river a while, close enough to hear it, and crosses where it runs wide and shallow." },
    { "id": "journey-land.river.bridge.1", "when": { "land": "river", "crossing": "bridge" }, "text": "Partway, the {way} comes down to the river and goes over it by the bridge, and the water runs deep and quick under your feet." },
    { "id": "journey-land.river.bridge.2", "when": { "land": "river", "crossing": "bridge" }, "text": "The {way} follows the river a while, close enough to hear it, and crosses at the bridge, where it runs too deep to wade." },
    { "id": "journey-land.river.ferry.1", "when": { "land": "river", "crossing": "ferry" }, "text": "At the river you wait for the ferry, and cross sitting on your pack with the brown water slapping at the boards." },
    { "id": "journey-land.river.3", "when": { "land": "river" }, "text": "For a while the {way} keeps company with a river, close enough to hear it." },
    { "id": "journey-land.river.4", "when": { "land": "river" }, "text": "The {way} runs along a river for a mile, with alders on the bank and the water loud over the stones." },
    { "id": "journey-land.lake.1", "when": { "land": "lake" }, "text": "For a while the {way} runs along a shore, and birds get up off the water as you pass." },
    { "id": "journey-land.fen.1", "when": { "land": "fen" }, "text": "The {way} goes out across the fen on a raised bank, reed on either hand taller than a man, open water glinting through it." },
    { "id": "journey-land.fen.2", "when": { "land": "fen" }, "text": "Out on the fen the sky is enormous, and the only things standing up in all that flatness are you and a heron." },
    { "id": "journey-land.fen.3", "when": { "land": "fen" }, "text": "Water stands on both sides, and the {way} between is soft enough to take the print of your boot and keep it." },
    { "id": "journey-land.wood.1", "when": { "land": "wood" }, "text": "For an hour the {way} runs under trees, and the light comes down green and broken through the leaves." },
    { "id": "journey-land.wood.2", "when": { "land": "wood" }, "text": "The {way} goes into the wood, and the wood closes over it, and for a long time there is nothing to see but the next bend." },
    { "id": "journey-land.wood.3", "when": { "land": "wood" }, "text": "Somewhere in the wood someone is cutting timber; you hear the axe a long time and never see who." },
    { "id": "journey-land.meadow.1", "when": { "land": "meadow" }, "text": "The {way} runs between hedges and small fields, past a farm or two where dogs bark at you over the gate." },
    { "id": "journey-land.meadow.2", "when": { "land": "meadow" }, "text": "It is easy going through open country: a mill, a ford, a man ploughing who stops to watch you go by." },
    { "id": "journey-land.meadow.3", "when": { "land": "meadow" }, "text": "Larks go up out of the grass on either hand, and come down again behind you." },
    { "id": "journey-land.fell.1", "when": { "land": "fell" }, "text": "The {way} climbs onto open moor, and the country falls away behind you in long brown folds." },
    { "id": "journey-land.fell.2", "when": { "land": "fell" }, "text": "Up on the tops there is nothing but heather, sky and wind, and a cairn now and then to say you are still on the {way}." },
    { "id": "journey-land.fell.3", "when": { "land": "fell" }, "text": "The {way} goes up by stony steps and down by worse, and the wind finds you on every rise." },
    { "id": "journey-land.fell.4", "when": { "land": "fell" }, "text": "Sheep stand on the {way} and watch you come, as if you were the one who had strayed." },
    { "id": "journey-land.fell.5", "when": { "land": "fell" }, "text": "There are no trees up here, and after the first mile no walls: only the {way}, the sky, and the long backs of the hills." },
    { "id": "journey-land.march.1", "when": { "land": "march" }, "text": "Between the march-stones the road crosses land that belongs to neither country: the {behind} country behind you, the {ahead} country ahead." },
    { "id": "journey-land.march.2", "when": { "land": "march" }, "text": "Halfway between the stones the land changes its mind. The {behind} country falls away behind you, and the {ahead} country begins." },
    { "id": "journey-land.march.3", "when": { "land": "march-alike" }, "text": "The road crosses the march, and the land does not notice: {ahead} country on both sides of the stones." },
    { "id": "journey-land.peak.1", "when": { "land": "peak" }, "text": "The {way} climbs into the hills, switching back and forth on itself, until the land you came from is small below you." },

    { "id": "journey-dark.1", "text": "The light goes before you are halfway, and you walk the rest by guess and by the pale line of the {way}." },
    { "id": "journey-dark.2", "text": "Night comes on while you are still on the {way}. An owl keeps pace with you for a while, and then thinks better of it." },

    { "id": "journey-arrive.town.1", "when": { "size": "town" }, "text": "{to} shows ahead a long while before you reach it: smoke, a roofline, the noise of it on the wind." },
    { "id": "journey-arrive.village.1", "when": { "size": "village" }, "text": "The smoke of {to} comes up over the next rise, and then the roofs." },
    { "id": "journey-arrive.hamlet.1", "when": { "size": "hamlet" }, "text": "{to} is a handful of roofs at the end of the road, and a dog that comes out to see who you are." },

    { "id": "journey-long.1", "text": "It is a long walk, and your feet know it by the end." },
    { "id": "journey-long.2", "text": "By the end of it you are footsore, and glad of the sight of anywhere at all." },
    { "id": "journey-long.3", "text": "The last mile is the longest, as it always is." }
  ]
}
data/voice/part.json:
{
  "about": "Someone leaves the company, or stops following it: by bond and manner. A person's own words (Leaves \"...\" in Kyr) are said instead.",
  "kinds": ["part"],
  "lines": [
    { "id": "part.kin.1", "when": { "bond": "kin" }, "text": "{Actor} holds on to you a moment longer than you expect. 'Come home when you can,' {actor} says, and turns back." },
    { "id": "part.kin.2", "when": { "bond": "kin" }, "text": "'Don't be long,' [say|says] {actor}. 'And don't do anything I wouldn't.'" },
    { "id": "part.friend.1", "when": { "bond": "friend" }, "text": "'You know where to find me,' [say|says] {actor}." },
    { "id": "part.hire.1", "when": { "bond": "hire" }, "text": "{Actor} nods, settles {their} pack, and goes {their} own way without looking back." },
    { "id": "part.fellow.1", "when": { "bond": "fellow" }, "text": "'Here's where I leave you,' [say|says] {actor}. 'Mind the road.'" },
    { "id": "part.fellow.2", "when": { "bond": "fellow" }, "text": "{Actor} lifts a hand, and is gone round the bend of the road." },
    { "id": "part.escort.1", "when": { "bond": "escort" }, "text": "{Actor} nods, and lets you go about your business." },
    { "id": "part.stranger.1", "when": { "bond": "stranger" }, "text": "{Actor} goes {their} own way." },
    { "id": "part.animal.1", "when": { "kind": "animal" }, "text": "{Actor} wanders off after something more interesting." },
    { "id": "part.animal.2", "when": { "kind": "animal" }, "text": "{Actor} stops, considers you, and goes back the way {they} came." }
  ]
}
data/voice/pet.json:
{
  "about": "The company makes much of a tame creature: by species, and whether it has been made much of before (moment: first, again).",
  "kinds": ["pet"],
  "lines": [
    { "id": "pet.dog.first.1", "when": { "species": "dog", "moment": "first" }, "text": "You crouch and hold out a hand. {Actor} sniffs it carefully, then leans {their} whole weight against your knee while you scratch behind {their} ears." },
    { "id": "pet.dog.first.2", "when": { "species": "dog", "moment": "first" }, "text": "{Actor} rolls over at once and shows you {their} belly. It is not a dignified dog." },
    { "id": "pet.dog.again.1", "when": { "species": "dog", "moment": "again" }, "text": "{Actor} leans into your hand, eyes half shut." },
    { "id": "pet.dog.again.2", "when": { "species": "dog", "moment": "again" }, "text": "{Actor}'s tail goes round like a cartwheel." },
    { "id": "pet.dog.again.3", "when": { "species": "dog", "moment": "again" }, "text": "{Actor} puts {their} chin on your knee and sighs, as if this were all {they} had ever wanted." },
    { "id": "pet.cat.1", "when": { "species": "cat" }, "text": "{Actor} allows it, for a moment, then walks away with {their} tail up." },
    { "id": "pet.cat.2", "when": { "species": "cat" }, "text": "{Actor} pushes {their} head hard against your hand and purrs like a kettle." },
    { "id": "pet.horse.1", "when": { "species": "horse" }, "text": "You run a hand down {actor}'s neck. It is warm, and {they} [shift|shifts] {their} weight and [let|lets] you." },
    { "id": "pet.goat.1", "when": { "species": "goat" }, "text": "{Actor} tolerates it, and then tries to eat your sleeve." },
    { "id": "pet.sheep.1", "when": { "species": "sheep" }, "text": "Your hand sinks into {actor}'s fleece up to the wrist. It is greasy, and warm, and smells of hill." },
    { "id": "pet.pig.1", "when": { "species": "pig" }, "text": "{Actor} grunts with deep approval while you scratch {their} back with a stick." },
    { "id": "pet.animal.1", "text": "{Actor} lets you." }
  ]
}
